function statusMessage(status: number): string {
  if (status === 422) return "Some inputs were not accepted.";
  if (status === 404) return "The rate service does not know this request.";
  if (status >= 500) return "The rate service had a problem. Try again in a moment.";
  return `The rate service answered with status ${status}.`;
}

export interface ApiClient {
  health(signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<HealthResponse>;
  meta(signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<Meta>;
  sampleParcels(signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<SampleParcels>;
  quote(body: QuoteRequest, signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<QuoteResponse>;
  breakeven(body: BreakevenRequest, signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<BreakevenResponse>;
  blended(body: BlendedRequest, signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<BlendedResponse>;
  yearly(body: YearlyRequest, signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<YearlyResponse>;
}

export interface ClientOptions {
  baseUrl?: string;
  fetchImpl?: typeof fetch;
}

export function createHttpClient({ baseUrl = API_BASE, fetchImpl }: ClientOptions = {}): ApiClient {
  const doFetch = fetchImpl ?? ((input: RequestInfo | URL, init?: RequestInit) => fetch(input, init));

  /** Fetch, map HTTP errors to ApiError, and check a 2xx body with the endpoint's guard. */
  async function request<T>(path: string, guard: (v: unknown) => T, init: RequestInit = {}): Promise<T> {
    let res: Response;
    try {
      res = await doFetch(`${baseUrl}${path}`, {
        ...init,
        headers: { Accept: "application/json", ...(init.body ? { "Content-Type": "application/json" } : {}) },
      });
    } catch (err) {
      if (err instanceof DOMException && err.name === "AbortError") throw err;
      throw new ApiError(0, "Cannot reach the rate service. Is the backend running?");
    }
    const body = await readJson(res);
    if (!res.ok) {
      const problems = problemsFromBody(body);
      throw new ApiError(res.status, statusMessage(res.status), problems);
    }
    if (body === null) throw new ApiError(res.status, "The rate service sent an empty answer.");
    try {
      return guard(body);
    } catch (err) {
      if (!(err instanceof ContractError)) throw err;
      const endpoint = `${init.method ?? "GET"} ${baseUrl}${path}`;
      const field = err.path || "(body)";
      throw new ApiError(
        res.status,
        `The rate service answered ${endpoint} in an unexpected shape (${field}: expected ${err.expected}). ` +
          "The frontend and backend versions probably differ.",
        [],
        { endpoint, path: field, detail: err.message },
      );
    }
  }

  const get = <T>(path: string, guard: (v: unknown) => T, signal?: AbortSignal) => request(path, guard, { signal });
  const post = <T>(path: string, guard: (v: unknown) => T, body: unknown, signal?: AbortSignal) =>
    request(path, guard, { method: "POST", body: JSON.stringify(body), signal });

  return {
    health: (signal) => get("/health", asHealth, signal),
    meta: (signal) => get("/meta", asMeta, signal),
    sampleParcels: (signal) => get("/sample-parcels", asSampleParcels, signal),
    quote: (body, signal) => post("/quote", asQuoteResponse, body, signal),
    breakeven: (body, signal) => post("/breakeven", asBreakevenResponse, body, signal),
    blended: (body, signal) => post("/blended", asBlendedResponse, body, signal),
    yearly: (body, signal) => post("/yearly", asYearlyResponse, body, signal),
  };
}

/** `?mock=1` serves typed mock responses; the mock module is a separate lazy chunk. */
export function isMockMode(search: string = typeof window === "undefined" ? "" : window.location.search): boolean {
  return new URLSearchParams(search).get("mock") === "1";
}

export function createMockClient(delayMs = 350): ApiClient {
  const load = () => import("./mocks");
  const wait = <T>(fn: () => T | Promise<T>): Promise<T> =>
    new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      setTimeout(() => {
        Promise.resolve().then(fn).then(resolve, reject);
      }, delayMs);
    });
  return {
    health: () => wait(() => ({ status: "ok" as const })),
    meta: () => wait(async () => (await load()).mockMeta),
    sampleParcels: () => wait(async () => (await load()).mockSampleParcels),
    quote: () => wait(async () => (await load()).mockQuote()),
    breakeven: () => wait(async () => (await load()).mockBreakeven()),
    blended: () => wait(async () => (await load()).mockBlended()),
    yearly: () => wait(async () => (await load()).mockYearly()),
  };
}

export function createClient(): ApiClient {
  return isMockMode() ? createMockClient() : createHttpClient();
}

# API contract

The FastAPI backend (`backend/`) serves JSON under `/api`. The frontend talks to
it only through these endpoints. Types below are the Pydantic models
(`backend/app/api/models.py`) and the TypeScript types
(`frontend/src/api/types.ts`), which must stay in sync; a contract test in each
side checks the example payloads in `docs/api-examples/`.

Money is a number in USD rounded to cents. Weights in pounds, lengths in inches,
distances in miles. Years are price-list labels (see `docs/data/SCHEMA.md`).

## Shared types

```ts
type Carrier = "usps" | "ups" | "fedex";
type Tier = "ground" | "two_three_day" | "next_day";
type DeliveryArea = "none" | "das" | "extended";
type UspsRateCard = "commercial" | "retail";

interface Parcel {
  weight_lb: number;            // > 0, <= 70
  length_in?: number;           // all three or none; > 0
  width_in?: number;
  height_in?: number;
  distance_miles: number;       // >= 0
  residential: boolean;
  speed: Tier;
  quantity?: number;            // default 1, integer >= 1
  price_charged?: number;       // overrides Controls.flat_price for this row
  delivery_area?: DeliveryArea; // default "none"
  nonstandard_packaging?: boolean; // default false
}

interface Controls {
  year?: number;                // omitted or null: latest year with all three carriers (2026);
                                // a year no carrier publishes is a 422
  as_of?: string;               // ISO date; default the year's January effective date
  usps_rate_card: UspsRateCard; // default "commercial"
  fuel_override_percent?: { ground?: number; express?: number }; // replaces the yearly default
  peak: boolean;                // default false; when true, as_of moves into the year's peak window
  flat_price: number;           // what the shop charges per parcel; default 9.99
}

interface LineItem {
  kind: "base" | "surcharge" | "fuel";
  label: string;                // carrier's own name, e.g. "Residential Surcharge"
  amount: number;
  surcharge_id?: string;        // links to surcharges.csv
  source?: string;              // "file p.N" for display
  condition?: string;           // surcharges.csv condition, for grouping surcharges by kind
}

interface Quote {
  carrier: Carrier;
  service_id: string;
  service_name: string;
  tier: Tier;
  zone: number;
  billable_weight_lb: number;
  dim_weight_lb: number | null;
  line_items: LineItem[];
  total: number;
  margin: number;               // price charged minus total
  available: boolean;           // false when the service cannot carry this parcel
  unavailable_reason?: string;  // e.g. "FedEx Ground serves business addresses only"
  as_of: string | null;         // ISO date the rules were resolved for
}
// An unavailable quote has line_items: [] and total: 0, margin: 0; zone and
// weights are null when they were not reached. Clients must check `available`.
```

## Endpoints

### GET /api/health
`{"status": "ok"}` for the Docker health check.

### GET /api/meta
Years per carrier, services (with `rate_card_notes`), default controls
(including the default `as_of` per carrier), fuel defaults per year with
`is_proxy`, the zone bands, the segment band labels, and the data limitations
text shown in the UI footer. Shape: `MetaResponse` in `backend/app/api/models.py`.

### GET /api/sample-parcels
The bundled illustrative parcel mix as `Parcel[]`, with a `description`.

### POST /api/quote  (question 1)
Request `{ parcel: Parcel, controls: Controls }`. Response
`{ quotes: Quote[], cheapest_by_tier: Record<Tier, {carrier, service_id, total}> }`,
quotes sorted by total within the requested tier first, then the other tiers
(unavailable quotes last within a tier). Only carriers that publish the
requested year are quoted (2027 is FedEx only). A tier with no available
service maps to `null` in `cheapest_by_tier`.

### POST /api/breakeven  (question 2)
Request `{ controls: Controls, residential: boolean, weights_lb?: number[], distances_miles?: number[] }`
(defaults: weights 1..70 step 1, distances at every zone band midpoint).
Response: a grid of cells `{ weight_lb, distance_miles, zone_usps, zone_private, winner: {carrier, service_id, total}, runner_up: {...}, saving, totals: Record<Carrier, number> }`
for the ground tier (FedEx Ground for business, Home Delivery for residential),
plus `breakeven_weight_lb: [{ distance_miles, zone_usps, zone_private, vs_ups, vs_fedex }]`
per distance band: the lightest grid weight at which the USPS total is >= the
rival's total, `null` when USPS wins at every weight. The default distances are
each USPS band's midpoint (rounded down) and, for the open last band, the
previous band's upper edge + 200 miles.

### GET /api/breakeven
Same response with the default grid; query parameters `residential`
(default true), `year`, `peak`, `usps_rate_card`.

### POST /api/blended  (question 3)
Request `{ parcels: Parcel[], controls: Controls, segment?: SegmentFilter }`.
Response per carrier: parcels shipped, blended cost per parcel, base vs
surcharge vs fuel split (absolute and share), surcharge breakdown by kind,
margin per parcel, share of parcels shipped at a loss, and the cheapest
carrier per parcel (a "best mix" row). Each parcel uses the cheapest service
of that carrier in the parcel's speed tier.

Shape: `BlendedResponse` in `backend/app/api/models.py`: `year`,
`parcels_considered`, `revenue_per_parcel`, `carriers[]` and `best_mix`. Each
carrier row (and `best_mix`) is a `Summary`: `parcels_shipped`,
`parcels_unavailable` (quantity no service of the carrier could carry),
`total_cost`, `cost_per_parcel`, `split.{base,surcharges,fuel}.{per_parcel,total,share}`,
`surcharges_by_condition[] {condition, total, per_parcel, share_of_cost}`,
`margin_per_parcel`, `total_margin`, `loss_share`, `parcels_at_loss`; carrier
rows add `carrier` and `services_used` (service_id -> parcels), `best_mix`
adds `parcels_by_carrier`. Everything is weighted by `quantity`.

### POST /api/yearly  (question 4)
Request `{ parcels: Parcel[], controls: Controls, next_year_increase_percent?: number }`.
Response per carrier and year: blended cost per parcel under that year's
prices and rules, the year-over-year change, the carrier's announced average
increase for comparison, and the driver breakdown: for each parcel segment
(weight band, zone band, residential, speed), its contribution to the change
in dollars per parcel. Optional projected next year from the slider.

Rules: each year is priced at its own base-rate effective date per carrier
(December 10 of that year when `peak`); `controls.as_of` and `controls.year`
are ignored. `fuel_override_percent` applies to every year. Only parcels the
carrier can ship in every one of its years are compared (`parcels_used`,
`parcels_excluded`). Years a carrier lacks are absent.

Shape: `YearlyResponse` in `backend/app/api/models.py`: `carriers[] {carrier,
parcels_used, parcels_excluded, years[], projected}`; `projected` is
`{year, increase_percent, cost_per_parcel}` or `null`. Each year row:
`year`, `as_of`, `cost_per_parcel`, `summary` (the blended `Summary`),
`services_used`, `change_vs_previous {from_year, dollars_per_parcel, percent}`
(null for the first year), `announced_increase {percent, basis, services,
source_type}` where `basis` is `"all"` (the carrier-wide row), 
`"average_of_services"` (plain average of the rows for the services used,
listed in `services`) or `"none"`, `drivers` (per dimension a list of
`{segment, parcels, change_per_parcel, change_total}`; the rounded
`change_per_parcel` values add up exactly to the rounded change), `fuel`
(`{ground, express}` each `{default_percent, is_proxy, applied_percent}`, null
for USPS) and `warnings` (e.g. a surcharge kind present the year before but
with no rules recorded this year).

### Segments
`SegmentFilter = { weight_band?: string, zone_band?: string, residential?: boolean, speed?: Tier }`.
Weight bands: `≤1`, `1–5`, `5–10`, `10–20`, `20–70` lb. Zone bands: `1–2`, `3–4`, `5–6`, `7–8`.

## Engine rules the endpoints share

- **Zone** from `data/processed/zone_from_distance.csv` per carrier: the band
  whose `min_miles <= distance <= max_miles`.
- **Billable weight** per carrier and `as_of` from `dim_weight.csv`: dimensions
  rounded per the row's rounding rule, dimensional weight = volume / divisor
  rounded up, only when volume exceeds `min_volume_cuin`; billable = max(actual
  rounded up to the next weight step, dimensional). The row is the one whose
  window contains `as_of`. Weight steps are the service's own table steps, so
  USPS Ground Advantage keeps its ounce steps under 1 lb (and the USPS commercial
  Priority Mail cards their 0.5 lb step). A billable weight above the heaviest
  step makes the service unavailable; USPS caps dimensional weight at 70 lb
  as its dim_weight row states.
- **Base rate**: the first weight step `>= billable weight` in the zone, for
  the service, rate card (`list` for UPS and FedEx, the USPS control otherwise)
  and year.
- **Surcharges**: every rule of that carrier and year whose window contains
  `as_of`, whose `applies_to` covers the service, whose `address_type`
  matches, and whose thresholds the parcel meets; peak conditions only when
  `controls.peak`. Rules in the same `exclusive_group` do not stack: the
  highest amount wins. Percent surcharges apply to the base rate.
- **Fuel**: `percent x (base + surcharges flagged fuel_applies)`, percent from
  `fuel_surcharge.csv` for the year and service group (ground services use
  `ground`, all others `express`) unless overridden. USPS has none.
- **Availability**: FedEx Ground for business addresses only, Home Delivery for
  residential only (from `services.csv`); weight over 70 lb is rejected.
- **as_of**: defaults to the base-rate `effective_date` of the year for each
  carrier, or `controls.as_of` when given. With `peak: true` it is December 10
  of the year (overriding `controls.as_of`), inside every carrier's peak window
  for which peak rows are recorded. `as_of` therefore also selects time-varying rules such
  as the USPS dimensional divisor (166 until 2026-07-11, 139 after) and the
  2026 USPS 8 % transportation increase.
- **Cheapest per tier**: among available services of the tier, lowest total.
- **Thresholds, windows and peak add-ons**: see "Matching rules" in
  `docs/data/SCHEMA.md` (bands inclusive on billable weight, a lone minimum weight
  strict on actual weight, dimensions strict, `effective_to` inclusive, peak
  add-ons only on top of the charge they add to).
- The engine never hardcodes an amount; every number comes from
  `data/processed/`.

## Errors
422 with `{ detail: [{ loc, msg }] }` for invalid input (Pydantic default),
with messages written for the shop owner, e.g. "weight_lb must be at most 70";
each entry also carries the Pydantic error `type`. Errors inside a parcel list
are prefixed "Parcel N: ". Real request/response pairs for every endpoint are
in `docs/api-examples/`, regenerated by `backend/scripts/export_api_examples.py`.
````

# Decisions

Running log of the choices made for this project, in the order they were made.
Each entry says what was decided, the alternatives considered, and why.
See `docs/ASSIGNMENT.md` for the brief and `docs/agent-log/` for the agent
conversations that led here.

## 2026-10-22 — Problem, user and scope

**Problem.** A small online shop sends a few hundred to a few thousand parcels
a month, has no negotiated carrier contract, and pays the published list
prices of FedEx, UPS and the Postal Service. Today the carrier is chosen by
habit. The dashboard helps the owner choose the carrier per kind of parcel,
and check whether the flat shipping price charged to customers still covers
the real cost once surcharges and yearly price increases are included.

**Questions the dashboard answers.**

1. For a given parcel (weight, dimensions, distance, residential or business,
   required speed), which service is cheapest once surcharges are included,
   and what are the line items of that price?
2. Where are the breakeven points between the Postal Service and FedEx or UPS
   ground, by weight and distance?
3. For the owner's whole set of parcels, what is the blended cost per parcel
   with each carrier, and how much of it is surcharges rather than base rate?
4. How did that blended cost change year by year under each year's published
   prices, compared with the average increase the carriers announced, and
   which kinds of parcels in the mix drove the change?

**Scope decisions.**

- Timebox: issues are sized to fit about five hours of focused work (the
  brief's upper bound). Extras are tracked separately and only started if
  time remains. Time actually spent is recorded by the owner, not estimated.
- Services: three speed tiers across the three carriers — ground, two to
  three day, and next day. Weight capped at 70 lb (the USPS maximum).
- Years covered: decided after the data survey (issue 1), based on what can
  actually be downloaded and parsed reliably.
- Parcel input: CSV upload plus a bundled illustrative sample mix. Columns:
  weight, length, width, height, distance in miles, residential flag,
  required speed, and an optional per-parcel price charged to the customer.
  Dimensional weight is computed from the dimensions.
- Price charged to the customer: a single flat price is the MVP control. The
  optional per-parcel column overrides it when present.
- Fuel and peak surcharges: a documented per-year default taken from the
  published history, a slider to stress test the fuel percentage, and a peak
  season toggle. A next-year increase slider sits on the year-over-year view.
- Zone from distance: a documented distance-band to zone mapping. Real
  ZIP-to-ZIP zones are a bonus, not MVP.
- The app never fetches live data; all rate tables are committed.

## 2026-10-22 — Stack

| Area | Decision | Alternatives considered | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| Backend | FastAPI, Pydantic models, pandas over committed CSV tables loaded in memory, managed with `uv` | DuckDB; SQLite | Rate cards are a few thousand rows. No database keeps Docker and setup trivial. |
| Data collection | Python scripts under `data/` that download the carriers' published rate documents, parse them (pdfplumber for PDFs), and write normalized CSVs that are committed | Hand-typed tables | Reproducible, documents provenance, and qualifies for the scraping bonus. |
| Frontend | Vite + React + TypeScript, Recharts for line and bar charts, a custom SVG heatmap for the breakeven map, plain CSS with design tokens | Chart.js (needs a matrix plugin for heatmaps); Plotly (over 1 MB, poor on mobile); Tailwind | Small bundle, declarative, the heatmap is a trivial grid. |
| Docker | `docker compose` with two services: uvicorn backend and an nginx container serving the Vite build and proxying `/api` | Single multi-stage image with FastAPI serving static files | Clean separation, one command for the reviewer. |
| Tests | pytest for pipeline, rate engine and API; Vitest + Testing Library for components; Playwright end to end at 1440 and 375 px with screenshots reviewed for UX | — | Required by the brief and by us. |
| Workflow | Private GitHub repo, one issue per task, a branch and git worktree per issue, parallel agents each in their own worktree, pull requests merged with merge commits | Commit straight to main | Keeps history and lets agents work in parallel without stepping on each other. |
| Agent log | `SessionEnd` hook exports every session (and subagent) transcript to `docs/agent-log/<session-id>.md` and commits it; home directory path redacted | Manual export | Required by the brief, zero effort once set up. |

## 2026-10-22 — Year range and data policy (from the data survey, issue #1)

Full findings in `docs/data/QUALITY.md`; sources per file in `data/raw/<carrier>/SOURCES.md`.

- **Years: 2023 through 2026**, under each year's January list prices
  (USPS 2023 uses the July 2023 tables, when Ground Advantage launched).
  2022 is dropped from the MVP because USPS sold a different product set.
  FedEx 2027 rates are already published and are kept as an optional forward year.
- **Base rates are parsed** from USPS CSV zips, FedEx XLSX (2022, 2025–2027)
  and text PDFs (FedEx 2023–2024, UPS all years), each validated against
  hand-checked prices.
- **Surcharge rules are curated** into a CSV with a source file and page per
  row, rather than parsed from prose PDFs.
- **Fuel surcharge:** per-year default from FedEx's published history,
  applied to UPS as a proxy and flagged; the UI slider overrides it. USPS has none.
- **Announced increases:** FedEx and USPS from primary sources; UPS from
  trade press, marked secondary.
- **Raw files:** only spreadsheets, CSV zips and small HTML snapshots are
  committed (about 8 MB). All PDFs are gitignored and restored by
  `data/fetch_raw.py` from `data/raw/manifest.csv` (URL, SHA-256, size),
  fetched one at a time with a pause between requests.
- **Citations:** every curated row carries file, page and verbatim quote,
  and a test checks the quote against the document.
- **USPS dimensional weight** verified in the DMM: divisor 166, then 139 from
  2026-07-12, above 1,728 cubic inches, all zones.
- **Schema** for all processed tables and the parcel CSV is fixed in
  `docs/data/SCHEMA.md` before any parser is written.
# Visual direction: the shipping ledger

The dashboard reads like a printed price sheet or a merchant's ledger, not like
a SaaS dashboard. Warm paper, black ink, hairline rules, figures set in a
newspaper serif, and colour reserved for meaning.

## Why it fits

The user is a shop owner deciding where a few dollars per parcel go. The
decision lives in a handful of numbers: which carrier is cheapest, what one
parcel costs, whether the flat price still leaves a margin. A ledger puts those
numbers first, in the largest type on the page, and pushes everything else
(assumptions, sliders, provenance) into small, quiet type around them. Rules
and columns instead of cards make it feel like an account the owner keeps, and
they print well for an accountant.

## Hierarchy

1. **The answer** (cheapest carrier, cost per parcel, margin): display serif,
   `--text-figure`, tabular figures, carrier or money colour.
2. **The question** each section answers: display serif, `--text-xl`.
3. **The owner's parcel set**: once loaded, a one-line strip (count, share to
   homes, speed split) with the full summary behind "Details", so the
   questions and the answer stay above the fold, also on a phone.

### Rule for every question view (issues #5 and #6)

The answer is the largest element of its section. Put it first under the
question, in `.answer > .answer__figure` (`--text-figure`), with a short
`.answer__caption` saying what it is ("UPS Ground, $8.41 per parcel, $1.58
margin"). Nothing else in the section, including the question (`--text-xl`),
chart titles and table figures, may be set larger. Charts and tables come
after the answer and explain it.
4. **Assumptions** (year, rate card, fuel, peak, flat price): a left rail in the
   UI face at `--text-sm`, always visible on desktop, a bottom sheet on phones
   behind a one-line summary bar.

## Palette (`src/styles/tokens.css`)

| Token | Light | Dark | Use |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--paper` | `#F5F1E8` | `#15140F` | page |
| `--sheet` | `#FBF9F4` | `#1E1C17` | rail, inputs, raised panels |
| `--ink` | `#1C1B18` | `#EDE8DC` | text, rules, focus ring |
| `--ink-muted` | `#5E5A50` | `#A9A292` | secondary text (6.1:1 / 7.3:1) |
| `--carrier-usps` | `#1F4E9A` | `#7FA8EE` | USPS everywhere (7.1:1 / 7.7:1) |
| `--carrier-ups` | `#7A4E0F` | `#D9A35A` | UPS everywhere (6.4:1 / 8.2:1) |
| `--carrier-fedex` | `#9C2A7E` | `#E68AC9` | FedEx everywhere (6.1:1 / 7.8:1) |
| `--loss` | `#B3261E` | `#F2877E` | negative margin (5.8:1 / 7.5:1) |
| `--profit` | `#1D6B3F` | `#6FCB94` | positive margin (5.8:1 / 9.4:1) |
| `--mock` | `#8A5A00` | `#E8B860` | the mock-data banner only |

Contrast ratios are against `--paper` and meet WCAG AA for body text in both
themes. Carrier hues follow the brands loosely (postal blue, brown, purple)
so the owner recognises them without a legend. Blue and purple are close for
some colour-vision deficiencies, so colour is never the only cue: every
carrier mark carries its name or initial, and money always carries a sign and
the word "loss" or "margin".

Each carrier also has a `-wash` tint for backgrounds and heatmap cells
(issue #5 scales intensity between the wash and the full colour).

## Type

- **Newsreader** (display serif, optical sizes) for questions and figures.
  A newspaper face gives the editorial voice and has good tabular numerals.
- **IBM Plex Sans** for the interface: labels, controls, tables. Industrial,
  slightly technical, legible at 12-14 px.

Both load from Google Fonts with `display=swap`; fallbacks are Georgia and
Helvetica/Arial. All figures use `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums` so
columns of prices line up.

## Spacing and shape

A 4 px base (`--space-1` … `--space-8`: 4, 8, 12, 16, 24, 32, 48, 72 px) with a
deliberate jump to 48-72 px between sections, so sections read as chapters.
Corners are nearly square (`--radius: 2px`). Separation comes from hairline
rules (`--rule`) and one heavy rule under the masthead and active tab, not
from shadows; the only shadow is on the mobile controls sheet, which really
does sit above the page.

## Motion

Only opacity and transform, 120-220 ms, for the sheet and tab underline. All
of it is disabled under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`.

## Charts (for issues #5 and #6)

- Use the carrier tokens for series and cells; read them in JS with
  `getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue("--carrier-usps")`
  or the `carrierColor()` helper in `src/lib/carriers.ts`, so dark mode works.
- Axis text in `--ink-muted`, gridlines in `--rule`, no chart borders.
- Announced increases and projections are dashed lines in the carrier colour.
# Frontend

Vite + React + TypeScript dashboard. Design direction and rules: [DESIGN.md](DESIGN.md).

## Run locally

Node 18.18+ (Docker uses Node 22).

```sh
npm ci
npm run dev            # http://localhost:5173
```

The dev server proxies `/api` to the backend at `VITE_API_TARGET`, default
`http://localhost:8001` (port 8000 is used by another app on the dev machine).
Start the backend on that port from the repository root:

```sh
cd backend && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8001
```

To point at a backend elsewhere: `VITE_API_TARGET=http://localhost:9000 npm run dev`
(or put the variable in `frontend/.env.local`).

Without a backend, open `http://localhost:5173/?mock=1`: the app serves the backend's
recorded example responses from `src/api/__fixtures__/` and shows a "Mock data" banner.
Mock answers do not change with the inputs.

## Scripts

| Script | What it does |
|---|---|
| `npm run dev` | dev server with the `/api` proxy |
| `npm run test` | Vitest + Testing Library, including the API contract test |
| `npm run typecheck` | `tsc -b --noEmit` |
| `npm run build` | type-check and build into `dist/` |

## API contract

`src/api/types.ts` mirrors `docs/API.md` and `backend/app/api/models.py`.
`src/api/contract.test.ts` checks every example payload in `src/api/__fixtures__/`
(copied from `docs/api-examples/`) against the runtime guards in `src/api/guards.ts`, so
a change on either side fails the tests until both agree.

/** A parcel as the server returns it (GET /sample-parcels): every key present, optionals null. */
export interface ParcelOut {
  weight_lb: number;
  length_in: number | null;
  width_in: number | null;
  height_in: number | null;
  distance_miles: number;
  residential: boolean;
  speed: Tier;
  quantity: number;
  price_charged: number | null;
  delivery_area: DeliveryArea;
  nonstandard_packaging: boolean;
}

export interface FuelOverride {
  ground?: number | null; // 0..100
  express?: number | null;
}

export interface Controls {
  year?: number | null; // null/absent: latest year with all three carriers
  as_of?: string | null; // ISO date
  usps_rate_card?: UspsRateCard; // default "commercial"
  fuel_override_percent?: FuelOverride | null;
  peak?: boolean; // default false
  flat_price?: number; // default 9.99
}

export interface SegmentFilter {
  weight_band?: WeightBand | null;
  zone_band?: ZoneBandLabel | null;
  residential?: boolean | null;
  speed?: Tier | null;
}

export interface QuoteRequest {
  parcel: Parcel;
  controls?: Controls;
}

export interface BreakevenRequest {
  controls?: Controls;
  residential?: boolean; // default true
  weights_lb?: number[] | null; // 1..200 values, each in (0, 70]
  distances_miles?: number[] | null; // 1..50 values, each >= 0
}

export interface BlendedRequest {
  parcels: Parcel[]; // 1..10,000
  controls?: Controls;
  segment?: SegmentFilter | null;
}

export interface YearlyRequest {
  parcels: Parcel[]; // 1..10,000
  controls?: Controls;
  next_year_increase_percent?: number | null; // -50..100
}

/* ---------- shared response pieces ---------- */

/* ---------- POST /api/yearly ---------- */

export interface Change {
  from_year: number;
  dollars_per_parcel: number;
  percent: number | null;
}

export interface Announced {
  percent: number | null;
  basis: "all" | "average_of_services" | "none";

}

export interface Driver {

export interface Drivers {

}

export interface FuelGroupUsed {
  default_percent: number | null;
  is_proxy: boolean | null;

}

export interface YearRow {
  year: number;
  as_of: string | null;
  cost_per_parcel: number;
  summary: Summary;
  services_used: string[];
  change_vs_previous: Change | null; // null for the first year
  announced_increase: Announced;
  drivers: Drivers | null;
  fuel: { ground: FuelGroupUsed; express: FuelGroupUsed } | null; // null for USPS
  warnings: string[];
}

export interface Projection {
  year: number;
  increase_percent: number;
  cost_per_parcel: number;
}

export interface CarrierYears {
  carrier: Carrier;
  parcels_used: number;
  parcels_excluded: number;

}

export interface YearlyResponse {
  carriers: CarrierYears[];

/* ---------- errors ---------- */

/** One entry of a 422 body, as backend/app/api/errors.py writes it: always loc, msg and type. */
export interface ValidationIssue {
  loc: (string | number)[];
  msg: string; // written for the shop owner; parcel-list errors start "Parcel N: "
  type: string; // the Pydantic error type, e.g. "less_than_equal"
}

/** 422 body. */
export interface ValidationErrorBody {
  detail: ValidationIssue[];
}

/** FastAPI's own errors (404, 405) carry a plain string; the client accepts both. */
export interface HttpErrorBody {
  detail: string;
}

} from "./guards";

export const API_BASE = "/api";

/** A readable problem with one input field, for display to the shop owner. */
export interface FieldProblem {
  field: string;
  message: string;
}

export class ApiError extends Error {
  readonly status: number;
  readonly problems: FieldProblem[];
  /** Set when a 2xx answer did not match the contract (src/api/types.ts). */
  readonly contract?: { endpoint: string; path: string; detail: string };

  constructor(
    status: number,
    message: string,
    problems: FieldProblem[] = [],
    contract?: { endpoint: string; path: string; detail: string },
  ) {
    super(message);
    this.name = "ApiError";
    this.status = status;
    this.problems = problems;
    if (contract) this.contract = contract;
  }
}

/** Turn a Pydantic `loc` like ["body","parcels",3,"weight_lb"] into "parcels row 4 · weight_lb". */
export function describeLoc(loc: readonly (string | number)[]): string {
  const parts = loc[0] === "body" || loc[0] === "query" ? loc.slice(1) : loc;
  return parts
    .map((p) => (typeof p === "number" ? `row ${p + 1}` : p))
    .join(" · ");
}

function isIssue(x: unknown): x is ValidationIssue {
  return (
    typeof x === "object" &&
    x !== null &&
    Array.isArray((x as ValidationIssue).loc) &&
    typeof (x as ValidationIssue).msg === "string"
  );
}

export function problemsFromBody(body: unknown): FieldProblem[] {
  if (typeof body !== "object" || body === null || !("detail" in body)) return [];
  const detail = (body as ValidationErrorBody | HttpErrorBody).detail;
  if (typeof detail === "string") return [{ field: "", message: detail }];
  if (!Array.isArray(detail)) return [];
  return detail.filter(isIssue).map((d) => ({ field: describeLoc(d.loc), message: d.msg }));
}
import { createContext, useContext, useEffect, useState, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { ApiError, createClient, type ApiClient } from "./client";

const ApiContext = createContext<ApiClient | null>(null);

export function ApiProvider({ client, children }: { client?: ApiClient; children: ReactNode }) {
  const [value] = useState<ApiClient>(() => client ?? createClient());
  return <ApiContext.Provider value={value}>{children}</ApiContext.Provider>;
}

export function useApi(): ApiClient {
  const c = useContext(ApiContext);
  if (!c) throw new Error("useApi must be used inside <ApiProvider>");
  return c;
}

export type Loadable<T> =
  | { status: "idle" }
  | { status: "loading" }
  | { status: "ok"; data: T }
  | { status: "error"; error: ApiError | Error };

/** Run `load` whenever `deps` change; aborts the previous request. */
export function useLoad<T>(load: ((signal: AbortSignal) => Promise<T>) | null, deps: readonly unknown[]): Loadable<T> {
  const [state, setState] = useState<Loadable<T>>({ status: load ? "loading" : "idle" });
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!load) {
      setState({ status: "idle" });
      return;
    }
    const ctrl = new AbortController();
    setState({ status: "loading" });
    load(ctrl.signal).then(
      (data) => !ctrl.signal.aborted && setState({ status: "ok", data }),
      (error: unknown) => {
        if (ctrl.signal.aborted) return;
        setState({ status: "error", error: error instanceof Error ? error : new Error(String(error)) });
      },
    );
    return () => ctrl.abort();
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, deps);
  return state;
}

import type { FuelGroup, MetaDefaults, UspsRateCard } from "../api/types";

/**
 * The controls as the UI holds them: every field resolved. Assignable to the request
 * type `Controls`, which leaves fields with a server default optional.
 */
export interface ControlsState {
  year: number;
  usps_rate_card: UspsRateCard;
  peak: boolean;
  flat_price: number;
  fuel_override_percent?: { ground?: number; express?: number };
}

export function controlsFromMeta(d: MetaDefaults): ControlsState {
  return { year: d.year, usps_rate_card: d.usps_rate_card, peak: d.peak, flat_price: d.flat_price };
}

export const VIEWS = ["quote", "breakeven", "blended", "yearly"] as const;
export type ViewId = (typeof VIEWS)[number];

export interface AppState {
  controls: ControlsState;
  view: ViewId;
}

export const FALLBACK_CONTROLS: ControlsState = {
  year: 2026,
  usps_rate_card: "commercial",
  peak: false,
  flat_price: 9.99,
};

export const FUEL_MIN = 0;
export const FUEL_MAX = 40;
export const PRICE_MAX = 1000;

const KEYS = {
  year: "year",
  card: "usps",
  fuelGround: "fuel_ground",
  fuelExpress: "fuel_express",
  peak: "peak",
  price: "price",
  view: "view",
} as const;

/** Params the app owns; anything else in the query string (e.g. mock=1) is preserved. */
const OWNED = new Set<string>(Object.values(KEYS));

function num(params: URLSearchParams, key: string, min: number, max: number): number | undefined {
  const raw = params.get(key);
  if (raw === null || raw.trim() === "") return undefined;
  const n = Number(raw);
  return Number.isFinite(n) && n >= min && n <= max ? n : undefined;
}

export function readState(search: string, defaults: ControlsState = FALLBACK_CONTROLS): AppState {
  const params = new URLSearchParams(search);
  const year = num(params, KEYS.year, 2000, 2100);
  const card = params.get(KEYS.card);
  const ground = num(params, KEYS.fuelGround, FUEL_MIN, FUEL_MAX);
  const express = num(params, KEYS.fuelExpress, FUEL_MIN, FUEL_MAX);
  const price = num(params, KEYS.price, 0, PRICE_MAX);
  const view = params.get(KEYS.view);
  const fuel: Partial<Record<FuelGroup, number>> = {
    ...(ground !== undefined ? { ground } : {}),
    ...(express !== undefined ? { express } : {}),
  };
  const controls: ControlsState = {
    year: year !== undefined && Number.isInteger(year) ? year : defaults.year,
    usps_rate_card: card === "retail" || card === "commercial" ? card : defaults.usps_rate_card,
    peak: params.has(KEYS.peak) ? params.get(KEYS.peak) === "1" : defaults.peak,
    flat_price: price ?? defaults.flat_price,
    ...(Object.keys(fuel).length > 0 ? { fuel_override_percent: fuel } : {}),
  };
  return { controls, view: (VIEWS as readonly string[]).includes(view ?? "") ? (view as ViewId) : "quote" };
}

/** Serialize, leaving out values equal to the defaults so shared links stay short. */
export function writeState(state: AppState, currentSearch = "", defaults: ControlsState = FALLBACK_CONTROLS): string {
  const params = new URLSearchParams(currentSearch);
  for (const key of OWNED) params.delete(key);
  const c = state.controls;
  if (c.year !== defaults.year) params.set(KEYS.year, String(c.year));
  if (c.usps_rate_card !== defaults.usps_rate_card) params.set(KEYS.card, c.usps_rate_card);
  if (c.fuel_override_percent?.ground !== undefined) params.set(KEYS.fuelGround, String(c.fuel_override_percent.ground));
  if (c.fuel_override_percent?.express !== undefined) params.set(KEYS.fuelExpress, String(c.fuel_override_percent.express));
  if (c.peak !== defaults.peak) params.set(KEYS.peak, c.peak ? "1" : "0");
  if (c.flat_price !== defaults.flat_price) params.set(KEYS.price, String(c.flat_price));
  if (state.view !== "quote") params.set(KEYS.view, state.view);
  const out = params.toString();
  return out ? `?${out}` : "";
}

/* ---------- reducer ---------- */

export type Action =
  | { type: "year"; year: number }
  | { type: "card"; card: UspsRateCard }
  | { type: "fuel"; group: FuelGroup; percent: number }
  | { type: "fuelReset"; group: FuelGroup }
  | { type: "peak"; peak: boolean }
  | { type: "price"; price: number }
  | { type: "view"; view: ViewId }
  | { type: "replace"; state: AppState };

function withFuel(c: ControlsState, group: FuelGroup, percent: number | undefined): ControlsState {
  const { [group]: _dropped, ...rest } = c.fuel_override_percent ?? {};
  const next = percent === undefined ? rest : { ...rest, [group]: percent };
  const { fuel_override_percent: _old, ...base } = c;
  return Object.keys(next).length > 0 ? { ...base, fuel_override_percent: next } : base;
}

export function reducer(state: AppState, action: Action): AppState {
  const set = (controls: ControlsState): AppState => ({ ...state, controls });
  switch (action.type) {
    case "year":
      // A new year has its own fuel defaults; an override from another year would mislead.
      return set(withFuel(withFuel({ ...state.controls, year: action.year }, "ground", undefined), "express", undefined));
    case "card":
      return set({ ...state.controls, usps_rate_card: action.card });
    case "fuel":
      return set(withFuel(state.controls, action.group, Math.min(FUEL_MAX, Math.max(FUEL_MIN, action.percent))));
    case "fuelReset":
      return set(withFuel(state.controls, action.group, undefined));
    case "peak":
      return set({ ...state.controls, peak: action.peak });
    case "price":
      return set({ ...state.controls, flat_price: Math.min(PRICE_MAX, Math.max(0, action.price)) });
    case "view":
      return { ...state, view: action.view };
    case "replace":
      return action.state;
  }
}

export const formatUsd = (n: number) => usd.format(n);
export const formatInt = (n: number) => int.format(n);
export const formatShare = (share: number) => `${Math.round(share * 100)}%`;
export const formatPercent = (n: number) => `${Number.isInteger(n) ? n : n.toFixed(2).replace(/0$/, "")}%`;

export const CARRIER_NAME: Record<Carrier, string> = { usps: "USPS", ups: "UPS", fedex: "FedEx" };
export const TIER_NAME: Record<Tier, string> = {
  ground: "Ground",
  two_three_day: "2–3 day",
  next_day: "Next day",
};
import { useRef, type KeyboardEvent, type ReactNode } from "react";
import type { ViewId } from "../state/urlState";
import { QUESTIONS } from "../views/types";

export interface QuestionTabsProps {
  active: ViewId;
  onSelect: (id: ViewId) => void;
  renderPanel: (id: ViewId) => ReactNode;
}

const tabId = (id: ViewId) => `tab-${id}`;
const panelId = (id: ViewId) => `panel-${id}`;

/** WAI-ARIA tabs with automatic activation; arrow keys, Home and End move between questions. */
export function QuestionTabs({ active, onSelect, renderPanel }: QuestionTabsProps) {
  const refs = useRef<Partial<Record<ViewId, HTMLButtonElement | null>>>({});
  const activeDef = QUESTIONS.find((q) => q.id === active) ?? QUESTIONS[0]!;

  const onKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    const i = QUESTIONS.findIndex((q) => q.id === active);
    const last = QUESTIONS.length - 1;
    const next =
      e.key === "ArrowRight" ? (i === last ? 0 : i + 1)
      : e.key === "ArrowLeft" ? (i === 0 ? last : i - 1)
      : e.key === "Home" ? 0
      : e.key === "End" ? last
      : null;
    if (next === null) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    const id = QUESTIONS[next]!.id;
    onSelect(id);
    refs.current[id]?.focus();
  };

  return (
    <div className="questions">
      <div className="questions__tabs" role="tablist" aria-label="Questions" onKeyDown={onKeyDown}>
        {QUESTIONS.map((q) => (
          <button
            key={q.id}
            ref={(el) => {
              refs.current[q.id] = el;
            }}
            id={tabId(q.id)}
            type="button"
            role="tab"
            aria-selected={q.id === active}
            aria-controls={panelId(q.id)}
            tabIndex={q.id === active ? 0 : -1}
            className="questions__tab"
            onClick={() => onSelect(q.id)}
          >
            <span className="questions__num">{String(q.number).padStart(2, "0")}</span>
            <span className="questions__short">{q.short}</span>
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>
      <section
        id={panelId(activeDef.id)}
        role="tabpanel"
        aria-labelledby={tabId(activeDef.id)}
        className="questions__panel"
        tabIndex={0}
      >
        <p className="kicker">Question {activeDef.number}</p>
        <h2 className="questions__question">{activeDef.question}</h2>
        {renderPanel(activeDef.id)}
      </section>
    </div>
  );
}
.questions {
  margin-top: var(--space-6);
}

.questions__tabs {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr));
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule-strong);
}

.questions__tab {
  display: grid;
  gap: 2px;
  align-content: start;
  min-height: 3.5rem;
  padding: var(--space-2) var(--space-3) var(--space-3) 0;
  border: 0;
  background: transparent;
  text-align: left;
  cursor: pointer;
  color: var(--ink-muted);
  position: relative;
}

.questions__tab::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  left: 0;
  right: var(--space-3);
  bottom: -1px;
  height: 4px;
  background: var(--ink);
  transform: scaleX(0);
  transform-origin: left;
  transition: transform var(--duration) var(--ease-out);
}

.questions__tab:hover {
  color: var(--ink);
}

.questions__tab:hover::after {
  transform: scaleX(0.25);
}

.questions__tab[aria-selected="true"] {
  color: var(--ink);
}

.questions__tab[aria-selected="true"]::after {
  transform: scaleX(1);
}

.questions__num {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: var(--text-lg);
  line-height: 1;
}

.questions__short {
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
  font-weight: 600;
  line-height: 1.2;
}

.questions__panel {
  padding-top: var(--space-6);
  display: grid;
  gap: var(--space-3);
}

.questions__panel:focus-visible {
  outline-offset: 6px;
  box-shadow: none;
}

/* The question is context; the answer figure below it is the largest thing in the section. */
.questions__question {
  font-size: var(--text-xl);
  font-weight: 500;
  max-width: 40ch;
  line-height: 1.2;
}

/* The answer: the one number the owner came for. Issues #5 and #6 use these classes. */
.answer {
  display: grid;
  gap: var(--space-1);
}

.answer__figure {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: var(--text-figure);
  font-weight: 500;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums lining-nums;
  line-height: 1;
  letter-spacing: -0.02em;
}

.answer__caption {
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
  color: var(--ink-muted);
  max-width: 48ch;
}

.answer-slot {
  margin-top: var(--space-4);
  padding: var(--space-6) var(--space-5);
  border: 1px dashed var(--ink-muted);
  display: grid;
  gap: var(--space-2);
  max-width: var(--measure);
}

.answer-slot__figure {
  color: var(--ink-muted);
}

.answer-slot__text {
  font-size: var(--text-base);
  line-height: 1.5;
}

.answer-slot__need {
  font-weight: 600;
}

.answer-slot__note {
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
  color: var(--ink-muted);
}

@media (max-width: 39.999rem) {
  .questions__tabs {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  }

  .questions__tab:nth-child(-n + 2) {
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule);
  }
}

@media (max-width: 39.999rem) {
  .questions {
    margin-top: var(--space-5);
  }

  .questions__panel {
    padding-top: var(--space-4);
  }

  .questions__question {
    font-size: var(--text-lg);
  }

  .answer-slot {
    padding: var(--space-4);
  }
}

  --carrier-ups: #7a4e0f;

  /* Status */
  --mock: #8a5a00;

  --text-lg: 1.1875rem;
  --text-xl: clamp(1.375rem, 1.1rem + 1vw, 1.75rem);
  --text-2xl: clamp(1.75rem, 1.2rem + 2vw, 2.625rem);
  --text-figure: clamp(2.75rem, 1.6rem + 4.5vw, 5rem);

  /* Spacing: a 4 px base with a deliberate jump for section breaks */
  --space-1: 0.25rem;
  --space-2: 0.5rem;
  --space-3: 0.75rem;
  --space-4: 1rem;
  --space-5: 1.5rem;
  --space-6: 2rem;
  --space-7: 3rem;
  --space-8: 4.5rem;

  --rail-width: 19rem;

  --radius: 2px;

  --duration-fast: 120ms;
  --duration: 220ms;
  --ease-out: cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);

  --shadow-sheet: 0 -12px 40px rgb(28 27 24 / 0.18);
}

# API fixtures

These JSON files are copies of `docs/api-examples/*.json`, real request/response pairs
generated by the backend (`backend/scripts/export_api_examples.py`) on branch
`issue-3-engine-api`, commit `c6b8492` (PR #17). Do not edit them by hand. When the
backend regenerates its examples, copy them over again:

```sh
cp ../docs/api-examples/*.json src/api/__fixtures__/
```

Two extra files cover years where not every carrier publishes prices: `breakeven-2027.json`
and `quote-2027.json` (2027 is FedEx only). They were produced by the backend as merged to main (PR #17,
merge 5785f6f) through FastAPI's `TestClient` (POST bodies inside each file), not by the export
script, so regenerate them the same way if the backend changes.

Each file is `{ request: {method, path, body}, response: {status, body} }`.

They are used by:

- `src/api/contract.test.ts`, which validates every response body against the runtime
  guards in `src/api/guards.ts` (which follow `src/api/types.ts`), so drift between the
  backend and the frontend types fails the tests;
- `src/api/mocks.ts`, which serves these recorded responses in tests and in the
  `?mock=1` dev mode. Mock responses are the recorded examples: they do not react to the
  request (a different parcel or year returns the same recorded answer).

import { ApiProvider } from "./api/ApiContext";
import { createMockClient, type ApiClient } from "./api/client";

  return render(

      <App />
    </ApiProvider>,
  );
}

    expect(within(section).queryByRole("table", { name: /weight/i })).not.toBeInTheDocument();

    const details = within(section).getByRole("button", { name: "Details" });
    expect(details).toHaveAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");
    await userEvent.click(details);
    expect(details).toHaveAttribute("aria-expanded", "true");
    expect(within(section).getByText(/Illustrative parcel mix/)).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(within(section).getByRole("table", { name: /weight/i })).toBeInTheDocument();
    const zones = within(section).getByRole("table", { name: /distance/i });
    expect(within(zones).getByRole("rowheader", { name: /Zone 1\s*0–50 mi/ })).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(within(section).getByText(/have their\s+own price/)).toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it("shows CSV problems with row numbers and keeps the previous set", async () => {
    renderApp();
    const file = new File(["weight_lb,distance_miles,residential,speed\n80,100,true,ground\n"], "march.csv", {
      type: "text/csv",
    });
    await userEvent.upload(screen.getByLabelText("Upload CSV"), file);
    const alert = await screen.findByRole("alert");
    expect(alert).toHaveTextContent("march.csv was not loaded: 1 problem to fix.");
    expect(alert).toHaveTextContent("Row 2");
    expect(alert).toHaveTextContent("over the 70 lb limit");
    expect(screen.getByText("No parcels loaded yet.")).toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it("mirrors controls and the active question to the URL", async () => {
    renderApp();
    await screen.findByRole("option", { name: "2025" });
    await userEvent.selectOptions(screen.getByRole("combobox", { name: "Price list year" }), "2025");

    const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
    expect(params.get("year")).toBe("2025");

import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";
import { render, screen } from "@testing-library/react";
import userEvent from "@testing-library/user-event";
import { ApiProvider } from "../api/ApiContext";
import { createMockClient } from "../api/client";
import { App } from "../App";
import { SHEET_QUERY } from "../hooks/useSheet";

function setViewport(mobile: boolean) {
  vi.stubGlobal("matchMedia", (query: string) => ({
    matches: query === SHEET_QUERY ? mobile : false,
    media: query,
    addEventListener: () => {},
    removeEventListener: () => {},
  }));
}

const renderApp = () =>
  render(
    <ApiProvider client={createMockClient(0)}>

describe("settings sheet on a phone", () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    window.history.replaceState(null, "", "/");
    setViewport(true);
  });
  afterEach(() => vi.unstubAllGlobals());

  it("is a named modal dialog that takes focus and makes the page inert", async () => {
    renderApp();
    const opener = screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Adjust" });
    await userEvent.click(opener);
    const dialog = screen.getByRole("dialog", { name: "Assumptions" });
    expect(dialog).toHaveAttribute("aria-modal", "true");
    expect(dialog).toContainElement(document.activeElement as HTMLElement);
    expect(screen.getByRole("main", { hidden: true })).toHaveAttribute("inert");
    expect(opener.closest(".mobile-bar")).toHaveAttribute("inert");
  });

  it("wraps Tab and Shift+Tab inside the sheet", async () => {
    renderApp();
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Adjust" }));

/**
 * Small helpers shared by the Q1 and Q2 views (issue #5). Kept here rather than in src/lib
 * so this branch does not touch shared files; move to src/lib if Q3/Q4 need them too.
 */
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import type { Carrier, Meta } from "../../api/types";
import { CARRIERS } from "../../api/types";
import { formatUsd } from "../../lib/format";

/** "+$1.58 margin" / "−$1.90 loss": sign and word, never colour alone. */
export function marginText(margin: number): string {
  if (Math.abs(margin) < 0.005) return "$0.00, break-even";
  return margin > 0 ? `+${formatUsd(margin)} margin` : `−${formatUsd(-margin)} loss`;
}

export const marginClass = (margin: number) => (margin < -0.004 ? "is-loss" : margin > 0.004 ? "is-profit" : "");

/** Carriers that publish prices for `year`; all three when meta is not loaded yet. */
export function carriersForYear(meta: Meta | null, year: number): Carrier[] {
  if (!meta) return [...CARRIERS];
  return CARRIERS.filter((c) => meta.years[c]?.includes(year));
}

export function serviceName(meta: Meta | null, serviceId: string): string {
  const found = meta?.services.find((s) => s.service_id === serviceId);
  if (found) return found.display_name;
  return serviceId
    .split("_")
    .map((w) => (w === "usps" || w === "ups" ? w.toUpperCase() : w === "fedex" ? "FedEx" : w[0]!.toUpperCase() + w.slice(1)))
    .join(" ");
}

/** The value after it has stopped changing for `delayMs`. */
export function useDebounced<T>(value: T, delayMs: number): T {
  const [settled, setSettled] = useState(value);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (delayMs <= 0) {
      setSettled(value);
      return;
    }
    const t = setTimeout(() => setSettled(value), delayMs);
    return () => clearTimeout(t);
  }, [value, delayMs]);
  return delayMs <= 0 ? value : settled;
}

/** "2027 prices are published by FedEx only" style sentence, or null when all three publish. */
export function missingCarriersNote(available: Carrier[], year: number, names: Record<Carrier, string>): string | null {
  if (available.length === CARRIERS.length) return null;
  if (available.length === 0) return `No carrier has published ${year} prices in this data.`;
  const list = available.map((c) => names[c]).join(" and ");
  const missing = CARRIERS.filter((c) => !available.includes(c)).map((c) => names[c]).join(" and ");
  return `${year} prices are published by ${list} only; ${missing} ${available.length === 2 ? "has" : "have"} not announced ${year} prices yet, so ${available.length === 1 ? "there is no comparison" : "they are left out"}.`;
}
EOF

cat > quote/quoteModel.ts <<'EOF'
import type { Carrier, LineItem, Quote, QuoteResponse, Tier } from "../../api/types";
import type { FieldProblem } from "../../api/client";

export interface Split {
  base: number;
  surcharges: number;
  fuel: number;
}

export function splitOf(items: readonly LineItem[]): Split {
  const sum = (kind: LineItem["kind"]) => items.filter((i) => i.kind === kind).reduce((a, i) => a + i.amount, 0);
  return { base: sum("base"), surcharges: sum("surcharge"), fuel: sum("fuel") };
}

export interface TierView {
  /** Cheapest available service per carrier in the tier, cheapest first. */
  ranked: Quote[];
  /** Services in the tier that cannot carry this parcel, with their reason. */
  unavailable: Quote[];
  /** Available services in the tier that lose to a cheaper service of the same carrier. */
  alternatives: Quote[];
}

export function tierView(res: QuoteResponse, tier: Tier): TierView {
  const inTier = res.quotes.filter((q) => q.tier === tier);
  const available = inTier.filter((q) => q.available).sort((a, b) => a.total - b.total);
  const seen = new Set<Carrier>();
  const ranked: Quote[] = [];
  const alternatives: Quote[] = [];
  for (const q of available) {
    if (seen.has(q.carrier)) alternatives.push(q);
    else {
      seen.add(q.carrier);
      ranked.push(q);
    }
  }
  return { ranked, unavailable: inTier.filter((q) => !q.available), alternatives };
}

/** Billable weight was set by the box's size rather than its weight, for at least one service. */
export function dimDrivers(quotes: readonly Quote[], actualLb: number): Quote[] {
  return quotes.filter((q) => q.available && q.dim_weight_lb !== null && q.dim_weight_lb > Math.ceil(actualLb - 1e-9));
}

/** Zone per carrier for the feedback under the distance input. */
export function zonesByCarrier(quotes: readonly Quote[]): Partial<Record<Carrier, number>> {
  const out: Partial<Record<Carrier, number>> = {};
  for (const q of quotes) if (q.zone !== null && out[q.carrier] === undefined) out[q.carrier] = q.zone;
  return out;
}

export type FormField = "weight" | "dims" | "distance" | "speed" | "residential" | "delivery_area" | "packaging";

const FIELD_OF: Record<string, FormField> = {
  weight_lb: "weight",
  length_in: "dims",
  width_in: "dims",
  height_in: "dims",
  distance_miles: "distance",
  speed: "speed",
  residential: "residential",
  delivery_area: "delivery_area",
  nonstandard_packaging: "packaging",
};

/** Map 422 problems ("parcel · weight_lb") to form fields; the rest go to `other`. */
export function problemsByField(problems: readonly FieldProblem[]): {
  byField: Partial<Record<FormField, string[]>>;
  other: FieldProblem[];
} {
  const byField: Partial<Record<FormField, string[]>> = {};
  const other: FieldProblem[] = [];
  for (const p of problems) {
    const last = p.field.split(" · ").pop() ?? "";
    const field = p.field.startsWith("parcel") ? FIELD_OF[last] : undefined;
    if (field) byField[field] = [...(byField[field] ?? []), p.message];
    else other.push(p);
  }
  return { byField, other };
}

import type { DeliveryArea, Parcel, Tier } from "../../api/types";

/** The quote form as the user types it: strings, so half-typed numbers survive. */
export interface Draft {
  lb: string;
  oz: string;
  length: string;
  width: string;
  height: string;
  distance: string;
  residential: boolean;
  speed: Tier;
  area: DeliveryArea;
  nonstandard: boolean;
}

export const DEFAULT_DRAFT: Draft = {
  lb: "3",
  oz: "",
  length: "12",
  width: "10",
  height: "6",
  distance: "600",
  residential: true,
  speed: "ground",
  area: "none",
  nonstandard: false,
};

const parseNum = (s: string): number | null => {
  const t = s.trim();
  if (t === "") return null;
  const n = Number(t);
  return Number.isFinite(n) ? n : NaN;
};

/** Total weight in lb from the lb and oz boxes; null when neither is filled, NaN when garbled. */
export function draftWeight(d: Draft): number | null {
  const lb = parseNum(d.lb);
  const oz = parseNum(d.oz);
  if (lb === null && oz === null) return null;
  if (Number.isNaN(lb) || Number.isNaN(oz)) return NaN;
  return Math.round(((lb ?? 0) + (oz ?? 0) / 16) * 10000) / 10000;
}

export type LocalErrors = Partial<Record<"weight" | "dims" | "distance", string>>;

/**
 * Turn the draft into a request parcel. Only shape problems are caught here (empty, not a
 * number, two of three dimensions); ranges are left to the server so its 422 messages show.
 */
export function draftToParcel(d: Draft): { parcel: Parcel; errors: null } | { parcel: null; errors: LocalErrors } {
  const errors: LocalErrors = {};
  const weight = draftWeight(d);
  if (weight === null) errors.weight = "Enter the weight.";
  else if (Number.isNaN(weight)) errors.weight = "Weight must be a number.";
  const dims = [d.length, d.width, d.height].map(parseNum);
  const filled = dims.filter((x) => x !== null).length;
  if (dims.some((x) => Number.isNaN(x))) errors.dims = "Dimensions must be numbers.";
  else if (filled > 0 && filled < 3) errors.dims = "Give all three dimensions, or leave all three empty.";
  const distance = parseNum(d.distance);
  if (distance === null) errors.distance = "Enter the distance.";
  else if (Number.isNaN(distance)) errors.distance = "Distance must be a number.";
  if (Object.keys(errors).length > 0) return { parcel: null, errors };
  const parcel: Parcel = {
    weight_lb: weight!,
    distance_miles: distance!,
    residential: d.residential,
    speed: d.speed,
    delivery_area: d.area,
    nonstandard_packaging: d.nonstandard,
    ...(filled === 3 ? { length_in: dims[0]!, width_in: dims[1]!, height_in: dims[2]! } : {}),
  };
  return { parcel, errors: null };
}

const str = (n: number | null | undefined) => (n === null || n === undefined ? "" : String(n));

export function draftFromParcel(p: Parcel): Draft {
  const whole = Math.floor(p.weight_lb);
  const oz = Math.round((p.weight_lb - whole) * 16 * 100) / 100;
  return {
    lb: p.weight_lb < 1 ? "" : String(oz > 0 && whole >= 1 ? whole : p.weight_lb),
    oz: p.weight_lb < 1 ? String(Math.round(p.weight_lb * 16 * 100) / 100) : oz > 0 ? String(oz) : "",
    length: str(p.length_in),
    width: str(p.width_in),
    height: str(p.height_in),
    distance: String(p.distance_miles),
    residential: p.residential,
    speed: p.speed,
    area: p.delivery_area ?? "none",
    nonstandard: p.nonstandard_packaging ?? false,
  };
}

import { useId, type ReactNode } from "react";
import type { Carrier, DeliveryArea, Parcel, Tier } from "../../api/types";
import { CARRIERS, TIERS } from "../../api/types";
import { CARRIER_NAME, TIER_NAME } from "../../lib/format";
import { draftFromParcel, draftWeight, type Draft } from "./draft";
import type { FormField } from "./quoteModel";

export interface QuoteFormProps {
  draft: Draft;
  onChange: (next: Draft) => void;
  /** Messages per field: local shape checks and the server's 422 messages. */
  errors: Partial<Record<FormField, string[]>>;
  /** Zone per carrier from the last quote, shown under the distance. */
  zones: Partial<Record<Carrier, number>> | null;
  parcels: Parcel[] | null;
}

const AREA_LABEL: Record<DeliveryArea, string> = {
  none: "Standard area",
  das: "Remote (DAS)",
  extended: "Extended remote",
};

function zoneLine(zones: Partial<Record<Carrier, number>>): string | null {
  const entries = CARRIERS.filter((c) => zones[c] !== undefined).map((c) => [c, zones[c]!] as const);
  if (entries.length === 0) return null;
  const distinct = new Set(entries.map(([, z]) => z));
  if (distinct.size === 1) return `Zone ${entries[0]![1]}${entries.length > 1 ? " for every carrier" : ` (${CARRIER_NAME[entries[0]![0]]})`}`;
  return entries.map(([c, z]) => `${CARRIER_NAME[c]} zone ${z}`).join(" · ");
}

function parcelLabel(p: Parcel, i: number): string {
  const dims = p.length_in ? ` · ${p.length_in}×${p.width_in}×${p.height_in} in` : "";
  return `#${i + 1}: ${p.weight_lb} lb${dims} · ${p.distance_miles} mi · ${p.residential ? "home" : "business"} · ${TIER_NAME[p.speed]}`;
}

const MAX_PICKS = 300;

function Errors({ id, messages }: { id: string; messages: string[] | undefined }) {
  if (!messages || messages.length === 0) return null;
  return (
    <p id={id} className="control__error qf__error">
      {messages.join(" ")}
    </p>
  );
}

function Field({ label, htmlFor, children, hint }: { label: string; htmlFor?: string; children: ReactNode; hint?: ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <div className="qf__field">
      <label className="control__label" htmlFor={htmlFor}>
        {label}
      </label>
      {children}
      {hint}
    </div>
  );
}

export function QuoteForm({ draft, onChange, errors, zones, parcels }: QuoteFormProps) {
  const uid = useId();
  const id = (s: string) => `${uid}-${s}`;
  const set = <K extends keyof Draft>(key: K, value: Draft[K]) => onChange({ ...draft, [key]: value });
  const described = (field: FormField) => (errors[field]?.length ? { "aria-describedby": id(`${field}-err`), "aria-invalid": true } : {});
  const weight = draftWeight(draft);
  const ozUsed = draft.oz.trim() !== "" && weight !== null && !Number.isNaN(weight);
  const zoneText = zones ? zoneLine(zones) : null;

  return (
    <form className="qf" aria-label="Your parcel" onSubmit={(e) => e.preventDefault()}>
      <h3 className="kicker qf__title">Your parcel</h3>

      {parcels && parcels.length > 0 && (
        <Field label="Start from one of your parcels" htmlFor={id("pick")}>
          <select
            id={id("pick")}
            className="select"
            value=""
            onChange={(e) => {
              const p = parcels[Number(e.target.value)];
              if (p) onChange(draftFromParcel(p));
            }}
          >
            <option value="">Choose a parcel…</option>
            {parcels.slice(0, MAX_PICKS).map((p, i) => (
              <option key={i} value={i}>
                {parcelLabel(p, i)}
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>
        </Field>
      )}

      <fieldset className="control qf__group" {...described("weight")}>
        <legend className="control__label">Weight</legend>
        <div className="qf__pair">
          <label className="qf__unit">
            <input
              className="qf__input"
              inputMode="decimal"
              value={draft.lb}
              onChange={(e) => set("lb", e.target.value)}
              aria-label="Weight in pounds"
              aria-invalid={errors.weight?.length ? true : undefined}
            />
            <span aria-hidden="true">lb</span>
          </label>
          <label className="qf__unit">
            <input
              className="qf__input"
              inputMode="decimal"
              value={draft.oz}
              onChange={(e) => set("oz", e.target.value)}
              aria-label="Plus ounces"
              placeholder="0"
            />
            <span aria-hidden="true">oz</span>
          </label>
        </div>
        <p className="control__hint">
          {ozUsed ? `= ${weight} lb. ` : ""}Ounces help for light parcels: USPS prices them in ounce steps under 1 lb.
        </p>
        <Errors id={id("weight-err")} messages={errors.weight} />
      </fieldset>

      <fieldset className="control qf__group" {...described("dims")}>
        <legend className="control__label">
          Box size <span className="qf__optional">optional, inches</span>
        </legend>
        <div className="qf__dims">
          {(["length", "width", "height"] as const).map((k, i) => (
            <label key={k} className="qf__unit">
              <input
                className="qf__input"
                inputMode="decimal"
                value={draft[k]}
                onChange={(e) => set(k, e.target.value)}
                aria-label={`${k[0]!.toUpperCase()}${k.slice(1)} in inches`}
                aria-invalid={errors.dims?.length ? true : undefined}
              />
              {i < 2 && <span aria-hidden="true">×</span>}
            </label>
          ))}
        </div>
        <p className="control__hint">Large light boxes are billed by size (dimensional weight).</p>
        <Errors id={id("dims-err")} messages={errors.dims} />
      </fieldset>

      <Field
        label="Distance"
        htmlFor={id("distance")}
        hint={
          <>
            {zoneText && (
              <p className="control__hint qf__zone" aria-live="polite">
                {zoneText}
              </p>
            )}
            <Errors id={id("distance-err")} messages={errors.distance} />
          </>
        }
      >
        <label className="qf__unit">
          <input
            id={id("distance")}
            className="qf__input"
            inputMode="decimal"
            value={draft.distance}
            onChange={(e) => set("distance", e.target.value)}
            {...described("distance")}
          />
          <span aria-hidden="true">miles</span>
        </label>
      </Field>

      <fieldset className="control qf__group" {...described("residential")}>
        <legend className="control__label">Delivered to</legend>
        <div className="qf-seg qf-seg--2">
          {[
            [true, "A home"],
            [false, "A business"],
          ].map(([value, label]) => (
            <label key={String(value)} className="qf-seg__opt">
              <input
                type="radio"
                name={id("res")}
                checked={draft.residential === value}
                onChange={() => set("residential", value as boolean)}
              />
              <span>{label as string}</span>
            </label>
          ))}
        </div>
        <Errors id={id("residential-err")} messages={errors.residential} />
      </fieldset>

      <fieldset className="control qf__group" {...described("speed")}>
        <legend className="control__label">Speed needed</legend>
        <div className="qf-seg qf-seg--3">
          {TIERS.map((t: Tier) => (
            <label key={t} className="qf-seg__opt">
              <input type="radio" name={id("speed")} checked={draft.speed === t} onChange={() => set("speed", t)} />
              <span>{TIER_NAME[t]}</span>
            </label>
          ))}
        </div>
        <Errors id={id("speed-err")} messages={errors.speed} />
      </fieldset>

      <Field label="Delivery area" htmlFor={id("area")} hint={<Errors id={id("delivery_area-err")} messages={errors.delivery_area} />}>
        <select
          id={id("area")}
          className="select"
          value={draft.area}
          onChange={(e) => set("area", e.target.value as DeliveryArea)}
          {...described("delivery_area")}
        >
          {(Object.keys(AREA_LABEL) as DeliveryArea[]).map((a) => (
            <option key={a} value={a}>
              {AREA_LABEL[a]}
            </option>
          ))}
        </select>
      </Field>

      <label className="qf__check">
        <input type="checkbox" checked={draft.nonstandard} onChange={(e) => set("nonstandard", e.target.checked)} />
        <span>
          Not a box
          <small>Tubes, bags or other nonstandard packaging</small>
        </span>
      </label>
      <Errors id={id("packaging-err")} messages={errors.packaging} />
    </form>
  );
}

import { useId } from "react";
import type { Quote } from "../../api/types";
import { carrierVar, carrierWashVar } from "../../lib/carriers";
import { CARRIER_NAME, formatUsd } from "../../lib/format";
import { splitOf } from "./quoteModel";

/** Base, surcharges and fuel as one bar; widths are shares of `scale` (the dearest row's total). */
export function StackedBar({ quote, scale }: { quote: Quote; scale: number }) {
  const s = splitOf(quote.line_items);
  const pct = (n: number) => `${scale > 0 ? (n / scale) * 100 : 0}%`;
  const c = quote.carrier;
  const label = `Base ${formatUsd(s.base)}, surcharges ${formatUsd(s.surcharges)}, fuel ${formatUsd(s.fuel)}`;
  return (
    <span className="qbar" role="img" aria-label={label} title={label}>
      <span className="qbar__part qbar__part--base" style={{ width: pct(s.base), background: carrierVar(c) }} />
      <span
        className="qbar__part qbar__part--surcharge"
        style={{
          width: pct(s.surcharges),
          backgroundImage: `repeating-linear-gradient(135deg, ${carrierVar(c)} 0 2px, ${carrierWashVar(c)} 2px 5px)`,
        }}
      />
      <span
        className="qbar__part qbar__part--fuel"
        style={{ width: pct(s.fuel), background: carrierWashVar(c), borderColor: carrierVar(c) }}
      />
    </span>
  );
}

export interface QuoteRowProps {
  quote: Quote;
  rank: number;
  cheapest: number;
  scale: number;
  open: boolean;
  onToggle: () => void;
}

export function QuoteRow({ quote, rank, cheapest, scale, open, onToggle }: QuoteRowProps) {
  const panelId = useId();
  const delta = quote.total - cheapest;
  const s = splitOf(quote.line_items);
  return (
    <li className={`qr ${open ? "qr--open" : ""}`}>
      <button type="button" className="qr__head" aria-expanded={open} aria-controls={panelId} onClick={onToggle}>
        <span className="qr__rank" aria-hidden="true">
          {rank}
        </span>
        <span className="qr__who">
          <span className="qr__carrier" style={{ color: carrierVar(quote.carrier) }}>
            {CARRIER_NAME[quote.carrier]}
          </span>
          <span className="qr__service">{quote.service_name}</span>
        </span>
        <span className="qr__bar">
          <StackedBar quote={quote} scale={scale} />
        </span>
        <span className="qr__money">
          <span className="qr__total">{formatUsd(quote.total)}</span>
          <span className="qr__delta">{rank === 1 ? "cheapest" : `+${formatUsd(delta)}`}</span>
        </span>
        <span className="qr__chev" aria-hidden="true" />
        <span className="visually-hidden">{open ? ", hide line items" : ", show line items"}</span>
      </button>
      <div id={panelId} className="qr__panel" hidden={!open}>
        <table className="qitems">
          <caption className="visually-hidden">
            Line items of {quote.service_name}
          </caption>
          <thead>
            <tr>
              <th scope="col">Item</th>
              <th scope="col">Source</th>
              <th scope="col" className="num">
                Amount
              </th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            {quote.line_items.map((li, i) => (
              <tr key={i} className={`qitems__row qitems__row--${li.kind}`}>
                <th scope="row">
                  <span className="qitems__kind">{li.kind === "base" ? "Base" : li.kind === "fuel" ? "Fuel" : "Surcharge"}</span>
                  {li.label}
                </th>
                <td className="qitems__src">{li.source ? <cite>{li.source}</cite> : "—"}</td>
                <td className="num">{formatUsd(li.amount)}</td>
              </tr>
            ))}
          </tbody>
          <tfoot>
            <tr>
              <th scope="row" colSpan={2}>
                Total{" "}
                <span className="qitems__sub">
                  base {formatUsd(s.base)} · surcharges {formatUsd(s.surcharges)} · fuel {formatUsd(s.fuel)}
                </span>
              </th>
              <td className="num">{formatUsd(quote.total)}</td>
            </tr>
          </tfoot>
        </table>
        <p className="qr__facts">
          Zone {quote.zone ?? "—"} · billed as {quote.billable_weight_lb ?? "—"} lb
          {quote.dim_weight_lb !== null ? ` (dimensional weight ${quote.dim_weight_lb} lb)` : ""}
          {quote.as_of ? ` · rules as of ${quote.as_of}` : ""}
        </p>
      </div>
    </li>
  );
}
