import { useState } from "react";
import type { Quote, QuoteResponse, Tier } from "../../api/types";
import { TIERS } from "../../api/types";
import { carrierVar } from "../../lib/carriers";
import { CARRIER_NAME, TIER_NAME, formatUsd } from "../../lib/format";
import { dimDrivers, tierView } from "./quoteModel";
import { QuoteRow } from "./QuoteRow";
import { marginClass, marginText } from "./shared";

export interface QuoteAnswerProps {
  res: QuoteResponse;
  tier: Tier;
  flatPrice: number;
}

/** The answer: the cheapest service for the chosen speed, its total as the largest figure. */
export function QuoteAnswer({ res, tier, flatPrice }: QuoteAnswerProps) {
  const pick = res.cheapest_by_tier[tier];
  const best = pick && res.quotes.find((q) => q.service_id === pick.service_id && q.tier === tier);
  if (!pick || !best) {
    return (
      <div className="answer qa">
        <p className="kicker">Cheapest for this parcel · {TIER_NAME[tier]}</p>
        <p className="answer__figure qa__none">None</p>
        <p className="answer__caption">No {TIER_NAME[tier].toLowerCase()} service can carry this parcel. The reasons are listed below.</p>
      </div>
    );
  }
  const price = best.margin + best.total; // the price charged the server used (flat price or override)
  return (
    <div className="answer qa">
      <p className="kicker">Cheapest for this parcel · {TIER_NAME[tier]}</p>
      <p className="answer__figure qa__figure" data-testid="quote-answer">
        {formatUsd(best.total)}
      </p>
      <p className="qa__service">
        <span className="qa__carrier" style={{ color: carrierVar(best.carrier) }}>
          {CARRIER_NAME[best.carrier]}
        </span>{" "}
        {best.service_name.replace(new RegExp(`^${CARRIER_NAME[best.carrier]} `), "")}
      </p>
      <p className={`qa__margin ${marginClass(best.margin)}`}>
        {marginText(best.margin)} <span className="qa__against">against your {formatUsd(Number.isFinite(price) ? price : flatPrice)} price</span>
      </p>
    </div>
  );
}

function DimNote({ quotes, actualLb }: { quotes: Quote[]; actualLb: number }) {
  const drivers = dimDrivers(quotes, actualLb);
  if (drivers.length === 0) return null;
  const heaviest = Math.max(...drivers.map((q) => q.billable_weight_lb ?? 0));
  return (
    <section className="qdim" aria-labelledby="qdim-title">
      <h3 id="qdim-title" className="kicker">
        Billed by size, not weight
      </h3>
      <p className="qdim__text">
        Carriers bill the larger of the actual weight and the dimensional weight (length × width × height ÷ the
        carrier's divisor), so this {actualLb} lb box is billed as up to {heaviest} lb.
      </p>
      <table className="qdim__table">
        <thead>
          <tr>
            <th scope="col">Service</th>
            <th scope="col" className="num">
              Actual
            </th>
            <th scope="col" className="num">
              Dimensional
            </th>
            <th scope="col" className="num">
              Billable
            </th>
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody>
          {drivers.map((q) => (
            <tr key={q.service_id}>
              <th scope="row">{q.service_name}</th>
              <td className="num">{actualLb} lb</td>
              <td className="num">{q.dim_weight_lb} lb</td>
              <td className="num qdim__billable">{q.billable_weight_lb} lb</td>
            </tr>
          ))}
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </section>
  );
}

export interface QuoteBreakdownProps {
  res: QuoteResponse;
  tier: Tier;
  actualLb: number;
  onTier: (t: Tier) => void;
}

/** The ranked list, the size note and the other speeds: everything that explains the answer. */
export function QuoteBreakdown({ res, tier, actualLb, onTier }: QuoteBreakdownProps) {
  const view = tierView(res, tier);
  const [openId, setOpenId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const scale = Math.max(0, ...view.ranked.map((q) => q.total));
  const cheapest = view.ranked[0]?.total ?? 0;
  const others = TIERS.filter((t) => t !== tier);

  return (
    <div className="qbreak">
      <section aria-labelledby="qrank-title">
        <div className="qbreak__head">
          <h3 id="qrank-title" className="qbreak__title">
            Every carrier, {TIER_NAME[tier].toLowerCase()}
          </h3>
          <p className="qkey" aria-hidden="true">
            <span className="qkey__sw qkey__sw--base" /> base <span className="qkey__sw qkey__sw--surcharge" /> surcharges{" "}
            <span className="qkey__sw qkey__sw--fuel" /> fuel
          </p>
        </div>
        {view.ranked.length > 0 && (
          <ol className="qrank">
            {view.ranked.map((q, i) => (
              <QuoteRow
                key={q.service_id}
                quote={q}
                rank={i + 1}
                cheapest={cheapest}
                scale={scale}
                open={openId === q.service_id}
                onToggle={() => setOpenId(openId === q.service_id ? null : q.service_id)}
              />
            ))}
          </ol>
        )}
        {view.alternatives.length > 0 && (
          <p className="qalt">
            Also available, dearer:{" "}
            {view.alternatives.map((q, i) => (
              <span key={q.service_id}>
                {i > 0 && " · "}
                {q.service_name} {formatUsd(q.total)}
              </span>
            ))}
          </p>
        )}
        {view.unavailable.length > 0 && (
          <ul className="qunavail" aria-label="Services that cannot carry this parcel">
            {view.unavailable.map((q) => (
              <li key={q.service_id}>
                <span className="qunavail__name">{q.service_name}</span>
                <span className="qunavail__reason">Not available: {q.unavailable_reason ?? "no reason given"}</span>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        )}
      </section>

      <DimNote quotes={res.quotes.filter((q) => q.tier === tier)} actualLb={actualLb} />

      <section className="qtiers" aria-labelledby="qtiers-title">
        <h3 id="qtiers-title" className="kicker">
          Other speeds, cheapest each
        </h3>
        <ul>
          {others.map((t) => {
            const pick = res.cheapest_by_tier[t];
            const q = pick && res.quotes.find((x) => x.service_id === pick.service_id && x.tier === t);
            return (
              <li key={t}>
                <span className="qtiers__tier">{TIER_NAME[t]}</span>
                <span className="qtiers__what">
                  {q ? (
                    <>
                      <span style={{ color: carrierVar(q.carrier) }}>{CARRIER_NAME[q.carrier]}</span> {q.service_name.replace(new RegExp(`^${CARRIER_NAME[q.carrier]} `), "")}
                    </>
                  ) : (
                    "no service can carry it"
                  )}
                </span>
                <span className="qtiers__total">{pick ? formatUsd(pick.total) : "—"}</span>
                <button type="button" className="btn btn--quiet qtiers__go" onClick={() => onTier(t)}>
                  Quote {TIER_NAME[t].toLowerCase()}
                </button>
              </li>
            );
          })}
        </ul>
      </section>
    </div>
  );
}
EOF

import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { useApi, useLoad } from "../api/ApiContext";
import { ApiError } from "../api/client";
import type { QuoteResponse } from "../api/types";
import { CARRIER_NAME } from "../lib/format";
import { draftToParcel, DEFAULT_DRAFT, type Draft } from "./quote/draft";
import { QuoteForm } from "./quote/QuoteForm";
import { problemsByField, zonesByCarrier, type FormField } from "./quote/quoteModel";
import { QuoteAnswer, QuoteBreakdown } from "./quote/QuoteResult";
import { carriersForYear, missingCarriersNote, useDebounced } from "./quote/shared";
import type { ViewProps } from "./types";
import "./quote/quote.css";

export interface QuoteViewProps extends ViewProps {
  /** Wait this long after the last keystroke before asking for a quote. */
  debounceMs?: number;
  initialDraft?: Draft;
}

export function QuoteView({ controls, meta, parcels, debounceMs = 300, initialDraft = DEFAULT_DRAFT }: QuoteViewProps) {
  const api = useApi();
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState<Draft>(initialDraft);
  const [attempt, setAttempt] = useState(0);
  const built = useMemo(() => draftToParcel(draft), [draft]);
  const requestKey = built.parcel ? JSON.stringify({ parcel: built.parcel, controls }) : null;
  const settledKey = useDebounced(requestKey, debounceMs);

  const state = useLoad<QuoteResponse>(
    settledKey ? (signal) => api.quote(JSON.parse(settledKey), signal) : null,
    [api, settledKey, attempt],
  );

  // Keep the last answer on screen (dimmed) while the next one loads, so typing does not flash.
  const [last, setLast] = useState<{ key: string; data: QuoteResponse } | null>(null);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (state.status === "ok" && settledKey) setLast({ key: settledKey, data: state.data });
  }, [state, settledKey]);

  const apiError = state.status === "error" ? state.error : null;
  const serverProblems = apiError instanceof ApiError && apiError.status === 422 ? problemsByField(apiError.problems) : null;
  const errors: Partial<Record<FormField, string[]>> = { ...(serverProblems?.byField ?? {}) };
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(built.errors ?? {})) errors[k as FormField] = [v];

  const pending = requestKey !== settledKey || state.status === "loading";
  const shown = state.status === "ok" ? state.data : apiError ? null : (last?.data ?? null);
  const stale = shown !== null && (pending || last?.key !== requestKey);
  const actualLb = built.parcel?.weight_lb ?? 0;

  const available = carriersForYear(meta, controls.year);
  const yearNote = missingCarriersNote(available, controls.year, CARRIER_NAME);
  const blocked = built.errors !== null || serverProblems !== null;

  return (
    <div className="qv">
      {yearNote && (
        <p className="view-note" role="note">
          {yearNote}
        </p>
      )}

      <div className="qv__answer" aria-live="polite" aria-busy={pending}>
        {blocked ? (
          <div className="answer qa">
            <p className="kicker">Cheapest for this parcel</p>
            <p className="answer__figure qa__none">$—.——</p>
            <p className="answer__caption">Fix the input marked in “Your parcel” to see the price.</p>
          </div>
        ) : apiError ? (
          <div className="view-error" role="alert">
            <p className="view-error__title">The quote could not be priced.</p>
            <p>{apiError.message}</p>
            <button type="button" className="btn" onClick={() => setAttempt((n) => n + 1)}>
              Try again
            </button>
          </div>
        ) : shown ? (
          <div className={stale ? "is-stale" : undefined}>
            <QuoteAnswer res={shown} tier={draft.speed} flatPrice={controls.flat_price} />
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="answer qa" data-testid="quote-loading">
            <p className="kicker">Cheapest for this parcel</p>
            <p className="answer__figure skeleton skeleton--figure" aria-label="Pricing…">
              $00.00
            </p>
            <p className="skeleton skeleton--line" aria-hidden="true" />
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      <div className="qv__grid">
        <QuoteForm
          draft={draft}
          onChange={setDraft}
          errors={errors}
          zones={shown && !stale ? zonesByCarrier(shown.quotes) : null}
          parcels={parcels}
        />
        <div className="qv__detail">
          {serverProblems && serverProblems.other.length > 0 && (
            <ul className="view-error" role="alert">
              {serverProblems.other.map((p, i) => (
                <li key={i}>{p.field ? `${p.field}: ${p.message}` : p.message}</li>
              ))}
            </ul>
          )}
          {shown && !blocked ? (
            <div className={stale ? "is-stale" : undefined}>
              <QuoteBreakdown
                res={shown}
                tier={draft.speed}
                actualLb={actualLb}
                onTier={(t) => setDraft({ ...draft, speed: t })}
              />
            </div>
          ) : !apiError && !blocked ? (
            <div className="skeleton-rows" aria-hidden="true">
              <span className="skeleton skeleton--row" />
              <span className="skeleton skeleton--row" />
              <span className="skeleton skeleton--row" />
            </div>
          ) : null}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
EOF

/* States shared by the Q1 and Q2 views (issue #5): notes, errors, skeletons, stale answers. */
.view-note {

.qf-seg--2 {

.qf-seg--3 {
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
}

.qf-seg__opt {
  position: relative;
  display: grid;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.qf-seg__opt + .qf-seg__opt {
  border-left: 1px solid var(--ink);
}

.qf-seg__opt input {
  position: absolute;
  opacity: 0;
  inset: 0;

}

.qf-seg__opt span {

}

.qf-seg__opt:hover span {
  background: var(--wash);

.qf-seg__opt input:checked + span {
  background: var(--ink);

}

.qf-seg__opt input:focus-visible + span {
  outline: 2px solid var(--focus);
  outline-offset: 2px;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px var(--focus-halo);
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
}

import type { BreakevenBand, BreakevenCell, BreakevenResponse, Carrier, Meta } from "../../api/types";
import { CARRIERS } from "../../api/types";
import { formatInt } from "../../lib/format";
import { serviceName } from "../quote/shared";

/** The ground service each carrier competes with on this map. */
export function groundService(carrier: Carrier, residential: boolean): string {
  if (carrier === "usps") return "usps_ground_advantage";
  if (carrier === "ups") return "ups_ground";
  return residential ? "fedex_home_delivery" : "fedex_ground";
}

export const groundName = (meta: Meta | null, c: Carrier, residential: boolean) =>
  serviceName(meta, groundService(c, residential));

/** Saving buckets for cell intensity; fixed in dollars so the legend means the same on every map. */
export const SAVING_STEPS = [1, 3, 10] as const;
export const SAVING_LABELS = ["under $1", "$1–3", "$3–10", "$10 or more"] as const;

export function savingLevel(saving: number): 0 | 1 | 2 | 3 {
  if (saving < SAVING_STEPS[0]) return 0;
  if (saving < SAVING_STEPS[1]) return 1;
  if (saving < SAVING_STEPS[2]) return 2;
  return 3;
}

/** Cells indexed [row = weight][col = distance], in the order of the response's axes. */
export function cellGrid(res: BreakevenResponse): (BreakevenCell | null)[][] {
  const wi = new Map(res.weights_lb.map((w, i) => [w, i]));
  const di = new Map(res.distances_miles.map((d, i) => [d, i]));
  const grid: (BreakevenCell | null)[][] = res.weights_lb.map(() => res.distances_miles.map(() => null));
  for (const c of res.cells) {
    const r = wi.get(c.weight_lb);
    const col = di.get(c.distance_miles);
    if (r !== undefined && col !== undefined) grid[r]![col] = c;
  }
  return grid;
}

export const zoneLabel = (zUsps: number | null, zPrivate: number | null) =>
  zUsps === zPrivate || zPrivate === null ? `zone ${zUsps ?? "—"}` : `zone ${zUsps ?? "—"} (UPS/FedEx ${zPrivate})`;

const fmtMi = (d: number) => `${formatInt(d)} mi`;
const fmtLb = (w: number) => `${Number.isInteger(w) ? w : w.toFixed(1)} lb`;

function joinOr(names: string[]): string {
  if (names.length <= 1) return names[0] ?? "";
  return `${names.slice(0, -1).join(", ")} or ${names[names.length - 1]}`;
}

interface BandFacts {
  band: BreakevenBand;
  first: number | null; // lightest grid weight where a rival matches or beats USPS
  rivals: Carrier[]; // the rivals that do so at `first`
  beyond: Carrier[]; // non-USPS winners at weights >= first
  uspsStillWins: number; // cells >= first that USPS still wins
}

function bandFacts(res: BreakevenResponse, grid: (BreakevenCell | null)[][], col: number): BandFacts {
  const band = res.breakeven_weight_lb[col]!;
  const vs: [Carrier, number | null][] = [
    ["ups", band.vs_ups],
    ["fedex", band.vs_fedex],
  ];
  const known = vs.filter((x): x is [Carrier, number] => x[1] !== null);
  const first = known.length ? Math.min(...known.map((x) => x[1])) : null;
  const rivals = known.filter((x) => x[1] === first).map((x) => x[0]);
  const beyond = new Set<Carrier>();
  let uspsStillWins = 0;
  if (first !== null) {
    res.weights_lb.forEach((w, r) => {
      const win = grid[r]?.[col]?.winner?.carrier;
      if (w < first || !win) return;
      if (win === "usps") uspsStillWins += 1;
      else beyond.add(win);
    });
  }
  return { band, first, rivals, beyond: CARRIERS.filter((c) => beyond.has(c)), uspsStillWins };
}

export interface Readout {
  /** The figure: where USPS first stops winning, or a word when it never does. */
  figure: string;
  caption: string;
  lines: string[];
  /** True when USPS has no prices for the year, so there is nothing to compare. */
  noUsps: boolean;
}

/** Plain-language breakeven lines from `breakeven_weight_lb`, grouping neighbouring bands that read the same. */
export function readout(res: BreakevenResponse, meta: Meta | null): Readout {
  const res_ = res.residential;
  const usps = groundName(meta, "usps", res_);
  const name = (c: Carrier) => groundName(meta, c, res_);
  const maxW = res.weights_lb[res.weights_lb.length - 1] ?? 70;
  const minW = res.weights_lb[0] ?? 1;
  const noUsps = !res.cells.some((c) => c.totals.usps !== undefined);
  if (noUsps) {
    const present = CARRIERS.filter((c) => res.cells.some((x) => x.totals[c] !== undefined));
    return {
      figure: present.length === 1 ? `${name(present[0]!).split(" ")[0]} only` : "No USPS",
      caption: `USPS has no ${res.year} prices in this data, so there is no breakeven to draw.`,
      lines: [],
      noUsps,
    };
  }
  const grid = cellGrid(res);
  const facts = res.distances_miles.map((_, col) => bandFacts(res, grid, col));

  // Group consecutive bands with the same story.
  const key = (f: BandFacts) => `${f.first}|${f.rivals.join()}|${f.beyond.join()}|${f.uspsStillWins > 0}`;
  const groups: BandFacts[][] = [];
  for (const f of facts) {
    const g = groups[groups.length - 1];
    if (g && key(g[0]!) === key(f)) g.push(f);
    else groups.push([f]);
  }

  const where = (g: BandFacts[]) => {
    const a = g[0]!.band;
    const b = g[g.length - 1]!.band;
    if (g.length === 1) return `at ${fmtMi(a.distance_miles)} (zone ${a.zone_usps ?? "—"})`;
    return `from ${fmtMi(a.distance_miles)} to ${fmtMi(b.distance_miles)} (zones ${a.zone_usps ?? "—"}–${b.zone_usps ?? "—"})`;
  };

  const lines = groups.map((g) => {
    const f = g[0]!;
    const w = where(g);
    const W = w[0]!.toUpperCase() + w.slice(1);
    if (f.first === null) return `${W}, ${usps} is cheapest at every weight up to ${fmtLb(maxW)}.`;
    const rivals = joinOr(f.rivals.map(name));
    if (f.first <= minW) return `${W}, ${rivals} ${f.rivals.length > 1 ? "match" : "matches"} or ${f.rivals.length > 1 ? "beat" : "beats"} ${usps} from the lightest weight.`;
    const prev = res.weights_lb[res.weights_lb.indexOf(f.first) - 1] ?? f.first;
    const winners = f.beyond.map(name);
    const tail =
      winners.length === 0
        ? `from ${fmtLb(f.first)} ${rivals} costs the same`
        : f.uspsStillWins > 0
          ? `from ${fmtLb(f.first)} ${joinOr(winners)} wins at most weights (USPS still wins ${f.uspsStillWins} of them)`
          : `beyond that ${joinOr(winners)} wins`;
    return `${W}, ${usps} is cheapest up to ${fmtLb(prev)}; ${tail}.`;
  });

  const crossings = facts.filter((f) => f.first !== null);
  if (crossings.length === 0) {
    return {
      figure: "Never",
      caption: `${usps} is the cheapest ground service at every weight from ${fmtLb(minW)} to ${fmtLb(maxW)} and every distance on this map.`,
      lines,
      noUsps,
    };
  }
  const lowest = Math.min(...crossings.map((f) => f.first!));
  const at = crossings.filter((f) => f.first === lowest);
  const rivalSet = CARRIERS.filter((c) => at.some((f) => f.rivals.includes(c)));
  const dists = at.map((f) => fmtMi(f.band.distance_miles));
  const distText = at.length === crossings.length && at.length === facts.length ? "at every distance" : `at ${joinOr(dists).replace(/ or /, " and ")}`;
  return {
    figure: fmtLb(lowest),
    caption: `${usps} stops being the cheapest ${res_ ? "home" : "business"} delivery from ${fmtLb(lowest)} ${distText}, where ${joinOr(rivalSet.map(name))} ${rivalSet.length > 1 ? "match or beat" : "matches or beats"} it.`,
    lines,
    noUsps,
  };
}

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";

/** Width of an element, following resizes; `fallback` where ResizeObserver is missing (tests). */
export function useWidth<T extends HTMLElement>(fallback: number) {
  const ref = useRef<T | null>(null);
  const [width, setWidth] = useState(fallback);
  useEffect(() => {
    const el = ref.current;
    if (!el || typeof ResizeObserver === "undefined") return;
    const ro = new ResizeObserver((entries) => {
      const w = entries[0]?.contentRect.width;
      if (w && w > 0) setWidth(Math.floor(w));
    });
    ro.observe(el);
    return () => ro.disconnect();
  }, []);
  return [ref, width] as const;
}

import { useMemo, useRef, useState, type KeyboardEvent } from "react";
import type { BreakevenCell, BreakevenResponse, Carrier, Meta } from "../../api/types";
import { CARRIERS } from "../../api/types";
import { CARRIER_NAME, formatInt, formatUsd } from "../../lib/format";
import { cellGrid, groundName, savingLevel, zoneLabel } from "./readout";
import { useWidth } from "./useWidth";

const LEVEL_MIX = [22, 48, 74, 100] as const;

export function cellFill(c: BreakevenCell | null): string {
  if (!c?.winner) return "var(--wash)";
  const v = `var(--carrier-${c.winner.carrier})`;
  const w = `var(--carrier-${c.winner.carrier}-wash)`;
  return `color-mix(in srgb, ${v} ${LEVEL_MIX[savingLevel(c.saving)]}%, ${w})`;
}

function cellLabel(c: BreakevenCell | null, meta: Meta | null, residential: boolean): string {
  if (!c) return "no data";
  const head = `${c.weight_lb} lb, ${formatInt(c.distance_miles)} mi`;
  if (!c.winner) return `${head}: no ground service can carry it`;
  const win = `${groundName(meta, c.winner.carrier, residential)} cheapest at ${formatUsd(c.winner.total)}`;
  const run = c.runner_up
    ? `, ${formatUsd(c.saving)} less than ${groundName(meta, c.runner_up.carrier, residential)}`
    : ", no other carrier to compare";
  return `${head}: ${win}${run}`;
}

const AXIS_W = 46;
const HEAD_H = 38;

export interface HeatmapProps {
  res: BreakevenResponse;
  meta: Meta | null;
}

export function Heatmap({ res, meta }: HeatmapProps) {
  const grid = useMemo(() => cellGrid(res), [res]);
  const rows = res.weights_lb.length;
  const cols = res.distances_miles.length;
  const [wrapRef, width] = useWidth<HTMLDivElement>(640);
  const compact = width < 480;
  const colW = Math.max(30, (Math.max(width, 280) - AXIS_W) / Math.max(cols, 1));
  const rowH = rows > 40 ? (compact ? 6 : 7) : compact ? 18 : 22;
  const svgW = AXIS_W + colW * cols;
  const svgH = HEAD_H + rowH * rows + 2;

  const [active, setActive] = useState({ r: 0, c: 0 });
  const [hover, setHover] = useState<{ r: number; c: number } | null>(null);
  const [focused, setFocused] = useState(false);
  const [pinned, setPinned] = useState(false);
  const cellRefs = useRef<(SVGRectElement | null)[]>([]);

  const show = hover ?? (focused || pinned ? active : null);
  const shownCell = show ? (grid[show.r]?.[show.c] ?? null) : null;

  const moveTo = (r: number, c: number) => {
    const nr = Math.min(rows - 1, Math.max(0, r));
    const nc = Math.min(cols - 1, Math.max(0, c));
    setActive({ r: nr, c: nc });
    setHover(null);
    cellRefs.current[nr * cols + nc]?.focus();
  };

  const onKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent<SVGSVGElement>) => {
    const { r, c } = active;
    const map: Record<string, [number, number] | undefined> = {
      ArrowUp: [r - 1, c],
      ArrowDown: [r + 1, c],
      ArrowLeft: [r, c - 1],
      ArrowRight: [r, c + 1],
      PageUp: [r - 10, c],
      PageDown: [r + 10, c],
      Home: e.ctrlKey ? [0, 0] : [r, 0],
      End: e.ctrlKey ? [rows - 1, cols - 1] : [r, cols - 1],
    };
    if (e.key === "Escape") {
      setPinned(false);
      setFocused(false);
      return;
    }
    const to = map[e.key];
    if (!to) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    setFocused(true);
    moveTo(to[0], to[1]);
  };

  // Boundaries where the winner changes: drawn in ink so regions read without colour.
  const boundaries: string[] = [];
  for (let r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
    for (let c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
      const here = grid[r]?.[c]?.winner?.carrier;
      const right = grid[r]?.[c + 1]?.winner?.carrier;
      const below = grid[r + 1]?.[c]?.winner?.carrier;
      const x = AXIS_W + c * colW;
      const y = HEAD_H + r * rowH;
      if (c + 1 < cols && here !== right) boundaries.push(`M${x + colW},${y}v${rowH}`);
      if (r + 1 < rows && here !== below) boundaries.push(`M${x},${y + rowH}h${colW}`);
    }
  }

  // Name each run of one winner inside a column when it is tall enough to hold a label.
  const runLabels: { x: number; y: number; carrier: Carrier }[] = [];
  for (let c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
    let start = 0;
    for (let r = 1; r <= rows; r++) {
      const prev = grid[r - 1]?.[c]?.winner?.carrier;
      const cur = r < rows ? grid[r]?.[c]?.winner?.carrier : undefined;
      if (cur === prev && r < rows) continue;
      if (prev && (r - start) * rowH >= 26) {
        runLabels.push({ x: AXIS_W + c * colW + colW / 2, y: HEAD_H + ((start + r) / 2) * rowH, carrier: prev });
      }
      start = r;
    }
  }

  const weightTicks = res.weights_lb
    .map((w, r) => ({ w, r }))
    .filter(({ w, r }) => (rows > 40 ? r === 0 || w % 10 === 0 : true));

  const tip = show && shownCell ? tooltipPos(show, colW, rowH, svgW) : null;

  return (
    <div className="hm" ref={wrapRef}>
      <div className="hm__scroll">
        <svg
          className="hm__svg"
          width={svgW}
          height={svgH}
          viewBox={`0 0 ${svgW} ${svgH}`}
          role="grid"
          aria-label={`Cheapest ground carrier by weight (rows, ${res.weights_lb[0]} to ${res.weights_lb[rows - 1]} lb) and distance (columns). Arrow keys move between cells.`}
          aria-rowcount={rows}
          aria-colcount={cols}
          onKeyDown={onKeyDown}
          onPointerLeave={() => setHover(null)}
        >
          <g aria-hidden="true" className="hm__axis">
            {res.distances_miles.map((d, c) => {
              const band = res.breakeven_weight_lb[c];
              const x = AXIS_W + c * colW + colW / 2;
              return (
                <g key={d}>
                  <text x={x} y={14} textAnchor="middle" className="hm__colhead">
                    {compact ? formatInt(d) : `${formatInt(d)} mi`}
                  </text>
                  <text x={x} y={29} textAnchor="middle" className="hm__colsub">
                    {compact ? `z${band?.zone_usps ?? "—"}` : `zone ${band?.zone_usps ?? "—"}`}
                  </text>
                </g>
              );
            })}
            {weightTicks.map(({ w, r }) => (
              <text key={w} x={AXIS_W - 6} y={HEAD_H + r * rowH + rowH / 2} dy="0.35em" textAnchor="end" className="hm__rowhead">
                {w} lb
              </text>
            ))}
          </g>
          {res.weights_lb.map((w, r) => (
            <g key={w} role="row" aria-rowindex={r + 1}>
              {res.distances_miles.map((d, c) => {
                const cell = grid[r]?.[c] ?? null;
                const isActive = active.r === r && active.c === c;
                return (
                  <rect
                    key={d}
                    ref={(el) => {
                      cellRefs.current[r * cols + c] = el;
                    }}
                    role="gridcell"
                    aria-colindex={c + 1}
                    aria-label={cellLabel(cell, meta, res.residential)}
                    aria-selected={isActive}
                    tabIndex={isActive ? 0 : -1}
                    data-carrier={cell?.winner?.carrier ?? "none"}
                    data-level={cell ? savingLevel(cell.saving) : 0}
                    x={AXIS_W + c * colW}
                    y={HEAD_H + r * rowH}
                    width={colW}
                    height={rowH}
                    style={{ fill: cellFill(cell) }}
                    className="hm__cell"
                    onPointerEnter={(e) => e.pointerType === "mouse" && setHover({ r, c })}
                    onClick={() => {
                      setActive({ r, c });
                      setPinned(true);
                    }}
                    onFocus={() => {
                      setActive({ r, c });
                      setFocused(true);
                    }}
                    onBlur={() => setFocused(false)}
                  />
                );
              })}
            </g>
          ))}
          <path d={boundaries.join("")} className="hm__boundary" aria-hidden="true" />
          <g aria-hidden="true">
            {runLabels.map((l, i) => (
              <text key={i} x={l.x} y={l.y} dy="0.35em" textAnchor="middle" className="hm__runlabel">
                {compact ? CARRIER_NAME[l.carrier] : CARRIER_NAME[l.carrier]}
              </text>
            ))}
          </g>
          {show && (
            <rect
              aria-hidden="true"
              className="hm__focus"
              x={AXIS_W + show.c * colW + 1}
              y={HEAD_H + show.r * rowH}
              width={colW - 2}
              height={rowH}
            />
          )}
        </svg>
        {tip && shownCell && (
          <div className="hm__tip" role="status" style={{ left: tip.left, top: tip.top }} data-below={tip.below}>
            <Tooltip cell={shownCell} meta={meta} residential={res.residential} />
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function tooltipPos(at: { r: number; c: number }, colW: number, rowH: number, svgW: number) {
  const TIP_W = 220;
  const cx = AXIS_W + at.c * colW + colW / 2;
  const left = Math.min(Math.max(4, cx - TIP_W / 2), Math.max(4, svgW - TIP_W - 4));
  const y = HEAD_H + at.r * rowH;
  const below = y < 170;
  return { left, top: below ? y + rowH + 8 : y - 8, below };
}

export function Tooltip({ cell, meta, residential }: { cell: BreakevenCell; meta: Meta | null; residential: boolean }) {
  const entries = CARRIERS.filter((c) => cell.totals[c] !== undefined).sort((a, b) => cell.totals[a]! - cell.totals[b]!);
  return (
    <>
      <p className="hm__tiphead">
        {cell.weight_lb} lb · {formatInt(cell.distance_miles)} mi
        <span>{zoneLabel(cell.zone_usps, cell.zone_private)}</span>
      </p>
      <table className="hm__tiptable">
        <tbody>
          {entries.map((c) => (
            <tr key={c} className={cell.winner?.carrier === c ? "is-winner" : undefined}>
              <th scope="row">
                <span className={`hm__dot hm__dot--${c}`} aria-hidden="true" />
                {groundName(meta, c, residential)}
              </th>
              <td className="num">{formatUsd(cell.totals[c]!)}</td>
            </tr>
          ))}
        </tbody>
      </table>
      <p className="hm__tipfoot">
        {cell.winner && cell.runner_up
          ? `${CARRIER_NAME[cell.winner.carrier]} saves ${formatUsd(cell.saving)} over ${CARRIER_NAME[cell.runner_up.carrier]}`
          : cell.winner
            ? `Only ${CARRIER_NAME[cell.winner.carrier]} has a price here`
            : "No ground service can carry it"}
      </p>
    </>
  );
}

import { useMemo } from "react";
import type { BreakevenResponse } from "../../api/types";
import { CARRIER_NAME, formatInt, formatUsd } from "../../lib/format";
import { cellGrid } from "./readout";

/** The map as a plain table: the accessible and printable alternative to the heatmap. */
export function BreakevenTable({ res, id }: { res: BreakevenResponse; id: string }) {
  const grid = useMemo(() => cellGrid(res), [res]);
  return (
    <div className="hmt" id={id}>
      <table className="hmt__table">
        <caption>
          Cheapest ground carrier and its price by weight and distance ({res.residential ? "home" : "business"} delivery,{" "}
          {res.year}). The second line is how much more the next cheapest carrier costs.
        </caption>
        <thead>
          <tr>
            <th scope="col">Weight</th>
            {res.distances_miles.map((d, c) => (
              <th key={d} scope="col" className="num">
                {formatInt(d)} mi
                <span className="hmt__zone">zone {res.breakeven_weight_lb[c]?.zone_usps ?? "—"}</span>
              </th>
            ))}
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody>
          {res.weights_lb.map((w, r) => (
            <tr key={w}>
              <th scope="row">{w} lb</th>
              {res.distances_miles.map((d, c) => {
                const cell = grid[r]?.[c];
                if (!cell?.winner) return <td key={d}>—</td>;
                return (
                  <td key={d} className={`num hmt__cell hmt__cell--${cell.winner.carrier}`}>
                    <span className="hmt__who">{CARRIER_NAME[cell.winner.carrier]}</span> {formatUsd(cell.winner.total)}
                    {cell.runner_up && <span className="hmt__next">next +{formatUsd(cell.saving)}</span>}
                  </td>
                );
              })}
            </tr>
          ))}
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </div>
  );
}

import { useId, useState } from "react";
import { useApi, useLoad } from "../api/ApiContext";
import type { BreakevenResponse, Carrier } from "../api/types";
import { CARRIERS } from "../api/types";
import { CARRIER_NAME } from "../lib/format";
import { BreakevenTable } from "./breakeven/BreakevenTable";
import { Heatmap } from "./breakeven/Heatmap";
import { SAVING_LABELS, groundName, readout } from "./breakeven/readout";
import { carriersForYear, missingCarriersNote } from "./quote/shared";
import type { ViewProps } from "./types";
import "./quote/shared.css";
import "./breakeven/breakeven.css";

function Legend({ res, meta }: { res: BreakevenResponse; meta: ViewProps["meta"] }) {
  const winners = CARRIERS.filter((c) => res.cells.some((x) => x.winner?.carrier === c));
  return (
    <div className="hml" aria-label="Legend" role="group">
      <ul className="hml__carriers">
        {winners.map((c: Carrier) => (
          <li key={c}>
            <span className={`hml__sw hml__sw--${c}`} aria-hidden="true" />
            <strong>{CARRIER_NAME[c]}</strong> {groundName(meta, c, res.residential).replace(new RegExp(`^${CARRIER_NAME[c]} `), "")}{" "}
            cheapest
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>
      <div className="hml__ramp">
        <span className="hml__ramplabel">Saving over the next cheapest:</span>
        <ol>
          {SAVING_LABELS.map((l, i) => (
            <li key={l}>
              <span className={`hml__step hml__step--${i}`} aria-hidden="true" />
              {l}
            </li>
          ))}
        </ol>
      </div>
      <p className="hml__note">Black lines mark where the cheapest carrier changes. Tap, hover or focus a cell for every price.</p>
    </div>
  );
}

export function BreakevenView({ controls, meta }: ViewProps) {
  const api = useApi();
  const [residential, setResidential] = useState(true);
  const [asTable, setAsTable] = useState(false);
  const [attempt, setAttempt] = useState(0);
  const uid = useId();
  const key = JSON.stringify({ controls, residential });
  const state = useLoad<BreakevenResponse>((signal) => api.breakeven({ controls, residential }, signal), [api, key, attempt]);

  const available = carriersForYear(meta, controls.year);
  const yearNote = missingCarriersNote(available, controls.year, CARRIER_NAME);
  const res = state.status === "ok" ? state.data : null;
  const r = res ? readout(res, meta) : null;

  return (
    <div className="bv">
      <fieldset className="bv__toggle">
        <legend className="visually-hidden">Delivered to</legend>
        <div className="qf-seg qf-seg--2">
          {[
            [true, "Homes"],
            [false, "Businesses"],
          ].map(([value, label]) => (
            <label key={String(value)} className="qf-seg__opt">
              <input type="radio" name={`${uid}-res`} checked={residential === value} onChange={() => setResidential(value as boolean)} />
              <span>{label as string}</span>
            </label>
          ))}
        </div>
      </fieldset>

      {yearNote && (
        <p className="view-note" role="note">
          {yearNote}
        </p>
      )}

      {state.status === "error" ? (
        <div className="view-error" role="alert">
          <p className="view-error__title">The breakeven map could not be drawn.</p>
          <p>{state.error.message}</p>
          <button type="button" className="btn" onClick={() => setAttempt((n) => n + 1)}>
            Try again
          </button>
        </div>
      ) : !res || !r ? (
        <div data-testid="breakeven-loading" aria-busy="true">
          <div className="answer">
            <p className="kicker">Where USPS stops winning</p>
            <p className="answer__figure skeleton skeleton--figure" aria-label="Loading…">
              00 lb
            </p>
            <p className="skeleton skeleton--line" aria-hidden="true" />
          </div>
          <div className="skeleton bv__skeleton-map" aria-hidden="true" />
        </div>
      ) : (
        <>
          <div className="answer bv__answer" aria-live="polite">
            <p className="kicker">Where USPS stops winning · {residential ? "home" : "business"} delivery</p>
            <p className="answer__figure" data-testid="breakeven-answer">
              {r.figure}
            </p>
            <p className="answer__caption bv__caption">{r.caption}</p>
          </div>
          {r.lines.length > 0 && (
            <ul className="bv__lines" aria-label="Breakeven by distance">
              {r.lines.map((l) => (
                <li key={l}>{l}</li>
              ))}
            </ul>
          )}

          {!r.noUsps && res.cells.length > 0 && (
            <section className="bv__map" aria-labelledby={`${uid}-map`}>
              <div className="bv__maphead">
                <h3 id={`${uid}-map`} className="bv__maptitle">
                  Cheapest ground service, {res.weights_lb[0]}–{res.weights_lb[res.weights_lb.length - 1]} lb by distance
                </h3>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  className="btn"
                  aria-expanded={asTable}
                  aria-controls={`${uid}-table`}
                  onClick={() => setAsTable(!asTable)}
                >
                  {asTable ? "Show as map" : "Show as table"}
                </button>
              </div>
              <Legend res={res} meta={meta} />
              {asTable ? <BreakevenTable res={res} id={`${uid}-table`} /> : <Heatmap res={res} meta={meta} />}
            </section>
          )}
        </>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

    await waitFor(() => expect(breakeven).toHaveBeenLastCalledWith({ controls: next, residential: false }, expect.anything()));
  });

  it("says plainly that 2027 is FedEx only and draws no map", async () => {
    const res = asBreakevenResponse(be2027Fx.response.body);
    setup({ breakeven: async () => res }, { ...mockDefaultControls, year: 2027 });
    expect(await screen.findByTestId("breakeven-answer")).toHaveTextContent("FedEx only");
    expect(screen.getByRole("note")).toHaveTextContent("2027 prices are published by FedEx only");
    expect(screen.getByText(/USPS has no 2027 prices/)).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.queryByRole("grid")).not.toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it("shows a loading skeleton, then a retryable error", async () => {
    let fail = true;
    const breakeven = vi.fn(async () => {
      if (fail) throw new ApiError(500, "The rate service had a problem. Try again in a moment.");
      return mockBreakevenResponse;
    });
    setup({ breakeven });
    expect(screen.getByTestId("breakeven-loading")).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(await screen.findByRole("alert")).toHaveTextContent("The rate service had a problem");
    fail = false;
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Try again" }));
    expect(await screen.findByTestId("breakeven-answer")).toHaveTextContent("27 lb");
  });
});

describe("readout", () => {
  it("says Never when USPS wins every cell", () => {
    const res = {
      ...mockBreakevenResponse,
      breakeven_weight_lb: mockBreakevenResponse.breakeven_weight_lb.map((b) => ({ ...b, vs_ups: null, vs_fedex: null })),
    };
    expect(readout(res, mockMeta).figure).toBe("Never");
  });

  it("buckets savings in fixed dollar steps", () => {
    expect([0, 0.99, 1, 2.99, 3, 9.99, 10, 60].map(savingLevel)).toEqual([0, 0, 1, 1, 2, 2, 3, 3]);
  });
});

at 55 % opacity while the next one loads, so typing never flashes a skeleton. Each
carrier row is a disclosure button: rank, carrier name in its colour, a stacked bar

by texture and not only by tint), total and the difference to the cheapest. Line items
carry their source under the label in small muted type. Unavailable services are struck
through and muted, with the reason in words. When dimensional weight sets the billable
weight, a ruled note shows actual, dimensional and billable weight per service. Server
422 messages appear under the input they concern, in `--loss`, and the input gets

cheapest, with a caption naming the distances and rivals; one plain sentence per

winner's carrier colour mixed with its wash in four fixed saving steps (under $1,

where USPS stops or starts winning and a dotted line where UPS and FedEx swap; runs
tall enough carry the carrier name. Colour is therefore never the only cue. The grid is
a roving-tabindex `role="grid"` (arrows, Home/End, PageUp/PageDown, Escape closes the
tooltip); hover, tap or focus shows every carrier's total. "Show as table" swaps the
map for a sticky-header table. At 375 px the map fits without horizontal scroll (columns
shrink, headers abbreviate to "z5").

```
Issue #5 is finished: Q1 (quote a parcel) and Q2 (breakeven map) both run against the real backend. The work is on branch `issue-5-quote-breakeven` in `~/parcel-rates-issue-5`, in 3 commits (ac81840, e03371c, 092b833). Nothing is pushed and no PR is open. Tests, typecheck and build all pass. I stopped both servers I started (backend on 8787, Vite on 5173).

**Q1 – quote a parcel** (`frontend/src/views/QuoteView.tsx` and `frontend/src/views/quote/`)
- **Inputs:**
  - weight in lb plus an oz box, with a "= 1.5 lb" hint
  - optional L×W×H
  - distance; after a quote it shows the zone, e.g. "Zone 5 for every carrier"
  - home or business
  - speed tier
  - delivery area
  - "Not a box"
  - a "Start from one of your parcels" picker when a parcel set is loaded
- **Pricing:** it reprices as you type, 300 ms after the last change, and on any global control change. While the next quote loads, the previous answer stays visible but dimmed.
- **Answer first:** the cheapest total at full figure size, then carrier and service, then the margin with a sign and the word "margin" or "loss" in the profit/loss colour.
- **Ranked list:** each carrier's cheapest service in the tier, with a bar split into base (solid), surcharges (hatched) and fuel (outlined wash), the total and the gap to the cheapest. Opening a row shows every line item with its source citation, the subtotals, zone, billable weight and the "as of" date.
- **Other rows and notes:**
  - pricier services from the same carrier
  - unavailable services, struck through and muted, with the reason in words
  - a "Billed by size, not weight" note with actual, dimensional and billable weight per service, plus one sentence of explanation
  - the other speeds on one line each, with a button to quote that speed
- **422 errors:** each message appears under the input it concerns (weight, dims, distance, speed and so on) and that input is marked invalid. The form also catches simple mistakes before calling the server: empty weight, two of three dimensions, non-numbers.

**Q2 – breakeven map** (`frontend/src/views/BreakevenView.tsx` and `frontend/src/views/breakeven/`)
- **Answer first:** the lightest weight at which USPS stops being cheapest (e.g. "27 lb"), with a caption naming the distances and rivals. Below it, one plain sentence per distance band, worked out from `breakeven_weight_lb` plus the cells; neighbouring bands that say the same thing are merged.
- **Map:** a custom SVG grid with a toggle between homes and businesses.
  - Colour is the winning carrier; intensity is the saving over the runner-up in four fixed steps (under $1, $1–3, $3–10, $10+), so the legend means the same on every map.
  - A heavy line marks where USPS starts or stops winning and a dotted line where UPS and FedEx swap. Tall enough stretches carry the carrier's name, so colour is never the only cue.
  - Hover, tap or focus shows a tooltip with every carrier's total and the saving.
  - It is keyboard navigable: arrows, Home/End, PageUp/PageDown, and Escape closes the tooltip. Only one cell is in the tab order at a time.
  - The legend names every carrier in text. "Show as table" swaps the map for a table with sticky headers.
  - At 375 px it fits with no horizontal scroll.

**Both views:** loading skeletons, an error state with "Try again", and a plain note for 2027 ("2027 prices are published by FedEx only…"). In 2027 Q2 shows "FedEx only" and draws no map. Both respond to every global control.

**Tests:** 25 new tests in `frontend/src/views/quote/QuoteView.test.tsx` and `frontend/src/views/breakeven/BreakevenView.test.tsx`, using the client mock and the existing fixtures; I didn't need new ones. They cover:
- the answer, its margin, and controls reaching the request
- line items opening, unavailable reasons, the size note and other speeds
- 422 messages next to their inputs and the client-side checks
- the 2027 note, prefill from a parcel, and loading and error states
- 560 map cells, tooltip contents, keyboard moves with one tab stop, the table, the toggle, and a few readout unit tests

`npm run test` passes all 117, and `npm run typecheck` and `npm run build` are clean.

**Screenshots:** 16 files in `frontend/e2e/screenshots/`: q1-typical, q1-bulky (18 lb, 50×14×10 in, 900 mi), q2-residential and q2-business, at 1440 and 375, light and dark. Playwright ran from the scratchpad. Playwright 1.49.1 was needed because Node here is 18.

**What I found reviewing the screenshots, and what I changed:**
- **Heatmap stripes:** each cell's outline made the rows look striped, which hurt legibility. I removed it and kept only thin column separators. I also raised rows to 8 px on all widths, so the map is 560 px tall on a phone and easier to tap.
- **Busy boundaries:** too many black lines between UPS and FedEx made the map noisy. Now the USPS boundary is heavy and the UPS/FedEx one is dotted.
- **Unclear sentences:** "USPS still wins 21 of them" was confusing. They now read like "…cheapest up to 26 lb and again from 51 lb; between 27 lb and 50 lb UPS Ground or FedEx Home Delivery mostly wins."
- **Cramped line items on phones:** a separate Source column squeezed the labels, so the source now sits under each label.
- **Repeated carrier name:** rows said "USPS / USPS Ground Advantage", so the service name now drops the carrier prefix.

The answer is the largest element in every capture, and inputs and buttons are at least 44 px tall. The open issue is the map cells themselves: they are only 8 px tall, below the 44 px tap target. Tapping still works, but the table view is the accessible way to read them on a phone.

**API/contract issues**
- `LineItem.source` is not always "file p.N". For spreadsheets and CSV zips it is "file.xlsx (sheet)", and for fuel it is "….html (proxy)". The UI shows the string as it comes, so nothing breaks.
- UPS 2026 quotes report `as_of` 2026-09-07, the date of the updated rate guide, so "rules as of" differs between carriers.
- The quote endpoint did not reject a parcel with only `length_in` given; its only error was for the negative distance I sent with it. The form catches partial dimensions itself.
- Nothing in the shared files blocked me; I changed none of them.

**Shared helpers:** none existed for margin wording, carriers per year, debouncing, or the note/error/skeleton/toggle styles. I put them in `frontend/src/views/quote/shared.ts` and `shared.css`, which Q2 imports too. They could move to `src/lib` and `src/styles` if Q3/Q4 want them. I appended a section for these two views to `frontend/DESIGN.md`.

**What the sample data shows (2026 commercial, default fuel)**
- **Homes:** USPS Ground Advantage wins at every weight up to 70 lb out to 450 mi (zones 1–4). From 800 mi it stops winning at 27 lb, but it wins again from 51 lb, so UPS or FedEx Home Delivery only wins between 27 and 50 lb. Inside that window UPS and FedEx are usually within cents of each other, e.g. $54.21 against $54.26 at 31 lb and 800 mi. My guess is that UPS and FedEx add a large surcharge above 50 lb; I didn't check the line items for this.
- **Businesses:** USPS stops winning earlier, at 24 lb from 1,200 to 1,600 mi, and around 42 lb at 25 mi, where FedEx Ground wins. It wins again from 51 lb here too.
- **Bulky box:** for the 18 lb, 50×14×10 in box at 900 mi, dimensional weight bills UPS and FedEx at 51 lb and USPS at 43 lb. UPS adds $38.50 Additional Handling, so USPS is still cheapest at $105.06 against $123.86. That is a $95 loss on the $9.99 flat price.

```
interface BandFacts {
  band: BreakevenBand;
  first: number | null; // lightest grid weight where a rival matches or beats USPS
  rivals: Carrier[]; // the rivals that do so at `first`
  beyond: Carrier[]; // non-USPS winners at weights >= first
  /** Heaviest weight a rival wins, and the next grid weight (USPS wins again from there), if any. */
  lastRival: number | null;
  uspsAgainFrom: number | null;
  /** USPS still wins some weights between `first` and `lastRival`. */
  mixed: boolean;
}

function bandFacts(res: BreakevenResponse, grid: (BreakevenCell | null)[][], col: number): BandFacts {
  const band = res.breakeven_weight_lb[col]!;
  const vs: [Carrier, number | null][] = [
    ["ups", band.vs_ups],
    ["fedex", band.vs_fedex],
  ];
  const known = vs.filter((x): x is [Carrier, number] => x[1] !== null);
  const first = known.length ? Math.min(...known.map((x) => x[1])) : null;
  const rivals = known.filter((x) => x[1] === first).map((x) => x[0]);
  const beyond = new Set<Carrier>();
  let lastRivalIdx = -1;
  let firstIdx = -1;
  if (first !== null) {
    res.weights_lb.forEach((w, r) => {
      const win = grid[r]?.[col]?.winner?.carrier;
      if (w < first || !win || win === "usps") return;
      beyond.add(win);
      if (firstIdx < 0) firstIdx = r;
      lastRivalIdx = r;
    });
  }
  let mixed = false;
  for (let r = firstIdx; firstIdx >= 0 && r <= lastRivalIdx; r++) {
    if (grid[r]?.[col]?.winner?.carrier === "usps") mixed = true;
  }
  const lastRival = lastRivalIdx >= 0 ? res.weights_lb[lastRivalIdx]! : null;
  const uspsAgainFrom = lastRivalIdx >= 0 ? (res.weights_lb[lastRivalIdx + 1] ?? null) : null;
  return { band, first, rivals, beyond: CARRIERS.filter((c) => beyond.has(c)), lastRival, uspsAgainFrom, mixed };
}

export interface Readout {
  /** The figure: where USPS first stops winning, or a word when it never does. */
  figure: string;
  caption: string;
  lines: string[];
  /** True when USPS has no prices for the year, so there is nothing to compare. */
  noUsps: boolean;
}

/** Plain-language breakeven lines from `breakeven_weight_lb`, grouping neighbouring bands that read the same. */
export function readout(res: BreakevenResponse, meta: Meta | null): Readout {
  const res_ = res.residential;
  const usps = groundName(meta, "usps", res_);
  const name = (c: Carrier) => groundName(meta, c, res_);
  const maxW = res.weights_lb[res.weights_lb.length - 1] ?? 70;
  const minW = res.weights_lb[0] ?? 1;
  const noUsps = !res.cells.some((c) => c.totals.usps !== undefined);
  if (noUsps) {
    const present = CARRIERS.filter((c) => res.cells.some((x) => x.totals[c] !== undefined));
    return {
      figure: present.length === 1 ? `${name(present[0]!).split(" ")[0]} only` : "No USPS",
      caption: `USPS has no ${res.year} prices in this data, so there is no breakeven to draw.`,
      lines: [],
      noUsps,
    };
  }
  const grid = cellGrid(res);
  const facts = res.distances_miles.map((_, col) => bandFacts(res, grid, col));

  // Group consecutive bands with the same story.
  const key = (f: BandFacts) => `${f.first}|${f.rivals.join()}|${f.beyond.join()}|${f.lastRival}|${f.mixed}`;
  const groups: BandFacts[][] = [];
  for (const f of facts) {
    const g = groups[groups.length - 1];
    if (g && key(g[0]!) === key(f)) g.push(f);
    else groups.push([f]);
  }

  const where = (g: BandFacts[]) => {
    const a = g[0]!.band;
    const b = g[g.length - 1]!.band;
    if (g.length === 1) return `at ${fmtMi(a.distance_miles)} (zone ${a.zone_usps ?? "—"})`;
    return `from ${fmtMi(a.distance_miles)} to ${fmtMi(b.distance_miles)} (zones ${a.zone_usps ?? "—"}–${b.zone_usps ?? "—"})`;
  };

  const lines = groups.map((g) => {
    const f = g[0]!;
    const w = where(g);
    const W = w[0]!.toUpperCase() + w.slice(1);
    if (f.first === null) return `${W}, ${usps} is cheapest at every weight up to ${fmtLb(maxW)}.`;
    const rivals = joinOr(f.rivals.map(name));
    if (f.first <= minW) return `${W}, ${rivals} ${f.rivals.length > 1 ? "match" : "matches"} or ${f.rivals.length > 1 ? "beat" : "beats"} ${usps} from the lightest weight.`;
    const prev = res.weights_lb[res.weights_lb.indexOf(f.first) - 1] ?? f.first;
    const winners = joinOr(f.beyond.map(name));
    if (f.beyond.length === 0) return `${W}, ${usps} is cheapest up to ${fmtLb(prev)}; from ${fmtLb(f.first)} ${rivals} costs the same.`;
    const mostly = f.mixed ? "mostly " : "";
    if (f.uspsAgainFrom !== null && f.lastRival !== null) {
      return `${W}, ${usps} is cheapest up to ${fmtLb(prev)} and again from ${fmtLb(f.uspsAgainFrom)}; between ${fmtLb(f.first)} and ${fmtLb(f.lastRival)} ${winners} ${mostly}wins.`;
    }
    return `${W}, ${usps} is cheapest up to ${fmtLb(prev)}; beyond that ${winners} ${mostly}wins.`;
  });

  const crossings = facts.filter((f) => f.first !== null);
  if (crossings.length === 0) {
    return {
      figure: "Never",
      caption: `${usps} is the cheapest ground service at every weight from ${fmtLb(minW)} to ${fmtLb(maxW)} and every distance on this map.`,
      lines,
      noUsps,
    };
  }
  const lowest = Math.min(...crossings.map((f) => f.first!));
  const at = crossings.filter((f) => f.first === lowest);
  const rivalSet = CARRIERS.filter((c) => at.some((f) => f.rivals.includes(c)));
  const dists = at.map((f) => fmtMi(f.band.distance_miles));
  const distText = at.length === crossings.length && at.length === facts.length ? "at every distance" : `at ${joinOr(dists).replace(/ or /, " and ")}`;
  return {
    figure: fmtLb(lowest),
    caption: `${usps} stops being the cheapest ${res_ ? "home" : "business"} delivery from ${fmtLb(lowest)} ${distText}, where ${joinOr(rivalSet.map(name))} ${rivalSet.length > 1 ? "match or beat" : "matches or beats"} it.`,
    lines,
    noUsps,
  };
}
```

import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import type { BreakevenCell, BreakevenResponse, Carrier } from "../../api/types";
import { mockMeta } from "../../api/mocks";
import { readout } from "./readout";

const CODE: Record<string, Carrier> = { S: "usps", U: "ups", F: "fedex" };

interface Spec {
  /** One string per distance column, one letter per weight (S = USPS, U = UPS, F = FedEx wins). */
  columns: string[];
  residential?: boolean;
  year?: number;
  /** Carriers with prices this year (default all three). */
  carriers?: Carrier[];
  /** Pairwise breakeven weights per column, as the API sends them (default null). */
  vs?: { ups: number | null; fedex: number | null }[];
}

/** A small synthetic map: the winner costs $10, every other carrier $11 (so savings are $1). */
function grid({ columns, residential = true, year = 2026, carriers = ["usps", "ups", "fedex"], vs = [] }: Spec): BreakevenResponse {
  const weights = Array.from({ length: columns[0]!.length }, (_, i) => i + 1);
  const distances = columns.map((_, c) => (c + 1) * 100);
  const cells: BreakevenCell[] = [];
  columns.forEach((col, c) => {
    [...col].forEach((letter, r) => {
      const winner = CODE[letter]!;
      const totals: Partial<Record<Carrier, number>> = {};
      for (const k of carriers) totals[k] = k === winner ? 10 : 11;
      const runner = carriers.find((k) => k !== winner);
      cells.push({
        weight_lb: weights[r]!,
        distance_miles: distances[c]!,
        zone_usps: c + 2,
        zone_private: c + 2,
        winner: { carrier: winner, service_id: `${winner}_x`, total: 10 },
        runner_up: runner ? { carrier: runner, service_id: `${runner}_x`, total: 11 } : null,
        saving: runner ? 1 : 0,
        totals,
      });
    });
  });
  return {
    year,
    residential,
    weights_lb: weights,
    distances_miles: distances,
    cells,
    breakeven_weight_lb: distances.map((d, c) => ({
      distance_miles: d,
      zone_usps: c + 2,
      zone_private: c + 2,
      vs_ups: vs[c]?.ups ?? null,
      vs_fedex: vs[c]?.fedex ?? null,
    })),
  };
}

const cases: { name: string; spec: Spec; figure: string; lines: string[]; caption?: RegExp }[] = [
  {
    name: "USPS never loses",
    spec: { columns: ["SSSS", "SSSS"] },
    figure: "Never",
    lines: ["From 100 mi to 200 mi (zones 2–3), USPS Ground Advantage is cheapest at every weight up to 4 lb."],
    caption: /cheapest ground service at every weight from 1 lb to 4 lb/,
  },
  {
    name: "USPS loses at the lightest weight, then wins again",
    spec: { columns: ["UUSS"], vs: [{ ups: 1, fedex: null }] },
    figure: "1 lb",
    lines: ["At 100 mi (zone 2), UPS Ground wins from the lightest weight; USPS Ground Advantage is cheapest from 3 lb."],
  },
  {
    name: "winner flips back and forth, then USPS wins again",
    spec: { columns: ["SSUSUSS"], vs: [{ ups: 3, fedex: null }] },
    figure: "3 lb",
    lines: [
      "At 100 mi (zone 2), USPS Ground Advantage is cheapest up to 2 lb and again from 6 lb; between 3 lb and 5 lb UPS Ground mostly wins.",
    ],
  },
  {
    name: "vs_ups null, vs_fedex set",
    spec: { columns: ["SSFF"], vs: [{ ups: null, fedex: 3 }] },
    figure: "3 lb",
    lines: ["At 100 mi (zone 2), USPS Ground Advantage is cheapest up to 2 lb; beyond that FedEx Home Delivery wins."],
    caption: /from 3 lb at every distance, where FedEx Home Delivery takes over/,
  },
  {
    name: "vs_fedex null, vs_ups set",
    spec: { columns: ["SUUU"], vs: [{ ups: 2, fedex: null }] },
    figure: "2 lb",
    lines: ["At 100 mi (zone 2), USPS Ground Advantage is cheapest up to 1 lb; beyond that UPS Ground wins."],
  },
  {
    name: "three-way crossover: FedEx beats USPS pairwise first, but UPS is cheapest overall",
    spec: { columns: ["SSUUFF"], vs: [{ ups: 3, fedex: 2 }] },
    figure: "3 lb",
    lines: ["At 100 mi (zone 2), USPS Ground Advantage is cheapest up to 2 lb; beyond that UPS Ground or FedEx Home Delivery wins."],
    caption: /where UPS Ground takes over/,
  },
  {
    name: "a rival that beats USPS pairwise but never wins overall is not named",
    spec: { columns: ["SSUU"], vs: [{ ups: 3, fedex: 3 }] },
    figure: "3 lb",
    lines: ["At 100 mi (zone 2), USPS Ground Advantage is cheapest up to 2 lb; beyond that UPS Ground wins."],
    caption: /where UPS Ground takes over\.$/,
  },
  {
    name: "earliest crossing names only the distances where it happens",
    spec: { columns: ["SSSS", "SSFF", "SFFF"] },
    figure: "2 lb",
    lines: [
      "At 100 mi (zone 2), USPS Ground Advantage is cheapest at every weight up to 4 lb.",
      "At 200 mi (zone 3), USPS Ground Advantage is cheapest up to 2 lb; beyond that FedEx Home Delivery wins.",
      "At 300 mi (zone 4), USPS Ground Advantage is cheapest up to 1 lb; beyond that FedEx Home Delivery wins.",
    ],
    caption: /from 2 lb at 300 mi, where FedEx Home Delivery takes over/,
  },
  {
    name: "business delivery names FedEx Ground",
    spec: { columns: ["SSFF"], residential: false },
    figure: "3 lb",
    lines: ["At 100 mi (zone 2), USPS Ground Advantage is cheapest up to 2 lb; beyond that FedEx Ground wins."],
    caption: /cheapest business delivery from 3 lb/,
  },
  {
    name: "2027: FedEx only",
    spec: { columns: ["FF", "FF"], year: 2027, carriers: ["fedex"] },
    figure: "FedEx only",
    lines: [],
    caption: /USPS has no 2027 prices/,
  },
];

describe("readout", () => {
  it.each(cases)("$name", ({ spec, figure, lines, caption }) => {
    const r = readout(grid(spec), mockMeta);
    expect(r.figure).toBe(figure);
    expect(r.lines).toEqual(lines);
    if (caption) expect(r.caption).toMatch(caption);
  });

  it("names every carrier in a sentence only if it wins a cell in that column", () => {
    const r = readout(grid({ columns: ["SSUUFF", "SSUUUU"], vs: [{ ups: 3, fedex: 2 }, { ups: 3, fedex: 3 }] }), mockMeta);
    expect(r.lines[1]).not.toMatch(/FedEx/);
  });

  it("reports no USPS when the year has none, without a breakeven", () => {
    expect(readout(grid({ columns: ["FU"], year: 2027, carriers: ["fedex", "ups"] }), mockMeta)).toMatchObject({
      figure: "No USPS",
      noUsps: true,
    });
  });
});

  const onKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent<SVGSVGElement>) => {
    const { r, c } = active;
    const map: Record<string, [number, number] | undefined> = {
      ArrowUp: [r - 1, c],
      ArrowDown: [r + 1, c],
      ArrowLeft: [r, c - 1],
      ArrowRight: [r, c + 1],
      PageUp: [r - 10, c],
      PageDown: [r + 10, c],
      Home: e.ctrlKey ? [0, 0] : [r, 0],
      End: e.ctrlKey ? [rows - 1, cols - 1] : [r, cols - 1],
    };
    if (e.key === "Escape") {
      setPinned(false);
      setFocused(false);
      return;
    }
    const to = map[e.key];
    if (!to) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    setFocused(true);
    moveTo(to[0], to[1]);
  };

  const boundaries: string[] = [];
  const rivalEdges: string[] = [];
  const edge = (a: Carrier | undefined, b: Carrier | undefined) => (a === "usps" || b === "usps" ? boundaries : rivalEdges);
  for (let r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
    for (let c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
      const here = grid[r]?.[c]?.winner?.carrier;
      const right = grid[r]?.[c + 1]?.winner?.carrier;
      const below = grid[r + 1]?.[c]?.winner?.carrier;
      const x = AXIS_W + c * colW;
      const y = HEAD_H + r * rowH;
      if (c + 1 < cols && here !== right) edge(here, right).push(`M${x + colW},${y}v${rowH}`);
      if (r + 1 < rows && here !== below) edge(here, below).push(`M${x},${y + rowH}h${colW}`);

export function decorations(

import { useId, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import type { BreakevenResponse, Meta } from "../../api/types";
import { CARRIERS } from "../../api/types";
import { CARRIER_NAME, formatInt, formatUsd } from "../../lib/format";
import { cellGrid, groundName, zoneLabel } from "./readout";

/**
 * The map as a plain table, one distance band at a time: every carrier's total per weight, the
 * cheapest and its saving. Carries at least what the heatmap tooltip carries.
 */
export function BreakevenTable({ res, meta, id }: { res: BreakevenResponse; meta: Meta | null; id: string }) {
  const grid = useMemo(() => cellGrid(res), [res]);
  const [col, setCol] = useState(0);
  const uid = useId();
  const carriers = CARRIERS.filter((c) => res.cells.some((x) => x.totals[c] !== undefined));
  const band = res.breakeven_weight_lb[col];
  const zones = band ? zoneLabel(band.zone_usps, band.zone_private) : "";
  const distance = res.distances_miles[col] ?? 0;

  return (
    <div className="hmt" id={id}>
      <div className="hmt__pick">
        <label className="control__label" htmlFor={`${uid}-band`}>
          Distance
        </label>
        <select id={`${uid}-band`} className="select" value={col} onChange={(e) => setCol(Number(e.target.value))}>
          {res.distances_miles.map((d, c) => {
            const b = res.breakeven_weight_lb[c];
            return (
              <option key={d} value={c}>
                {formatInt(d)} mi, {b ? zoneLabel(b.zone_usps, b.zone_private) : ""}
              </option>
            );
          })}
        </select>
      </div>
      <div className="hmt__scroll">
        <table className="hmt__table">
          <caption>
            Ground prices at {formatInt(distance)} mi ({zones}), {res.residential ? "home" : "business"} delivery, {res.year}.
          </caption>
          <thead>
            <tr>
              <th scope="col">Weight</th>
              {carriers.map((c) => (
                <th key={c} scope="col" className="num">
                  {groundName(meta, c, res.residential)}
                </th>
              ))}
              <th scope="col">Cheapest</th>
              <th scope="col" className="num">
                Saving
              </th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            {res.weights_lb.map((w, r) => {
              const cell = grid[r]?.[col] ?? null;
              const win = cell?.winner?.carrier;
              return (
                <tr key={w}>
                  <th scope="row">{w} lb</th>
                  {carriers.map((c) => {
                    const t = cell?.totals[c];
                    return (
                      <td key={c} className={`num ${win === c ? "hmt__win" : ""}`}>
                        {t === undefined ? "—" : formatUsd(t)}
                      </td>
                    );
                  })}
                  <td className={win ? `hmt__who hmt__who--${win}` : undefined}>{win ? CARRIER_NAME[win] : "none"}</td>
                  <td className="num">
                    {cell?.runner_up ? `${formatUsd(cell.saving)} vs ${CARRIER_NAME[cell.runner_up.carrier]}` : "—"}
                  </td>
                </tr>
              );
            })}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

57	    """The highest minimum billable weight among the applied surcharge rules

67	def quote_service(
68	    tables: RateTables, service: Service, parcel: Parcel, controls: Controls, year: int | None = None
69	) -> Quote:
70	    year = controls.year if year is None else year
71	    carrier = service.carrier
72	    as_of = resolve_as_of(tables, carrier, year, controls)
73	    if as_of is None:
74	        return _unavailable(service, f"{carrier.upper()} has no {year} price list")
75	
76	    if parcel.residential and not service.residential_allowed:
77	        return _unavailable(service, f"{service.display_name} serves business addresses only", as_of=as_of)
78	    if not parcel.residential and not service.business_allowed:
79	        return _unavailable(service, f"{service.display_name} serves residential addresses only", as_of=as_of)

82	    if zone is None:
83	        return _unavailable(service, "distance is outside every zone band", as_of=as_of)
84	
85	    rate_card = rate_card_for(service, controls)
86	    steps = tables.rate_steps(carrier, service.service_id, rate_card, year, zone)
87	    if not steps:

89	            service, f"no {year} {rate_card} prices for {service.display_name}", zone=zone, as_of=as_of
90	        )

93	    measured = measure(parcel, dim_rule)
94	    dim = float(measured.dim_weight) if measured.dim_weight is not None else None
95	    step = tables.find_step(steps, measured.weight)
96	    if step is None:
97	        return _unavailable(
98	            service,
99	            f"billable weight {_fmt_weight(measured.weight)} lb is above the heaviest published "
100	            f"price ({_fmt_weight(steps[-1].max_weight_lb)} lb)",
101	            zone=zone,
102	            as_of=as_of,
103	            dim=dim,
104	        )
105	    billable = step.max_weight_lb
106	    base_price = money(step.price)
107	
108	    def surcharges_at(weight: Decimal, price: Decimal):
109	        return match_surcharges(
110	            tables,
111	            service=service,
112	            year=year,
113	            rate_card=rate_card,
114	            zone=zone,

117	            parcel=parcel,
118	            controls=controls,

120	            base_price=price,
121	        )
122	
123	    applied = surcharges_at(billable, base_price)
124	    base_label = f"{service.display_name} base rate (zone {zone}, {_fmt_weight(billable)} lb)"
125	    raising = minimum_billable(applied)
126	    if raising is not None and raising[0] > billable:
127	        minimum, setter = raising
128	        raised = tables.find_step(steps, minimum)
129	        if raised is None:

131	                service,
132	                f"the {_fmt_weight(minimum)} lb minimum billable weight of the {setter.display_name} is above "
133	                f"the heaviest published price ({_fmt_weight(steps[-1].max_weight_lb)} lb)",
134	                zone=zone,
135	                as_of=as_of,
136	                dim=dim,
137	            )
138	        step = raised
139	        billable = step.max_weight_lb
140	        base_price = money(step.price)
141	        # Re-match at the raised weight: percent amounts and weight bands follow the new base.
142	        applied = surcharges_at(billable, base_price)
143	        base_label = (
144	            f"{service.display_name} base rate (zone {zone}), billed at the {_fmt_weight(minimum)} lb "
145	            f"minimum of the {setter.display_name}"
146	        )
147	
148	    items: list[LineItem] = [
149	        LineItem(

152	            amount=base_price,

154	        )
155	    ]

172	    if pct is not None:

177	                amount=money(fuel_basis * pct / Decimal(100)),
178	                source=fuel_source,
179	            )

181	
182	    total = sum((li.amount for li in items), ZERO)
183	    return Quote(

199	def quote_all(tables: RateTables, parcel: Parcel, controls: Controls) -> list[Quote]:
200	    """Every service of every carrier that publishes prices for the year,
201	    sorted by total within the parcel's tier first, then the other tiers."""
202	    quotes = [
203	        quote_service(tables, s, parcel, controls)
204	        for s in tables.services.values()
205	        if (s.carrier, controls.year) in tables.base_effective
206	    ]
207	    tier_rank = {t: i for i, t in enumerate(TIERS)}
208	
209	    def key(q: Quote):
210	        return (
211	            q.tier != parcel.speed,
212	            tier_rank.get(q.tier, 99),
213	            not q.available,
214	            q.total,
215	        )
216	
217	    return sorted(quotes, key=key)

223	        if not q.available:

225	        best = result.get(q.tier)
226	        if best is None or q.total < best.total:
227	            result[q.tier] = q

233	) -> Quote | None:

235	    best: Quote | None = None
