"""Quote one parcel for one service, and for every service of every carrier."""

from __future__ import annotations

from decimal import Decimal

from .rules import (
    fuel_percent,
    match_surcharges,
    measure,
    resolve_as_of,
    resolve_dim_rule,
    source_label,
    zone_for,
)
from .tables import TIERS, RateTables, Service
from .types import Controls, LineItem, Parcel, Quote, money

ZERO = Decimal("0")


def rate_card_for(service: Service, controls: Controls) -> str:
    """USPS uses the dashboard control; UPS and FedEx publish one card."""
    if controls.usps_rate_card in service.rate_cards:
        return controls.usps_rate_card
    return service.rate_cards[0]


def price_charged(parcel: Parcel, controls: Controls) -> Decimal:
    value = parcel.price_charged if parcel.price_charged is not None else controls.flat_price
    return Decimal(str(value))


def _fmt_weight(w: Decimal) -> str:
    return f"{w.normalize():f}"


def _unavailable(service: Service, reason: str, zone=None, as_of=None, billable=None, dim=None) -> Quote:
    return Quote(
        carrier=service.carrier,
        service_id=service.service_id,
        service_name=service.display_name,
        tier=service.tier,
        zone=zone,
        billable_weight_lb=billable,
        dim_weight_lb=dim,
        line_items=(),
        total=ZERO,
        margin=ZERO,
        available=False,
        unavailable_reason=reason,
        as_of=as_of,
    )


def quote_service(
    tables: RateTables, service: Service, parcel: Parcel, controls: Controls, year: int | None = None
) -> Quote:
    year = controls.year if year is None else year
    carrier = service.carrier
    as_of = resolve_as_of(tables, carrier, year, controls)
    if as_of is None:
        return _unavailable(service, f"{carrier.upper()} has no {year} price list")

    if parcel.residential and not service.residential_allowed:
        return _unavailable(service, f"{service.display_name} serves business addresses only", as_of=as_of)
    if not parcel.residential and not service.business_allowed:
        return _unavailable(service, f"{service.display_name} serves residential addresses only", as_of=as_of)

    zone = zone_for(tables, carrier, parcel.distance_miles)
    if zone is None:
        return _unavailable(service, "distance is outside every zone band", as_of=as_of)

    rate_card = rate_card_for(service, controls)
    steps = tables.rate_steps(carrier, service.service_id, rate_card, year, zone)
    if not steps:
        return _unavailable(
            service, f"no {year} {rate_card} prices for {service.display_name}", zone=zone, as_of=as_of
        )

    dim_rule = resolve_dim_rule(tables, carrier, year, as_of)
    measured = measure(parcel, dim_rule)
    dim = float(measured.dim_weight) if measured.dim_weight is not None else None
    step = tables.find_step(steps, measured.weight)
    if step is None:
        return _unavailable(
            service,
            f"billable weight {_fmt_weight(measured.weight)} lb is above the heaviest published "
            f"price ({_fmt_weight(steps[-1].max_weight_lb)} lb)",
            zone=zone,
            as_of=as_of,
            dim=dim,
        )
    billable = step.max_weight_lb
    base_price = money(step.price)

    items: list[LineItem] = [
        LineItem(
            kind="base",
            label=f"{service.display_name} base rate (zone {zone}, {_fmt_weight(billable)} lb)",
            amount=base_price,
            source=source_label(step.source_file, step.source_ref),
        )
    ]
    applied = match_surcharges(
        tables,
        service=service,
        year=year,
        rate_card=rate_card,
        zone=zone,
        billable=billable,
        measured=measured,
        parcel=parcel,
        controls=controls,
        as_of=as_of,
        base_price=base_price,
    )
    fuel_basis = base_price
    for rule, amount in applied:
        items.append(
            LineItem(
                kind="surcharge",
                label=rule.display_name,
                amount=amount,
                surcharge_id=rule.surcharge_id,
                source=source_label(rule.source_file, rule.source_page),
                condition=rule.condition,
            )
        )
        if rule.fuel_applies:
            fuel_basis += amount

    pct, fuel_source = fuel_percent(tables, carrier, year, service, controls.fuel_override_percent)
    if pct is not None:
        items.append(
            LineItem(
                kind="fuel",
                label=f"Fuel Surcharge ({_fmt_weight(pct)}%)",
                amount=money(fuel_basis * pct / Decimal(100)),
                source=fuel_source,
            )
        )

    total = sum((li.amount for li in items), ZERO)
    return Quote(
        carrier=carrier,
        service_id=service.service_id,
        service_name=service.display_name,
        tier=service.tier,
        zone=zone,
        billable_weight_lb=float(billable),
        dim_weight_lb=dim,
        line_items=tuple(items),
        total=total,
        margin=price_charged(parcel, controls) - total,
        available=True,
        as_of=as_of,
    )


def quote_all(tables: RateTables, parcel: Parcel, controls: Controls) -> list[Quote]:
    """Every service of every carrier that publishes prices for the year,
    sorted by total within the parcel's tier first, then the other tiers."""
    quotes = [
        quote_service(tables, s, parcel, controls)
        for s in tables.services.values()
        if (s.carrier, controls.year) in tables.base_effective
    ]
    tier_rank = {t: i for i, t in enumerate(TIERS)}

    def key(q: Quote):
        return (
            q.tier != parcel.speed,
            tier_rank.get(q.tier, 99),
            not q.available,
            q.total,
        )

    return sorted(quotes, key=key)


def cheapest_by_tier(quotes: list[Quote]) -> dict[str, Quote | None]:
    result: dict[str, Quote | None] = {t: None for t in TIERS}
    for q in quotes:
        if not q.available:
            continue
        best = result.get(q.tier)
        if best is None or q.total < best.total:
            result[q.tier] = q
    return result


def cheapest_for_carrier(
    tables: RateTables, carrier: str, tier: str, parcel: Parcel, controls: Controls, year: int | None = None
) -> Quote | None:
    """Cheapest available service of one carrier in one tier, or None."""
    best: Quote | None = None
    for service in tables.services_for(carrier, tier):
        q = quote_service(tables, service, parcel, controls, year=year)
        if q.available and (best is None or q.total < best.total):
            best = q
    return best

"""Parcel segments used by the segment filter and the yearly driver breakdown.

Band labels and edges come from docs/API.md ("Segments"). Zone bands use the
USPS zone of the parcel's distance, the finest of the carriers' band tables.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass

from .rules import zone_for
from .tables import RateTables
from .types import Parcel

# (label, lower bound exclusive, upper bound inclusive)
WEIGHT_BANDS: tuple[tuple[str, float, float], ...] = (
    ("≤1", 0.0, 1.0),
    ("1–5", 1.0, 5.0),
    ("5–10", 5.0, 10.0),
    ("10–20", 10.0, 20.0),
    ("20–70", 20.0, 70.0),
)
ZONE_BANDS: tuple[tuple[str, int, int], ...] = (
    ("1–2", 1, 2),
    ("3–4", 3, 4),
    ("5–6", 5, 6),
    ("7–8", 7, 8),
)
SEGMENT_CARRIER = "usps"
DIMENSIONS = ("weight_band", "zone_band", "residential", "speed")


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class SegmentFilter:
    weight_band: str | None = None
    zone_band: str | None = None
    residential: bool | None = None
    speed: str | None = None


def weight_band(parcel: Parcel) -> str:
    for label, low, high in WEIGHT_BANDS:
        if low < parcel.weight_lb <= high:
            return label
    return WEIGHT_BANDS[-1][0]


def zone_band(tables: RateTables, parcel: Parcel) -> str:
    zone = zone_for(tables, SEGMENT_CARRIER, parcel.distance_miles)
    for label, low, high in ZONE_BANDS:
        if zone is not None and low <= zone <= high:
            return label
    return ZONE_BANDS[-1][0]


def residential_label(parcel: Parcel) -> str:
    return "residential" if parcel.residential else "business"


def segment_of(tables: RateTables, parcel: Parcel) -> dict[str, str]:
    return {
        "weight_band": weight_band(parcel),
        "zone_band": zone_band(tables, parcel),
        "residential": residential_label(parcel),
        "speed": parcel.speed,
    }


def matches(tables: RateTables, parcel: Parcel, f: SegmentFilter | None) -> bool:
    if f is None:
        return True
    if f.weight_band is not None and weight_band(parcel) != f.weight_band:
        return False
    if f.zone_band is not None and zone_band(tables, parcel) != f.zone_band:
        return False
    if f.residential is not None and parcel.residential != f.residential:
        return False
    if f.speed is not None and parcel.speed != f.speed:
        return False
    return True

```

"""Question 3: blended cost per parcel per carrier for a parcel mix."""

from __future__ import annotations

from decimal import Decimal

from .quote import cheapest_for_carrier, price_charged
from .segments import SegmentFilter, matches
from .tables import RateTables
from .types import Controls, Parcel, Quote, Totals

ZERO = Decimal("0")


def _r(value: Decimal, places: str = "0.01") -> float:
    from decimal import ROUND_HALF_UP

    return float(value.quantize(Decimal(places), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP))


def _share(part: Decimal, whole: Decimal) -> float:
    return _r(part / whole, "0.0001") if whole else 0.0


def summarize(t: Totals, unavailable: int = 0) -> dict:
    n = Decimal(t.parcels) if t.parcels else None

    def per(x: Decimal) -> float:
        return _r(x / n) if n else 0.0

    by_condition = [
        {
            "condition": cond,
            "total": _r(amount),
            "per_parcel": per(amount),
            "share_of_cost": _share(amount, t.total),
        }
        for cond, amount in sorted(t.by_condition.items(), key=lambda kv: -kv[1])
    ]
    return {
        "parcels_shipped": t.parcels,
        "parcels_unavailable": unavailable,
        "total_cost": _r(t.total),
        "cost_per_parcel": per(t.total),
        "split": {
            "base": {"per_parcel": per(t.base), "total": _r(t.base), "share": _share(t.base, t.total)},
            "surcharges": {
                "per_parcel": per(t.surcharges),
                "total": _r(t.surcharges),
                "share": _share(t.surcharges, t.total),
            },
            "fuel": {"per_parcel": per(t.fuel), "total": _r(t.fuel), "share": _share(t.fuel, t.total)},
        },
        "surcharges_by_condition": by_condition,
        "margin_per_parcel": per(t.margin),
        "total_margin": _r(t.margin),
        "loss_share": round(t.loss_parcels / t.parcels, 4) if t.parcels else 0.0,
        "parcels_at_loss": t.loss_parcels,
    }


def per_parcel_quotes(
    tables: RateTables, carrier: str, parcels: list[Parcel], controls: Controls, year: int | None = None
) -> list[Quote | None]:
    """Each parcel at the carrier's cheapest available service in its tier."""
    return [cheapest_for_carrier(tables, carrier, p.speed, p, controls, year=year) for p in parcels]


def blended(
    tables: RateTables,
    parcels: list[Parcel],
    controls: Controls,
    segment: SegmentFilter | None = None,
) -> dict:
    selected = [p for p in parcels if matches(tables, p, segment)]
    carriers = [c for c in tables.carriers() if (c, controls.year) in tables.base_effective]

    quotes_by_carrier: dict[str, list[Quote | None]] = {}
    results = []
    for carrier in carriers:
        quotes = per_parcel_quotes(tables, carrier, selected, controls)
        quotes_by_carrier[carrier] = quotes
        totals = Totals()
        unavailable = 0
        services: dict[str, int] = {}
        for parcel, q in zip(selected, quotes):
            if q is None:
                unavailable += parcel.quantity
                continue
            totals.add(q, parcel.quantity)
            services[q.service_id] = services.get(q.service_id, 0) + parcel.quantity
        results.append({"carrier": carrier, **summarize(totals, unavailable), "services_used": services})

    best = Totals()
    best_unavailable = 0
    counts: dict[str, int] = {c: 0 for c in carriers}
    for i, parcel in enumerate(selected):
        options = [quotes_by_carrier[c][i] for c in carriers if quotes_by_carrier[c][i] is not None]
        if not options:
            best_unavailable += parcel.quantity
            continue
        q = min(options, key=lambda x: x.total)
        best.add(q, parcel.quantity)
        counts[q.carrier] += parcel.quantity

    revenue = sum((price_charged(p, controls) * p.quantity for p in selected), ZERO)
    n = sum(p.quantity for p in selected)
    return {
        "year": controls.year,
        "parcels_considered": n,
        "revenue_per_parcel": _r(revenue / n) if n else 0.0,
        "carriers": results,
        "best_mix": {**summarize(best, best_unavailable), "parcels_by_carrier": counts},
    }

```

"""Question 4: blended cost per parcel year over year, against the announced
increase, with the parcel segments that drove the change."""

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import replace
from decimal import ROUND_HALF_UP, Decimal

from .blended import per_parcel_quotes, summarize
from .segments import DIMENSIONS, segment_of
from .tables import RateTables
from .types import Controls, Parcel, Quote, Totals

ZERO = Decimal("0")
CENT = Decimal("0.01")


def _r(value: Decimal, places: str = "0.01") -> float:
    return float(value.quantize(Decimal(places), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP))


def allocate_cents(values: dict[str, Decimal], total: Decimal) -> dict[str, float]:
    """Round each value to cents so the rounded values still add up to the
    rounded total (largest remainder)."""
    target = total.quantize(CENT, rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP)
    floors = {k: (v / CENT).to_integral_value(rounding="ROUND_FLOOR") for k, v in values.items()}
    remainder = int(target / CENT - sum(floors.values()))
    order = sorted(values, key=lambda k: (values[k] / CENT - floors[k]), reverse=True)
    if remainder < 0:
        order = list(reversed(order))
    step = 1 if remainder >= 0 else -1
    for k in order[: abs(remainder)]:
        floors[k] += step
    return {k: float(floors[k] * CENT) for k in values}


def announced_increase(tables: RateTables, carrier: str, year: int, services_used: list[str], usps_card: str) -> dict:
    rows = [
        r
        for r in tables.increases
        if r.carrier == carrier and r.year == year and r.rate_card in ("", "list", usps_card)
    ]
    overall = [r for r in rows if r.product_scope == "all"]
    if overall:
        r = overall[0]
        return {
            "percent": float(r.percent),
            "basis": "all",
            "services": [],
            "source_type": r.source_type,
        }
    scoped = [r for r in rows if r.product_scope in services_used]
    if not scoped:
        return {"percent": None, "basis": "none", "services": [], "source_type": None}
    avg = sum((r.percent for r in scoped), ZERO) / len(scoped)
    return {
        "percent": _r(avg, "0.01"),
        "basis": "average_of_services",
        "services": sorted({r.product_scope for r in scoped}),
        "source_type": ",".join(sorted({r.source_type for r in scoped})),
    }


def _drivers(
    tables: RateTables,
    parcels: list[Parcel],
    prev: list[Quote],
    cur: list[Quote],
    n: int,
) -> dict[str, list[dict]]:
    total_change = sum(((c.total - p.total) * x.quantity for x, p, c in zip(parcels, prev, cur)), ZERO)
    out: dict[str, list[dict]] = {}
    segs = [segment_of(tables, p) for p in parcels]
    for dim in DIMENSIONS:
        change: dict[str, Decimal] = {}
        count: dict[str, int] = {}
        for x, s, p, c in zip(parcels, segs, prev, cur):
            key = s[dim]
            change[key] = change.get(key, ZERO) + (c.total - p.total) * x.quantity
            count[key] = count.get(key, 0) + x.quantity
        per_parcel = {k: v / n for k, v in change.items()}
        rounded = allocate_cents(per_parcel, total_change / n)
        out[dim] = [
            {
                "segment": k,
                "parcels": count[k],
                "change_per_parcel": rounded[k],
                "change_total": _r(change[k]),
            }
            for k in sorted(change, key=lambda k: -abs(change[k]))
        ]
    return out


def yearly(
    tables: RateTables,
    parcels: list[Parcel],
    controls: Controls,
    next_year_increase_percent: float | None = None,
) -> dict:
    result = []
    for carrier in tables.carriers():
        years = tables.years_for(carrier)
        per_year: dict[int, list[Quote | None]] = {}
        for y in years:
            cy = replace(controls, year=y, as_of=None)
            per_year[y] = per_parcel_quotes(tables, carrier, parcels, cy, year=y)

        # Like-for-like: only parcels the carrier can ship in every year.
        keep = [i for i in range(len(parcels)) if all(per_year[y][i] is not None for y in years)]
        used = [parcels[i] for i in keep]
        n = sum(p.quantity for p in used)
        excluded = sum(p.quantity for p in parcels) - n

        rows = []
        prev_y: int | None = None
        prev_cost: Decimal | None = None
        for y in years:
            quotes = [per_year[y][i] for i in keep]
            totals = Totals()
            for p, q in zip(used, quotes):
                totals.add(q, p.quantity)
            cost = totals.total / n if n else ZERO
            services = sorted({q.service_id for q in quotes})
            row = {
                "year": y,
                "as_of": quotes[0].as_of.isoformat() if quotes else None,
                "cost_per_parcel": _r(cost),
                "summary": summarize(totals),
                "services_used": services,
                "change_vs_previous": None,
                "announced_increase": announced_increase(
                    tables, carrier, y, services, controls.usps_rate_card
                ),
                "drivers": None,
            }
            if prev_y is not None and n:
                diff = cost - prev_cost
                row["change_vs_previous"] = {
                    "from_year": prev_y,
                    "dollars_per_parcel": _r(diff),
                    "percent": _r(diff / prev_cost * 100, "0.01") if prev_cost else None,
                }
                prev_quotes = [per_year[prev_y][i] for i in keep]
                row["drivers"] = _drivers(tables, used, prev_quotes, quotes, n)
            rows.append(row)
            prev_y, prev_cost = y, cost

        projected = None
        if next_year_increase_percent is not None and rows and n:
            last = rows[-1]
            factor = Decimal(1) + Decimal(str(next_year_increase_percent)) / Decimal(100)
            projected = {
                "year": last["year"] + 1,
                "increase_percent": next_year_increase_percent,
                "cost_per_parcel": _r(prev_cost * factor),
            }
        result.append(
            {
                "carrier": carrier,
                "parcels_used": n,
                "parcels_excluded": excluded,
                "years": rows,
                "projected": projected,
            }
        )
    return {"carriers": result}

```

```
"""Question 2: USPS vs UPS / FedEx ground breakeven by weight and distance."""

from __future__ import annotations

from decimal import Decimal

from .quote import cheapest_for_carrier
from .rules import zone_for
from .tables import RateTables
from .types import Controls, Parcel, Quote

GROUND = "ground"
USPS = "usps"
PRIVATE = ("ups", "fedex")
# docs/API.md: the open-ended last band is sampled this far past the
# previous band's upper edge.
LAST_BAND_OFFSET_MILES = 200


def default_weights(tables: RateTables) -> list[float]:
    """1 lb steps up to the lowest ground-service weight limit (70 lb)."""
    limit = min(s.max_weight_lb for s in tables.services.values() if s.tier == GROUND)
    return [float(w) for w in range(1, limit + 1)]


def default_distances(tables: RateTables) -> list[float]:
    """One distance per USPS zone band: the midpoint, or for the open-ended
    last band the previous band's upper edge plus LAST_BAND_OFFSET_MILES."""
    out: list[float] = []
    prev_max = 0
    for band in tables.zone_bands.get(USPS, []):
        if band.max_miles is None:
            out.append(float(prev_max + LAST_BAND_OFFSET_MILES))
        else:
            out.append(float((band.min_miles + band.max_miles) // 2))
            prev_max = band.max_miles
    return out


def _pick(q: Quote) -> dict:
    return {"carrier": q.carrier, "service_id": q.service_id, "total": float(q.total)}


def breakeven(
    tables: RateTables,
    controls: Controls,
    residential: bool,
    weights_lb: list[float] | None = None,
    distances_miles: list[float] | None = None,
) -> dict:
    weights = sorted(weights_lb) if weights_lb else default_weights(tables)
    distances = sorted(distances_miles) if distances_miles else default_distances(tables)
    carriers = [c for c in tables.carriers() if (c, controls.year) in tables.base_effective]

    cells = []
    bands = []
    for d in distances:
        first_loss: dict[str, float | None] = {c: None for c in PRIVATE}
        for w in weights:
            parcel = Parcel(weight_lb=w, distance_miles=d, residential=residential, speed=GROUND)
            quotes = {
                c: q
                for c in carriers
                if (q := cheapest_for_carrier(tables, c, GROUND, parcel, controls)) is not None
            }
            ranked = sorted(quotes.values(), key=lambda q: q.total)
            usps = quotes.get(USPS)
            for c in PRIVATE:
                other = quotes.get(c)
                if usps and other and first_loss[c] is None and usps.total >= other.total:
                    first_loss[c] = w
            private_zone = next((q.zone for q in ranked if q.carrier != USPS), None)
            cells.append(
                {
                    "weight_lb": w,
                    "distance_miles": d,
                    "zone_usps": zone_for(tables, USPS, d),
                    "zone_private": private_zone if private_zone is not None else zone_for(tables, "ups", d),
                    "winner": _pick(ranked[0]) if ranked else None,
                    "runner_up": _pick(ranked[1]) if len(ranked) > 1 else None,
                    "saving": float(ranked[1].total - ranked[0].total) if len(ranked) > 1 else 0.0,
                    "totals": {q.carrier: float(q.total) for q in ranked},
                }
            )
        bands.append(
            {
                "distance_miles": d,
                "zone_usps": zone_for(tables, USPS, d),
                "zone_private": zone_for(tables, "ups", d),
                "vs_ups": first_loss["ups"],
                "vs_fedex": first_loss["fedex"],
            }
        )
    return {
        "year": controls.year,
        "residential": residential,
        "weights_lb": weights,

- `content`:

```
"""Generate backend/app/sample_parcels.csv, the bundled ILLUSTRATIVE parcel mix.

This is not real shipping data. It imitates a small online shop selling
apparel and home goods: mostly light parcels, some medium boxes, a few bulky
boxes that trigger dimensional weight, about 75 % residential and 85 % ground,
distances spread across every zone, a handful in delivery areas and a couple
with non-standard packaging. A fixed seed keeps the file reproducible:

    uv run --directory backend python scripts/make_sample_parcels.py
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import csv
import random
from pathlib import Path

SEED = 20261023
N = 200
OUT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "app" / "sample_parcels.csv"
COLUMNS = [
    "weight_lb",
    "length_in",
    "width_in",
    "height_in",
    "distance_miles",
    "residential",
    "speed",
    "quantity",
    "price_charged",
    "delivery_area",
    "nonstandard_packaging",
]

# (share, weight range lb, box sizes in inches) — illustrative product mix
PROFILES = [
    (0.62, (0.3, 5.0), [(10, 8, 2), (12, 9, 3), (12, 10, 4), (14, 10, 4), (10, 7, 5)]),  # apparel mailers
    (0.28, (5.0, 20.0), [(16, 12, 8), (18, 14, 8), (16, 16, 10), (20, 14, 10)]),  # home goods
    (0.10, (4.0, 18.0), [(24, 18, 16), (28, 20, 14), (30, 18, 18), (22, 22, 20)]),  # bulky boxes
]
# One distance range per USPS zone band (miles), sampled evenly.
DISTANCES = [(5, 50), (51, 150), (151, 300), (301, 600), (601, 1000), (1001, 1400), (1401, 1800), (1801, 2700)]


def _row(rng: random.Random) -> dict:
    r = rng.random()
    acc = 0.0
    for share, (wmin, wmax), boxes in PROFILES:
        acc += share
        if r <= acc:
            break
    weight = round(rng.uniform(wmin, wmax), 1)
    with_dims = rng.random() < 0.8 or share == PROFILES[2][0]
    length, width, height = rng.choice(boxes) if with_dims else ("", "", "")
    lo, hi = rng.choice(DISTANCES)
    speed_roll = rng.random()
    speed = "ground" if speed_roll < 0.85 else ("two_three_day" if speed_roll < 0.96 else "next_day")
    area_roll = rng.random()
    area = "das" if area_roll < 0.04 else ("extended" if area_roll < 0.06 else "none")
    return {
        "weight_lb": weight,
        "length_in": length,
        "width_in": width,
        "height_in": height,
        "distance_miles": rng.randint(lo, hi),
        "residential": "true" if rng.random() < 0.75 else "false",
        "speed": speed,
        "quantity": rng.choice([1, 1, 1, 1, 2, 3]),
        "price_charged": "" if rng.random() < 0.85 else rng.choice([7.99, 12.99, 14.99]),
        "delivery_area": area,
        "nonstandard_packaging": "false",
    }


def main() -> None:
    rng = random.Random(SEED)
    rows = [_row(rng) for _ in range(N)]
    for i in rng.sample(range(N), 2):
        rows[i]["nonstandard_packaging"] = "true"
    OUT.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with OUT.open("w", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        writer = csv.DictWriter(fh, fieldnames=COLUMNS)
        writer.writeheader()
        writer.writerows(rows)
    print(f"wrote {len(rows)} illustrative parcels to {OUT}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

```

```
"""Pydantic models for the API contract (docs/API.md).

These mirror frontend/src/api/types.ts. Field constraints double as the 422
messages a shop owner sees (see app/api/errors.py).
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import date
from typing import Literal

from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field, model_validator

Carrier = Literal["usps", "ups", "fedex"]
Tier = Literal["ground", "two_three_day", "next_day"]
DeliveryArea = Literal["none", "das", "extended"]
UspsRateCard = Literal["commercial", "retail"]
WeightBand = Literal["≤1", "1–5", "5–10", "10–20", "20–70"]
ZoneBand = Literal["1–2", "3–4", "5–6", "7–8"]

MAX_WEIGHT_LB = 70  # app cap from docs/API.md (USPS maximum); not a price
MAX_PARCELS = 10_000


# ---- requests -------------------------------------------------------------
class Parcel(BaseModel):
    weight_lb: float = Field(gt=0, le=MAX_WEIGHT_LB)
    length_in: float | None = Field(default=None, gt=0)
    width_in: float | None = Field(default=None, gt=0)
    height_in: float | None = Field(default=None, gt=0)
    distance_miles: float = Field(ge=0)
    residential: bool
    speed: Tier
    quantity: int = Field(default=1, ge=1)
    price_charged: float | None = Field(default=None, ge=0)
    delivery_area: DeliveryArea = "none"
    nonstandard_packaging: bool = False

    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def _all_or_no_dimensions(self) -> "Parcel":
        given = [v is not None for v in (self.length_in, self.width_in, self.height_in)]
        if any(given) and not all(given):
            raise ValueError("give length_in, width_in and height_in together, or none of them")
        return self


class FuelOverride(BaseModel):
    ground: float | None = Field(default=None, ge=0, le=100)
    express: float | None = Field(default=None, ge=0, le=100)


class Controls(BaseModel):
    year: int | None = Field(default=None, description="default: latest year with all three carriers")
    as_of: date | None = None
    usps_rate_card: UspsRateCard = "commercial"
    fuel_override_percent: FuelOverride | None = None
    peak: bool = False
    flat_price: float = Field(default=9.99, ge=0)


class SegmentFilter(BaseModel):
    weight_band: WeightBand | None = None
    zone_band: ZoneBand | None = None
    residential: bool | None = None
    speed: Tier | None = None


class QuoteRequest(BaseModel):
    parcel: Parcel
    controls: Controls = Field(default_factory=Controls)


class BreakevenRequest(BaseModel):
    controls: Controls = Field(default_factory=Controls)
    residential: bool = True
    weights_lb: list[float] | None = Field(default=None, min_length=1, max_length=200)
    distances_miles: list[float] | None = Field(default=None, min_length=1, max_length=50)

    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def _grid_in_range(self) -> "BreakevenRequest":
        for w in self.weights_lb or []:
            if not 0 < w <= MAX_WEIGHT_LB:
                raise ValueError(f"every weight in weights_lb must be above 0 and at most {MAX_WEIGHT_LB}")
        for d in self.distances_miles or []:
            if d < 0:
                raise ValueError("distances_miles cannot be negative")
        return self


class BlendedRequest(BaseModel):
    parcels: list[Parcel] = Field(min_length=1, max_length=MAX_PARCELS)
    controls: Controls = Field(default_factory=Controls)
    segment: SegmentFilter | None = None


class YearlyRequest(BaseModel):
    parcels: list[Parcel] = Field(min_length=1, max_length=MAX_PARCELS)
    controls: Controls = Field(default_factory=Controls)
    next_year_increase_percent: float | None = Field(default=None, ge=-50, le=100)


# ---- responses ------------------------------------------------------------
class Out(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")


class LineItem(Out):
    kind: Literal["base", "surcharge", "fuel"]
    label: str
    amount: float
    surcharge_id: str | None = None
    source: str | None = None
    condition: str | None = None


class Quote(Out):

    total: float
    margin: float
    available: bool
    unavailable_reason: str | None = None
    as_of: date | None = None


class Pick(Out):
    carrier: Carrier
    service_id: str
    total: float


class QuoteResponse(Out):
    quotes: list[Quote]
    cheapest_by_tier: dict[Tier, Pick | None]


class BreakevenCell(Out):
    weight_lb: float
    distance_miles: float
    zone_usps: int | None
    zone_private: int | None
    winner: Pick | None
    runner_up: Pick | None
    saving: float
    totals: dict[Carrier, float]


class BreakevenBand(Out):
    distance_miles: float
    zone_usps: int | None
    zone_private: int | None
    vs_ups: float | None
    vs_fedex: float | None


class BreakevenResponse(Out):

class SplitPart(Out):

class Split(Out):

class ConditionTotal(Out):

class Summary(Out):

class CarrierBlended(Summary):

class BestMix(Summary):

class BlendedResponse(Out):

"""422 responses written for a shop owner: {detail: [{loc, msg, type}]}."""

from __future__ import annotations

from fastapi import Request
from fastapi.encoders import jsonable_encoder
from fastapi.exceptions import RequestValidationError
from fastapi.responses import JSONResponse


def _num(value) -> str:
    if isinstance(value, float) and value.is_integer():
        return str(int(value))
    return str(value)


def _field(loc: tuple) -> str:
    names = [str(p) for p in loc if isinstance(p, str) and p not in ("body", "query")]
    return names[-1] if names else "request"


def _prefix(loc: tuple) -> str:
    parts = list(loc)
    if "parcels" in parts:
        i = parts.index("parcels")
        if i + 1 < len(parts) and isinstance(parts[i + 1], int):
            return f"Parcel {parts[i + 1] + 1}: "
    return ""


def friendly_message(error: dict) -> str:
    loc = tuple(error.get("loc", ()))
    kind = error.get("type", "")
    ctx = error.get("ctx") or {}
    field = _field(loc)
    messages = {
        "missing": f"{field} is required",
        "less_than_equal": f"{field} must be at most {_num(ctx.get('le'))}",
        "less_than": f"{field} must be less than {_num(ctx.get('lt'))}",
        "greater_than": f"{field} must be greater than {_num(ctx.get('gt'))}",
        "greater_than_equal": f"{field} must be at least {_num(ctx.get('ge'))}",
        "float_parsing": f"{field} must be a number",
        "float_type": f"{field} must be a number",
        "int_parsing": f"{field} must be a whole number",
        "int_type": f"{field} must be a whole number",
        "int_from_float": f"{field} must be a whole number",
        "bool_parsing": f"{field} must be true or false",
        "bool_type": f"{field} must be true or false",
        "literal_error": f"{field} must be one of {ctx.get('expected')}",
        "date_parsing": f"{field} must be a date like 2026-01-18",
        "date_from_datetime_parsing": f"{field} must be a date like 2026-01-18",
        "date_type": f"{field} must be a date like 2026-01-18",
        "too_short": f"{field} needs at least {ctx.get('min_length')} item(s)",
        "too_long": f"{field} can have at most {ctx.get('max_length')} items",
        "list_type": f"{field} must be a list",
        "model_type": f"{field} must be an object",
        "dict_type": f"{field} must be an object",
        "json_invalid": "the request body is not valid JSON",
        "extra_forbidden": f"{field} is not a known field",
    }
    if kind == "value_error":
        msg = str(error.get("msg", "")).removeprefix("Value error, ")
    else:
        msg = messages.get(kind, str(error.get("msg", "invalid value")))
    return _prefix(loc) + msg


async def validation_handler(_: Request, exc: RequestValidationError) -> JSONResponse:
    detail = [
        {"loc": list(e.get("loc", ())), "msg": friendly_message(e), "type": e.get("type", "")}
        for e in exc.errors()
    ]
    return JSONResponse(status_code=422, content=jsonable_encoder({"detail": detail}))


def invalid(loc: list, msg: str, kind: str = "value_error") -> RequestValidationError:
    """Build a 422 for checks that need the loaded data (e.g. unknown year)."""
    return RequestValidationError([{"loc": tuple(loc), "msg": msg, "type": kind}])

"""HTTP routes. Thin: validate, convert to engine types, call the engine."""

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import asdict

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Request

from app.engine import breakeven as be
from app.engine import segments as seg
from app.engine.blended import blended
from app.engine.quote import cheapest_by_tier, quote_all
from app.engine.tables import RateTables
from app.engine.types import Controls as EngineControls
from app.engine.types import FuelOverride as EngineFuel
from app.engine.types import Parcel as EngineParcel
from app.engine.types import Quote as EngineQuote
from app.engine.yearly import yearly

from . import models as m
from .errors import invalid

router = APIRouter(prefix="/api")

LIMITATIONS = [
    "List prices only: a shipper with a negotiated contract pays less.",
    "Zones are estimated from distance bands, not looked up from ZIP code pairs.",
    "The UPS fuel surcharge default is a proxy taken from FedEx's published history.",
    "UPS announced increases come from trade press, not from UPS itself.",
    "UPS peak (demand) surcharge documents for the 2025-26 and 2026-27 seasons are not in the sources, "
    "so UPS 2025 and 2026 peak quotes carry no peak charges.",
    "FedEx 2027 surcharges are incomplete (only the Home Delivery residential charge and January peak "
    "rows are recorded), so 2027 totals understate surcharges.",
    "Peak surcharges are modelled as a toggle that prices on December 10 of the year, not by ship date.",
]
SAMPLE_DESCRIPTION = (
    "Illustrative parcel mix for a small online shop selling apparel and home goods "
    "(generated by backend/scripts/make_sample_parcels.py with a fixed seed). Not real shipping data."
)


def get_tables(request: Request) -> RateTables:
    return request.app.state.tables


def default_year(tables: RateTables) -> int:
    common = set(tables.all_years())
    for carrier in tables.carriers():
        common &= set(tables.years_for(carrier))
    return max(common) if common else max(tables.all_years())


def to_controls(c: m.Controls, tables: RateTables, loc: list) -> EngineControls:
    year = c.year if c.year is not None else default_year(tables)
    years = tables.all_years()
    if year not in years:
        raise invalid(loc + ["year"], f"year must be one of {', '.join(map(str, years))}")
    fuel = None
    if c.fuel_override_percent is not None:
        fuel = EngineFuel(ground=c.fuel_override_percent.ground, express=c.fuel_override_percent.express)
    return EngineControls(
        year=year,
        as_of=c.as_of,
        usps_rate_card=c.usps_rate_card,
        fuel_override_percent=fuel,
        peak=c.peak,
        flat_price=c.flat_price,
    )


def to_parcel(p: m.Parcel) -> EngineParcel:
    return EngineParcel(**p.model_dump())


def quote_out(q: EngineQuote) -> dict:
    return {
        "carrier": q.carrier,
        "service_id": q.service_id,
        "service_name": q.service_name,
        "tier": q.tier,
        "zone": q.zone,
        "billable_weight_lb": q.billable_weight_lb,
        "dim_weight_lb": q.dim_weight_lb,
        "line_items": [
            {
                "kind": li.kind,
                "label": li.label,
                "amount": float(li.amount),
                "surcharge_id": li.surcharge_id,
                "source": li.source,
                "condition": li.condition,
            }
            for li in q.line_items
        ],
        "total": float(q.total),
        "margin": float(q.margin),
        "available": q.available,
        "unavailable_reason": q.unavailable_reason,
        "as_of": q.as_of,
    }


@router.get("/health")
def health() -> dict:
    return {"status": "ok"}


@router.get("/meta", response_model=m.MetaResponse)
def meta(tables: RateTables = Depends(get_tables)) -> dict:
    year = default_year(tables)
    return {
        "years": {c: tables.years_for(c) for c in tables.carriers()},
        "services": [
            {**asdict(s), "rate_cards": list(s.rate_cards)} for s in tables.services.values()
        ],
        "defaults": {
            "year": year,
            "usps_rate_card": "commercial",
            "peak": False,
            "flat_price": m.Controls().flat_price,
            "as_of": {c: tables.base_effective[(c, year)] for c in tables.carriers() if (c, year) in tables.base_effective},
        },
        "fuel_defaults": [
            {
                "carrier": f.carrier,
                "year": f.year,
                "service_group": f.service_group,
                "default_percent": float(f.default_percent),
                "is_proxy": f.is_proxy,
                "window_start": f.window_start,
                "window_end": f.window_end,
            }
            for f in sorted(tables.fuel.values(), key=lambda f: (f.carrier, f.year, f.service_group))
        ],
        "zone_bands": [
            {"carrier": b.carrier, "zone": b.zone, "min_miles": b.min_miles, "max_miles": b.max_miles}
            for c in tables.carriers()
            for b in tables.zone_bands.get(c, [])
        ],
        "segments": {
            "weight_bands": [b[0] for b in seg.WEIGHT_BANDS],
            "zone_bands": [b[0] for b in seg.ZONE_BANDS],
        },
        "limitations": LIMITATIONS,
    }


@router.get("/sample-parcels", response_model=m.SampleParcelsResponse)
def sample_parcels(request: Request) -> dict:
    return {"description": SAMPLE_DESCRIPTION, "parcels": request.app.state.sample_parcels}


@router.post("/quote", response_model=m.QuoteResponse)
def quote(body: m.QuoteRequest, tables: RateTables = Depends(get_tables)) -> dict:
    controls = to_controls(body.controls, tables, ["body", "controls"])
    quotes = quote_all(tables, to_parcel(body.parcel), controls)
    cheapest = cheapest_by_tier(quotes)
    return {
        "quotes": [quote_out(q) for q in quotes],
        "cheapest_by_tier": {
            tier: ({"carrier": q.carrier, "service_id": q.service_id, "total": float(q.total)} if q else None)
            for tier, q in cheapest.items()
        },
    }


@router.post("/breakeven", response_model=m.BreakevenResponse)
def breakeven(body: m.BreakevenRequest, tables: RateTables = Depends(get_tables)) -> dict:
    controls = to_controls(body.controls, tables, ["body", "controls"])
    return be.breakeven(tables, controls, body.residential, body.weights_lb, body.distances_miles)


@router.get("/breakeven", response_model=m.BreakevenResponse)
def breakeven_get(
    residential: bool = True,
    year: int | None = None,
    peak: bool = False,
    usps_rate_card: m.UspsRateCard = "commercial",
    tables: RateTables = Depends(get_tables),
) -> dict:
    """Convenience GET with default grid (issue #3 lists GET; docs/API.md uses POST)."""
    c = m.Controls(year=year, peak=peak, usps_rate_card=usps_rate_card)
    controls = to_controls(c, tables, ["query"])
    return be.breakeven(tables, controls, residential)


@router.post("/blended", response_model=m.BlendedResponse)
def blended_route(body: m.BlendedRequest, tables: RateTables = Depends(get_tables)) -> dict:
    controls = to_controls(body.controls, tables, ["body", "controls"])
    segment = seg.SegmentFilter(**body.segment.model_dump()) if body.segment else None
    return blended(tables, [to_parcel(p) for p in body.parcels], controls, segment)


@router.post("/yearly", response_model=m.YearlyResponse)
def yearly_route(body: m.YearlyRequest, tables: RateTables = Depends(get_tables)) -> dict:
    controls = to_controls(body.controls, tables, ["body", "controls"])
    return yearly(tables, [to_parcel(p) for p in body.parcels], controls, body.next_year_increase_percent)

"""FastAPI application: loads the rate tables once and serves /api."""

from __future__ import annotations

import csv
import os
from contextlib import asynccontextmanager
from pathlib import Path

from fastapi import FastAPI
from fastapi.exceptions import RequestValidationError
from fastapi.middleware.cors import CORSMiddleware

from app.api.errors import validation_handler
from app.api.models import Parcel
from app.api.routes import router
from app.engine.tables import RateTables, load_tables

REPO_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
DEFAULT_DATA_DIR = REPO_ROOT / "data" / "processed"
SAMPLE_PARCELS_CSV = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "sample_parcels.csv"
DEV_ORIGINS = ["http://localhost:5173"]


def data_dir() -> Path:
    return Path(os.environ.get("DATA_DIR") or DEFAULT_DATA_DIR)


def load_sample_parcels(path: Path = SAMPLE_PARCELS_CSV) -> list[dict]:
    with path.open(newline="", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        rows = list(csv.DictReader(fh))
    parcels = []
    for r in rows:
        clean = {k: v for k, v in r.items() if v not in ("", None)}
        parcels.append(Parcel.model_validate(clean).model_dump(exclude_none=True))
    return parcels


def create_app(tables: RateTables | None = None) -> FastAPI:
    @asynccontextmanager
    async def lifespan(app: FastAPI):
        if getattr(app.state, "tables", None) is None:
            app.state.tables = load_tables(data_dir())
        yield

    app = FastAPI(title="Parcel rates API", version="0.1.0", lifespan=lifespan)
    app.state.tables = tables
    app.state.sample_parcels = load_sample_parcels()
    app.add_middleware(
        CORSMiddleware,
        allow_origins=DEV_ORIGINS,
        allow_methods=["GET", "POST"],
        allow_headers=["*"],
    )
    app.add_exception_handler(RequestValidationError, validation_handler)
    app.include_router(router)
    return app


app = create_app()

from __future__ import annotations

import csv
import math
from decimal import ROUND_HALF_UP, Decimal
from pathlib import Path

import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

from app.engine.tables import RateTables, load_tables
from app.main import DEFAULT_DATA_DIR, create_app

DATA = DEFAULT_DATA_DIR


@pytest.fixture(scope="session")
def tables() -> RateTables:
    return load_tables(DATA)


@pytest.fixture(scope="session")
def client(tables):
    with TestClient(create_app(tables)) as c:
        yield c


# ---- independent CSV helpers for hand computation -------------------------
def read_csv(rel: str) -> list[dict[str, str]]:
    with (DATA / rel).open(newline="", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        return list(csv.DictReader(fh))


def only(rows: list[dict], **where) -> dict:
    hits = [r for r in rows if all(r[k] == v for k, v in where.items())]
    assert len(hits) == 1, f"expected one row for {where}, got {len(hits)}"
    return hits[0]


def zone_from_csv(carrier: str, miles: float) -> int:
    for r in read_csv("zone_from_distance.csv"):
        if r["carrier"] != carrier:
            continue
        hi = float(r["max_miles"]) if r["max_miles"] else math.inf
        if float(r["min_miles"]) <= miles <= hi:
            return int(r["zone"])
    raise AssertionError("no zone")


def cents(x: Decimal) -> Decimal:
    return x.quantize(Decimal("0.01"), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP)


# ---- synthetic dataset ------------------------------------------------------
SERVICE_COLS = dict(rate_card_notes="", max_weight_lb="70", notes="")


def synthetic_tables(surcharges=(), fuel=None) -> RateTables:
    """Two services, one zone, weights 1-3 lb; amounts chosen by the test."""
    services = [
        dict(carrier="ups", service_id="ups_ground", display_name="UPS Ground", tier="ground",
             residential_allowed="true", business_allowed="true", rate_cards="list", **SERVICE_COLS),
        dict(carrier="usps", service_id="usps_ground_advantage", display_name="USPS Ground Advantage",
             tier="ground", residential_allowed="true", business_allowed="true",
             rate_cards="retail,commercial", **SERVICE_COLS),
    ]
    zones = [
        dict(carrier="ups", zone="2", min_miles="0", max_miles=""),
        dict(carrier="usps", zone="2", min_miles="0", max_miles=""),
    ]
    base = []
    for carrier, sid, card in (("ups", "ups_ground", "list"), ("usps", "usps_ground_advantage", "commercial")):
        for w, price in (("1", "10.00"), ("2", "12.00"), ("3", "14.50")):
            base.append(dict(carrier=carrier, service_id=sid, rate_card=card, year="2030",
                             effective_date="2030-01-01", zone="2", max_weight_lb=w, price=price,
                             source_file=f"{carrier}/x.pdf", source_ref="3"))
    if fuel is None:
        fuel = [dict(carrier="ups", year="2030", service_group="ground", default_percent="12.50",
                     is_proxy="false", window_start="", window_end="", source_file="ups/f.html", source_ref="")]
    dims = [dict(carrier=c, year="2030", effective_from="2030-01-01", effective_to="", divisor="139",
                 min_volume_cuin="0", rounding="round each dimension to the nearest whole inch",
                 source_file="", source_ref="") for c in ("ups", "usps")]
    return RateTables.from_rows(services=services, zones=zones, base_rates=base,
                                surcharges=list(surcharges), dim_weight=dims, fuel=fuel)


def rule(**kw) -> dict:
    base = dict(carrier="ups", year="2030", rate_card="", surcharge_id="s", display_name="S",
                condition="residential", applies_to="all", address_type="any", min_weight_lb="",
                max_weight_lb="", min_length_in="", min_width_in="", min_length_plus_girth_in="",
                min_volume_cuft="", zone_min="", zone_max="", amount="1.00", unit="usd",
                exclusive_group="g", effective_from="2030-01-01", effective_to="", fuel_applies="false",
                source_file="ups/s.pdf", source_page="7")
    base.update(kw)
    return base

"""Quotes computed by hand from the CSV rows, one per carrier.

Each test looks the rows up in data/processed with the csv module (not with
the engine's loader) and rebuilds the line items independently.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import math
from decimal import Decimal

from app.engine.quote import quote_service
from app.engine.types import Controls, Parcel
from tests.conftest import cents, only, read_csv, zone_from_csv


def _price(carrier, service_id, card, year, zone, weight) -> Decimal:
    rows = read_csv(f"{carrier}/base_rates.csv")
    candidates = [
        r for r in rows
        if r["service_id"] == service_id and r["rate_card"] == card and r["year"] == str(year)
        and r["zone"] == str(zone) and Decimal(r["max_weight_lb"]) >= weight
    ]
    return Decimal(min(candidates, key=lambda r: Decimal(r["max_weight_lb"]))["price"])


def _fuel(carrier, year, group) -> Decimal:
    return Decimal(only(read_csv(f"{carrier}/fuel_surcharge.csv"), year=str(year), service_group=group)["default_percent"])


def _amounts(quote):
    return [(li.kind, li.surcharge_id, li.amount) for li in quote.line_items]


def test_usps_ground_advantage_by_hand(tables):
    parcel = Parcel(weight_lb=2.3, distance_miles=400, residential=True, speed="ground")
    zone = zone_from_csv("usps", 400)
    expected_base = _price("usps", "usps_ground_advantage", "commercial", 2026, zone, Decimal("2.3"))

    q = quote_service(tables, tables.services["usps_ground_advantage"], parcel, Controls(year=2026))

    assert q.zone == zone
    assert q.billable_weight_lb == 3.0
    assert _amounts(q) == [("base", None, expected_base)]
    assert q.total == expected_base
    assert q.margin == Decimal("9.99") - expected_base


def test_usps_retail_card_and_ounce_steps(tables):
    parcel = Parcel(weight_lb=0.3, distance_miles=20, residential=False, speed="ground")
    zone = zone_from_csv("usps", 20)
    expected = _price("usps", "usps_ground_advantage", "retail", 2025, zone, Decimal("0.3"))
    q = quote_service(tables, tables.services["usps_ground_advantage"], parcel,
                      Controls(year=2025, usps_rate_card="retail"))
    assert q.billable_weight_lb == 0.5
    assert q.total == expected


def test_ups_ground_residential_das_with_dim_weight_by_hand(tables):
    parcel = Parcel(weight_lb=4.2, length_in=12, width_in=10, height_in=8, distance_miles=700,
                    residential=True, speed="ground", delivery_area="das")
    zone = zone_from_csv("ups", 700)
    dim_row = only(read_csv("ups/dim_weight.csv"), year="2026")
    dim_weight = math.ceil(12 * 10 * 8 / int(dim_row["divisor"]))  # dims already whole inches
    billable = max(math.ceil(4.2), dim_weight)
    base = _price("ups", "ups_ground", "list", 2026, zone, Decimal(billable))
    sur = read_csv("ups/surcharges.csv")
    res = only(sur, year="2026", condition="residential", applies_to="ups_ground")
    das = only(sur, year="2026", condition="delivery_area", applies_to="ups_ground", address_type="residential")
    flagged = base + sum(Decimal(r["amount"]) for r in (res, das) if r["fuel_applies"] == "true")
    fuel = cents(flagged * _fuel("ups", 2026, "ground") / 100)

    q = quote_service(tables, tables.services["ups_ground"], parcel, Controls(year=2026))

    assert q.dim_weight_lb == dim_weight
    assert q.billable_weight_lb == billable
    assert _amounts(q) == [
        ("base", None, base),
        ("surcharge", res["surcharge_id"], Decimal(res["amount"])),
        ("surcharge", das["surcharge_id"], Decimal(das["amount"])),
        ("fuel", None, fuel),
    ]
    assert q.total == base + Decimal(res["amount"]) + Decimal(das["amount"]) + fuel
    assert q.line_items[1].label == res["display_name"]
    assert q.line_items[1].source == f"{res['source_file'].rsplit('/', 1)[-1]} p.{res['source_page']}"


def test_fedex_ground_business_additional_handling_by_hand(tables):
    parcel = Parcel(weight_lb=10, length_in=50, width_in=10, height_in=10, distance_miles=900,
                    residential=False, speed="ground")
    zone = zone_from_csv("fedex", 900)
    dim_row = only(read_csv("fedex/dim_weight.csv"), year="2025")
    billable = max(10, math.ceil(50 * 10 * 10 / int(dim_row["divisor"])))
    base = _price("fedex", "fedex_ground", "list", 2025, zone, Decimal(billable))
    # Longest side 50 > 48: additional handling (length), zone 5-6, January window.
    ah = [
        r for r in read_csv("fedex/surcharges.csv")
        if r["year"] == "2025" and r["condition"] == "additional_handling_length" and r["min_length_in"] == "48"
        and int(r["zone_min"]) <= zone <= int(r["zone_max"]) and r["effective_from"] == "2025-01-06"
    ]
    assert len(ah) == 1
    ah = ah[0]
    fuel = cents((base + Decimal(ah["amount"])) * _fuel("fedex", 2025, "ground") / 100)

    q = quote_service(tables, tables.services["fedex_ground"], parcel, Controls(year=2025))

    assert q.billable_weight_lb == billable
    assert _amounts(q) == [
        ("base", None, base),
        ("surcharge", ah["surcharge_id"], Decimal(ah["amount"])),
        ("fuel", None, fuel),
    ]
    assert q.total == base + Decimal(ah["amount"]) + fuel


def test_no_dimensions_means_no_dim_weight_or_dimension_surcharges(tables):
    parcel = Parcel(weight_lb=10, distance_miles=900, residential=False, speed="ground")
    q = quote_service(tables, tables.services["fedex_ground"], parcel, Controls(year=2025))
    assert q.dim_weight_lb is None
    assert [li.kind for li in q.line_items] == ["base", "fuel"]


def test_unknown_year_for_carrier_is_unavailable(tables):
    parcel = Parcel(weight_lb=1, distance_miles=10, residential=False, speed="ground")
    q = quote_service(tables, tables.services["ups_ground"], parcel, Controls(year=2027))
    assert not q.available and "2027" in q.unavailable_reason


def test_billable_weight_above_table_is_unavailable(tables):
    parcel = Parcel(weight_lb=20, length_in=40, width_in=30, height_in=20, distance_miles=10,
                    residential=False, speed="ground")
    q = quote_service(tables, tables.services["ups_ground"], parcel, Controls(year=2026))
    assert not q.available and "heaviest published price" in q.unavailable_reason


def test_usps_dim_weight_is_capped_at_the_70_lb_price(tables):
    parcel = Parcel(weight_lb=20, length_in=40, width_in=30, height_in=20, distance_miles=10,
                    residential=False, speed="ground")
    q = quote_service(tables, tables.services["usps_ground_advantage"], parcel, Controls(year=2026))
    assert q.available and q.dim_weight_lb == 70 and q.billable_weight_lb == 70

```

"""Fuel, exclusive groups, peak gating and time-varying rules."""

from __future__ import annotations

import math
from datetime import date
from decimal import Decimal

from app.engine.quote import quote_service
from app.engine.rules import resolve_dim_rule, zone_for
from app.engine.types import Controls, FuelOverride, Parcel
from tests.conftest import cents, read_csv, rule, synthetic_tables

HOME = Parcel(weight_lb=1.5, distance_miles=10, residential=True, speed="ground", delivery_area="das")


def _items(q):
    return {li.surcharge_id or li.kind: li.amount for li in q.line_items}


# ---- fuel (docs/data/SCHEMA.md "Engine tests for fuel") --------------------
def _fuel_tables():
    return synthetic_tables(
        surcharges=[
            rule(surcharge_id="res", condition="residential", address_type="residential", amount="3.10",
                 exclusive_group="res", fuel_applies="true"),
            rule(surcharge_id="das", condition="delivery_area", amount="2.05", exclusive_group="das",
                 fuel_applies="false"),
        ]
    )


def test_fuel_applies_to_base_plus_flagged_surcharges_only():
    t = _fuel_tables()
    q = quote_service(t, t.services["ups_ground"], HOME, Controls(year=2030))
    items = _items(q)
    assert items["base"] == Decimal("12.00") and items["res"] == Decimal("3.10") and items["das"] == Decimal("2.05")
    assert items["fuel"] == cents(Decimal("0.125") * (Decimal("12.00") + Decimal("3.10")))  # 1.89
    assert q.total == Decimal("12.00") + Decimal("3.10") + Decimal("2.05") + items["fuel"]


def test_fuel_override_replaces_yearly_default():
    t = _fuel_tables()
    q = quote_service(t, t.services["ups_ground"], HOME,
                      Controls(year=2030, fuel_override_percent=FuelOverride(ground=20)))
    assert _items(q)["fuel"] == cents(Decimal("0.20") * Decimal("15.10"))
    assert q.line_items[-1].source == "fuel override"
    # an override for the other group leaves the default in place
    q2 = quote_service(t, t.services["ups_ground"], HOME,
                       Controls(year=2030, fuel_override_percent=FuelOverride(express=50)))
    assert _items(q2)["fuel"] == cents(Decimal("0.125") * Decimal("15.10"))


def test_usps_has_no_fuel_line_even_with_override():
    t = _fuel_tables()
    q = quote_service(t, t.services["usps_ground_advantage"], HOME,
                      Controls(year=2030, fuel_override_percent=FuelOverride(ground=30)))
    assert all(li.kind != "fuel" for li in q.line_items)


def test_usps_real_quotes_have_no_fuel_line(tables):
    for sid in ("usps_ground_advantage", "usps_priority_mail", "usps_priority_mail_express"):
        q = quote_service(tables, tables.services[sid], HOME, Controls(year=2026))
        assert q.available and all(li.kind != "fuel" for li in q.line_items)


def test_carrier_without_fuel_row_for_year_gets_no_fuel_line():
    t = synthetic_tables(fuel=[dict(carrier="ups", year="2029", service_group="ground", default_percent="9",
                                    is_proxy="true", window_start="", window_end="", source_file="", source_ref="")])
    q = quote_service(t, t.services["ups_ground"], HOME, Controls(year=2030))
    assert all(li.kind != "fuel" for li in q.line_items)


# ---- exclusive groups ------------------------------------------------------
def test_same_exclusive_group_keeps_only_the_highest():
    t = synthetic_tables(surcharges=[
        rule(surcharge_id="low", condition="additional_handling_weight", min_weight_lb="1", amount="5.00",
             exclusive_group="handling"),
        rule(surcharge_id="high", condition="additional_handling_packaging", amount="9.00",
             exclusive_group="handling"),
        rule(surcharge_id="other", condition="residential", amount="1.00", exclusive_group="res"),
    ])
    parcel = Parcel(weight_lb=2, distance_miles=5, residential=True, speed="ground", nonstandard_packaging=True)
    q = quote_service(t, t.services["ups_ground"], parcel, Controls(year=2030))
    ids = [li.surcharge_id for li in q.line_items if li.kind == "surcharge"]
    assert ids == ["high", "other"]


def test_percent_surcharge_applies_to_base_rate():
    t = synthetic_tables(surcharges=[
        rule(surcharge_id="pct", condition="transportation_time_limited", amount="8", unit="percent",
             exclusive_group="t"),
    ])
    q = quote_service(t, t.services["usps_ground_advantage"], HOME, Controls(year=2030))
    assert _items(q)["pct"] == cents(Decimal("12.00") * Decimal("0.08"))


def test_rule_filters_address_rate_card_service_zone_and_window():
    t = synthetic_tables(surcharges=[
        rule(surcharge_id="biz", address_type="commercial", exclusive_group="a"),
        rule(surcharge_id="retail_only", rate_card="retail", exclusive_group="b"),
        rule(surcharge_id="air", applies_to="air", exclusive_group="c"),
        rule(surcharge_id="far", zone_min="5", exclusive_group="d"),
        rule(surcharge_id="old", effective_to="2029-12-31", exclusive_group="e"),
        rule(surcharge_id="ground", applies_to="ground", exclusive_group="f"),
        rule(surcharge_id="listed", applies_to="usps_ground_advantage,ups_ground", exclusive_group="g"),
    ])
    q = quote_service(t, t.services["ups_ground"], HOME, Controls(year=2030))
    assert [li.surcharge_id for li in q.line_items if li.kind == "surcharge"] == ["ground", "listed"]


def test_dimension_thresholds():
    t = synthetic_tables(surcharges=[
        rule(surcharge_id="len", condition="additional_handling_length", min_length_in="48", exclusive_group="1"),
        rule(surcharge_id="wid", condition="additional_handling_width", min_width_in="30", exclusive_group="2"),
        rule(surcharge_id="girth", condition="oversize", min_length_plus_girth_in="105", exclusive_group="3"),
        rule(surcharge_id="vol", condition="nonstandard_volume", min_volume_cuft="2", exclusive_group="4"),
    ])
    small = Parcel(weight_lb=1, length_in=48, width_in=30, height_in=2, distance_miles=1, residential=False,
                   speed="ground")
    assert [li.kind for li in quote_service(t, t.services["usps_ground_advantage"], small,
                                            Controls(year=2030)).line_items] == ["base"]
    # 49 x 31 x 20: longest > 48, second > 30, L+G = 49 + 2*51 = 151 > 105, 30380 cu in > 2 cu ft
    big = Parcel(weight_lb=1, length_in=20, width_in=49, height_in=31, distance_miles=1, residential=False,
                 speed="ground")
    q = quote_service(t, t.services["usps_ground_advantage"], big, Controls(year=2030))
    # dim weight pushes billable past the 3 lb table: unavailable
    assert not q.available


# ---- peak ------------------------------------------------------------------
def test_peak_add_ons_only_with_the_charge_they_add_to():
    t = synthetic_tables(surcharges=[
        rule(surcharge_id="ah", condition="additional_handling_packaging", amount="20.00", exclusive_group="h"),
        rule(surcharge_id="peak_ah", condition="peak_additional_handling", amount="5.00", exclusive_group="ph"),
        rule(surcharge_id="peak_os", condition="peak_oversize", amount="50.00", exclusive_group="po"),
        rule(surcharge_id="peak_res", condition="peak_residential", address_type="residential",
             amount="0.50", exclusive_group="pr"),
    ])
    plain = Parcel(weight_lb=1, distance_miles=1, residential=True, speed="ground")
    odd = Parcel(weight_lb=1, distance_miles=1, residential=True, speed="ground", nonstandard_packaging=True)
    ids = lambda q: [li.surcharge_id for li in q.line_items if li.kind == "surcharge"]  # noqa: E731
    peak = Controls(year=2030, peak=True)
    assert ids(quote_service(t, t.services["ups_ground"], plain, peak)) == ["peak_res"]
    assert ids(quote_service(t, t.services["ups_ground"], odd, peak)) == ["ah", "peak_ah", "peak_res"]
    assert ids(quote_service(t, t.services["ups_ground"], odd, Controls(year=2030))) == ["ah"]


def test_peak_moves_as_of_to_december_10(tables):
    parcel = Parcel(weight_lb=2, distance_miles=700, residential=True, speed="ground")
    q = quote_service(tables, tables.services["fedex_home_delivery"], parcel, Controls(year=2026, peak=True))
    assert q.as_of == date(2026, 12, 10)
    peak_rows = [
        r for r in read_csv("fedex/surcharges.csv")
        if r["year"] == "2026" and r["condition"] == "peak_residential"
        and r["effective_from"] <= "2026-12-10" <= (r["effective_to"] or "9999")
    ]
    assert len(peak_rows) == 1
    items = {li.surcharge_id: li.amount for li in q.line_items}
    assert items[peak_rows[0]["surcharge_id"]] == Decimal(peak_rows[0]["amount"])
    off = quote_service(tables, tables.services["fedex_home_delivery"], parcel, Controls(year=2026))
    assert peak_rows[0]["surcharge_id"] not in {li.surcharge_id for li in off.line_items}


def test_peak_rows_outside_their_window_do_not_apply(tables):
    # The 2025-labelled UPS peak rows cover the 2024-25 season only.
    parcel = Parcel(weight_lb=2, distance_miles=700, residential=True, speed="ground")
    q = quote_service(tables, tables.services["ups_ground"], parcel, Controls(year=2025, peak=True))
    assert not any(li.condition and li.condition.startswith("peak_") for li in q.line_items)
    q24 = quote_service(tables, tables.services["ups_ground"], parcel, Controls(year=2024, peak=True))
    assert any(li.condition == "peak_residential" for li in q24.line_items)


def test_usps_2026_transportation_increase_by_window(tables):
    parcel = Parcel(weight_lb=2, distance_miles=700, residential=True, speed="ground")
    sid = "usps_ground_advantage"
    jan = quote_service(tables, tables.services[sid], parcel, Controls(year=2026))
    assert [li.kind for li in jan.line_items] == ["base"]
    may = quote_service(tables, tables.services[sid], parcel, Controls(year=2026, as_of=date(2026, 5, 1)))
    row = [r for r in read_csv("usps/surcharges.csv") if r["condition"] == "transportation_time_limited"][0]
    base = may.line_items[0].amount
    assert may.line_items[1].surcharge_id == row["surcharge_id"]
    assert may.line_items[1].amount == cents(base * Decimal(row["amount"]) / 100)


# ---- dimensional weight over time -------------------------------------------
def _usps_divisor(as_of: str) -> int:
    rows = [r for r in read_csv("usps/dim_weight.csv") if r["year"] == "2026"
            and r["effective_from"] <= as_of <= (r["effective_to"] or "9999")]
    assert len(rows) == 1
    return int(rows[0]["divisor"])


def test_usps_2026_dim_divisor_changes_on_july_12(tables):
    parcel = Parcel(weight_lb=1, length_in=15, width_in=15, height_in=12, distance_miles=700,
                    residential=True, speed="ground")
    svc = tables.services["usps_ground_advantage"]
    jan = quote_service(tables, svc, parcel, Controls(year=2026))
    jul = quote_service(tables, svc, parcel, Controls(year=2026, as_of=date(2026, 7, 12)))
    assert _usps_divisor("2026-01-18") == 166 and _usps_divisor("2026-07-12") == 139
    assert resolve_dim_rule(tables, "usps", 2026, date(2026, 7, 11)).divisor == 166
    assert jan.dim_weight_lb == math.ceil(15 * 15 * 12 / 166)
    assert jul.dim_weight_lb == math.ceil(15 * 15 * 12 / 139)


def test_usps_dim_weight_only_above_minimum_volume(tables):
    parcel = Parcel(weight_lb=1, length_in=12, width_in=12, height_in=12, distance_miles=700,
                    residential=True, speed="ground")  # exactly 1728 cu in
    q = quote_service(tables, tables.services["usps_ground_advantage"], parcel, Controls(year=2026))
    assert q.dim_weight_lb is None


def test_ups_2026_rounds_fractional_dimensions_up_but_2025_rounds_to_nearest(tables):
    parcel = Parcel(weight_lb=1, length_in=12.2, width_in=10.2, height_in=8.2, distance_miles=700,
                    residential=False, speed="ground")
    svc = tables.services["ups_ground"]
    q25 = quote_service(tables, svc, parcel, Controls(year=2025))
    q26 = quote_service(tables, svc, parcel, Controls(year=2026))
    assert q25.dim_weight_lb == math.ceil(12 * 10 * 8 / 139)  # 7
    assert q26.dim_weight_lb == math.ceil(13 * 11 * 9 / 139)  # 10


def test_zone_bands(tables):
    assert zone_for(tables, "usps", 0) == 1
    assert zone_for(tables, "usps", 50.5) == 2  # between integer bands: next band up
    assert zone_for(tables, "ups", 25) == 2
    assert zone_for(tables, "fedex", 5000) == 8
    assert zone_for(tables, "nobody", 10) is None


# ---- availability -----------------------------------------------------------
def test_fedex_ground_business_only_and_home_delivery_residential_only(tables):
    home = Parcel(weight_lb=2, distance_miles=300, residential=True, speed="ground")
    office = Parcel(weight_lb=2, distance_miles=300, residential=False, speed="ground")
    g = quote_service(tables, tables.services["fedex_ground"], home, Controls(year=2026))
    hd = quote_service(tables, tables.services["fedex_home_delivery"], office, Controls(year=2026))
    assert not g.available and "business" in g.unavailable_reason
    assert not hd.available and "residential" in hd.unavailable_reason
    assert quote_service(tables, tables.services["fedex_ground"], office, Controls(year=2026)).available
    assert quote_service(tables, tables.services["fedex_home_delivery"], home, Controls(year=2026)).available

"""Breakeven, blended and yearly views."""

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import replace
from decimal import Decimal

import pytest

from app.engine import segments as seg
from app.engine.blended import blended
from app.engine.breakeven import breakeven, default_distances, default_weights
from app.engine.quote import cheapest_for_carrier
from app.engine.types import Controls, Parcel
from app.engine.yearly import allocate_cents, announced_increase, yearly
from app.main import load_sample_parcels


@pytest.fixture(scope="module")
def sample():
    return [Parcel(**p) for p in load_sample_parcels()]


# ---- breakeven ---------------------------------------------------------------
def test_default_grid(tables):
    assert default_weights(tables) == [float(w) for w in range(1, 71)]
    d = default_distances(tables)
    assert len(d) == len(tables.zone_bands["usps"])
    assert d[0] == 25 and d[-1] == 2000  # last band: previous upper edge (1800) + 200


def test_usps_wins_light_and_near_residential(tables):
    r = breakeven(tables, Controls(year=2026), residential=True, weights_lb=[1, 2], distances_miles=[25, 100])
    for cell in r["cells"]:
        assert cell["winner"]["carrier"] == "usps"
        assert cell["saving"] >= 0
        assert cell["zone_usps"] in (1, 2)


def test_some_band_has_a_finite_breakeven(tables):
    for residential in (True, False):
        r = breakeven(tables, Controls(year=2026), residential=residential)
        assert len(r["cells"]) == 70 * 8
        finite = [b for b in r["breakeven_weight_lb"] if b["vs_ups"] is not None or b["vs_fedex"] is not None]
        assert finite, "USPS should lose to UPS or FedEx somewhere on the grid"
        for b in finite:
            cell = next(c for c in r["cells"] if c["distance_miles"] == b["distance_miles"]
                        and c["weight_lb"] == (b["vs_ups"] or b["vs_fedex"]))
            other = "ups" if b["vs_ups"] is not None else "fedex"
            assert cell["totals"]["usps"] >= cell["totals"][other]


def test_breakeven_uses_home_delivery_for_residential(tables):
    r = breakeven(tables, Controls(year=2026), residential=True, weights_lb=[60], distances_miles=[2000])
    picks = {r["cells"][0]["winner"]["service_id"], r["cells"][0]["runner_up"]["service_id"]}
    assert "fedex_ground" not in picks


# ---- blended -----------------------------------------------------------------
def test_blended_totals_equal_sum_of_per_parcel_quotes(tables, sample):
    controls = Controls(year=2026)
    r = blended(tables, sample, controls)
    for row in r["carriers"]:
        total = Decimal(0)
        for p in sample:
            q = cheapest_for_carrier(tables, row["carrier"], p.speed, p, controls)
            total += q.total * p.quantity
        assert row["total_cost"] == float(total)
        split = row["split"]
        assert abs(split["base"]["total"] + split["surcharges"]["total"] + split["fuel"]["total"]
                   - row["total_cost"]) < 0.011
        assert abs(sum(c["total"] for c in row["surcharges_by_condition"]) - split["surcharges"]["total"]) < 0.05
        assert row["parcels_shipped"] == sum(p.quantity for p in sample)
        assert 0 <= row["loss_share"] <= 1
    best = r["best_mix"]
    assert best["cost_per_parcel"] <= min(c["cost_per_parcel"] for c in r["carriers"])
    assert sum(best["parcels_by_carrier"].values()) == best["parcels_shipped"]


def test_blended_margin_uses_price_charged_over_flat_price(tables):
    p1 = Parcel(weight_lb=1, distance_miles=10, residential=False, speed="ground", price_charged=100)
    p2 = Parcel(weight_lb=1, distance_miles=10, residential=False, speed="ground")
    r = blended(tables, [p1, p2], Controls(year=2026, flat_price=0))
    usps = next(c for c in r["carriers"] if c["carrier"] == "usps")
    cost = float(cheapest_for_carrier(tables, "usps", "ground", p1, Controls(year=2026)).total)
    assert usps["margin_per_parcel"] == round((100 - cost + 0 - cost) / 2, 2)
    assert usps["loss_share"] == 0.5
    assert r["revenue_per_parcel"] == 50


def test_blended_segment_filter(tables, sample):
    f = seg.SegmentFilter(weight_band="1–5", residential=True, speed="ground")
    r = blended(tables, sample, Controls(year=2026), f)
    expected = sum(p.quantity for p in sample if seg.matches(tables, p, f))
    assert r["parcels_considered"] == expected > 0
    for z in ("1–2", "3–4", "5–6", "7–8"):
        assert blended(tables, sample, Controls(year=2026), seg.SegmentFilter(zone_band=z))["parcels_considered"] > 0


def test_blended_reports_unshippable_parcels(tables):
    huge = Parcel(weight_lb=20, length_in=40, width_in=30, height_in=20, distance_miles=10,
                  residential=False, speed="ground")
    r = blended(tables, [huge], Controls(year=2026))
    ups = next(c for c in r["carriers"] if c["carrier"] == "ups")
    assert ups["parcels_unavailable"] == 1 and ups["parcels_shipped"] == 0 and ups["cost_per_parcel"] == 0
    assert r["best_mix"]["parcels_by_carrier"]["usps"] == 1


def test_segments_cover_every_band(tables):
    assert seg.weight_band(Parcel(weight_lb=0.5, distance_miles=1, residential=True, speed="ground")) == "≤1"
    assert seg.weight_band(Parcel(weight_lb=70, distance_miles=1, residential=True, speed="ground")) == "20–70"
    assert seg.zone_band(tables, Parcel(weight_lb=1, distance_miles=5000, residential=True, speed="ground")) == "7–8"


# ---- yearly ------------------------------------------------------------------
def test_yearly_drivers_sum_to_total_change(tables, sample):
    r = yearly(tables, sample, Controls(year=2026), next_year_increase_percent=4)
    by_carrier = {c["carrier"]: c for c in r["carriers"]}
    assert [y["year"] for y in by_carrier["ups"]["years"]] == tables.years_for("ups")
    assert 2027 in [y["year"] for y in by_carrier["fedex"]["years"]]
    for c in r["carriers"]:
        rows = c["years"]
        assert rows[0]["change_vs_previous"] is None and rows[0]["drivers"] is None
        for prev, row in zip(rows, rows[1:]):
            change = row["change_vs_previous"]["dollars_per_parcel"]
            assert abs((row["cost_per_parcel"] - prev["cost_per_parcel"]) - change) <= 0.011
            for dim in ("weight_band", "zone_band", "residential", "speed"):
                contributions = sum(d["change_per_parcel"] for d in row["drivers"][dim])
                assert abs(contributions - change) <= 0.01, (c["carrier"], row["year"], dim)
        last = rows[-1]["cost_per_parcel"]
        assert c["projected"]["year"] == rows[-1]["year"] + 1
        assert abs(c["projected"]["cost_per_parcel"] - last * 1.04) <= 0.011


def test_yearly_cost_equals_blended_for_each_year(tables, sample):
    r = yearly(tables, sample, Controls(year=2026))
    for c in r["carriers"]:
        assert c["parcels_excluded"] == 0
        for row in c["years"]:
            b = blended(tables, sample, Controls(year=row["year"]))
            match = next(x for x in b["carriers"] if x["carrier"] == c["carrier"])
            assert row["cost_per_parcel"] == match["cost_per_parcel"]


def test_yearly_peak_prices_on_december_10(tables, sample):
    r = yearly(tables, sample[:20], Controls(year=2026, peak=True))
    for c in r["carriers"]:
        for row in c["years"]:
            assert row["as_of"] == f"{row['year']}-12-10"


def test_announced_increase_prefers_all_then_averages_services(tables):
    ups = announced_increase(tables, "ups", 2026, ["ups_ground"], "commercial")
    assert ups["basis"] == "all" and ups["percent"] == 5.9 and ups["source_type"] == "secondary"
    usps = announced_increase(tables, "usps", 2026, ["usps_ground_advantage", "usps_priority_mail"], "commercial")
    assert usps["basis"] == "average_of_services"
    assert usps["percent"] == round((7.8 + 6.6) / 2, 2)
    card = announced_increase(tables, "usps", 2023, ["usps_ground_advantage"], "retail")
    assert card["percent"] == -3.2
    none = announced_increase(tables, "usps", 2019, ["usps_ground_advantage"], "retail")
    assert none["percent"] is None and none["basis"] == "none"


def test_yearly_warns_when_a_year_lacks_surcharge_rules(tables, sample):
    r = yearly(tables, sample[:10], Controls(year=2026))
    fedex = next(c for c in r["carriers"] if c["carrier"] == "fedex")
    y27 = next(y for y in fedex["years"] if y["year"] == 2027)
    assert y27["warnings"] and "delivery_area" in y27["warnings"][0]
    assert all(not y["warnings"] for y in fedex["years"] if y["year"] < 2027)


def test_allocate_cents_keeps_the_rounded_sum():
    values = {"a": Decimal("0.333"), "b": Decimal("0.333"), "c": Decimal("0.334")}
    out = allocate_cents(values, sum(values.values()))
    assert round(sum(out.values()), 2) == 1.0
    neg = {"a": Decimal("-0.335"), "b": Decimal("-0.335")}
    assert round(sum(allocate_cents(neg, sum(neg.values())).values()), 2) == -0.67


def test_fuel_override_applies_to_every_year(tables, sample):
    controls = replace(Controls(year=2026), fuel_override_percent=None)
    from app.engine.types import FuelOverride

    over = yearly(tables, sample[:5], replace(controls, fuel_override_percent=FuelOverride(ground=0, express=0)))
    ups = next(c for c in over["carriers"] if c["carrier"] == "ups")
    assert all(y["summary"]["split"]["fuel"]["total"] == 0 for y in ups["years"])

```
