/**
 * Typed mock responses for tests and the `?mock=1` dev mode.
 *
 * Shapes follow ./types.ts. The numbers come from a small toy price formula,
 * shaped to resemble published list prices (USPS cheap when light, UPS/FedEx
 * catching up with weight, residential surcharges on private carriers). They
 * are NOT real prices and must never be shown without the mock banner.
 */
import type {
  BlendedCarrier,
  BlendedRequest,
  BlendedResponse,
  BreakevenCell,
  BreakevenRequest,
  BreakevenResponse,
  Carrier,
  CarrierPick,
  Controls,
  FuelDefault,
  LineItem,
  Meta,
  Parcel,
  Quote,
  QuoteRequest,
  QuoteResponse,
  SampleParcels,
  ServiceInfo,
  Tier,
  YearlyRequest,
  YearlyResponse,
  ZoneBand,
} from "./types";
import { CARRIERS, TIERS } from "./types";

const round2 = (n: number) => Math.round(n * 100) / 100;

export const mockDefaultControls: Controls = {
  year: 2026,
  usps_rate_card: "commercial",
  peak: false,
  flat_price: 9.99,
};

const services: ServiceInfo[] = [
  ["usps", "usps_ground_advantage", "USPS Ground Advantage", "ground", true, true],
  ["usps", "usps_priority_mail", "Priority Mail", "two_three_day", true, true],
  ["usps", "usps_priority_mail_express", "Priority Mail Express", "next_day", true, true],
  ["ups", "ups_ground", "UPS Ground", "ground", true, true],
  ["ups", "ups_3_day_select", "UPS 3 Day Select", "two_three_day", true, true],
  ["ups", "ups_2nd_day_air", "UPS 2nd Day Air", "two_three_day", true, true],
  ["ups", "ups_next_day_air_saver", "UPS Next Day Air Saver", "next_day", true, true],
  ["fedex", "fedex_ground", "FedEx Ground", "ground", false, true],
  ["fedex", "fedex_home_delivery", "FedEx Home Delivery", "ground", true, false],
  ["fedex", "fedex_express_saver", "FedEx Express Saver", "two_three_day", true, true],
  ["fedex", "fedex_standard_overnight", "FedEx Standard Overnight", "next_day", true, true],
].map(([carrier, service_id, display_name, tier, residential_allowed, business_allowed]) => ({
  carrier: carrier as Carrier,
  service_id: service_id as string,
  display_name: display_name as string,
  tier: tier as Tier,
  residential_allowed: residential_allowed as boolean,
  business_allowed: business_allowed as boolean,
}));

/** Values copied from data/processed/{fedex,ups}/fuel_surcharge.csv. */
const fuelTable: [number, number, number][] = [
  [2023, 18.0, 19.25],
  [2024, 16.25, 16.0],
  [2025, 20.5, 19.25],
  [2026, 26.25, 28.75],
];
const fuel_defaults: FuelDefault[] = fuelTable.flatMap(([year, ground, express]) =>
  (["fedex", "ups"] as const).flatMap((carrier) => [
    { carrier, year, service_group: "ground" as const, default_percent: ground, is_proxy: carrier === "ups" },
    { carrier, year, service_group: "express" as const, default_percent: express, is_proxy: carrier === "ups" },
  ]),
);
fuel_defaults.push(
  { carrier: "fedex", year: 2027, service_group: "ground", default_percent: 26.25, is_proxy: true },
  { carrier: "fedex", year: 2027, service_group: "express", default_percent: 28.75, is_proxy: true },
);

const uspsEdges: [number, number, number | null][] = [
  [1, 0, 50], [2, 51, 150], [3, 151, 300], [4, 301, 600],
  [5, 601, 1000], [6, 1001, 1400], [7, 1401, 1800], [8, 1801, null],
];
const zone_bands: ZoneBand[] = [
  ...uspsEdges.map(([zone, min_miles, max_miles]) => ({ carrier: "usps" as const, zone, min_miles, max_miles })),
  ...(["ups", "fedex"] as const).flatMap((carrier) =>
    uspsEdges.slice(1).map(([zone, min_miles, max_miles]) => ({
      carrier, zone, min_miles: zone === 2 ? 0 : min_miles, max_miles,
    })),
  ),
];

export const mockMeta: Meta = {
  years: { usps: [2023, 2024, 2025, 2026], ups: [2023, 2024, 2025, 2026], fedex: [2023, 2024, 2025, 2026, 2027] },
  services,
  default_controls: mockDefaultControls,
  fuel_defaults,
  zone_bands,
  limitations: [
    "Published list prices only: no negotiated discounts, no account-specific rates.",
    "Zones are estimated from straight-line distance bands, not from ZIP-to-ZIP zone charts.",
    "UPS fuel surcharge uses the FedEx published history as a proxy.",
    "UPS announced increases come from trade press, not from UPS itself.",
  ],
};

export const mockSampleParcels: SampleParcels = {
  description:
    "Illustrative month for a small home-goods shop: mostly light residential parcels by ground, a few heavy or bulky ones, some expedited.",
  parcels: [
    { weight_lb: 0.5, length_in: 9, width_in: 6, height_in: 2, distance_miles: 120, residential: true, speed: "ground", quantity: 180 },
    { weight_lb: 0.9, length_in: 10, width_in: 8, height_in: 3, distance_miles: 650, residential: true, speed: "ground", quantity: 140 },
    { weight_lb: 1.8, length_in: 12, width_in: 9, height_in: 4, distance_miles: 340, residential: true, speed: "ground", quantity: 120 },
    { weight_lb: 2.5, length_in: 12, width_in: 10, height_in: 6, distance_miles: 1500, residential: true, speed: "ground", quantity: 90 },
    { weight_lb: 4, length_in: 14, width_in: 12, height_in: 8, distance_miles: 900, residential: true, speed: "ground", quantity: 70 },
    { weight_lb: 3, length_in: 12, width_in: 12, height_in: 6, distance_miles: 220, residential: false, speed: "ground", quantity: 40 },
    { weight_lb: 7.5, length_in: 18, width_in: 14, height_in: 10, distance_miles: 1200, residential: true, speed: "ground", quantity: 35 },
    { weight_lb: 12, length_in: 20, width_in: 16, height_in: 12, distance_miles: 450, residential: false, speed: "ground", quantity: 20 },
    { weight_lb: 22, length_in: 24, width_in: 18, height_in: 14, distance_miles: 2100, residential: true, speed: "ground", quantity: 8, price_charged: 24.99 },
    { weight_lb: 1.2, length_in: 10, width_in: 8, height_in: 4, distance_miles: 800, residential: true, speed: "two_three_day", quantity: 45, price_charged: 14.99 },
    { weight_lb: 3.5, length_in: 14, width_in: 10, height_in: 6, distance_miles: 1900, residential: true, speed: "two_three_day", quantity: 15, price_charged: 19.99 },
    { weight_lb: 1, length_in: 10, width_in: 8, height_in: 4, distance_miles: 500, residential: true, speed: "next_day", quantity: 6, price_charged: 34.99 },
    { weight_lb: 6, length_in: 30, width_in: 6, height_in: 6, distance_miles: 700, residential: true, speed: "ground", quantity: 10, nonstandard_packaging: true },
    { weight_lb: 2, length_in: 12, width_in: 9, height_in: 4, distance_miles: 1100, residential: true, speed: "ground", quantity: 12, delivery_area: "das" },
  ],
};

/* ---------- toy price engine ---------- */

function zoneFor(carrier: Carrier, miles: number): number {
  const band = zone_bands.find(
    (b) => b.carrier === carrier && miles >= b.min_miles && (b.max_miles === null || miles <= b.max_miles),
  );
  return band ? band.zone : 8;
}

const tierFactor: Record<Tier, number> = { ground: 1, two_three_day: 1.9, next_day: 4.2 };
const yearFactor = (year: number) => Math.pow(1.059, year - 2026);

function fuelPercent(carrier: Carrier, tier: Tier, c: Controls): number {
  if (carrier === "usps") return 0;
  const group = tier === "ground" ? "ground" : "express";
  const override = c.fuel_override_percent?.[group];
  if (override !== undefined) return override;
  const row = fuel_defaults.find((f) => f.carrier === "fedex" && f.year === c.year && f.service_group === group);
  return row?.default_percent ?? 20;
}

function billable(p: Parcel, carrier: Carrier): { billable: number; dim: number | null } {
  const actual = p.weight_lb < 1 && carrier === "usps" ? Math.ceil(p.weight_lb * 16) / 16 : Math.ceil(p.weight_lb);
  if (p.length_in === undefined || p.width_in === undefined || p.height_in === undefined) {
    return { billable: actual, dim: null };
  }
  const volume = p.length_in * p.width_in * p.height_in;
  if (carrier === "usps" && volume <= 1728) return { billable: actual, dim: null };
  const dim = Math.ceil(volume / (carrier === "usps" ? 166 : 139));
  return { billable: Math.max(actual, dim), dim };
}

function priceService(p: Parcel, s: ServiceInfo, c: Controls): Quote {
  const carrier = s.carrier;
  const zone = zoneFor(carrier, p.distance_miles);
  const { billable: bw, dim } = billable(p, carrier);
  const available = p.residential ? s.residential_allowed : s.business_allowed;
  const tf = tierFactor[s.tier] * (s.service_id.endsWith("_air") || s.service_id.endsWith("priority_overnight") ? 1.15 : 1);
  const curve =
    carrier === "usps"
      ? 4.6 + 0.62 * zone + bw * (0.55 + 0.11 * zone) + (c.usps_rate_card === "retail" ? 1.6 : 0)
      : (carrier === "ups" ? 9.6 : 9.4) + 0.48 * zone + bw * (0.34 + 0.07 * zone);
  const base = round2(curve * tf * yearFactor(c.year));
  const items: LineItem[] = [{ kind: "base", label: "Base rate", amount: base, source: "mock" }];
  if (carrier !== "usps" && p.residential) {
    items.push({ kind: "surcharge", label: "Residential Surcharge", amount: round2(5.95 * yearFactor(c.year)), surcharge_id: `${carrier}_residential` });
  }
  if (carrier !== "usps" && p.delivery_area && p.delivery_area !== "none") {
    items.push({ kind: "surcharge", label: p.delivery_area === "das" ? "Delivery Area Surcharge" : "Extended Delivery Area Surcharge", amount: p.delivery_area === "das" ? 4.45 : 5.55 });
  }
  if (p.nonstandard_packaging) {
    items.push({ kind: "surcharge", label: carrier === "usps" ? "Nonstandard Fee" : "Additional Handling", amount: carrier === "usps" ? 4 : 25 });
  }
  if (c.peak && carrier !== "usps" && p.residential) {
    items.push({ kind: "surcharge", label: "Peak Surcharge", amount: 0.4 });
  }
  const fp = fuelPercent(carrier, s.tier, c);
  const fuelBase = items.reduce((sum, i) => sum + i.amount, 0);
  if (fp > 0) items.push({ kind: "fuel", label: `Fuel Surcharge (${fp}%)`, amount: round2((fuelBase * fp) / 100) });
  const total = round2(items.reduce((sum, i) => sum + i.amount, 0));
  const price = p.price_charged ?? c.flat_price;
  return {
    carrier,
    service_id: s.service_id,
    service_name: s.display_name,
    tier: s.tier,
    zone,
    billable_weight_lb: bw,
    dim_weight_lb: dim,
    line_items: items,
    total,
    margin: round2(price - total),
    available,
    ...(available ? {} : { unavailable_reason: `${s.display_name} serves ${s.residential_allowed ? "residential" : "business"} addresses only` }),
  };
}

function cheapest(quotes: Quote[], tier: Tier, carrier?: Carrier): Quote | undefined {
  return quotes
    .filter((q) => q.available && q.tier === tier && (carrier === undefined || q.carrier === carrier))
    .sort((a, b) => a.total - b.total)[0];
}

const pick = (q: Quote): CarrierPick => ({ carrier: q.carrier, service_id: q.service_id, total: q.total });

export function mockQuote({ parcel, controls }: QuoteRequest): QuoteResponse {
  const quotes = services.map((s) => priceService(parcel, s, controls));
  const order = (q: Quote) => (q.tier === parcel.speed ? 0 : 1);
  quotes.sort((a, b) => order(a) - order(b) || TIERS.indexOf(a.tier) - TIERS.indexOf(b.tier) || a.total - b.total);
  const cheapest_by_tier = Object.fromEntries(
    TIERS.map((t) => {
      const q = cheapest(quotes, t);
      return [t, q ? pick(q) : null];
    }),
  ) as Record<Tier, CarrierPick | null>;
  return { quotes, cheapest_by_tier };
}

const DEFAULT_DISTANCES = [25, 100, 225, 450, 800, 1200, 1600, 2000];

export function mockBreakeven(req: BreakevenRequest): BreakevenResponse {
  const weights = req.weights_lb ?? Array.from({ length: 70 }, (_, i) => i + 1);
  const distances = req.distances_miles ?? DEFAULT_DISTANCES;
  const cells: BreakevenCell[] = [];
  for (const w of weights) {
    for (const d of distances) {
      const parcel: Parcel = { weight_lb: w, distance_miles: d, residential: req.residential, speed: "ground" };
      const quotes = services.filter((s) => s.tier === "ground").map((s) => priceService(parcel, s, req.controls));
      const best = CARRIERS.map((c) => cheapest(quotes, "ground", c)).filter((q): q is Quote => !!q).sort((a, b) => a.total - b.total);
      const [winner, runner] = best;
      if (!winner || !runner) continue;
      cells.push({
        weight_lb: w,
        distance_miles: d,
        zone_usps: zoneFor("usps", d),
        zone_private: zoneFor("ups", d),
        winner: pick(winner),
        runner_up: pick(runner),
        saving: round2(runner.total - winner.total),
      });
    }
  }
  const breakeven_weight_lb = distances.map((d) => {
    const at = (vs: Carrier) => {
      for (const w of weights) {
        const parcel: Parcel = { weight_lb: w, distance_miles: d, residential: req.residential, speed: "ground" };
        const qs = services.filter((s) => s.tier === "ground").map((s) => priceService(parcel, s, req.controls));
        const u = cheapest(qs, "ground", "usps");
        const o = cheapest(qs, "ground", vs);
        if (u && o && o.total < u.total) return w;
      }
      return null;
    };
    return { distance_miles: d, vs_ups_lb: at("ups"), vs_fedex_lb: at("fedex") };
  });
  return { cells, breakeven_weight_lb };
}

function blendFor(parcels: Parcel[], controls: Controls, choose: (qs: Quote[], p: Parcel) => Quote | undefined, label: Carrier | "best_mix"): BlendedCarrier {
  let shipped = 0, unavailable = 0, cost = 0, base = 0, sur = 0, fuel = 0, margin = 0, losses = 0;
  const bySurcharge = new Map<string, number>();
  for (const p of parcels) {
    const qty = p.quantity ?? 1;
    const qs = services.map((s) => priceService(p, s, controls));
    const q = choose(qs, p);
    if (!q) { unavailable += qty; continue; }
    shipped += qty;
    cost += q.total * qty;
    margin += q.margin * qty;
    if (q.margin < 0) losses += qty;
    for (const li of q.line_items) {
      if (li.kind === "base") base += li.amount * qty;
      else if (li.kind === "fuel") fuel += li.amount * qty;
      else {
        sur += li.amount * qty;
        bySurcharge.set(li.label, (bySurcharge.get(li.label) ?? 0) + li.amount * qty);
      }
    }
  }
  const per = (n: number) => (shipped ? round2(n / shipped) : 0);
  const share = (n: number) => (cost ? Math.round((n / cost) * 1000) / 1000 : 0);
  return {
    carrier: label,
    parcels_shipped: shipped,
    parcels_unavailable: unavailable,
    cost_per_parcel: per(cost),
    split_per_parcel: { base: per(base), surcharges: per(sur), fuel: per(fuel) },
    split_share: { base: share(base), surcharges: share(sur), fuel: share(fuel) },
    surcharge_breakdown: [...bySurcharge.entries()].map(([lbl, amt]) => ({ label: lbl, amount_per_parcel: per(amt), share: share(amt) })),
    margin_per_parcel: per(margin),
    loss_share: shipped ? Math.round((losses / shipped) * 1000) / 1000 : 0,
  };
}

export function mockBlended({ parcels, controls }: BlendedRequest): BlendedResponse {
  const counts: Partial<Record<Carrier, number>> = {};
  const rows = CARRIERS.map((c) => blendFor(parcels, controls, (qs, p) => cheapest(qs, p.speed, c), c));
  rows.push(
    blendFor(parcels, controls, (qs, p) => {
      const q = cheapest(qs, p.speed);
      if (q) counts[q.carrier] = (counts[q.carrier] ?? 0) + (p.quantity ?? 1);
      return q;
    }, "best_mix"),
  );
  return { carriers: rows, best_mix_counts: counts };
}

export function mockYearly({ parcels, controls, next_year_increase_percent }: YearlyRequest): YearlyResponse {
  const announced: Record<Carrier, Record<number, number>> = {
    usps: { 2023: -0.7, 2024: 5.4, 2025: 3.9, 2026: 7.8 },
    ups: { 2023: 6.9, 2024: 5.9, 2025: 5.9, 2026: 5.9 },
    fedex: { 2023: 6.9, 2024: 5.9, 2025: 5.9, 2026: 5.9, 2027: 5.9 },
  };
  const carriers = CARRIERS.map((carrier) => {
    let prev: number | null = null;
    const points = mockMeta.years[carrier].map((year) => {
      const r = blendFor(parcels, { ...controls, year }, (qs, p) => cheapest(qs, p.speed, carrier), carrier);
      const cost = r.cost_per_parcel;
      const change = prev === null ? null : round2(((cost - prev) / prev) * 100);
      prev = cost;
      return {
        year, cost_per_parcel: cost, change_percent: change,
        announced_increase_percent: announced[carrier][year] ?? null,
        announced_source: carrier === "ups" ? ("secondary" as const) : ("primary" as const),
      };
    });
    const last = points[points.length - 1];
    if (next_year_increase_percent !== undefined && last && last.cost_per_parcel !== null) {
      points.push({
        year: last.year + 1,
        cost_per_parcel: round2(last.cost_per_parcel * (1 + next_year_increase_percent / 100)),
        change_percent: next_year_increase_percent,
        announced_increase_percent: null,
        announced_source: null,
        projected: true,
      } as (typeof points)[number] & { projected: boolean });
    }
    return { carrier, points };
  });
  const drivers = CARRIERS.flatMap((carrier) =>
    [2024, 2025, 2026].map((to_year) => ({
      carrier, from_year: to_year - 1, to_year,
      contributions: [
        { dimension: "residential" as const, band: "residential", contribution_per_parcel: 0.21 },
        { dimension: "weight_band" as const, band: "1–5", contribution_per_parcel: 0.14 },
        { dimension: "zone_band" as const, band: "5–6", contribution_per_parcel: 0.09 },
        { dimension: "speed" as const, band: "two_three_day", contribution_per_parcel: 0.05 },
      ],
    })),
  );
  return { carriers, drivers };
}

cd ~/parcel-rates-issue-4/frontend && cat > src/lib/parcelCsv.ts <<'EOF'
import Papa from "papaparse";
import type { DeliveryArea, Parcel, Tier } from "../api/types";
import { DELIVERY_AREAS, TIERS } from "../api/types";

/** Columns from docs/data/SCHEMA.md, section "Parcel set input". */
export const REQUIRED_COLUMNS = ["weight_lb", "distance_miles", "residential", "speed"] as const;
export const OPTIONAL_COLUMNS = [
  "length_in",
  "width_in",
  "height_in",
  "quantity",
  "price_charged",
  "delivery_area",
  "nonstandard_packaging",
] as const;
export const ALL_COLUMNS = [...REQUIRED_COLUMNS, ...OPTIONAL_COLUMNS] as const;

export const MAX_WEIGHT_LB = 70;
export const MAX_ROWS = 20000;

export interface CsvProblem {
  /** Spreadsheet row number (the header is row 1); null for problems with the whole file. */
  row: number | null;
  column?: string;
  message: string;
}

export interface CsvResult {
  parcels: Parcel[];
  errors: CsvProblem[];
  warnings: CsvProblem[];
}

const TRUE_WORDS = new Set(["true", "yes", "1", "y"]);
const FALSE_WORDS = new Set(["false", "no", "0", "n"]);

export function parseBool(raw: string): boolean | undefined {
  const v = raw.trim().toLowerCase();
  if (TRUE_WORDS.has(v)) return true;
  if (FALSE_WORDS.has(v)) return false;
  return undefined;
}

function parseNumber(raw: string): number | undefined {
  const cleaned = raw.trim().replace(/^\$/, "").replace(/,/g, "");
  if (cleaned === "") return undefined;
  const n = Number(cleaned);
  return Number.isFinite(n) ? n : undefined;
}

const SPEED_ALIASES: Record<string, Tier> = {
  ground: "ground",
  two_three_day: "two_three_day",
  "2-3 day": "two_three_day",
  "2_3_day": "two_three_day",
  next_day: "next_day",
  overnight: "next_day",
  "next day": "next_day",
};

type Row = Record<string, string | undefined>;

class RowReader {
  readonly errors: CsvProblem[] = [];
  constructor(private readonly row: Row, private readonly rowNumber: number) {}

  private fail(column: string, message: string): undefined {
    this.errors.push({ row: this.rowNumber, column, message });
    return undefined;
  }

  text(column: string): string {
    return (this.row[column] ?? "").trim();
  }

  number(column: string, required: boolean, check: (n: number) => string | null): number | undefined {
    const raw = this.text(column);
    if (raw === "") return required ? this.fail(column, `${column} is empty`) : undefined;
    const n = parseNumber(raw);
    if (n === undefined) return this.fail(column, `${column} "${raw}" is not a number`);
    const problem = check(n);
    return problem ? this.fail(column, problem) : n;
  }

  bool(column: string, required: boolean): boolean | undefined {
    const raw = this.text(column);
    if (raw === "") return required ? this.fail(column, `${column} is empty; use true or false`) : undefined;
    const b = parseBool(raw);
    if (b === undefined) return this.fail(column, `${column} "${raw}" is not true/false, yes/no or 1/0`);
    return b;
  }

  speed(): Tier | undefined {
    const raw = this.text("speed");
    if (raw === "") return this.fail("speed", "speed is empty");
    const tier = SPEED_ALIASES[raw.toLowerCase()];
    if (!tier) return this.fail("speed", `speed "${raw}" is not one of ${TIERS.join(", ")}`);
    return tier;
  }

  deliveryArea(): DeliveryArea | undefined {
    const raw = this.text("delivery_area").toLowerCase();
    if (raw === "") return undefined;
    if ((DELIVERY_AREAS as readonly string[]).includes(raw)) return raw as DeliveryArea;
    return this.fail("delivery_area", `delivery_area "${raw}" is not one of ${DELIVERY_AREAS.join(", ")}`);
  }
}

const positive = (col: string) => (n: number) => (n > 0 ? null : `${col} must be more than 0`);

function readRow(row: Row, rowNumber: number): { parcel?: Parcel; errors: CsvProblem[] } {
  const r = new RowReader(row, rowNumber);
  const weight = r.number("weight_lb", true, (n) => {
    if (n <= 0) return "weight_lb must be more than 0";
    if (n > MAX_WEIGHT_LB) return `weight_lb ${n} is over the ${MAX_WEIGHT_LB} lb limit`;
    return null;
  });
  const distance = r.number("distance_miles", true, (n) => (n >= 0 ? null : "distance_miles cannot be negative"));
  const residential = r.bool("residential", true);
  const speed = r.speed();
  const length = r.number("length_in", false, positive("length_in"));
  const width = r.number("width_in", false, positive("width_in"));
  const height = r.number("height_in", false, positive("height_in"));
  const quantity = r.number("quantity", false, (n) =>
    Number.isInteger(n) && n >= 1 ? null : "quantity must be a whole number of at least 1",
  );
  const price = r.number("price_charged", false, (n) => (n >= 0 ? null : "price_charged cannot be negative"));
  const area = r.deliveryArea();
  const nonstandard = r.bool("nonstandard_packaging", false);

  const dimsGiven = ["length_in", "width_in", "height_in"].filter((c) => r.text(c) !== "");
  if (dimsGiven.length > 0 && dimsGiven.length < 3) {
    r.errors.push({
      row: rowNumber,
      column: "length_in",
      message: "give all three of length_in, width_in and height_in, or none",
    });
  }

  if (r.errors.length > 0 || weight === undefined || distance === undefined || residential === undefined || !speed) {
    return { errors: r.errors };
  }
  const parcel: Parcel = {
    weight_lb: weight,
    distance_miles: distance,
    residential,
    speed,
    quantity: quantity ?? 1,
    ...(length !== undefined && width !== undefined && height !== undefined
      ? { length_in: length, width_in: width, height_in: height }
      : {}),
    ...(price !== undefined ? { price_charged: price } : {}),
    ...(area !== undefined ? { delivery_area: area } : {}),
    ...(nonstandard !== undefined ? { nonstandard_packaging: nonstandard } : {}),
  };
  return { parcel, errors: [] };
}

export function parseParcelCsv(text: string): CsvResult {
  const parsed = Papa.parse<Row>(text.replace(/^﻿/, ""), {
    header: true,
    skipEmptyLines: "greedy",
    transformHeader: (h) => h.trim().toLowerCase(),
  });
  const headers = parsed.meta.fields ?? [];
  const missing = REQUIRED_COLUMNS.filter((c) => !headers.includes(c));
  if (missing.length > 0) {
    return {
      parcels: [],
      errors: [
        {
          row: null,
          message: `Missing required column${missing.length > 1 ? "s" : ""}: ${missing.join(", ")}. The first row must name the columns.`,
        },
      ],
      warnings: [],
    };
  }
  const warnings: CsvProblem[] = headers
    .filter((h) => h !== "" && !(ALL_COLUMNS as readonly string[]).includes(h))
    .map((h) => ({ row: null, column: h, message: `Column "${h}" is not used and was ignored` }));

  if (parsed.data.length === 0) {
    return { parcels: [], errors: [{ row: null, message: "The file has a header but no parcel rows." }], warnings };
  }
  if (parsed.data.length > MAX_ROWS) {
    return {
      parcels: [],
      errors: [{ row: null, message: `The file has ${parsed.data.length} rows; the limit is ${MAX_ROWS}. Use the quantity column to group identical parcels.` }],
      warnings,
    };
  }

  const parcels: Parcel[] = [];
  const errors: CsvProblem[] = [];
  parsed.data.forEach((row, i) => {
    const result = readRow(row, i + 2);
    if (result.parcel) parcels.push(result.parcel);
    errors.push(...result.errors);
  });
  return { parcels: errors.length > 0 ? [] : parcels, errors, warnings };
}

export const CSV_TEMPLATE = [
  ALL_COLUMNS.join(","),
  "0.8,9,6,3,120,true,ground,40,,none,false",
  "4.5,14,12,8,950,true,ground,12,,,",
  "2,12,9,4,1600,false,two_three_day,5,14.99,,",
  "1,,,,450,true,next_day,2,34.99,das,false",
].join("\n") + "\n";

/** Order of columns in the template: required first, then optional. Kept in sync with ALL_COLUMNS. */
export function templateHeader(): string {
  return ALL_COLUMNS.join(",");
}
EOF

cd ~/parcel-rates-issue-4/frontend && cat > src/lib/summary.ts <<'EOF'
import type { Parcel, Tier, WeightBand } from "../api/types";
import { TIERS, WEIGHT_BANDS } from "../api/types";

export interface Bucket {
  label: string;
  count: number; // parcels (sum of quantity)
  share: number; // 0..1
}

export interface ParcelSummary {
  rows: number;
  parcels: number;
  residentialShare: number;
  byTier: Record<Tier, number>; // share 0..1
  weight: Bucket[];
  distance: Bucket[];
  withOwnPrice: number; // parcels whose row sets price_charged
  meanWeightLb: number;
}

/** Upper bounds (inclusive) of the contract's weight bands: ≤1, 1–5, 5–10, 10–20, 20–70 lb. */
const WEIGHT_UPPER: Record<WeightBand, number> = { "≤1": 1, "1–5": 5, "5–10": 10, "10–20": 20, "20–70": 70 };

export function weightBand(lb: number): WeightBand {
  return WEIGHT_BANDS.find((b) => lb <= WEIGHT_UPPER[b]) ?? "20–70";
}

/** Distance bands follow the USPS zone pairs used for zone_band: 1–2, 3–4, 5–6, 7–8. */
export const DISTANCE_BANDS = [
  { label: "0–150 mi", zones: "1–2", max: 150 },
  { label: "151–600 mi", zones: "3–4", max: 600 },
  { label: "601–1,400 mi", zones: "5–6", max: 1400 },
  { label: "1,401+ mi", zones: "7–8", max: Infinity },
] as const;

export function distanceBand(miles: number): string {
  return (DISTANCE_BANDS.find((b) => miles <= b.max) ?? DISTANCE_BANDS[DISTANCE_BANDS.length - 1]!).label;
}

const qty = (p: Parcel) => p.quantity ?? 1;

function buckets(parcels: Parcel[], labels: readonly string[], key: (p: Parcel) => string, total: number): Bucket[] {
  const counts = new Map<string, number>(labels.map((l) => [l, 0]));
  for (const p of parcels) counts.set(key(p), (counts.get(key(p)) ?? 0) + qty(p));
  return labels.map((label) => {
    const count = counts.get(label) ?? 0;
    return { label, count, share: total ? count / total : 0 };
  });
}

export function summarize(parcels: Parcel[]): ParcelSummary {
  const total = parcels.reduce((s, p) => s + qty(p), 0);
  const share = (pred: (p: Parcel) => boolean) =>
    total ? parcels.filter(pred).reduce((s, p) => s + qty(p), 0) / total : 0;
  const byTier = Object.fromEntries(TIERS.map((t) => [t, share((p) => p.speed === t)])) as Record<Tier, number>;
  return {
    rows: parcels.length,
    parcels: total,
    residentialShare: share((p) => p.residential),
    byTier,
    weight: buckets(parcels, WEIGHT_BANDS, (p) => weightBand(p.weight_lb), total),
    distance: buckets(parcels, DISTANCE_BANDS.map((b) => b.label), (p) => distanceBand(p.distance_miles), total),
    withOwnPrice: parcels.filter((p) => p.price_charged !== undefined).reduce((s, p) => s + qty(p), 0),
    meanWeightLb: total ? parcels.reduce((s, p) => s + p.weight_lb * qty(p), 0) / total : 0,
  };
}

import type { Controls, FuelGroup } from "../api/types";

export const VIEWS = ["quote", "breakeven", "blended", "yearly"] as const;
export type ViewId = (typeof VIEWS)[number];

export interface AppState {
  controls: Controls;
  view: ViewId;
}

export const FALLBACK_CONTROLS: Controls = {
  year: 2026,
  usps_rate_card: "commercial",
  peak: false,
  flat_price: 9.99,
};

export const FUEL_MIN = 0;
export const FUEL_MAX = 40;
export const PRICE_MAX = 1000;

const KEYS = {
  year: "year",
  card: "usps",
  fuelGround: "fuel_ground",
  fuelExpress: "fuel_express",
  peak: "peak",
  price: "price",
  view: "view",
} as const;

/** Params the app owns; anything else in the query string (e.g. mock=1) is preserved. */
const OWNED = new Set<string>(Object.values(KEYS));

function num(params: URLSearchParams, key: string, min: number, max: number): number | undefined {
  const raw = params.get(key);
  if (raw === null || raw.trim() === "") return undefined;
  const n = Number(raw);
  return Number.isFinite(n) && n >= min && n <= max ? n : undefined;
}

export function readState(search: string, defaults: Controls = FALLBACK_CONTROLS): AppState {
  const params = new URLSearchParams(search);
  const year = num(params, KEYS.year, 2000, 2100);
  const card = params.get(KEYS.card);
  const ground = num(params, KEYS.fuelGround, FUEL_MIN, FUEL_MAX);
  const express = num(params, KEYS.fuelExpress, FUEL_MIN, FUEL_MAX);
  const price = num(params, KEYS.price, 0, PRICE_MAX);
  const view = params.get(KEYS.view);
  const fuel: Partial<Record<FuelGroup, number>> = {
    ...(ground !== undefined ? { ground } : {}),
    ...(express !== undefined ? { express } : {}),
  };
  const controls: Controls = {
    year: year !== undefined && Number.isInteger(year) ? year : defaults.year,
    usps_rate_card: card === "retail" || card === "commercial" ? card : defaults.usps_rate_card,
    peak: params.has(KEYS.peak) ? params.get(KEYS.peak) === "1" : defaults.peak,
    flat_price: price ?? defaults.flat_price,
    ...(Object.keys(fuel).length > 0 ? { fuel_override_percent: fuel } : {}),
  };
  return { controls, view: (VIEWS as readonly string[]).includes(view ?? "") ? (view as ViewId) : "quote" };
}

/** Serialize, leaving out values equal to the defaults so shared links stay short. */
export function writeState(state: AppState, currentSearch = "", defaults: Controls = FALLBACK_CONTROLS): string {
  const params = new URLSearchParams(currentSearch);
  for (const key of OWNED) params.delete(key);
  const c = state.controls;
  if (c.year !== defaults.year) params.set(KEYS.year, String(c.year));
  if (c.usps_rate_card !== defaults.usps_rate_card) params.set(KEYS.card, c.usps_rate_card);
  if (c.fuel_override_percent?.ground !== undefined) params.set(KEYS.fuelGround, String(c.fuel_override_percent.ground));
  if (c.fuel_override_percent?.express !== undefined) params.set(KEYS.fuelExpress, String(c.fuel_override_percent.express));
  if (c.peak !== defaults.peak) params.set(KEYS.peak, c.peak ? "1" : "0");
  if (c.flat_price !== defaults.flat_price) params.set(KEYS.price, String(c.flat_price));
  if (state.view !== "quote") params.set(KEYS.view, state.view);
  const out = params.toString();
  return out ? `?${out}` : "";
}

/* ---------- reducer ---------- */

export type Action =
  | { type: "year"; year: number }
  | { type: "card"; card: Controls["usps_rate_card"] }
  | { type: "fuel"; group: FuelGroup; percent: number }
  | { type: "fuelReset"; group: FuelGroup }
  | { type: "peak"; peak: boolean }
  | { type: "price"; price: number }
  | { type: "view"; view: ViewId }
  | { type: "replace"; state: AppState };

function withFuel(c: Controls, group: FuelGroup, percent: number | undefined): Controls {
  const { [group]: _dropped, ...rest } = c.fuel_override_percent ?? {};
  const next = percent === undefined ? rest : { ...rest, [group]: percent };
  const { fuel_override_percent: _old, ...base } = c;
  return Object.keys(next).length > 0 ? { ...base, fuel_override_percent: next } : base;
}

export function reducer(state: AppState, action: Action): AppState {
  const set = (controls: Controls): AppState => ({ ...state, controls });
  switch (action.type) {
    case "year":
      // A new year has its own fuel defaults; an override from another year would mislead.
      return set(withFuel(withFuel({ ...state.controls, year: action.year }, "ground", undefined), "express", undefined));
    case "card":
      return set({ ...state.controls, usps_rate_card: action.card });
    case "fuel":
      return set(withFuel(state.controls, action.group, Math.min(FUEL_MAX, Math.max(FUEL_MIN, action.percent))));
    case "fuelReset":
      return set(withFuel(state.controls, action.group, undefined));
    case "peak":
      return set({ ...state.controls, peak: action.peak });
    case "price":
      return set({ ...state.controls, flat_price: Math.min(PRICE_MAX, Math.max(0, action.price)) });
    case "view":
      return { ...state, view: action.view };
    case "replace":
      return action.state;
  }
}

import type { Carrier, FuelGroup, Meta } from "../api/types";

export interface FuelDefaultInfo {
  percent: number;
  /** Carriers whose default comes from another carrier's history. */
  proxyCarriers: Carrier[];
  /** True when carriers publish different defaults; the slider shows the first non-proxy one. */
  differs: boolean;
}

/** The year's documented fuel default for a service group, or null when no carrier has one. */
export function fuelDefault(meta: Meta | null, year: number, group: FuelGroup): FuelDefaultInfo | null {
  if (!meta) return null;
  const rows = meta.fuel_defaults.filter((f) => f.year === year && f.service_group === group);
  if (rows.length === 0) return null;
  const primary = rows.find((r) => !r.is_proxy) ?? rows[0]!;
  return {
    percent: primary.default_percent,
    proxyCarriers: rows.filter((r) => r.is_proxy).map((r) => r.carrier),
    differs: rows.some((r) => r.default_percent !== primary.default_percent),
  };
}

/** Every year any carrier has prices for, newest first, with the carriers missing that year. */
export function yearOptions(meta: Meta | null): { year: number; missing: Carrier[] }[] {
  if (!meta) return [];
  const carriers = Object.keys(meta.years) as Carrier[];
  const all = [...new Set(carriers.flatMap((c) => meta.years[c]))].sort((a, b) => b - a);
  return all.map((year) => ({ year, missing: carriers.filter((c) => !meta.years[c].includes(year)) }));
}

import { createContext, useContext, useEffect, useState, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { ApiError, createClient, type ApiClient } from "./client";

const ApiContext = createContext<ApiClient | null>(null);

export function ApiProvider({ client, children }: { client?: ApiClient; children: ReactNode }) {
  const [value] = useState<ApiClient>(() => client ?? createClient());
  return <ApiContext.Provider value={value}>{children}</ApiContext.Provider>;
}

export function useApi(): ApiClient {
  const c = useContext(ApiContext);
  if (!c) throw new Error("useApi must be used inside <ApiProvider>");
  return c;
}

export type Loadable<T> =
  | { status: "idle" }
  | { status: "loading" }
  | { status: "ok"; data: T }
  | { status: "error"; error: ApiError | Error };

/** Run `load` whenever `deps` change; aborts the previous request. */
export function useLoad<T>(load: ((signal: AbortSignal) => Promise<T>) | null, deps: readonly unknown[]): Loadable<T> {
  const [state, setState] = useState<Loadable<T>>({ status: load ? "loading" : "idle" });
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!load) {
      setState({ status: "idle" });
      return;
    }
    const ctrl = new AbortController();
    setState({ status: "loading" });
    load(ctrl.signal).then(
      (data) => !ctrl.signal.aborted && setState({ status: "ok", data }),
      (error: unknown) => {
        if (ctrl.signal.aborted) return;
        setState({ status: "error", error: error instanceof Error ? error : new Error(String(error)) });
      },
    );
    return () => ctrl.abort();
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, deps);
  return state;
}
EOF

cat > DESIGN.md <<'EOF'
# Visual direction: the shipping ledger

The dashboard reads like a printed price sheet or a merchant's ledger, not like
a SaaS dashboard. Warm paper, black ink, hairline rules, figures set in a
newspaper serif, and colour reserved for meaning.

## Why it fits

The user is a shop owner deciding where a few dollars per parcel go. The
decision lives in a handful of numbers: which carrier is cheapest, what one
parcel costs, whether the flat price still leaves a margin. A ledger puts those
numbers first, in the largest type on the page, and pushes everything else
(assumptions, sliders, provenance) into small, quiet type around them. Rules
and columns instead of cards make it feel like an account the owner keeps, and
they print well for an accountant.

## Hierarchy

1. **The answer** (cheapest carrier, cost per parcel, margin): display serif,
   `--text-figure`, tabular figures, carrier or money colour.
2. **The question** each section answers: display serif, `--text-2xl`.
3. **The owner's parcel set**: a ledger strip with the parcel count large and
   small distributions beside it.
4. **Assumptions** (year, rate card, fuel, peak, flat price): a left rail in the
   UI face at `--text-sm`, always visible on desktop, a bottom sheet on phones
   behind a one-line summary bar.

## Palette (`src/styles/tokens.css`)

| Token | Light | Dark | Use |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--paper` | `#F5F1E8` | `#15140F` | page |
| `--sheet` | `#FBF9F4` | `#1E1C17` | rail, inputs, raised panels |
| `--ink` | `#1C1B18` | `#EDE8DC` | text, rules, focus ring |
| `--ink-muted` | `#5E5A50` | `#A9A292` | secondary text (6.1:1 / 7.3:1) |
| `--carrier-usps` | `#1F4E9A` | `#7FA8EE` | USPS everywhere (7.1:1 / 7.7:1) |
| `--carrier-ups` | `#7A4E0F` | `#D9A35A` | UPS everywhere (6.4:1 / 8.2:1) |
| `--carrier-fedex` | `#9C2A7E` | `#E68AC9` | FedEx everywhere (6.1:1 / 7.8:1) |
| `--loss` | `#B3261E` | `#F2877E` | negative margin (5.8:1 / 7.5:1) |
| `--profit` | `#1D6B3F` | `#6FCB94` | positive margin (5.8:1 / 9.4:1) |
| `--mock` | `#8A5A00` | `#E8B860` | the mock-data banner only |

Contrast ratios are against `--paper` and meet WCAG AA for body text in both
themes. Carrier hues follow the brands loosely (postal blue, brown, purple)
so the owner recognises them without a legend. Blue and purple are close for
some colour-vision deficiencies, so colour is never the only cue: every
carrier mark carries its name or initial, and money always carries a sign and
the word "loss" or "margin".

Each carrier also has a `-wash` tint for backgrounds and heatmap cells
(issue #5 scales intensity between the wash and the full colour).

## Type

- **Newsreader** (display serif, optical sizes) for questions and figures.
  A newspaper face gives the editorial voice and has good tabular numerals.
- **IBM Plex Sans** for the interface: labels, controls, tables. Industrial,
  slightly technical, legible at 12-14 px.

Both load from Google Fonts with `display=swap`; fallbacks are Georgia and
Helvetica/Arial. All figures use `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums` so
columns of prices line up.

## Spacing and shape

A 4 px base (`--space-1` … `--space-8`: 4, 8, 12, 16, 24, 32, 48, 72 px) with a
deliberate jump to 48-72 px between sections, so sections read as chapters.
Corners are nearly square (`--radius: 2px`). Separation comes from hairline
rules (`--rule`) and one heavy rule under the masthead and active tab, not
from shadows; the only shadow is on the mobile controls sheet, which really
does sit above the page.

## Motion

Only opacity and transform, 120-220 ms, for the sheet and tab underline. All
of it is disabled under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`.

## Charts (for issues #5 and #6)

- Use the carrier tokens for series and cells; read them in JS with
  `getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue("--carrier-usps")`
  or the `carrierColor()` helper in `src/lib/carriers.ts`, so dark mode works.
- Axis text in `--ink-muted`, gridlines in `--rule`, no chart borders.
- Announced increases and projections are dashed lines in the carrier colour.
EOF

import type { Carrier } from "../api/types";

/** CSS variable for a carrier's colour; use in style props so dark mode follows. */
export const carrierVar = (c: Carrier) => `var(--carrier-${c})`;
export const carrierWashVar = (c: Carrier) => `var(--carrier-${c}-wash)`;

/** Resolved colour, for libraries that need a concrete value (e.g. Recharts fills). */
export function carrierColor(c: Carrier, el: Element = document.documentElement): string {
  return getComputedStyle(el).getPropertyValue(`--carrier-${c}`).trim();
}

import { useId } from "react";
import type { FuelGroup } from "../../api/types";
import { FUEL_MAX, FUEL_MIN } from "../../state/urlState";
import type { FuelDefaultInfo } from "../../lib/fuel";
import { formatPercent } from "../../lib/format";

export interface FuelSliderProps {
  group: FuelGroup;
  label: string;
  hint: string;
  override: number | undefined;
  defaultInfo: FuelDefaultInfo | null;
  onChange: (percent: number) => void;
  onReset: () => void;
}

const STEP = 0.25;

export function FuelSlider({ group, label, hint, override, defaultInfo, onChange, onReset }: FuelSliderProps) {
  const id = useId();
  const value = override ?? defaultInfo?.percent ?? 0;
  const isOverridden = override !== undefined;
  const markerLeft = defaultInfo ? ((defaultInfo.percent - FUEL_MIN) / (FUEL_MAX - FUEL_MIN)) * 100 : null;

  return (
    <div className={`fuel ${isOverridden ? "fuel--overridden" : ""}`} data-group={group}>
      <div className="fuel__head">
        <label htmlFor={id} className="control__label">
          {label}
        </label>
        <output htmlFor={id} className="fuel__value" aria-live="polite">
          {formatPercent(value)}
        </output>
      </div>
      <div className="fuel__track">
        <input
          id={id}
          type="range"
          min={FUEL_MIN}
          max={FUEL_MAX}
          step={STEP}
          value={value}
          aria-describedby={`${id}-hint`}
          aria-valuetext={`${formatPercent(value)}${isOverridden ? "" : ", the year's default"}`}
          onChange={(e) => onChange(Number(e.target.value))}
        />
        {markerLeft !== null && (
          <span className="fuel__marker" style={{ left: `${markerLeft}%` }} aria-hidden="true" title="Year's default" />
        )}
      </div>
      <div className="fuel__foot" id={`${id}-hint`}>
        {defaultInfo ? (
          <span>
            Default {formatPercent(defaultInfo.percent)} · {hint}
            {defaultInfo.proxyCarriers.length > 0 && " · UPS uses the FedEx history"}
          </span>
        ) : (
          <span>No published default for this year</span>
        )}
        {isOverridden && (
          <button type="button" className="btn btn--quiet fuel__reset" onClick={onReset}>
            Reset<span className="visually-hidden"> {label.toLowerCase()} to the default</span>
          </button>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import { useEffect, useId, useRef, useState } from "react";
import type { Meta } from "../../api/types";
import type { Action, AppState } from "../../state/urlState";
import { fuelDefault, yearOptions } from "../../lib/fuel";
import { CARRIER_NAME, formatPercent, formatUsd } from "../../lib/format";
import { FuelSlider } from "./FuelSlider";

export interface ControlRailProps {
  state: AppState;
  dispatch: (a: Action) => void;
  meta: Meta | null;
  metaStatus: "loading" | "ok" | "error" | "idle";
  onRetryMeta: () => void;
}

/** One-line summary of the assumptions, shown in the mobile bar. */
export function assumptionsLine(state: AppState): string {
  const c = state.controls;
  const fuel = c.fuel_override_percent
    ? `fuel ${[c.fuel_override_percent.ground, c.fuel_override_percent.express]
        .filter((v) => v !== undefined)
        .map((v) => formatPercent(v as number))
        .join("/")}`
    : "fuel default";
  return [String(c.year), `USPS ${c.usps_rate_card}`, fuel, c.peak ? "peak" : null, `${formatUsd(c.flat_price)}/parcel`]
    .filter(Boolean)
    .join(" · ");
}

function PriceInput({ value, onCommit }: { value: number; onCommit: (n: number) => void }) {
  const id = useId();
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState(value.toFixed(2));
  const [problem, setProblem] = useState<string | null>(null);
  useEffect(() => setDraft(value.toFixed(2)), [value]);

  const commit = () => {
    const n = Number(draft.replace(/^\$/, ""));
    if (draft.trim() === "" || !Number.isFinite(n) || n < 0) {
      setProblem("Enter a price of $0 or more");
      return;
    }
    setProblem(null);
    onCommit(Math.round(n * 100) / 100);
  };

  return (
    <div className="control">
      <label htmlFor={id} className="control__label">
        Flat price you charge per parcel
      </label>
      <div className={`money-input ${problem ? "money-input--invalid" : ""}`}>
        <span aria-hidden="true">$</span>
        <input
          id={id}
          inputMode="decimal"
          value={draft}
          aria-invalid={problem ? true : undefined}
          aria-describedby={`${id}-hint`}
          onChange={(e) => setDraft(e.target.value)}
          onBlur={commit}
          onKeyDown={(e) => e.key === "Enter" && commit()}
        />
      </div>
      <p id={`${id}-hint`} className={problem ? "control__error" : "control__hint"}>
        {problem ?? "A price column in your CSV overrides this per parcel."}
      </p>
    </div>
  );
}

export function ControlRail({ state, dispatch, meta, metaStatus, onRetryMeta }: ControlRailProps) {
  const c = state.controls;
  const years = yearOptions(meta);
  const yearList = years.length > 0 ? years : [{ year: c.year, missing: [] }];
  const yearId = useId();
  const peakId = useId();
  const railRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  return (
    <div className="rail__body" ref={railRef}>
      <p className="kicker rail__kicker">Assumptions</p>

      {metaStatus === "loading" && (
        <p className="rail__status" role="status">
          <span className="pulse" aria-hidden="true" /> Loading price lists…
        </p>
      )}
      {metaStatus === "error" && (
        <div className="rail__status rail__status--error" role="alert">
          <p>Cannot load the price lists. The controls use built-in defaults until the rate service answers.</p>
          <button type="button" className="btn" onClick={onRetryMeta}>
            Try again
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="control">
        <label htmlFor={yearId} className="control__label">
          Price list year
        </label>
        <select
          id={yearId}
          className="select"
          value={c.year}
          onChange={(e) => dispatch({ type: "year", year: Number(e.target.value) })}
        >
          {yearList.map(({ year, missing }) => (
            <option key={year} value={year}>
              {year}
              {missing.length > 0 ? ` (no ${missing.map((m) => CARRIER_NAME[m]).join(", ")})` : ""}
            </option>
          ))}
        </select>
      </div>

      <fieldset className="control segmented">
        <legend className="control__label">USPS prices</legend>
        {(
          [
            ["commercial", "Commercial", "online postage"],
            ["retail", "Retail", "Post Office counter"],
          ] as const
        ).map(([value, label, note]) => (
          <label key={value} className="segmented__option">
            <input
              type="radio"
              name="usps-rate-card"
              value={value}
              checked={c.usps_rate_card === value}
              onChange={() => dispatch({ type: "card", card: value })}
            />
            <span>
              {label}
              <small>{note}</small>
            </span>
          </label>
        ))}
      </fieldset>

      <fieldset className="control">
        <legend className="control__label">Fuel surcharge (UPS, FedEx)</legend>
        <FuelSlider
          group="ground"
          label="Ground"
          hint="ground services"
          override={c.fuel_override_percent?.ground}
          defaultInfo={fuelDefault(meta, c.year, "ground")}
          onChange={(percent) => dispatch({ type: "fuel", group: "ground", percent })}
          onReset={() => dispatch({ type: "fuelReset", group: "ground" })}
        />
        <FuelSlider
          group="express"
          label="Express"
          hint="2–3 day and next day"
          override={c.fuel_override_percent?.express}
          defaultInfo={fuelDefault(meta, c.year, "express")}
          onChange={(percent) => dispatch({ type: "fuel", group: "express", percent })}
          onReset={() => dispatch({ type: "fuelReset", group: "express" })}
        />
      </fieldset>

      <div className="control switch">
        <input
          id={peakId}
          type="checkbox"
          role="switch"
          checked={c.peak}
          aria-describedby={`${peakId}-hint`}
          onChange={(e) => dispatch({ type: "peak", peak: e.target.checked })}
        />
        <label htmlFor={peakId} className="control__label switch__label">
          Peak season surcharges
        </label>
        <p id={`${peakId}-hint`} className="control__hint switch__hint">
          Prices as of December 10, inside every carrier's peak window.
        </p>
      </div>

      <PriceInput value={c.flat_price} onCommit={(price) => dispatch({ type: "price", price })} />
    </div>
  );
}

import { useEffect, useId, useState } from "react";
import type { Meta } from "../../api/types";
import type { Action, AppState } from "../../state/urlState";
import { fuelDefault, yearOptions } from "../../lib/fuel";
import { CARRIER_NAME, formatPercent, formatUsd } from "../../lib/format";

  state: AppState;
  dispatch: (a: Action) => void;
  meta: Meta | null;
  metaStatus: "loading" | "ok" | "error" | "idle";
  onRetryMeta: () => void;
}

/** One-line summary of the assumptions, shown in the mobile bar. */
export function assumptionsLine(state: AppState): string {
  const c = state.controls;
  const o = c.fuel_override_percent;
  const fuel = o
    ? `fuel ${[o.ground, o.express].map((v) => (v === undefined ? "default" : formatPercent(v))).join(" / ")}`
    : "fuel default";
  return [String(c.year), `USPS ${c.usps_rate_card}`, fuel, c.peak ? "peak" : null, `${formatUsd(c.flat_price)} charged`]
    .filter(Boolean)
    .join(" · ");
}

function PriceInput({ value, onCommit }: { value: number; onCommit: (n: number) => void }) {
  const id = useId();
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState(value.toFixed(2));
  const [problem, setProblem] = useState<string | null>(null);
  useEffect(() => setDraft(value.toFixed(2)), [value]);

  const commit = () => {
    const cleaned = draft.trim().replace(/^\$/, "");
    const n = Number(cleaned);
    if (cleaned === "" || !Number.isFinite(n) || n < 0 || n > 1000) {
      setProblem("Enter a price between $0 and $1,000");
      return;

    setProblem(null);
    onCommit(Math.round(n * 100) / 100);

  return (
    <div className="control">

          value={draft}
          aria-invalid={problem ? true : undefined}
          aria-describedby={`${id}-hint`}
          onChange={(e) => setDraft(e.target.value)}
          onBlur={commit}
          onKeyDown={(e) => {
            if (e.key === "Enter") commit();

      </div>

import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from "react";
import type { Parcel } from "../api/types";
import { useApi } from "../api/ApiContext";
import { ApiError } from "../api/client";
import { parseParcelCsv, type CsvProblem } from "../lib/parcelCsv";

export interface ParcelSet {
  parcels: Parcel[];
  source: "sample" | "upload";
  name: string;
  description?: string;
}

export type ParcelSetStatus =
  | { kind: "idle" }
  | { kind: "loading"; what: "sample" | "file" }
  | { kind: "error"; message: string; problems: CsvProblem[]; fileName?: string };

const STORAGE_KEY = "parcel-rates:parcel-set:v1";
export const MAX_FILE_BYTES = 5 * 1024 * 1024;

function readStored(): ParcelSet | null {
  try {
    const raw = sessionStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
    if (!raw) return null;
    const value = JSON.parse(raw) as ParcelSet;
    return Array.isArray(value?.parcels) && value.parcels.length > 0 ? value : null;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

function store(set: ParcelSet | null) {
  try {
    if (set) sessionStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(set));
    else sessionStorage.removeItem(STORAGE_KEY);
  } catch {
    // Storage full or blocked (private mode): the set stays in memory only.
  }
}

export function useParcelSet() {
  const api = useApi();
  const [set, setSet] = useState<ParcelSet | null>(readStored);
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<ParcelSetStatus>({ kind: "idle" });

  useEffect(() => store(set), [set]);

  const loadSample = useCallback(async () => {
    setStatus({ kind: "loading", what: "sample" });
    try {
      const sample = await api.sampleParcels();
      setSet({ parcels: sample.parcels, source: "sample", name: "Sample mix", description: sample.description });
      setStatus({ kind: "idle" });
    } catch (err) {
      const message =
        err instanceof ApiError ? err.message : "The sample mix could not be loaded. Try again in a moment.";
      setStatus({ kind: "error", message, problems: [] });
    }
  }, [api]);

  const loadFile = useCallback(async (file: File) => {
    if (file.size > MAX_FILE_BYTES) {
      setStatus({
        kind: "error",
        message: `${file.name} is larger than 5 MB. Group identical parcels with the quantity column.`,
        problems: [],
        fileName: file.name,
      });
      return;
    }
    setStatus({ kind: "loading", what: "file" });
    let text: string;
    try {
      text = await file.text();
    } catch {
      setStatus({ kind: "error", message: `${file.name} could not be read.`, problems: [], fileName: file.name });
      return;
    }
    const result = parseParcelCsv(text);
    if (result.errors.length > 0) {
      setStatus({
        kind: "error",
        message: `${file.name} was not loaded: ${result.errors.length} problem${result.errors.length > 1 ? "s" : ""} to fix.`,
        problems: result.errors,
        fileName: file.name,
      });
      return;
    }
    setSet({ parcels: result.parcels, source: "upload", name: file.name });
    setStatus(
      result.warnings.length > 0
        ? { kind: "error", message: "Loaded, with notes:", problems: result.warnings, fileName: file.name }
        : { kind: "idle" },
    );
  }, []);

  const clear = useCallback(() => {
    setSet(null);
    setStatus({ kind: "idle" });
  }, []);

  return { set, status, loadSample, loadFile, clear };
}

import type { Bucket, ParcelSummary as Summary } from "../../lib/summary";
import { TIERS } from "../../api/types";
import { TIER_NAME, formatInt, formatShare } from "../../lib/format";

function MiniBars({ title, unit, buckets }: { title: string; unit: string; buckets: Bucket[] }) {
  const max = Math.max(...buckets.map((b) => b.share), 0.0001);
  return (
    <figure className="minibars">
      <figcaption className="kicker">{title}</figcaption>
      <table className="minibars__table">
        <caption className="visually-hidden">
          Parcels by {title.toLowerCase()}, share of the set
        </caption>
        <tbody>
          {buckets.map((b) => (
            <tr key={b.label}>
              <th scope="row">
                {b.label}
                {unit && <span className="minibars__unit"> {unit}</span>}
              </th>
              <td className="minibars__bar" aria-hidden="true">
                <span style={{ transform: `scaleX(${b.share / max})` }} />
              </td>
              <td className="minibars__value">
                {formatShare(b.share)}
                <span className="visually-hidden"> ({formatInt(b.count)} parcels)</span>
              </td>
            </tr>
          ))}
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </figure>
  );
}

export function ParcelSummary({ summary }: { summary: Summary }) {
  return (
    <div className="summary">
      <dl className="summary__facts">
        <div className="summary__lead">
          <dt className="kicker">Parcels in the set</dt>
          <dd className="figure summary__count">{formatInt(summary.parcels)}</dd>
          <dd className="summary__sub">
            {formatInt(summary.rows)} row{summary.rows === 1 ? "" : "s"} · mean {summary.meanWeightLb.toFixed(1)} lb
          </dd>
        </div>
        <div>
          <dt className="kicker">To homes</dt>
          <dd className="figure summary__fact">{formatShare(summary.residentialShare)}</dd>
          <dd className="summary__sub">residential addresses</dd>
        </div>
        <div>
          <dt className="kicker">Speed</dt>
          <dd className="summary__tiers">
            {TIERS.map((t) => (
              <span key={t}>
                <span className="summary__tier-share">{formatShare(summary.byTier[t])}</span> {TIER_NAME[t]}
              </span>
            ))}
          </dd>
        </div>
        {summary.withOwnPrice > 0 && (
          <div>
            <dt className="kicker">Own price</dt>
            <dd className="figure summary__fact">{formatInt(summary.withOwnPrice)}</dd>
            <dd className="summary__sub">parcels override the flat price</dd>
          </div>
        )}
      </dl>
      <div className="summary__dists">
        <MiniBars title="Weight" unit="lb" buckets={summary.weight} />
        <MiniBars title="Distance" unit="" buckets={summary.distance} />
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import { useId, useMemo, useRef } from "react";
import { CSV_TEMPLATE } from "../../lib/parcelCsv";
import { summarize } from "../../lib/summary";
import type { ParcelSet, ParcelSetStatus } from "../../hooks/useParcelSet";
import { ParcelSummary } from "./ParcelSummary";

export interface ParcelSetPanelProps {
  set: ParcelSet | null;
  status: ParcelSetStatus;
  onLoadSample: () => void;
  onLoadFile: (file: File) => void;
  onClear: () => void;
}

const TEMPLATE_HREF = `data:text/csv;charset=utf-8,${encodeURIComponent(CSV_TEMPLATE)}`;
const MAX_LISTED = 12;

function Problems({ status }: { status: Extract<ParcelSetStatus, { kind: "error" | "notice" }> }) {
  const shown = status.problems.slice(0, MAX_LISTED);
  const rest = status.problems.length - shown.length;
  return (
    <div
      className={`problems ${status.kind === "error" ? "problems--error" : "problems--notice"}`}
      role={status.kind === "error" ? "alert" : "status"}
    >
      <p className="problems__title">{status.message}</p>
      {shown.length > 0 && (
        <ul className="problems__list">
          {shown.map((p, i) => (
            <li key={i}>
              <span className="problems__where">{p.row === null ? "File" : `Row ${p.row}`}</span>
              <span>{p.message}</span>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      )}
      {rest > 0 && (
        <p className="problems__more">
          and {rest} more. Fix these first; the rest often share the same cause.
        </p>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

export function ParcelSetPanel({ set, status, onLoadSample, onLoadFile, onClear }: ParcelSetPanelProps) {
  const fileId = useId();
  const headingId = useId();
  const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const summary = useMemo(() => (set ? summarize(set.parcels) : null), [set]);
  const busy = status.kind === "loading";

  const actions = (
    <div className="parcels__actions">
      <button type="button" className="btn btn--primary" onClick={onLoadSample} disabled={busy}>
        {busy && status.what === "sample" ? "Loading sample…" : "Load sample mix"}
      </button>
      <label htmlFor={fileId} className="btn file-btn">
        {busy && status.what === "file" ? "Reading file…" : "Upload CSV"}
      </label>
      <input
        ref={inputRef}
        id={fileId}
        className="visually-hidden"
        type="file"
        accept=".csv,text/csv"
        disabled={busy}
        onChange={(e) => {
          const file = e.target.files?.[0];
          if (file) onLoadFile(file);
          if (inputRef.current) inputRef.current.value = "";
        }}
      />
      <a className="btn btn--quiet" href={TEMPLATE_HREF} download="parcel-set-template.csv">
        CSV template
      </a>
    </div>
  );

  return (
    <section className="parcels" aria-labelledby={headingId} aria-busy={busy}>
      <header className="parcels__head">
        <div>
          <h2 id={headingId} className="parcels__title">
            Your parcels
          </h2>
          {set ? (
            <p className="parcels__source">
              {set.source === "sample" ? "Sample mix" : set.name}
              {set.description && <span> · {set.description}</span>}{" "}
              <button type="button" className="btn btn--quiet parcels__clear" onClick={onClear}>
                Clear
              </button>
            </p>
          ) : null}
        </div>
        {actions}
      </header>

      {(status.kind === "error" || status.kind === "notice") && <Problems status={status} />}

      {summary ? (
        <ParcelSummary summary={summary} />
      ) : (
        <div className="parcels__empty">
          <p className="parcels__empty-lead">No parcels loaded yet.</p>
          <p>
            Questions 3 and 4 price your whole mix. Load the sample to explore, or upload a CSV with one row per kind
            of parcel: weight, distance, home or business, speed, and how many you ship.
          </p>
        </div>
      )}
    </section>
  );
}

import { useRef, type KeyboardEvent, type ReactNode } from "react";
import type { ViewId } from "../state/urlState";
import { QUESTIONS } from "../views/types";

export interface QuestionTabsProps {
  active: ViewId;
  onSelect: (id: ViewId) => void;
  renderPanel: (id: ViewId) => ReactNode;
}

const tabId = (id: ViewId) => `tab-${id}`;
const panelId = (id: ViewId) => `panel-${id}`;

/** WAI-ARIA tabs with automatic activation; arrow keys, Home and End move between questions. */
export function QuestionTabs({ active, onSelect, renderPanel }: QuestionTabsProps) {
  const refs = useRef<Partial<Record<ViewId, HTMLButtonElement | null>>>({});
  const activeDef = QUESTIONS.find((q) => q.id === active) ?? QUESTIONS[0]!;

  const onKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    const i = QUESTIONS.findIndex((q) => q.id === active);
    const last = QUESTIONS.length - 1;
    const next =
      e.key === "ArrowRight" ? (i === last ? 0 : i + 1)
      : e.key === "ArrowLeft" ? (i === 0 ? last : i - 1)
      : e.key === "Home" ? 0
      : e.key === "End" ? last
      : null;
    if (next === null) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    const id = QUESTIONS[next]!.id;
    onSelect(id);
    refs.current[id]?.focus();
  };

  return (
    <div className="questions">
      <div className="questions__tabs" role="tablist" aria-label="Questions" onKeyDown={onKeyDown}>
        {QUESTIONS.map((q) => (
          <button
            key={q.id}
            ref={(el) => {
              refs.current[q.id] = el;
            }}
            id={tabId(q.id)}
            type="button"
            role="tab"
            aria-selected={q.id === active}
            aria-controls={panelId(q.id)}
            tabIndex={q.id === active ? 0 : -1}
            className="questions__tab"
            onClick={() => onSelect(q.id)}
          >
            <span className="questions__num">{String(q.number).padStart(2, "0")}</span>
            <span className="questions__short">{q.short}</span>
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>
      <section
        id={panelId(activeDef.id)}
        role="tabpanel"
        aria-labelledby={tabId(activeDef.id)}
        className="questions__panel"
        tabIndex={0}
      >
        <p className="kicker">Question {activeDef.number}</p>
        <h2 className="questions__question">{activeDef.question}</h2>
        {renderPanel(activeDef.id)}
      </section>
    </div>
  );
}
EOF

import { useEffect, useReducer, useRef } from "react";
import type { Controls } from "../api/types";
import { FALLBACK_CONTROLS, readState, reducer, writeState, type Action, type AppState } from "../state/urlState";

/** App state mirrored to the query string with history.replaceState, so any view is a shareable link. */
export function useUrlState(defaults: Controls | null): [AppState, (a: Action) => void] {
  const effectiveDefaults = defaults ?? FALLBACK_CONTROLS;
  const [state, dispatch] = useReducer(reducer, undefined, () => readState(window.location.search));
  const adopted = useRef(false);

  // Once the backend's defaults arrive, re-read the URL against them (fills in anything the link left out).
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!defaults || adopted.current) return;
    adopted.current = true;
    dispatch({ type: "replace", state: readState(window.location.search, defaults) });
  }, [defaults]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const search = writeState(state, window.location.search, effectiveDefaults);
    if (search !== window.location.search) {
      window.history.replaceState(window.history.state, "", `${window.location.pathname}${search}${window.location.hash}`);
    }
  }, [state, effectiveDefaults]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const onPop = () => dispatch({ type: "replace", state: readState(window.location.search, effectiveDefaults) });
    window.addEventListener("popstate", onPop);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("popstate", onPop);
  }, [effectiveDefaults]);

  return [state, dispatch];
}

import { useCallback, useEffect, useId, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { useApi, useLoad } from "./api/ApiContext";
import { isMockMode } from "./api/client";
import { ControlRail, assumptionsLine } from "./components/controls/ControlRail";
import { ParcelSetPanel } from "./components/parcels/ParcelSetPanel";
import { QuestionTabs } from "./components/QuestionTabs";
import { Footer } from "./components/Footer";
import { useParcelSet } from "./hooks/useParcelSet";
import { useUrlState } from "./hooks/useUrlState";
import type { ViewId } from "./state/urlState";
import type { ViewProps } from "./views/types";
import { QuoteView } from "./views/QuoteView";
import { BreakevenView } from "./views/BreakevenView";
import { BlendedView } from "./views/BlendedView";
import { YearlyView } from "./views/YearlyView";

const VIEW_COMPONENTS: Record<ViewId, (p: ViewProps) => JSX.Element> = {
  quote: QuoteView,
  breakeven: BreakevenView,
  blended: BlendedView,
  yearly: YearlyView,
};

function useSheet() {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const toggleRef = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);
  const sheetRef = useRef<HTMLElement>(null);
  const close = useCallback(() => {
    setOpen(false);
    toggleRef.current?.focus();
  }, []);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return;
    sheetRef.current?.querySelector<HTMLElement>("select, input, button")?.focus();
    const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => e.key === "Escape" && close();
    document.addEventListener("keydown", onKey);
    return () => document.removeEventListener("keydown", onKey);
  }, [open, close]);
  return { open, setOpen, close, toggleRef, sheetRef };
}

export function App() {
  const api = useApi();
  const [metaAttempt, setMetaAttempt] = useState(0);
  const metaState = useLoad((signal) => api.meta(signal), [api, metaAttempt]);
  const meta = metaState.status === "ok" ? metaState.data : null;
  const [state, dispatch] = useUrlState(meta?.default_controls ?? null);
  const parcelSet = useParcelSet();
  const sheet = useSheet();
  const railId = useId();
  const mock = isMockMode();

  const viewProps: ViewProps = { controls: state.controls, meta, parcels: parcelSet.set?.parcels ?? null };

  return (
    <>
      <a className="skip-link" href="#main">
        Skip to the questions
      </a>
      {mock && (
        <p className="mock-banner" role="note">
          <strong>Mock data.</strong> Numbers come from a toy formula for design work, not from carrier price lists.
        </p>
      )}
      <header className="masthead">
        <div className="masthead__inner">
          <p className="kicker masthead__edition">
            {state.controls.year} published list prices · USPS, UPS, FedEx
          </p>
          <h1 className="masthead__title">Parcel Rates</h1>
          <p className="masthead__deck">
            Which carrier is cheapest for each kind of parcel you ship, and does your flat shipping price still cover
            the real cost after surcharges and yearly increases?
          </p>
        </div>
      </header>

      <div className="mobile-bar">
        <p className="mobile-bar__line">{assumptionsLine(state)}</p>
        <button
          ref={sheet.toggleRef}
          type="button"
          className="btn mobile-bar__toggle"
          aria-expanded={sheet.open}
          aria-controls={railId}
          onClick={() => sheet.setOpen(!sheet.open)}
        >
          Adjust
        </button>
      </div>

      <div className="layout">
        {sheet.open && <button type="button" className="sheet-backdrop" aria-label="Close assumptions" onClick={sheet.close} />}
        <aside
          id={railId}
          ref={sheet.sheetRef}
          className={`rail ${sheet.open ? "rail--open" : ""}`}
          aria-label="Assumptions"
        >
          <div className="rail__head">
            <h2 className="kicker rail__title">Assumptions</h2>
            <button type="button" className="btn btn--quiet rail__close" onClick={sheet.close}>
              Done
            </button>
          </div>
          <ControlRail
            state={state}
            dispatch={dispatch}
            meta={meta}
            metaStatus={metaState.status === "ok" ? "ok" : metaState.status}
            onRetryMeta={() => setMetaAttempt((n) => n + 1)}
          />
        </aside>

        <main id="main" className="main" tabIndex={-1}>
          <ParcelSetPanel
            set={parcelSet.set}
            status={parcelSet.status}
            onLoadSample={parcelSet.loadSample}
            onLoadFile={parcelSet.loadFile}
            onClear={parcelSet.clear}
          />
          <QuestionTabs
            active={state.view}
            onSelect={(view) => dispatch({ type: "view", view })}
            renderPanel={(id) => {
              const View = VIEW_COMPONENTS[id];
              return <View {...viewProps} />;
            }}
          />
          <Footer meta={meta} status={metaState.status} />
        </main>
      </div>
    </>
  );
}

.rail__body {
  display: grid;
  gap: var(--space-5);
  padding-top: var(--space-4);
}

.control {
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  border: 0;
  min-width: 0;
  display: grid;
  gap: var(--space-2);
}

.control__label,
.fuel__label,
.switch__label {
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
  font-weight: 600;
  padding: 0;
}

fieldset.control > legend {
  margin-bottom: var(--space-2);
}

.control__hint {
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
  color: var(--ink-muted);
}

.control__error {
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
  color: var(--loss);
  font-weight: 600;
}

.select {
  width: 100%;
  min-height: 2.75rem;
  padding: var(--space-2) var(--space-3);
  border: 1px solid var(--ink);
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  background: var(--paper);
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}

/* Segmented radio group */
.segmented__options {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  border: 1px solid var(--ink);
  border-radius: var(--radius);
}

.segmented__option {
  position: relative;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.segmented__option + .segmented__option {
  border-left: 1px solid var(--ink);
}

.segmented__option input {
  position: absolute;
  opacity: 0;
  inset: 0;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.segmented__text {
  display: grid;
  padding: var(--space-2) var(--space-3);
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
  font-weight: 600;
  min-height: 2.75rem;
  transition: background var(--duration-fast), color var(--duration-fast);
}

.segmented__text small {
  font-weight: 400;
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
  color: var(--ink-muted);
}

.segmented__option:hover .segmented__text {
  background: var(--wash);
}

.segmented__option input:checked + .segmented__text {
  background: var(--ink);
  color: var(--paper);
}

.segmented__option input:checked + .segmented__text small {
  color: inherit;
  opacity: 0.8;
}

.segmented__option input:focus-visible + .segmented__text {
  outline: 2px solid var(--focus);
  outline-offset: 2px;
}

/* Fuel sliders */
.fuel {
  display: grid;
  gap: var(--space-1);
}

.fuel + .fuel {
  margin-top: var(--space-4);
}

.fuel__head {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: baseline;
}

.fuel__value {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: var(--text-xl);
  font-weight: 500;
  line-height: 1;
}

.fuel--overridden .fuel__value {
  text-decoration: underline;
  text-decoration-thickness: 2px;
  text-underline-offset: 0.15em;
}

.fuel__track {
  position: relative;
  height: 2rem;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
}

.fuel__track input[type="range"] {
  width: 100%;
  margin: 0;
  accent-color: var(--ink);
  background: transparent;
  cursor: pointer;
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
}

/* The year's default: a tick that stays put while the thumb moves */
.fuel__marker {
  position: absolute;
  top: 0.15rem;
  bottom: 0.15rem;
  width: 2px;
  margin-left: -1px;
  background: var(--ink-muted);
  pointer-events: none;
}

.fuel__foot {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--space-2);
  min-height: 1.75rem;
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
  color: var(--ink-muted);
}

.fuel__reset {
  min-height: 1.75rem;
  padding: 0 var(--space-1);
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
  color: var(--ink);
}

/* Peak switch */
.switch {
  grid-template-columns: auto 1fr;
  align-items: center;
  column-gap: var(--space-3);
}

.switch input {
  appearance: none;
  width: 2.75rem;
  height: 1.5rem;
  margin: 0;
  border: 1px solid var(--ink);
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: var(--paper);
  position: relative;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background var(--duration-fast);
}

.switch input::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  top: 2px;
  left: 2px;
  width: 1.125rem;
  height: 1.125rem;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--ink);
  transition: transform var(--duration) var(--ease-out);
}

.switch input:checked {
  background: var(--ink);
}

.switch input:checked::after {
  background: var(--paper);
  transform: translateX(1.25rem);
}

.switch__label {
  cursor: pointer;
}

.switch__hint {
  grid-column: 1 / -1;
}

/* Money input */
.money-input {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--space-1);
  border-bottom: 2px solid var(--ink);
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: var(--text-xl);
}

.money-input input {
  width: 100%;
  min-width: 0;
  border: 0;
  background: transparent;
  padding: var(--space-1) 0;
  font: inherit;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}

.money-input input:focus-visible {
  outline: none;
  box-shadow: none;
}

.money-input:focus-within {
  outline: 2px solid var(--focus);
  outline-offset: 4px;
}

.money-input--invalid {
  border-color: var(--loss);
}

.parcels {

  align-items: flex-end;
  gap: var(--space-4);

  font-size: var(--text-xl);

  margin-top: var(--space-1);

  flex-wrap: wrap;

.summary {

import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { CSV_TEMPLATE, parseBool, parseParcelCsv } from "./parcelCsv";

const HEADER = "weight_lb,length_in,width_in,height_in,distance_miles,residential,speed,quantity,price_charged,delivery_area,nonstandard_packaging";

describe("parseParcelCsv", () => {
  it("parses a valid file with all columns", () => {
    const csv = `${HEADER}\n0.8,9,6,3,120,true,ground,40,12.5,das,false\n4,,,,950,no,next_day,,,,\n`;
    const { parcels, errors, warnings } = parseParcelCsv(csv);
    expect(errors).toEqual([]);
    expect(warnings).toEqual([]);
    expect(parcels).toEqual([
      {
        weight_lb: 0.8, length_in: 9, width_in: 6, height_in: 3, distance_miles: 120, residential: true,
        speed: "ground", quantity: 40, price_charged: 12.5, delivery_area: "das", nonstandard_packaging: false,
      },
      { weight_lb: 4, distance_miles: 950, residential: false, speed: "next_day", quantity: 1 },
    ]);
  });

  it("accepts only the required columns, in any order and case, and defaults quantity to 1", () => {
    const csv = "Speed, Residential ,DISTANCE_MILES,weight_lb\nground,1,300,2.5\n";
    const { parcels, errors } = parseParcelCsv(csv);
    expect(errors).toEqual([]);
    expect(parcels).toEqual([{ weight_lb: 2.5, distance_miles: 300, residential: true, speed: "ground", quantity: 1 }]);
  });

  it("rejects a file missing a required column with a file-level message", () => {
    const { parcels, errors } = parseParcelCsv("weight_lb,distance_miles,speed\n1,100,ground\n");
    expect(parcels).toEqual([]);
    expect(errors).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(errors[0]).toMatchObject({ row: null });
    expect(errors[0]!.message).toContain("residential");
  });

  it("reports a bad boolean with its spreadsheet row number", () => {
    const csv = "weight_lb,distance_miles,residential,speed\n1,100,true,ground\n2,200,maybe,ground\n";
    const { parcels, errors } = parseParcelCsv(csv);
    expect(parcels).toEqual([]);
    expect(errors).toEqual([
      { row: 3, column: "residential", message: 'residential "maybe" is not true/false, yes/no or 1/0' },
    ]);
  });

  it.each([
    ["true", true], ["TRUE", true], ["yes", true], ["Yes", true], ["1", true],
    ["false", false], ["no", false], ["0", false], [" No ", false],
  ])("reads %j as %s", (raw, expected) => {
    expect(parseBool(raw)).toBe(expected);
  });

  it("rejects weight over 70 lb and non-positive weight", () => {
    const csv = "weight_lb,distance_miles,residential,speed\n70.5,100,true,ground\n0,100,true,ground\n70,100,true,ground\n";
    const { errors } = parseParcelCsv(csv);
    expect(errors.map((e) => [e.row, e.column])).toEqual([[2, "weight_lb"], [3, "weight_lb"]]);
    expect(errors[0]!.message).toContain("70 lb");
  });

  it("validates optional columns: partial dimensions, quantity, area, speed, price", () => {
    const csv = [
      HEADER,
      "1,10,,,100,true,ground,,,,",
      "1,,,,100,true,ground,2.5,,,",
      "1,,,,100,true,ground,,,rural,",
      "1,,,,100,true,express,,,,",
      "1,,,,100,true,ground,,-1,,",
      "1,,,,100,true,ground,,,,perhaps",
    ].join("\n");
    const { errors } = parseParcelCsv(csv);
    expect(errors.map((e) => [e.row, e.column])).toEqual([
      [2, "length_in"],
      [3, "quantity"],
      [4, "delivery_area"],
      [5, "speed"],
      [6, "price_charged"],
      [7, "nonstandard_packaging"],
    ]);
  });

  it("accepts a $ sign on prices, speed aliases and a BOM, and warns about unknown columns", () => {
    const csv = "﻿weight_lb,distance_miles,residential,speed,sku\n1,100,yes,overnight,AB-1\n";
    const csv2 = "weight_lb,distance_miles,residential,speed,price_charged\n1,100,yes,ground,$9.50\n";
    const a = parseParcelCsv(csv);
    expect(a.errors).toEqual([]);
    expect(a.parcels[0]!.speed).toBe("next_day");
    expect(a.warnings).toEqual([{ row: null, column: "sku", message: 'Column "sku" is not used and was ignored' }]);
    expect(parseParcelCsv(csv2).parcels[0]!.price_charged).toBe(9.5);
  });

  it("reports a header-only file as empty", () => {
    expect(parseParcelCsv("weight_lb,distance_miles,residential,speed\n").errors[0]!.message).toContain("no parcel rows");
  });

  it("parses its own downloadable template without errors", () => {
    const { parcels, errors } = parseParcelCsv(CSV_TEMPLATE);
    expect(errors).toEqual([]);
    expect(parcels).toHaveLength(4);
  });
});
