cat > src/lib/summary.test.ts <<'EOF'
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import type { Parcel } from "../api/types";
import { distanceBand, summarize, weightBand } from "./summary";

const p = (o: Partial<Parcel>): Parcel => ({ weight_lb: 1, distance_miles: 100, residential: true, speed: "ground", ...o });

describe("summarize", () => {
  const parcels = [
    p({ weight_lb: 0.5, quantity: 6, distance_miles: 50 }),
    p({ weight_lb: 3, quantity: 3, residential: false, speed: "two_three_day", distance_miles: 700 }),
    p({ weight_lb: 25, distance_miles: 2000, speed: "next_day", price_charged: 30 }),
  ];
  const s = summarize(parcels);

  it("counts parcels by quantity, not rows", () => {
    expect(s.rows).toBe(3);
    expect(s.parcels).toBe(10);
    expect(s.withOwnPrice).toBe(1);
  });

  it("weights shares by quantity", () => {
    expect(s.residentialShare).toBeCloseTo(0.7);
    expect(s.byTier).toEqual({ ground: 0.6, two_three_day: 0.3, next_day: 0.1 });
    expect(s.meanWeightLb).toBeCloseTo((0.5 * 6 + 3 * 3 + 25) / 10);
  });

  it("buckets weight and distance into the contract's bands", () => {
    expect(s.weight.map((b) => [b.label, b.count])).toEqual([["≤1", 6], ["1–5", 3], ["5–10", 0], ["10–20", 0], ["20–70", 1]]);
    expect(s.distance.map((b) => b.count)).toEqual([6, 0, 3, 1]);
    expect(s.weight.reduce((a, b) => a + b.share, 0)).toBeCloseTo(1);
  });

  it("returns zero shares for an empty set", () => {
    const e = summarize([]);
    expect(e.parcels).toBe(0);
    expect(e.residentialShare).toBe(0);
    expect(e.weight.every((b) => b.share === 0)).toBe(true);
  });

  it("puts band edges in the lower band", () => {
    expect(weightBand(1)).toBe("≤1");
    expect(weightBand(1.01)).toBe("1–5");
    expect(weightBand(70)).toBe("20–70");
    expect(distanceBand(150)).toBe("0–150 mi");
    expect(distanceBand(151)).toBe("151–600 mi");
  });
});

cat > src/state/urlState.test.ts <<'EOF'
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { FALLBACK_CONTROLS, readState, reducer, writeState, type AppState } from "./urlState";

const base: AppState = { controls: FALLBACK_CONTROLS, view: "quote" };

describe("URL state", () => {
  it("writes nothing for the defaults", () => {
    expect(writeState(base)).toBe("");
    expect(readState("")).toEqual(base);
  });

  it("round-trips every control and the active view", () => {
    const state: AppState = {
      controls: {
        year: 2024,
        usps_rate_card: "retail",
        fuel_override_percent: { ground: 22.5, express: 30 },
        peak: true,
        flat_price: 7.5,
      },
      view: "blended",
    };
    const search = writeState(state);
    expect(search).toContain("year=2024");
    expect(readState(search)).toEqual(state);
  });

  it("keeps foreign params such as mock=1", () => {
    const search = writeState({ ...base, view: "yearly" }, "?mock=1&view=quote");
    const params = new URLSearchParams(search);
    expect(params.get("mock")).toBe("1");
    expect(params.get("view")).toBe("yearly");
  });

  it("ignores invalid values and falls back to defaults", () => {
    const s = readState("?year=abc&usps=wholesale&fuel_ground=95&price=-3&view=nope&peak=yes");
    expect(s).toEqual({ controls: { ...FALLBACK_CONTROLS, peak: false }, view: "quote" });
  });

  it("uses the backend defaults when given", () => {
    expect(readState("", { ...FALLBACK_CONTROLS, year: 2025 }).controls.year).toBe(2025);
  });
});

describe("reducer", () => {
  it("sets and resets one fuel group without touching the other", () => {
    let s = reducer(base, { type: "fuel", group: "ground", percent: 20 });
    s = reducer(s, { type: "fuel", group: "express", percent: 25 });
    s = reducer(s, { type: "fuelReset", group: "ground" });
    expect(s.controls.fuel_override_percent).toEqual({ express: 25 });
    s = reducer(s, { type: "fuelReset", group: "express" });
    expect(s.controls).not.toHaveProperty("fuel_override_percent");
  });

  it("clamps fuel and price to their ranges", () => {
    expect(reducer(base, { type: "fuel", group: "ground", percent: 99 }).controls.fuel_override_percent?.ground).toBe(40);
    expect(reducer(base, { type: "price", price: -5 }).controls.flat_price).toBe(0);
  });

  it("drops fuel overrides when the year changes", () => {
    const s = reducer(reducer(base, { type: "fuel", group: "ground", percent: 20 }), { type: "year", year: 2023 });
    expect(s.controls.year).toBe(2023);
    expect(s.controls.fuel_override_percent).toBeUndefined();
  });
});

cat > src/api/client.test.ts <<'EOF'
import { describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";
import { ApiError, createHttpClient, describeLoc, problemsFromBody } from "./client";
import { mockDefaultControls } from "./mocks";

const json = (status: number, body: unknown) =>
  new Response(JSON.stringify(body), { status, headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" } });

describe("API client", () => {
  it("GETs /api/meta and returns the parsed body", async () => {
    const fetchImpl = vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(json(200, { years: {} }));
    const api = createHttpClient({ fetchImpl });
    await expect(api.meta()).resolves.toEqual({ years: {} });
    expect(fetchImpl).toHaveBeenCalledWith("/api/meta", expect.objectContaining({ headers: expect.any(Object) }));
  });

  it("POSTs JSON to /api/quote", async () => {
    const fetchImpl = vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(json(200, { quotes: [], cheapest_by_tier: {} }));
    const api = createHttpClient({ fetchImpl });
    const parcel = { weight_lb: 2, distance_miles: 300, residential: true, speed: "ground" as const };
    await api.quote({ parcel, controls: mockDefaultControls });
    const [url, init] = fetchImpl.mock.calls[0]!;
    expect(url).toBe("/api/quote");
    expect(init.method).toBe("POST");
    expect(init.headers["Content-Type"]).toBe("application/json");
    expect(JSON.parse(init.body)).toEqual({ parcel, controls: mockDefaultControls });
  });

  it("turns a 422 into an ApiError with readable field problems", async () => {
    const fetchImpl = vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(
      json(422, {
        detail: [
          { loc: ["body", "parcels", 3, "weight_lb"], msg: "weight_lb must be at most 70", type: "value_error" },
          { loc: ["body", "controls", "flat_price"], msg: "flat_price must be at least 0" },
        ],
      }),
    );
    const api = createHttpClient({ fetchImpl });
    const err = await api.blended({ parcels: [], controls: mockDefaultControls }).catch((e: unknown) => e);
    expect(err).toBeInstanceOf(ApiError);
    const apiErr = err as ApiError;
    expect(apiErr.status).toBe(422);
    expect(apiErr.message).toBe("Some inputs were not accepted.");
    expect(apiErr.problems).toEqual([
      { field: "parcels · row 4 · weight_lb", message: "weight_lb must be at most 70" },
      { field: "controls · flat_price", message: "flat_price must be at least 0" },
    ]);
  });

  it("accepts a string detail (FastAPI HTTPException) and ignores junk", () => {
    expect(problemsFromBody({ detail: "Year 2019 is not covered" })).toEqual([{ field: "", message: "Year 2019 is not covered" }]);
    expect(problemsFromBody({ detail: [{ nope: 1 }] })).toEqual([]);
    expect(problemsFromBody("<html>")).toEqual([]);
    expect(describeLoc(["query", "year"])).toBe("year");
  });

  it("reports a 500 with a non-JSON body and a network failure", async () => {
    const api500 = createHttpClient({ fetchImpl: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(new Response("boom", { status: 500 })) });
    await expect(api500.sampleParcels()).rejects.toMatchObject({ status: 500, problems: [] });
    const apiDown = createHttpClient({ fetchImpl: vi.fn().mockRejectedValue(new TypeError("Failed to fetch")) });
    await expect(apiDown.meta()).rejects.toMatchObject({ status: 0, message: expect.stringContaining("backend") });
  });
});

import { useReducer } from "react";
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { fireEvent, render, screen, within } from "@testing-library/react";
import userEvent from "@testing-library/user-event";
import { mockMeta } from "../../api/mocks";
import { FALLBACK_CONTROLS, reducer, type AppState } from "../../state/urlState";
import { ControlRail, assumptionsLine } from "./ControlRail";

let latest: AppState;

function Harness({ initial }: { initial?: AppState }) {
  const [state, dispatch] = useReducer(reducer, initial ?? { controls: FALLBACK_CONTROLS, view: "quote" });
  latest = state;
  return <ControlRail state={state} dispatch={dispatch} meta={mockMeta} metaStatus="ok" onRetryMeta={() => {}} />;
}

describe("ControlRail", () => {
  it("shows the year's fuel default and no reset until the slider moves", () => {
    render(<Harness />);
    const ground = screen.getByRole("slider", { name: "Ground" });
    expect(ground).toHaveValue("26.25");
    expect(screen.getByText(/Year default 26\.25%, ground services/)).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.queryByRole("button", { name: /reset ground/i })).not.toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it("changing the fuel slider updates state and offers a reset that restores the default", async () => {
    render(<Harness />);
    const ground = screen.getByRole("slider", { name: "Ground" });
    fireEvent.change(ground, { target: { value: "31.5" } });
    expect(latest.controls.fuel_override_percent).toEqual({ ground: 31.5 });
    expect(ground).toHaveValue("31.5");
    const reset = screen.getByRole("button", { name: /reset ground fuel/i });
    await userEvent.click(reset);
    expect(latest.controls.fuel_override_percent).toBeUndefined();
    expect(ground).toHaveValue("26.25");
    expect(screen.queryByRole("button", { name: /reset ground fuel/i })).not.toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it("switches the USPS rate card", async () => {
    render(<Harness />);
    const group = screen.getByRole("group", { name: "USPS prices" });
    const retail = within(group).getByRole("radio", { name: /retail/i });
    expect(within(group).getByRole("radio", { name: /commercial/i })).toBeChecked();
    await userEvent.click(retail);
    expect(retail).toBeChecked();
    expect(latest.controls.usps_rate_card).toBe("retail");
  });

  it("lists every year and says which carriers are missing", async () => {
    render(<Harness />);
    const year = screen.getByRole("combobox", { name: "Price list year" });
    expect(within(year).getByRole("option", { name: "2027 (no USPS, UPS)" })).toBeInTheDocument();
    await userEvent.selectOptions(year, "2024");
    expect(latest.controls.year).toBe(2024);
    expect(screen.getByRole("slider", { name: "Ground" })).toHaveValue("16.25");
  });

  it("toggles peak and validates the flat price", async () => {
    render(<Harness />);
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole("switch", { name: /peak season/i }));
    expect(latest.controls.peak).toBe(true);

    const price = screen.getByRole("textbox", { name: /flat price/i });
    await userEvent.clear(price);
    await userEvent.type(price, "12.4{Enter}");
    expect(latest.controls.flat_price).toBe(12.4);

    await userEvent.clear(price);
    await userEvent.type(price, "abc{Enter}");
    expect(price).toHaveAttribute("aria-invalid", "true");
    expect(screen.getByText(/enter a price between/i)).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(latest.controls.flat_price).toBe(12.4);
  });

  it("shows an error with a retry when the price lists fail to load", async () => {
    let retried = 0;
    render(
      <ControlRail
        state={{ controls: FALLBACK_CONTROLS, view: "quote" }}
        dispatch={() => {}}
        meta={null}
        metaStatus="error"
        onRetryMeta={() => (retried += 1)}
      />,
    );
    expect(screen.getByRole("alert")).toHaveTextContent(/price lists did not load/i);
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: /try again/i }));
    expect(retried).toBe(1);
  });

  it("summarises the assumptions in one line for the mobile bar", () => {
    expect(assumptionsLine({ controls: FALLBACK_CONTROLS, view: "quote" })).toBe(
      "2026 · USPS commercial · fuel default · $9.99 charged",
    );
    expect(
      assumptionsLine({
        controls: { ...FALLBACK_CONTROLS, peak: true, fuel_override_percent: { express: 30 } },

import { beforeEach, describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { render, screen, within } from "@testing-library/react";
import userEvent from "@testing-library/user-event";
import { ApiProvider } from "./api/ApiContext";
import { createMockClient, type ApiClient } from "./api/client";
import { App } from "./App";

function renderApp(client: ApiClient = createMockClient(0)) {
  return render(
    <ApiProvider client={client}>
      <App />
    </ApiProvider>,
  );
}

describe("App", () => {
  beforeEach(() => window.history.replaceState(null, "", "/"));

  it("loads the sample mix and shows the set summary", async () => {
    renderApp();
    expect(screen.getByText("No parcels loaded yet.")).toBeInTheDocument();
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Load sample mix" }));
    const section = await screen.findByRole("region", { name: "Your parcels" });
    expect(await within(section).findByText("791")).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(within(section).getByText(/Illustrative month/)).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(within(section).getByRole("table", { name: /weight/i })).toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it("shows CSV problems with row numbers and keeps the previous set", async () => {
    renderApp();
    const file = new File(["weight_lb,distance_miles,residential,speed\n80,100,true,ground\n"], "march.csv", {
      type: "text/csv",
    });
    await userEvent.upload(screen.getByLabelText("Upload CSV"), file);
    const alert = await screen.findByRole("alert");
    expect(alert).toHaveTextContent("march.csv was not loaded: 1 problem to fix.");
    expect(alert).toHaveTextContent("Row 2");
    expect(alert).toHaveTextContent("over the 70 lb limit");
    expect(screen.getByText("No parcels loaded yet.")).toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it("mirrors controls and the active question to the URL", async () => {
    renderApp();
    await screen.findByRole("option", { name: "2025" });
    await userEvent.selectOptions(screen.getByRole("combobox", { name: "Price list year" }), "2025");
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole("tab", { name: /blended cost/i }));
    const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
    expect(params.get("year")).toBe("2025");
    expect(params.get("view")).toBe("blended");
    expect(screen.getByRole("tabpanel")).toHaveTextContent(/Across all your parcels/);
  });

  it("restores state from a shared link", async () => {
    window.history.replaceState(null, "", "/?view=yearly&usps=retail&peak=1");
    renderApp();
    expect(screen.getByRole("tab", { name: /year over year/i })).toHaveAttribute("aria-selected", "true");
    expect(screen.getByRole("radio", { name: /retail/i })).toBeChecked();
    expect(screen.getByRole("switch", { name: /peak/i })).toBeChecked();
  });

  it("moves between questions with the arrow keys", async () => {
    renderApp();
    const first = screen.getByRole("tab", { name: /quote a parcel/i });
    first.focus();
    await userEvent.keyboard("{ArrowRight}");
    expect(screen.getByRole("tab", { name: /breakeven map/i })).toHaveFocus();
    await userEvent.keyboard("{End}");
    expect(screen.getByRole("tab", { name: /year over year/i })).toHaveAttribute("aria-selected", "true");
  });

  it("renders the footer limitations from /api/meta", async () => {
    renderApp();
    expect(await screen.findByText(/Published list prices only/)).toBeInTheDocument();
  });
});
EOF

function readFileText(file: File): Promise<string> {

## Issue #4 report: frontend scaffold

The scaffold is built in the worktree `~/parcel-rates-issue-4`, on branch `issue-4-frontend-scaffold`, in 3 commits (c79c73b, 208fb13, cf23c1d). Nothing was pushed, no PR was opened and nothing was merged. Tests, typecheck and build all pass.

**Design direction: "shipping ledger".** The page is styled like a printed price sheet: warm paper, black ink, hairline rules, Newsreader for headings and numbers, IBM Plex Sans for the interface.
- The figures are the largest thing on the page (`--text-figure`).
- Each question is a large serif headline.
- The settings (year, rate card, fuel, peak, flat price) sit in quiet small type in a left column on desktop. On phones they move into a bottom sheet, opened from a sticky one-line summary bar.
- Colours carry meaning only: one fixed colour per carrier (USPS blue `#1F4E9A`, UPS brown `#7A4E0F`, FedEx purple `#9C2A7E`), plus loss and profit colours. Every text colour passes WCAG AA in light and dark.
- USPS blue and FedEx purple can look alike to colour-blind users, so the carrier name always appears next to the colour.
- Dark mode follows `prefers-color-scheme`.
- The reasoning, tokens and chart guidance for issues #5 and #6 are in `frontend/DESIGN.md`.

**What was built (all under `frontend/`)**
- **Stack:** Vite 6.4.5, React 18.3, TS 5.6, Recharts 3.2, Papa Parse, Vitest 3.2.7 with Testing Library and jsdom 25. Versions are pinned and run on Node 18.
- **Scripts:** `dev`, `build`, `typecheck`, `test`.
- **Dev server:** proxies `/api` to `localhost:8000`.
- **API layer:**
  - `src/api/types.ts` mirrors the contract.
  - `src/api/client.ts` has a fetch call for every endpoint. It turns a 422 into a readable list of field problems: the error location becomes text like "parcels · row 4 · weight_lb", and a plain-string `detail` is also handled. It also handles network failures and non-JSON replies.
  - `src/api/mocks.ts` produces mock responses from a small made-up price formula, so issues #5 and #6 can test against them. With `?mock=1` the mocks load as a separate chunk and a "Mock data" banner shows.
  - `ApiProvider`, `useApi` and `useLoad` are there for issues #5 and #6 to use.
- **Settings:** year select (marks years where a carrier has no prices), USPS commercial or retail, fuel sliders for ground and express with the year's default marked and a Reset button, peak toggle, and a validated flat-price input. Changing the year clears fuel overrides. The settings and the active question are mirrored to the URL and kept short; other parameters such as `mock=1` are preserved.
- **Parcel input:** CSV upload parsed in the browser.
  - It accepts true/false, yes/no and 1/0, plus a byte-order mark at the start of the file and a `$` in prices.
  - It rejects weights over 70 lb, a partial set of dimensions, and quantities that are not whole numbers.
  - Errors list the spreadsheet row number, and unknown columns produce a warning.
  - A file with errors is not loaded at all, and the parcels already loaded stay in place.
  - Also included: a "Load sample mix" button, a downloadable CSV template, and a summary of the set: parcel count, share residential, share by speed, and small bars for weight and distance.
  - The set is kept in sessionStorage, wrapped in try/catch.
- **Questions:** Q1 to Q4 are keyboard-operable tabs. Each view is a placeholder in its own file under `src/views/`, all taking the same props (`ViewProps`), so issues #5 and #6 replace one file each. The footer lists the data limitations from `/meta`.
- **Accessibility:** skip link, labels on every control, visible focus, a switch role on the peak toggle, Esc closes the phone sheet and focus returns to its button, and motion is off under reduced-motion.

**Results**
- `npm run test`: 49 tests pass in 6 files (CSV parser, summary, URL round trip and reducer, settings, API client 422 handling, and an app flow with the mock client), with no act() warnings.

**Screenshots** (in `frontend/e2e/screenshots/`): desktop and mobile, empty and with the sample loaded, the mobile settings sheet, and dark versions. Playwright 1.56.1 was installed only in the scratchpad, using the cached Chromium, not as a project dependency. There is no sideways scrolling at 1440 or 375. Two fixes after looking at them:

The phone layout was fine as it was.

**Gaps in `docs/API.md`.** I filled each with an assumption, marked `CONTRACT GAP` in `types.ts`. The contract should pin these down:
1. **`/sample-parcels`:** "`Parcel[]` with a `description`" can't work, because a JSON array can't carry a description. I assumed `{description, parcels}`.
2. **`/meta`:** no shape is given. I assumed `years: Record<Carrier, number[]>`, `services`, `default_controls`, `fuel_defaults` as rows of `{carrier, year, service_group, default_percent, is_proxy}`, `zone_bands`, and `limitations: string[]`.
   - Fuel overrides are set per service group, but the defaults are stored per carrier. If UPS and FedEx defaults ever differ, the slider's "default" is ambiguous; the contract should say which value the slider shows.
3. **`/quote`:** what `cheapest_by_tier` holds when a tier has no available service. I assumed `null`.
4. **`/breakeven`:** no shape for `breakeven_weight_lb`. I assumed `[{distance_miles, vs_ups_lb, vs_fedex_lb}]`, with null when USPS never loses. The winner for residential ground should also be named explicitly (FedEx Home Delivery vs FedEx Ground).

6. **`/yearly`:**

   - It should also say whether `controls.year` matters here and whether a fuel override applies to every year.
   - I assumed `carriers[].points[]`, with `projected: true` on the projected next year, and `drivers[]`.
7. **Segment bands:** it isn't clear whether a value on a band edge belongs to the lower band (I put 1 lb in ≤1), or whether bands use actual or billable weight.
8. **Example payloads:** the contract mentions example payloads in `docs/api-examples/`, but that folder doesn't exist. The mocks could serve as a starting point.
9. **Errors:** FastAPI's own errors return `detail` as a plain string, not an array. The client handles both, but the contract only describes the array.

"""Pydantic models for the API contract (docs/API.md).

These mirror frontend/src/api/types.ts. Field constraints double as the 422
messages a shop owner sees (see app/api/errors.py).
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import date
from typing import Literal

from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field, model_validator

Carrier = Literal["usps", "ups", "fedex"]
Tier = Literal["ground", "two_three_day", "next_day"]
DeliveryArea = Literal["none", "das", "extended"]
UspsRateCard = Literal["commercial", "retail"]
WeightBand = Literal["≤1", "1–5", "5–10", "10–20", "20–70"]
ZoneBand = Literal["1–2", "3–4", "5–6", "7–8"]

MAX_WEIGHT_LB = 70  # app cap from docs/API.md (USPS maximum); not a price
MAX_PARCELS = 10_000


# ---- requests -------------------------------------------------------------
class Parcel(BaseModel):
    weight_lb: float = Field(gt=0, le=MAX_WEIGHT_LB)
    length_in: float | None = Field(default=None, gt=0)
    width_in: float | None = Field(default=None, gt=0)
    height_in: float | None = Field(default=None, gt=0)
    distance_miles: float = Field(ge=0)
    residential: bool
    speed: Tier
    quantity: int = Field(default=1, ge=1)
    price_charged: float | None = Field(default=None, ge=0)
    delivery_area: DeliveryArea = "none"
    nonstandard_packaging: bool = False

    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def _all_or_no_dimensions(self) -> "Parcel":
        given = [v is not None for v in (self.length_in, self.width_in, self.height_in)]
        if any(given) and not all(given):
            raise ValueError("give length_in, width_in and height_in together, or none of them")
        return self


class FuelOverride(BaseModel):
    ground: float | None = Field(default=None, ge=0, le=100)
    express: float | None = Field(default=None, ge=0, le=100)


class Controls(BaseModel):
    year: int | None = Field(default=None, description="default: latest year with all three carriers")
    as_of: date | None = None
    usps_rate_card: UspsRateCard = "commercial"
    fuel_override_percent: FuelOverride | None = None
    peak: bool = False
    flat_price: float = Field(default=9.99, ge=0)


class SegmentFilter(BaseModel):
    weight_band: WeightBand | None = None
    zone_band: ZoneBand | None = None
    residential: bool | None = None
    speed: Tier | None = None


class QuoteRequest(BaseModel):
    parcel: Parcel
    controls: Controls = Field(default_factory=Controls)


class BreakevenRequest(BaseModel):
    controls: Controls = Field(default_factory=Controls)
    residential: bool = True
    weights_lb: list[float] | None = Field(default=None, min_length=1, max_length=200)
    distances_miles: list[float] | None = Field(default=None, min_length=1, max_length=50)

    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def _grid_in_range(self) -> "BreakevenRequest":
        for w in self.weights_lb or []:
            if not 0 < w <= MAX_WEIGHT_LB:
                raise ValueError(f"every weight in weights_lb must be above 0 and at most {MAX_WEIGHT_LB}")
        for d in self.distances_miles or []:
            if d < 0:
                raise ValueError("distances_miles cannot be negative")
        return self


class BlendedRequest(BaseModel):
    parcels: list[Parcel] = Field(min_length=1, max_length=MAX_PARCELS)
    controls: Controls = Field(default_factory=Controls)
    segment: SegmentFilter | None = None


class YearlyRequest(BaseModel):
    parcels: list[Parcel] = Field(min_length=1, max_length=MAX_PARCELS)
    controls: Controls = Field(default_factory=Controls)
    next_year_increase_percent: float | None = Field(default=None, ge=-50, le=100)


# ---- responses ------------------------------------------------------------
class Out(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")


class LineItem(Out):
    kind: Literal["base", "surcharge", "fuel"]
    label: str
    amount: float
    surcharge_id: str | None = None
    source: str | None = None
    condition: str | None = None


class Quote(Out):
    carrier: Carrier
    service_id: str
    service_name: str
    tier: Tier
    zone: int | None
    billable_weight_lb: float | None
    dim_weight_lb: float | None
    line_items: list[LineItem]
    total: float
    margin: float
    available: bool
    unavailable_reason: str | None = None
    as_of: date | None = None


class Pick(Out):
    carrier: Carrier
    service_id: str
    total: float


class QuoteResponse(Out):
    quotes: list[Quote]
    cheapest_by_tier: dict[Tier, Pick | None]


class BreakevenCell(Out):
    weight_lb: float
    distance_miles: float
    zone_usps: int | None
    zone_private: int | None
    winner: Pick | None
    runner_up: Pick | None
    saving: float
    totals: dict[Carrier, float]


class BreakevenBand(Out):
    distance_miles: float
    zone_usps: int | None
    zone_private: int | None
    vs_ups: float | None
    vs_fedex: float | None


class BreakevenResponse(Out):
    year: int
    residential: bool
    weights_lb: list[float]
    distances_miles: list[float]
    cells: list[BreakevenCell]
    breakeven_weight_lb: list[BreakevenBand]


class SplitPart(Out):
    per_parcel: float
    total: float
    share: float


class Split(Out):
    base: SplitPart
    surcharges: SplitPart
    fuel: SplitPart


class ConditionTotal(Out):

class Summary(Out):
    parcels_shipped: int

    total_cost: float
    cost_per_parcel: float
    split: Split
    surcharges_by_condition: list[ConditionTotal]
    margin_per_parcel: float
    total_margin: float
    loss_share: float
    parcels_at_loss: int


class CarrierBlended(Summary):
    carrier: Carrier
    services_used: dict[str, int]


class BestMix(Summary):
    parcels_by_carrier: dict[str, int]


class BlendedResponse(Out):
    year: int

    revenue_per_parcel: float
    carriers: list[CarrierBlended]
    best_mix: BestMix


class Change(Out):
    from_year: int

    percent: float | None


class Announced(Out):
    percent: float | None
    basis: Literal["all", "average_of_services", "none"]
    services: list[str]

class Driver(Out):
    segment: str
    parcels: int
    change_per_parcel: float
    change_total: float


class Drivers(Out):
    weight_band: list[Driver]
    zone_band: list[Driver]

class FuelGroupUsed(Out):

class YearRow(Out):

class CarrierYears(Out):

class ServiceOut(Out):

class FuelDefault(Out):

# API contract

The FastAPI backend (`backend/`) serves JSON under `/api`. The frontend talks to
it only through these endpoints. Types below are the Pydantic models
(`backend/app/api/models.py`) and the TypeScript types
(`frontend/src/api/types.ts`), which must stay in sync; a contract test in each
side checks the example payloads in `docs/api-examples/`.

Money is a number in USD rounded to cents. Weights in pounds, lengths in inches,
distances in miles. Years are price-list labels (see `docs/data/SCHEMA.md`).

## Shared types

```ts
type Carrier = "usps" | "ups" | "fedex";
type Tier = "ground" | "two_three_day" | "next_day";
type DeliveryArea = "none" | "das" | "extended";
type UspsRateCard = "commercial" | "retail";

interface Parcel {
  weight_lb: number;            // > 0, <= 70
  length_in?: number;           // all three or none; > 0
  width_in?: number;
  height_in?: number;
  distance_miles: number;       // >= 0
  residential: boolean;
  speed: Tier;
  quantity?: number;            // default 1, integer >= 1
  price_charged?: number;       // overrides Controls.flat_price for this row
  delivery_area?: DeliveryArea; // default "none"
  nonstandard_packaging?: boolean; // default false
}

interface Controls {
  year?: number;                // omitted or null: latest year with all three carriers (2026);
                                // a year no carrier publishes is a 422
  as_of?: string;               // ISO date; default the year's January effective date
  usps_rate_card: UspsRateCard; // default "commercial"
  fuel_override_percent?: { ground?: number; express?: number }; // replaces the yearly default
  peak: boolean;                // default false; when true, as_of moves into the year's peak window
  flat_price: number;           // what the shop charges per parcel; default 9.99
}

interface LineItem {
  kind: "base" | "surcharge" | "fuel";
  label: string;                // carrier's own name, e.g. "Residential Surcharge"
  amount: number;
  surcharge_id?: string;        // links to surcharges.csv
  source?: string;              // "file p.N" for display
  condition?: string;           // surcharges.csv condition, for grouping surcharges by kind
}

interface Quote {
  carrier: Carrier;
  service_id: string;
  service_name: string;
  tier: Tier;
  zone: number;
  billable_weight_lb: number;
  dim_weight_lb: number | null;
  line_items: LineItem[];
  total: number;
  margin: number;               // price charged minus total
  available: boolean;           // false when the service cannot carry this parcel
  unavailable_reason?: string;  // e.g. "FedEx Ground serves business addresses only"
  as_of: string | null;         // ISO date the rules were resolved for
}
// An unavailable quote has line_items: [] and total: 0, margin: 0; zone and
// weights are null when they were not reached. Clients must check `available`.
```

## Endpoints

### GET /api/health
`{"status": "ok"}` for the Docker health check.

### GET /api/meta
Years per carrier, services (with `rate_card_notes`), default controls
(including the default `as_of` per carrier), fuel defaults per year with
`is_proxy`, the zone bands, the segment band labels, and the data limitations
text shown in the UI footer. Shape: `MetaResponse` in `backend/app/api/models.py`.

### GET /api/sample-parcels
The bundled illustrative parcel mix as `Parcel[]`, with a `description`.

### POST /api/quote  (question 1)
Request `{ parcel: Parcel, controls: Controls }`. Response
`{ quotes: Quote[], cheapest_by_tier: Record<Tier, {carrier, service_id, total}> }`,
quotes sorted by total within the requested tier first, then the other tiers
(unavailable quotes last within a tier). Only carriers that publish the
requested year are quoted (2027 is FedEx only). A tier with no available
service maps to `null` in `cheapest_by_tier`.

### POST /api/breakeven  (question 2)
Request `{ controls: Controls, residential: boolean, weights_lb?: number[], distances_miles?: number[] }`
(defaults: weights 1..70 step 1, distances at every zone band midpoint).
Response: a grid of cells `{ weight_lb, distance_miles, zone_usps, zone_private, winner: {carrier, service_id, total}, runner_up: {...}, saving, totals: Record<Carrier, number> }`
for the ground tier (FedEx Ground for business, Home Delivery for residential),
plus `breakeven_weight_lb: [{ distance_miles, zone_usps, zone_private, vs_ups, vs_fedex }]`
per distance band: the lightest grid weight at which the USPS total is >= the
rival's total, `null` when USPS wins at every weight. The default distances are
each USPS band's midpoint (rounded down) and, for the open last band, the
previous band's upper edge + 200 miles.

### GET /api/breakeven
Same response with the default grid; query parameters `residential`
(default true), `year`, `peak`, `usps_rate_card`.

### POST /api/blended  (question 3)
Request `{ parcels: Parcel[], controls: Controls, segment?: SegmentFilter }`.
Response per carrier: parcels shipped, blended cost per parcel, base vs
surcharge vs fuel split (absolute and share), surcharge breakdown by kind,
margin per parcel, share of parcels shipped at a loss, and the cheapest
carrier per parcel (a "best mix" row). Each parcel uses the cheapest service
of that carrier in the parcel's speed tier.

Shape: `BlendedResponse` in `backend/app/api/models.py`: `year`,
`parcels_considered`, `revenue_per_parcel`, `carriers[]` and `best_mix`. Each
carrier row (and `best_mix`) is a `Summary`: `parcels_shipped`,
`parcels_unavailable` (quantity no service of the carrier could carry),
`total_cost`, `cost_per_parcel`, `split.{base,surcharges,fuel}.{per_parcel,total,share}`,
`surcharges_by_condition[] {condition, total, per_parcel, share_of_cost}`,
`margin_per_parcel`, `total_margin`, `loss_share`, `parcels_at_loss`; carrier
rows add `carrier` and `services_used` (service_id -> parcels), `best_mix`
adds `parcels_by_carrier`. Everything is weighted by `quantity`.

### POST /api/yearly  (question 4)
Request `{ parcels: Parcel[], controls: Controls, next_year_increase_percent?: number }`.
Response per carrier and year: blended cost per parcel under that year's
prices and rules, the year-over-year change, the carrier's announced average
increase for comparison, and the driver breakdown: for each parcel segment
(weight band, zone band, residential, speed), its contribution to the change
in dollars per parcel. Optional projected next year from the slider.

Rules: each year is priced at its own base-rate effective date per carrier
(December 10 of that year when `peak`); `controls.as_of` and `controls.year`
are ignored. `fuel_override_percent` applies to every year. Only parcels the
carrier can ship in every one of its years are compared (`parcels_used`,
`parcels_excluded`). Years a carrier lacks are absent.

Shape: `YearlyResponse` in `backend/app/api/models.py`: `carriers[] {carrier,
parcels_used, parcels_excluded, years[], projected}`; `projected` is
`{year, increase_percent, cost_per_parcel}` or `null`. Each year row:
`year`, `as_of`, `cost_per_parcel`, `summary` (the blended `Summary`),
`services_used`, `change_vs_previous {from_year, dollars_per_parcel, percent}`
(null for the first year), `announced_increase {percent, basis, services,
source_type}` where `basis` is `"all"` (the carrier-wide row), 
`"average_of_services"` (plain average of the rows for the services used,
listed in `services`) or `"none"`, `drivers` (per dimension a list of
`{segment, parcels, change_per_parcel, change_total}`; the rounded
`change_per_parcel` values add up exactly to the rounded change), `fuel`
(`{ground, express}` each `{default_percent, is_proxy, applied_percent}`, null
for USPS) and `warnings` (e.g. a surcharge kind present the year before but
with no rules recorded this year).

### Segments
`SegmentFilter = { weight_band?: string, zone_band?: string, residential?: boolean, speed?: Tier }`.
Weight bands: `≤1`, `1–5`, `5–10`, `10–20`, `20–70` lb. Zone bands: `1–2`, `3–4`, `5–6`, `7–8`.

## Engine rules the endpoints share

- **Zone** from `data/processed/zone_from_distance.csv` per carrier: the band
  whose `min_miles <= distance <= max_miles`.
- **Billable weight** per carrier and `as_of` from `dim_weight.csv`: dimensions
  rounded per the row's rounding rule, dimensional weight = volume / divisor
  rounded up, only when volume exceeds `min_volume_cuin`; billable = max(actual
  rounded up to the next weight step, dimensional). The row is the one whose
  window contains `as_of`. Weight steps are the service's own table steps, so
  USPS Ground Advantage keeps its ounce steps under 1 lb (and the USPS commercial
  Priority Mail cards their 0.5 lb step). A billable weight above the heaviest
  step makes the service unavailable; USPS caps dimensional weight at 70 lb
  as its dim_weight row states.
- **Base rate**: the first weight step `>= billable weight` in the zone, for
  the service, rate card (`list` for UPS and FedEx, the USPS control otherwise)
  and year.
- **Surcharges**: every rule of that carrier and year whose window contains
  `as_of`, whose `applies_to` covers the service, whose `address_type`
  matches, and whose thresholds the parcel meets; peak conditions only when
  `controls.peak`. Rules in the same `exclusive_group` do not stack: the
  highest amount wins. Percent surcharges apply to the base rate.
- **Fuel**: `percent x (base + surcharges flagged fuel_applies)`, percent from
  `fuel_surcharge.csv` for the year and service group (ground services use
  `ground`, all others `express`) unless overridden. USPS has none.
- **Availability**: FedEx Ground for business addresses only, Home Delivery for
  residential only (from `services.csv`); weight over 70 lb is rejected.
- **as_of**: defaults to the base-rate `effective_date` of the year for each
  carrier, or `controls.as_of` when given. With `peak: true` it is December 10
  of the year (overriding `controls.as_of`), inside every carrier's peak window
  for which peak rows are recorded. `as_of` therefore also selects time-varying rules such
  as the USPS dimensional divisor (166 until 2026-07-11, 139 after) and the
  2026 USPS 8 % transportation increase.
- **Cheapest per tier**: among available services of the tier, lowest total.
- **Thresholds, windows and peak add-ons**: see "Matching rules" in
  `docs/data/SCHEMA.md` (bands inclusive on billable weight, a lone minimum weight
  strict on actual weight, dimensions strict, `effective_to` inclusive, peak
  add-ons only on top of the charge they add to).
- The engine never hardcodes an amount; every number comes from
  `data/processed/`.

## Errors
422 with `{ detail: [{ loc, msg }] }` for invalid input (Pydantic default),
with messages written for the shop owner, e.g. "weight_lb must be at most 70";
each entry also carries the Pydantic error `type`. Errors inside a parcel list
are prefixed "Parcel N: ". Real request/response pairs for every endpoint are
in `docs/api-examples/`, regenerated by `backend/scripts/export_api_examples.py`.
````

</details>

cd ~/parcel-rates-issue-4/frontend && cp src/api/types.ts /tmp/claude-1000/-home-aivuk-parcel-rates/31d666d4-9d83-44bd-bae6-ef26e807eeb3/scratchpad/types.ts.bak && cat > src/api/types.ts <<'EOF'
/**
 * Types mirroring docs/API.md and backend/app/api/models.py (branch issue-3-engine-api).
 * Keep in sync: src/api/contract.test.ts validates every example payload in
 * src/api/__fixtures__/ against the guards in ./guards.ts, which follow these types.
 *
 * Request types follow the Pydantic request models (fields with a server default are optional).
 * Response types follow the response models, which use `extra="forbid"` and serialize
 * missing optionals as `null`, not as absent keys.
 */

export type Carrier = "usps" | "ups" | "fedex";
export type Tier = "ground" | "two_three_day" | "next_day";
export type DeliveryArea = "none" | "das" | "extended";
export type UspsRateCard = "commercial" | "retail";
export type FuelGroup = "ground" | "express";
export type WeightBand = "≤1" | "1–5" | "5–10" | "10–20" | "20–70";
export type ZoneBandLabel = "1–2" | "3–4" | "5–6" | "7–8";

export const CARRIERS: readonly Carrier[] = ["usps", "ups", "fedex"] as const;
export const TIERS: readonly Tier[] = ["ground", "two_three_day", "next_day"] as const;
export const DELIVERY_AREAS: readonly DeliveryArea[] = ["none", "das", "extended"] as const;
export const WEIGHT_BANDS: readonly WeightBand[] = ["≤1", "1–5", "5–10", "10–20", "20–70"] as const;
export const ZONE_BANDS: readonly ZoneBandLabel[] = ["1–2", "3–4", "5–6", "7–8"] as const;

/* ---------- requests ---------- */

/** A parcel as the frontend sends it (absent = server default). */
export interface Parcel {
  weight_lb: number; // > 0, <= 70
  length_in?: number; // all three or none; > 0
  width_in?: number;
  height_in?: number;
  distance_miles: number; // >= 0
  residential: boolean;
  speed: Tier;
  quantity?: number; // default 1, integer >= 1
  price_charged?: number; // overrides Controls.flat_price for this row
  delivery_area?: DeliveryArea; // default "none"
  nonstandard_packaging?: boolean; // default false
}

/** A parcel as the server returns it (GET /sample-parcels): every key present, optionals null. */
export interface ParcelOut {
  weight_lb: number;
  length_in: number | null;
  width_in: number | null;
  height_in: number | null;
  distance_miles: number;
  residential: boolean;
  speed: Tier;
  quantity: number;
  price_charged: number | null;
  delivery_area: DeliveryArea;
  nonstandard_packaging: boolean;
}

export interface FuelOverride {
  ground?: number | null; // 0..100
  express?: number | null;
}

export interface Controls {
  year?: number | null; // null/absent: latest year with all three carriers
  as_of?: string | null; // ISO date
  usps_rate_card?: UspsRateCard; // default "commercial"
  fuel_override_percent?: FuelOverride | null;
  peak?: boolean; // default false
  flat_price?: number; // default 9.99
}

export interface SegmentFilter {
  weight_band?: WeightBand | null;
  zone_band?: ZoneBandLabel | null;
  residential?: boolean | null;
  speed?: Tier | null;
}

export interface QuoteRequest {
  parcel: Parcel;
  controls?: Controls;
}

export interface BreakevenRequest {
  controls?: Controls;
  residential?: boolean; // default true
  weights_lb?: number[] | null; // 1..200 values, each in (0, 70]
  distances_miles?: number[] | null; // 1..50 values, each >= 0
}

export interface BlendedRequest {
  parcels: Parcel[]; // 1..10,000
  controls?: Controls;
  segment?: SegmentFilter | null;
}

export interface YearlyRequest {
  parcels: Parcel[]; // 1..10,000
  controls?: Controls;
  next_year_increase_percent?: number | null; // -50..100
}

/* ---------- shared response pieces ---------- */

export interface LineItem {
  kind: "base" | "surcharge" | "fuel";
  label: string;
  amount: number;
  surcharge_id: string | null;
  source: string | null; // "file p.N" for display
  condition: string | null; // surcharges.csv condition, for grouping
}

/** An unavailable quote has line_items [], total 0, margin 0, and null zone/weights. Check `available`. */
export interface Quote {
  carrier: Carrier;
  service_id: string;
  service_name: string;
  tier: Tier;
  zone: number | null;
  billable_weight_lb: number | null;
  dim_weight_lb: number | null;
  line_items: LineItem[];
  total: number;
  margin: number;
  available: boolean;
  unavailable_reason: string | null;
  as_of: string | null;
}

export interface CarrierPick {
  carrier: Carrier;
  service_id: string;
  total: number;
}

/* ---------- GET /api/health ---------- */

export interface HealthResponse {
  status: "ok";
}

/* ---------- GET /api/meta ---------- */

export interface ServiceInfo {
  carrier: Carrier;
  service_id: string;
  display_name: string;
  tier: Tier;
  residential_allowed: boolean;
  business_allowed: boolean;
  rate_cards: string[];
  rate_card_notes: string;
  max_weight_lb: number;
  notes: string;
}

export interface FuelDefault {
  carrier: Carrier;
  year: number;
  service_group: FuelGroup;
  default_percent: number;
  is_proxy: boolean;
  window_start: string | null;
  window_end: string | null;
}

export interface ZoneBand {
  carrier: Carrier;
  zone: number;
  min_miles: number;
  max_miles: number | null; // null = open-ended
}

export interface MetaDefaults {
  year: number;
  usps_rate_card: UspsRateCard;
  peak: boolean;
  flat_price: number;
  as_of: Partial<Record<Carrier, string>>;
}

export interface Meta {
  years: Partial<Record<Carrier, number[]>>;
  services: ServiceInfo[];
  defaults: MetaDefaults;
  fuel_defaults: FuelDefault[];
  zone_bands: ZoneBand[];
  segments: { weight_bands: string[]; zone_bands: string[] };
  limitations: string[];
}

/* ---------- GET /api/sample-parcels ---------- */

export interface SampleParcels {
  description: string;
  parcels: ParcelOut[];
}

/* ---------- POST /api/quote ---------- */

export interface QuoteResponse {
  quotes: Quote[];
  cheapest_by_tier: Partial<Record<Tier, CarrierPick | null>>;
}

/* ---------- POST|GET /api/breakeven ---------- */

export interface BreakevenCell {
  weight_lb: number;
  distance_miles: number;
  zone_usps: number | null;
  zone_private: number | null;
  winner: CarrierPick | null;
  runner_up: CarrierPick | null;
  saving: number;
  totals: Partial<Record<Carrier, number>>;
}

/** Lightest grid weight at which USPS is >= the rival; null when USPS wins at every weight. */
export interface BreakevenBand {
  distance_miles: number;
  zone_usps: number | null;
  zone_private: number | null;
  vs_ups: number | null;
  vs_fedex: number | null;
}

export interface BreakevenResponse {
  year: number;
  residential: boolean;
  weights_lb: number[];
  distances_miles: number[];
  cells: BreakevenCell[];
  breakeven_weight_lb: BreakevenBand[];
}

/* ---------- POST /api/blended ---------- */

export interface SplitPart {
  per_parcel: number;
  total: number;
  share: number; // 0..1
}

export interface Split {
  base: SplitPart;
  surcharges: SplitPart;
  fuel: SplitPart;
}

export interface ConditionTotal {
  condition: string;
  total: number;
  per_parcel: number;
  share_of_cost: number;
}

/** Everything weighted by quantity. */
export interface Summary {
  parcels_shipped: number;
  parcels_unavailable: number;
  total_cost: number;
  cost_per_parcel: number;
  split: Split;
  surcharges_by_condition: ConditionTotal[];
  margin_per_parcel: number;
  total_margin: number;
  loss_share: number; // 0..1
  parcels_at_loss: number;
}

export interface CarrierBlended extends Summary {
  carrier: Carrier;
  services_used: Record<string, number>; // service_id -> parcels
}

export interface BestMix extends Summary {
  parcels_by_carrier: Record<string, number>;
}

export interface BlendedResponse {
  year: number;
  parcels_considered: number;
  revenue_per_parcel: number;
  carriers: CarrierBlended[];
  best_mix: BestMix;
}

/* ---------- POST /api/yearly ---------- */

export interface Change {
  from_year: number;
  dollars_per_parcel: number;
  percent: number | null;
}

export interface Announced {
  percent: number | null;
  basis: "all" | "average_of_services" | "none";
  services: string[];
  source_type: string | null; // "primary" | "secondary"
}

export interface Driver {
  segment: string;
  parcels: number;
  change_per_parcel: number;
  change_total: number;
}

export interface Drivers {
  weight_band: Driver[];
  zone_band: Driver[];
  residential: Driver[];
  speed: Driver[];
}

export interface FuelGroupUsed {
  default_percent: number | null;
  is_proxy: boolean | null;
  applied_percent: number | null;
}

export interface YearRow {
  year: number;
  as_of: string | null;
  cost_per_parcel: number;
  summary: Summary;
  services_used: string[];
  change_vs_previous: Change | null; // null for the first year
  announced_increase: Announced;
  drivers: Drivers | null;
  fuel: { ground: FuelGroupUsed; express: FuelGroupUsed } | null; // null for USPS
  warnings: string[];
}

export interface Projection {
  year: number;
  increase_percent: number;
  cost_per_parcel: number;
}

export interface CarrierYears {
  carrier: Carrier;
  parcels_used: number;
  parcels_excluded: number;
  years: YearRow[];
  projected: Projection | null;
}

export interface YearlyResponse {
  carriers: CarrierYears[];
}

/* ---------- errors ---------- */

export interface ValidationIssue {
  loc: (string | number)[];
  msg: string;
  type?: string;
}

export interface ValidationErrorBody {
  /** Pydantic default is an array; FastAPI HTTPException gives a string. */
  detail: ValidationIssue[] | string;
}
EOF

**Tool call:** `Bash` <sub>toolu_01YUzi7Q8YHWkWX8qpzQAPup</sub>

- `command`:

```
cd ~/parcel-rates-issue-4/frontend && cat > src/api/guards.ts <<'EOF'
/**
 * Hand-written runtime guards for the API responses, one per type in ./types.ts.
 * Objects are checked exactly (unknown or missing keys fail), like the backend's
 * `extra="forbid"`, so contract drift on either side fails src/api/contract.test.ts.
 */
import type {
  BlendedResponse,
  BreakevenResponse,
  Carrier,
  HealthResponse,
  Meta,
  QuoteResponse,
  SampleParcels,
  ValidationErrorBody,
  YearlyResponse,
} from "./types";
import { CARRIERS, DELIVERY_AREAS, TIERS } from "./types";

export class ContractError extends Error {
  constructor(path: string, expected: string, got: unknown) {
    super(`${path || "(root)"}: expected ${expected}, got ${JSON.stringify(got)?.slice(0, 80)}`);
    this.name = "ContractError";
  }
}

type Check = (v: unknown, path: string) => void;

const num: Check = (v, p) => {
  if (typeof v !== "number" || !Number.isFinite(v)) throw new ContractError(p, "number", v);
};
const int: Check = (v, p) => {
  if (!Number.isInteger(v)) throw new ContractError(p, "integer", v);
};
const str: Check = (v, p) => {
  if (typeof v !== "string") throw new ContractError(p, "string", v);
};
const bool: Check = (v, p) => {
  if (typeof v !== "boolean") throw new ContractError(p, "boolean", v);
};
const isoDate: Check = (v, p) => {
  if (typeof v !== "string" || !/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(v)) throw new ContractError(p, "ISO date", v);
};
const lit =
  (...values: readonly unknown[]): Check =>
  (v, p) => {
    if (!values.includes(v)) throw new ContractError(p, `one of ${values.join("|")}`, v);
  };
const nullable =
  (c: Check): Check =>
  (v, p) => {
    if (v !== null) c(v, p);
  };
const arr =
  (c: Check): Check =>
  (v, p) => {
    if (!Array.isArray(v)) throw new ContractError(p, "array", v);
    v.forEach((x, i) => c(x, `${p}[${i}]`));
  };
const isObj = (v: unknown): v is Record<string, unknown> => typeof v === "object" && v !== null && !Array.isArray(v);
const obj =
  (shape: Record<string, Check>): Check =>
  (v, p) => {
    if (!isObj(v)) throw new ContractError(p, "object", v);
    for (const k of Object.keys(v)) if (!(k in shape)) throw new ContractError(`${p}.${k}`, "no such key", v[k]);
    for (const [k, c] of Object.entries(shape)) {
      if (!(k in v)) throw new ContractError(`${p}.${k}`, "key present", undefined);
      c(v[k], `${p}.${k}`);
    }
  };
/** Object with an open key set; `key` checks each key. */
const record =
  (key: Check, value: Check): Check =>
  (v, p) => {
    if (!isObj(v)) throw new ContractError(p, "object", v);
    for (const [k, x] of Object.entries(v)) {
      key(k, `${p}{key}`);
      value(x, `${p}.${k}`);
    }
  };
const extend = (base: Record<string, Check>, more: Record<string, Check>) => obj({ ...base, ...more });

const carrier = lit(...CARRIERS);
const tier = lit(...TIERS);

const parcelOut = obj({
  weight_lb: num,
  length_in: nullable(num),
  width_in: nullable(num),
  height_in: nullable(num),
  distance_miles: num,
  residential: bool,
  speed: tier,
  quantity: int,
  price_charged: nullable(num),
  delivery_area: lit(...DELIVERY_AREAS),
  nonstandard_packaging: bool,
});

const pick = obj({ carrier, service_id: str, total: num });

const lineItem = obj({
  kind: lit("base", "surcharge", "fuel"),
  label: str,
  amount: num,
  surcharge_id: nullable(str),
  source: nullable(str),
  condition: nullable(str),
});

const quote = obj({
  carrier,
  service_id: str,
  service_name: str,
  tier,
  zone: nullable(int),
  billable_weight_lb: nullable(num),
  dim_weight_lb: nullable(num),
  line_items: arr(lineItem),
  total: num,
  margin: num,
  available: bool,
  unavailable_reason: nullable(str),
  as_of: nullable(isoDate),
});

const splitPart = obj({ per_parcel: num, total: num, share: num });
const summaryShape: Record<string, Check> = {
  parcels_shipped: int,
  parcels_unavailable: int,
  total_cost: num,
  cost_per_parcel: num,
  split: obj({ base: splitPart, surcharges: splitPart, fuel: splitPart }),
  surcharges_by_condition: arr(obj({ condition: str, total: num, per_parcel: num, share_of_cost: num })),
  margin_per_parcel: num,
  total_margin: num,
  loss_share: num,
  parcels_at_loss: int,
};

const driver = obj({ segment: str, parcels: int, change_per_parcel: num, change_total: num });
const fuelGroupUsed = obj({ default_percent: nullable(num), is_proxy: nullable(bool), applied_percent: nullable(num) });

const checks = {
  health: obj({ status: lit("ok") }),
  meta: obj({
    years: record(carrier, arr(int)),
    services: arr(
      obj({
        carrier,
        service_id: str,
        display_name: str,
        tier,
        residential_allowed: bool,
        business_allowed: bool,
        rate_cards: arr(str),
        rate_card_notes: str,
        max_weight_lb: int,
        notes: str,
      }),
    ),
    defaults: obj({
      year: int,
      usps_rate_card: lit("commercial", "retail"),
      peak: bool,
      flat_price: num,
      as_of: record(carrier, isoDate),
    }),
    fuel_defaults: arr(
      obj({
        carrier,
        year: int,
        service_group: lit("ground", "express"),
        default_percent: num,
        is_proxy: bool,
        window_start: nullable(isoDate),
        window_end: nullable(isoDate),
      }),
    ),
    zone_bands: arr(obj({ carrier, zone: int, min_miles: int, max_miles: nullable(int) })),
    segments: obj({ weight_bands: arr(str), zone_bands: arr(str) }),
    limitations: arr(str),
  }),
  sampleParcels: obj({ description: str, parcels: arr(parcelOut) }),
  quote: obj({ quotes: arr(quote), cheapest_by_tier: record(tier, nullable(pick)) }),
  breakeven: obj({
    year: int,
    residential: bool,
    weights_lb: arr(num),
    distances_miles: arr(num),
    cells: arr(
      obj({
        weight_lb: num,
        distance_miles: num,
        zone_usps: nullable(int),
        zone_private: nullable(int),
        winner: nullable(pick),
        runner_up: nullable(pick),
        saving: num,
        totals: record(carrier, num),
      }),
    ),
    breakeven_weight_lb: arr(
      obj({
        distance_miles: num,
        zone_usps: nullable(int),
        zone_private: nullable(int),
        vs_ups: nullable(num),
        vs_fedex: nullable(num),
      }),
    ),
  }),
  blended: obj({
    year: int,
    parcels_considered: int,
    revenue_per_parcel: num,
    carriers: arr(extend(summaryShape, { carrier, services_used: record(str, int) })),
    best_mix: extend(summaryShape, { parcels_by_carrier: record(carrier, int) }),
  }),
  yearly: obj({
    carriers: arr(
      obj({
        carrier,
        parcels_used: int,
        parcels_excluded: int,
        years: arr(
          obj({
            year: int,
            as_of: nullable(isoDate),
            cost_per_parcel: num,
            summary: obj(summaryShape),
            services_used: arr(str),
            change_vs_previous: nullable(obj({ from_year: int, dollars_per_parcel: num, percent: nullable(num) })),
            announced_increase: obj({
              percent: nullable(num),
              basis: lit("all", "average_of_services", "none"),
              services: arr(str),
              source_type: nullable(str),
            }),
            drivers: nullable(
              obj({ weight_band: arr(driver), zone_band: arr(driver), residential: arr(driver), speed: arr(driver) }),
            ),
            fuel: nullable(obj({ ground: fuelGroupUsed, express: fuelGroupUsed })),
            warnings: arr(str),
          }),
        ),
        projected: nullable(obj({ year: int, increase_percent: num, cost_per_parcel: num })),
      }),
    ),
  }),
  validationError: obj({
    detail: arr(obj({ loc: arr((v, p) => (typeof v === "number" ? int(v, p) : str(v, p))), msg: str, type: str })),
  }),
} satisfies Record<string, Check>;

function guard<T>(check: Check) {
  return (v: unknown): T => {
    check(v, "");
    return v as T;
  };
}

export const asHealth = guard<HealthResponse>(checks.health);
export const asMeta = guard<Meta>(checks.meta);
export const asSampleParcels = guard<SampleParcels>(checks.sampleParcels);
export const asQuoteResponse = guard<QuoteResponse>(checks.quote);
export const asBreakevenResponse = guard<BreakevenResponse>(checks.breakeven);
export const asBlendedResponse = guard<BlendedResponse>(checks.blended);
export const asYearlyResponse = guard<YearlyResponse>(checks.yearly);
export const asValidationError = guard<ValidationErrorBody>(checks.validationError);

/** Type-level check that the guards' carrier list stays the contract's. */
export type _CarrierCheck = Carrier extends (typeof CARRIERS)[number] ? true : never;
EOF

import type { Parcel, ParcelOut } from "../api/types";

/** Server parcels carry every key with nulls; the UI and requests use absent keys instead. */
export function fromParcelOut(p: ParcelOut): Parcel {
  const dims =
    p.length_in !== null && p.width_in !== null && p.height_in !== null
      ? { length_in: p.length_in, width_in: p.width_in, height_in: p.height_in }
      : {};
  return {
    weight_lb: p.weight_lb,
    distance_miles: p.distance_miles,
    residential: p.residential,
    speed: p.speed,
    quantity: p.quantity,
    ...dims,
    ...(p.price_charged !== null ? { price_charged: p.price_charged } : {}),
    ...(p.delivery_area !== "none" ? { delivery_area: p.delivery_area } : {}),
    ...(p.nonstandard_packaging ? { nonstandard_packaging: true } : {}),
  };
}
EOF

import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import blended from "./__fixtures__/blended.json";
import breakeven from "./__fixtures__/breakeven.json";
import health from "./__fixtures__/health.json";

import quote422 from "./__fixtures__/quote-422.json";
import quote from "./__fixtures__/quote.json";
import sample from "./__fixtures__/sample-parcels.json";

import {
  ContractError,
  asBlendedResponse,
  asBreakevenResponse,
  asHealth,
  asMeta,
  asQuoteResponse,
  asSampleParcels,
  asValidationError,
  asYearlyResponse,
} from "./guards";
import { fromParcelOut } from "../lib/parcels";
import { parseParcelCsv } from "../lib/parcelCsv";

const cases: [string, { response: { status: number; body: unknown } }, (v: unknown) => unknown][] = [
  ["health", health, asHealth],
  ["meta", meta, asMeta],
  ["sample-parcels", sample, asSampleParcels],
  ["quote", quote, asQuoteResponse],
  ["quote-422", quote422, asValidationError],
  ["breakeven", breakeven, asBreakevenResponse],
  ["blended", blended, asBlendedResponse],
  ["yearly", yearly, asYearlyResponse],
];

describe("contract: backend example payloads match src/api/types.ts", () => {
  it("covers every fixture file", () => {
    const files = readdirSync(new URL("./__fixtures__/", import.meta.url)).filter((f) => f.endsWith(".json"));
    expect(files.map((f) => f.replace(".json", "")).sort()).toEqual(cases.map(([n]) => n).sort());
  });

  it.each(cases)("%s response body passes its guard", (_name, fixture, guard) => {
    expect(() => guard(fixture.response.body)).not.toThrow();
  });

  it("rejects drift: an unknown key, a missing key, a wrong type", () => {
    const body = structuredClone(quote.response.body) as { quotes: Record<string, unknown>[] };
    const extra = structuredClone(body);
    extra.quotes[0]!.discount = 1;
    expect(() => asQuoteResponse(extra)).toThrow(/quotes\[0\]\.discount: expected no such key/);
    const missing = structuredClone(body);
    delete missing.quotes[0]!.as_of;
    expect(() => asQuoteResponse(missing)).toThrow(ContractError);
    const wrong = structuredClone(body);
    wrong.quotes[0]!.carrier = "dhl";
    expect(() => asQuoteResponse(wrong)).toThrow(/quotes\[0\]\.carrier/);
  });

  it("the sample parcels survive the round trip through the CSV rules", () => {
    const parcels = asSampleParcels(sample.response.body).parcels.map(fromParcelOut);
    const header = "weight_lb,length_in,width_in,height_in,distance_miles,residential,speed,quantity,price_charged,delivery_area,nonstandard_packaging";
    const rows = parcels.map((p) =>
      [p.weight_lb, p.length_in, p.width_in, p.height_in, p.distance_miles, p.residential, p.speed, p.quantity, p.price_charged, p.delivery_area, p.nonstandard_packaging]
        .map((v) => (v === undefined ? "" : String(v)))
        .join(","),
    );
    const parsed = parseParcelCsv([header, ...rows].join("\n"));
    expect(parsed.errors).toEqual([]);
    expect(parsed.parcels).toEqual(parcels);
  });
});

cat > README.md <<'EOF'
# Frontend

Vite + React + TypeScript dashboard. Design direction and rules: [DESIGN.md](DESIGN.md).

## Run locally

Node 18.18+ (Docker uses Node 22).

```sh
npm ci
npm run dev            # http://localhost:5173
```

The dev server proxies `/api` to the backend at `VITE_API_TARGET`, default
`http://localhost:8001` (port 8000 is used by another app on the dev machine).
Start the backend on that port from the repository root:

```sh
cd backend && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8001
```

To point at a backend elsewhere: `VITE_API_TARGET=http://localhost:9000 npm run dev`
(or put the variable in `frontend/.env.local`).

Without a backend, open `http://localhost:5173/?mock=1`: the app serves the backend's
recorded example responses from `src/api/__fixtures__/` and shows a "Mock data" banner.
Mock answers do not change with the inputs.

## Scripts

| Script | What it does |
|---|---|
| `npm run dev` | dev server with the `/api` proxy |
| `npm run test` | Vitest + Testing Library, including the API contract test |
| `npm run typecheck` | `tsc -b --noEmit` |
| `npm run build` | type-check and build into `dist/` |

## API contract

export const FALLBACK_USPS_ZONES: ZoneBand[] = [

export function zoneLabel(b: ZoneBand): string {

export function zoneRange(b: ZoneBand): string {
  return b.max_miles === null ? `${miles.format(b.min_miles)}+ mi` : `${miles.format(b.min_miles)}–${miles.format(b.max_miles)} mi`;

/**
 * The USPS zone a distance falls in. Bands are whole miles with gaps (50, then 51), so a
 * fractional distance goes to the first band whose upper edge it does not pass.
 */

  const sorted = [...bands].sort((x, y) => x.zone - y.zone);

}

  const usps = (bands ?? []).filter((b) => b.carrier === "usps").sort((x, y) => x.zone - y.zone);
  return usps.length > 0 ? usps : FALLBACK_USPS_ZONES;
}

```
import { useEffect, useId, useMemo, useRef, useState } from "react";
import type { ZoneBand } from "../../api/types";
import { TIERS } from "../../api/types";
import { CSV_TEMPLATE } from "../../lib/parcelCsv";
import { summarize, type ParcelSummary as Summary } from "../../lib/summary";
import { TIER_NAME, formatInt, formatShare } from "../../lib/format";
import type { ParcelSet, ParcelSetStatus } from "../../hooks/useParcelSet";
import { ParcelSummary } from "./ParcelSummary";

export interface ParcelSetPanelProps {
  set: ParcelSet | null;
  status: ParcelSetStatus;
  /** Zone bands from /api/meta; the USPS ones bucket the distance distribution. */
  zoneBands?: ZoneBand[];
  onLoadSample: () => void;
  onLoadFile: (file: File) => void;
  onClear: () => void;
}

const TEMPLATE_HREF = `data:text/csv;charset=utf-8,${encodeURIComponent(CSV_TEMPLATE)}`;
const MAX_LISTED = 12;

function Problems({ status }: { status: Extract<ParcelSetStatus, { kind: "error" | "notice" }> }) {
  const shown = status.problems.slice(0, MAX_LISTED);
  const rest = status.problems.length - shown.length;
  return (
    <div
      className={`problems ${status.kind === "error" ? "problems--error" : "problems--notice"}`}
      role={status.kind === "error" ? "alert" : "status"}
    >
      <p className="problems__title">{status.message}</p>
      {shown.length > 0 && (
        <ul className="problems__list">
          {shown.map((p, i) => (
            <li key={i}>
              <span className="problems__where">{p.row === null ? "File" : `Row ${p.row}`}</span>
              <span>{p.message}</span>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      )}
      {rest > 0 && <p className="problems__more">and {rest} more. Fix these first; the rest often share the same cause.</p>}
    </div>
  );
}

/** One line: count, share to homes, speed split. */
function StripFacts({ summary }: { summary: Summary }) {
  return (
    <p className="strip__facts">
      <span className="strip__count">
        <span className="figure">{formatInt(summary.parcels)}</span> parcels
      </span>
      <span>{formatShare(summary.residentialShare)} to homes</span>
      <span>
        {TIERS.filter((t) => summary.byTier[t] > 0)
          .map((t) => `${formatShare(summary.byTier[t])} ${TIER_NAME[t].toLowerCase()}`)
          .join(" · ")}
      </span>
    </p>
  );
}

export function ParcelSetPanel({ set, status, zoneBands, onLoadSample, onLoadFile, onClear }: ParcelSetPanelProps) {
  const fileId = useId();
  const headingId = useId();
  const detailsId = useId();
  const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const summary = useMemo(() => (set ? summarize(set.parcels, zoneBands) : null), [set, zoneBands]);
  const busy = status.kind === "loading";
  const [expanded, setExpanded] = useState(false);

  // A newly loaded set starts collapsed, so the questions stay above the fold.
  useEffect(() => setExpanded(false), [set]);

  const fileInput = (
    <input
      ref={inputRef}
      id={fileId}
      className="visually-hidden"
      type="file"
      accept=".csv,text/csv"
      disabled={busy}
      onChange={(e) => {
        const file = e.target.files?.[0];
        if (file) onLoadFile(file);
        if (inputRef.current) inputRef.current.value = "";
      }}
    />
  );
  const uploadLabel = (text: string) => (
    <label htmlFor={fileId} className="btn file-btn">
      {busy && status.what === "file" ? "Reading file…" : text}
    </label>
  );
  const sampleButton = (
    <button type="button" className={`btn ${set ? "" : "btn--primary"}`} onClick={onLoadSample} disabled={busy}>
      {busy && status.what === "sample" ? "Loading sample…" : set ? "Use sample mix" : "Load sample mix"}
    </button>
  );
  const templateLink = (
    <a className="btn btn--quiet" href={TEMPLATE_HREF} download="parcel-set-template.csv">
      CSV template
    </a>
  );
  const problems = (status.kind === "error" || status.kind === "notice") && <Problems status={status} />;

  if (!set || !summary) {
    return (
      <section className="parcels" aria-labelledby={headingId} aria-busy={busy}>
        <header className="parcels__head">
          <h2 id={headingId} className="parcels__title">
            Your parcels
          </h2>
          <div className="parcels__actions">
            {sampleButton}
            {fileInput}
            {uploadLabel("Upload CSV")}
            {templateLink}
          </div>
        </header>
        {problems}
        <div className="parcels__empty">
          <p className="parcels__empty-lead">No parcels loaded yet.</p>
          <p>
            Questions 3 and 4 price your whole mix. Load the sample to explore, or upload a CSV with one row per kind
            of parcel: weight, distance, home or business, speed, and how many you ship.
          </p>
        </div>
      </section>
    );
  }

  return (
    <section className={`parcels parcels--loaded ${expanded ? "is-expanded" : ""}`} aria-labelledby={headingId} aria-busy={busy}>
      <div className="strip">
        <div className="strip__main">
          <h2 id={headingId} className="kicker strip__title">
            Your parcels <span className="strip__source">· {set.source === "sample" ? "sample mix" : set.name}</span>
          </h2>
          <StripFacts summary={summary} />
        </div>
        <div className="strip__actions">
          <button
            type="button"
            className="btn strip__toggle"
            aria-expanded={expanded}
            aria-controls={detailsId}
            onClick={() => setExpanded((e) => !e)}
          >
            {expanded ? "Hide details" : "Details"}
          </button>
          {fileInput}
          {uploadLabel("Replace")}
        </div>
      </div>
      {problems}
      <div id={detailsId} className="parcels__details" hidden={!expanded}>
        {set.description && <p className="parcels__source">{set.description}</p>}
        <ParcelSummary summary={summary} />
        <div className="parcels__actions">
          {sampleButton}
          {templateLink}
          <button type="button" className="btn btn--quiet" onClick={onClear}>
            Clear the set
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

/* Loaded set: a one-line strip, details on demand */
.parcels--loaded {
  gap: var(--space-3);
  padding-bottom: var(--space-4);
}

.parcels__details {

}

}

.summary__note strong {

import type { QuestionDef, ViewProps } from "./types";

/** Placeholder for a question view; replaced by issues #5 (Q1, Q2) and #6 (Q3, Q4). */
export function QuestionPlaceholder({ def, parcels }: { def: QuestionDef } & Pick<ViewProps, "parcels">) {
  const blocked = def.needsParcels && !parcels;
  return (
    <div className="answer-slot" data-testid={`placeholder-${def.id}`}>
      <div className="answer">
        <p className="kicker">{def.answerLabel}</p>
        <p className="answer__figure answer-slot__figure" aria-label="Not computed yet">
          $—.——
        </p>
      </div>
      <p className="answer-slot__text">{def.answerSlot}</p>
      {blocked && <p className="answer-slot__need">Load your parcels above first: this question prices your whole mix.</p>}
      <p className="answer-slot__note">View in progress (issue #{def.issue}).</p>
    </div>
  );
}
EOF

## Issue #4, round 2: all five items are done

Four new commits on `issue-4-frontend-scaffold` in `~/parcel-rates-issue-4` (aa4a361, 77ee6b4, dbebc9e, 4e82a2f). Nothing was pushed. Tests (62 in 7 files), typecheck and build all pass.

export interface ApiClient {
  health(signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<HealthResponse>;
  meta(signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<Meta>;
  sampleParcels(signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<SampleParcels>;
  quote(body: QuoteRequest, signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<QuoteResponse>;
  breakeven(body: BreakevenRequest, signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<BreakevenResponse>;
  blended(body: BlendedRequest, signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<BlendedResponse>;
  yearly(body: YearlyRequest, signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<YearlyResponse>;
}

export interface ClientOptions {
  baseUrl?: string;
  fetchImpl?: typeof fetch;
}

export function createHttpClient({ baseUrl = API_BASE, fetchImpl }: ClientOptions = {}): ApiClient {
  const doFetch = fetchImpl ?? ((input: RequestInfo | URL, init?: RequestInit) => fetch(input, init));

  async function request<T>(path: string, init: RequestInit = {}): Promise<T> {
    let res: Response;
    try {
      res = await doFetch(`${baseUrl}${path}`, {
        ...init,
        headers: { Accept: "application/json", ...(init.body ? { "Content-Type": "application/json" } : {}) },
      });
    } catch (err) {
      if (err instanceof DOMException && err.name === "AbortError") throw err;
      throw new ApiError(0, "Cannot reach the rate service. Is the backend running?");
    }
    const body = await readJson(res);
    if (!res.ok) {
      const problems = problemsFromBody(body);
      throw new ApiError(res.status, statusMessage(res.status), problems);
    }
    if (body === null) throw new ApiError(res.status, "The rate service sent an empty answer.");
    return body as T;
  }

  const post = <T>(path: string, body: unknown, signal?: AbortSignal) =>
    request<T>(path, { method: "POST", body: JSON.stringify(body), signal });

  return {
    health: (signal) => request<HealthResponse>("/health", { signal }),
    meta: (signal) => request<Meta>("/meta", { signal }),
    sampleParcels: (signal) => request<SampleParcels>("/sample-parcels", { signal }),
    quote: (body, signal) => post<QuoteResponse>("/quote", body, signal),

s=s[:a]+'''/**
 * How numbers are written in the file. A semicolon delimiter means a European export:
 * comma is the decimal separator and "." may group thousands. Otherwise "." is the decimal
 * point and "," may group thousands (or, for a value like "2,5", be a decimal comma).
 */
export type NumberStyle = { decimal: "." | ","; delimiter: string };

export interface ParsedNumber {
  value?: number;
  /** Set when the text could be read two ways; the value is the reading named here. */
  ambiguity?: string;
}

const PLAIN = /^-?\\d+(\\.\\d+)?$/;
const COMMA_THOUSANDS = /^\\d{1,3}(,\\d{3})+(\\.\\d+)?$/;
const DOT_THOUSANDS = /^\\d{1,3}(\\.\\d{3})+(,\\d+)?$/;
const COMMA_DECIMAL = /^-?\\d+,\\d+$/;
const SHORT_COMMA_DECIMAL = /^-?\\d+,\\d{1,2}$/;

export function parseNumber(raw: string, style: NumberStyle = { decimal: ".", delimiter: "," }): ParsedNumber {
  const t = raw.trim().replace(/^\\$/, "").replace(/\\s/g, "");
  if (t === "") return {};
  const num = (x: string): ParsedNumber => ({ value: Number(x) });

  if (style.decimal === ",") {
    if (COMMA_DECIMAL.test(t) || /^-?\\d+$/.test(t)) return num(t.replace(",", "."));
    if (DOT_THOUSANDS.test(t)) {
      const value = Number(t.replace(/\\./g, "").replace(",", "."));
      if (t.includes(",")) return { value };
      // "1.234" in a semicolon file: thousands group (1234) or decimal point (1.234)?
      return { value, ambiguity: `"${raw.trim()}" read as ${value} (the "." taken as a thousands separator); write ${value} or ${t} with a comma decimal to be sure` };
    }
    if (PLAIN.test(t)) return num(t); // "2.5": not a thousands group, so a decimal point
    return {};
  }

  if (PLAIN.test(t)) return num(t);
  if (COMMA_THOUSANDS.test(t)) {
    const value = Number(t.replace(/,/g, ""));
    // With a comma delimiter the value was quoted on purpose, so a group like "1,234" is thousands.
    if (style.delimiter === "," || t.includes(".")) return { value };
    return { value, ambiguity: `"${raw.trim()}" read as ${value} (the "," taken as a thousands separator); if it is a decimal comma, write ${t.replace(",", ".")}` };
  }
  if (SHORT_COMMA_DECIMAL.test(t)) return num(t.replace(",", ".")); // "2,5": cannot be a thousands group
  return {};
}

cat > src/hooks/useParcelSet.test.tsx <<'EOF'
import type { ReactNode } from "react";
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { act, renderHook, waitFor } from "@testing-library/react";
import { ApiProvider } from "../api/ApiContext";
import { createMockClient, type ApiClient } from "../api/client";
import { mockSampleParcels } from "../api/mocks";
import type { SampleParcels } from "../api/types";
import { useParcelSet } from "./useParcelSet";

function deferred<T>() {
  let resolve!: (v: T) => void;
  let reject!: (e: unknown) => void;
  const promise = new Promise<T>((res, rej) => {
    resolve = res;
    reject = rej;
  });
  return { promise, resolve, reject };
}

function setup(sampleCalls: Promise<SampleParcels>[]) {
  const client: ApiClient = { ...createMockClient(0), sampleParcels: () => sampleCalls.shift()! };
  const wrapper = ({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) => <ApiProvider client={client}>{children}</ApiProvider>;
  return renderHook(() => useParcelSet(), { wrapper });
}

const csv = (rows: string) => new File([`weight_lb,distance_miles,residential,speed\n${rows}`], "mine.csv", { type: "text/csv" });

describe("useParcelSet: only the latest load commits", () => {
  it("a slow sample request does not overwrite a file uploaded meanwhile", async () => {
    const slow = deferred<SampleParcels>();
    const { result } = setup([slow.promise]);
    let samplePromise!: Promise<void>;
    act(() => {
      samplePromise = result.current.loadSample();
    });
    await act(() => result.current.loadFile(csv("2,100,true,ground\n")));
    expect(result.current.set?.name).toBe("mine.csv");
    await act(async () => {
      slow.resolve(mockSampleParcels);
      await samplePromise;
    });
    expect(result.current.set?.name).toBe("mine.csv");
    expect(result.current.status).toEqual({ kind: "idle" });
  });

  it("an older sample request resolving last loses to the newer one", async () => {
    const first = deferred<SampleParcels>();
    const second = deferred<SampleParcels>();
    const { result } = setup([first.promise, second.promise]);
    let p1!: Promise<void>;
    let p2!: Promise<void>;
    act(() => {
      p1 = result.current.loadSample();
      p2 = result.current.loadSample();
    });
    await act(async () => {
      second.resolve({ ...mockSampleParcels, description: "newer" });
      await p2;
    });
    await act(async () => {
      first.resolve({ ...mockSampleParcels, description: "older" });
      await p1;
    });
    expect(result.current.set?.description).toBe("newer");
  });

  it("a failed request that was superseded does not show its error", async () => {
    const failing = deferred<SampleParcels>();
    const { result } = setup([failing.promise]);
    let p!: Promise<void>;
    act(() => {
      p = result.current.loadSample();
    });
    act(() => result.current.clear());
    await act(async () => {
      failing.reject(new Error("boom"));
      await p;
    });
    expect(result.current.status).toEqual({ kind: "idle" });
    expect(result.current.set).toBeNull();
  });

  it("clear cancels a pending load", async () => {
    const slow = deferred<SampleParcels>();
    const { result } = setup([slow.promise]);
    let p!: Promise<void>;
    act(() => {
      p = result.current.loadSample();
    });
    act(() => result.current.clear());
    await act(async () => {
      slow.resolve(mockSampleParcels);
      await p;
    });
    await waitFor(() => expect(result.current.set).toBeNull());
  });
});
EOF

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";

/** True while the media query matches. False where matchMedia is missing (old browsers, jsdom). */
export function useMediaQuery(query: string): boolean {
  const get = () => typeof window !== "undefined" && typeof window.matchMedia === "function" && window.matchMedia(query).matches;
  const [matches, setMatches] = useState(get);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (typeof window.matchMedia !== "function") return;
    const mql = window.matchMedia(query);
    const onChange = () => setMatches(mql.matches);
    onChange();
    mql.addEventListener("change", onChange);
    return () => mql.removeEventListener("change", onChange);
  }, [query]);
  return matches;
}
