/** Pure derivations for the Q3 blended view, kept apart from rendering so they are easy to test. */
import type { BlendedResponse, Carrier, CarrierBlended, Parcel, SegmentFilter } from "../../api/types";

export interface BlendedAnswer {
  cheapest: CarrierBlended;
  others: CarrierBlended[];
  /** Best mix minus cheapest single carrier, per parcel (negative = the mix is cheaper). */
  mixSavingPerParcel: number;
  mixSavingTotal: number;
  /** True when some carrier could not ship part of the set, so averages cover different parcels. */
  unevenCoverage: boolean;
}

/** Cheapest carrier by cost per parcel among carriers that shipped anything. */
export function blendedAnswer(r: BlendedResponse): BlendedAnswer | null {
  const shipped = r.carriers.filter((c) => c.parcels_shipped > 0);
  if (shipped.length === 0) return null;
  const sorted = [...shipped].sort((a, b) => a.cost_per_parcel - b.cost_per_parcel);
  const cheapest = sorted[0]!;
  return {
    cheapest,
    others: sorted.slice(1),
    mixSavingPerParcel: round2(cheapest.cost_per_parcel - r.best_mix.cost_per_parcel),
    mixSavingTotal: round2(cheapest.total_cost - r.best_mix.total_cost),
    unevenCoverage: r.carriers.some((c) => c.parcels_unavailable > 0),
  };
}

export const round2 = (n: number) => Math.round(n * 100) / 100;

/* ---------- stacked split ---------- */

export const MAX_KINDS = 3;
export const OTHER_KIND = "__other";

/** Surcharge kinds ordered by their total across carriers; the top MAX_KINDS get their own segment. */
export function surchargeKinds(r: BlendedResponse): { shown: string[]; folded: string[] } {
  const totals = new Map<string, number>();
  for (const c of r.carriers)
    for (const s of c.surcharges_by_condition) totals.set(s.condition, (totals.get(s.condition) ?? 0) + s.total);
  const order = [...totals.entries()].sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]).map(([k]) => k);
  if (order.length <= MAX_KINDS + 1) return { shown: order, folded: [] };
  return { shown: order.slice(0, MAX_KINDS), folded: order.slice(MAX_KINDS) };
}

export interface SplitRow {
  carrier: Carrier;
  label: string;
  base: number;
  fuel: number;
  /** per surcharge kind key (a condition or OTHER_KIND): dollars per parcel */
  kinds: Record<string, number>;
  surcharges: number;
  total: number;
  surchargeShare: number;
  fuelShare: number;
}

export function splitRows(r: BlendedResponse, kinds: { shown: string[]; folded: string[] }, names: Record<Carrier, string>): SplitRow[] {
  return r.carriers
    .filter((c) => c.parcels_shipped > 0)
    .map((c) => {
      const byKind: Record<string, number> = {};
      for (const k of kinds.shown) byKind[k] = 0;
      if (kinds.folded.length) byKind[OTHER_KIND] = 0;
      for (const s of c.surcharges_by_condition) {
        const key = kinds.shown.includes(s.condition) ? s.condition : OTHER_KIND;
        byKind[key] = round2((byKind[key] ?? 0) + s.per_parcel);
      }
      return {
        carrier: c.carrier,
        label: names[c.carrier],
        base: c.split.base.per_parcel,
        fuel: c.split.fuel.per_parcel,
        kinds: byKind,
        surcharges: c.split.surcharges.per_parcel,
        total: c.cost_per_parcel,
        surchargeShare: c.split.surcharges.share,
        fuelShare: c.split.fuel.share,
      };
    });
}

/* ---------- segment filter ---------- */

export type SegmentKey = keyof SegmentFilter;

/** Drop unset keys, so "All" everywhere sends no segment at all. */
export function cleanSegment(s: SegmentFilter): SegmentFilter | null {
  const out: SegmentFilter = {};
  if (s.weight_band != null) out.weight_band = s.weight_band;
  if (s.zone_band != null) out.zone_band = s.zone_band;
  if (s.residential != null) out.residential = s.residential;
  if (s.speed != null) out.speed = s.speed;
  return Object.keys(out).length ? out : null;
}

export const totalQuantity = (parcels: Parcel[]) => parcels.reduce((n, p) => n + (p.quantity ?? 1), 0);

import { useId } from "react";
import type { SegmentFilter, Tier, WeightBand, ZoneBandLabel } from "../../api/types";
import { TIERS } from "../../api/types";
import { tierName } from "./money";

export interface ChipOption<T> {
  value: T;
  label: string;
}

/** A row of toggle chips that behaves like a radio group; "All" clears the dimension. */
export function ChipGroup<T>({
  legend,
  options,
  value,
  onChange,
  equals = (a, b) => a === b,
}: {
  legend: string;
  options: ChipOption<T>[];
  value: T;
  onChange: (v: T) => void;
  equals?: (a: T, b: T) => boolean;
}) {
  const id = useId();
  return (
    <div className="chips" role="group" aria-labelledby={id}>
      <span id={id} className="chips__legend">
        {legend}
      </span>
      <div className="chips__row">
        {options.map((o) => {
          const on = equals(o.value, value);
          return (
            <button
              key={o.label}
              type="button"
              className={`chip ${on ? "chip--on" : ""}`}
              aria-pressed={on}
              onClick={() => onChange(o.value)}
            >
              {o.label}
            </button>
          );
        })}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

const DEFAULT_WEIGHTS: WeightBand[] = ["≤1", "1–5", "5–10", "10–20", "20–70"];
const DEFAULT_ZONES: ZoneBandLabel[] = ["1–2", "3–4", "5–6", "7–8"];

export function SegmentChips({
  value,
  onChange,
  weightBands = DEFAULT_WEIGHTS,
  zoneBands = DEFAULT_ZONES,
}: {
  value: SegmentFilter;
  onChange: (next: SegmentFilter) => void;
  weightBands?: readonly string[];
  zoneBands?: readonly string[];
}) {
  const set = <K extends keyof SegmentFilter>(key: K, v: SegmentFilter[K]) => onChange({ ...value, [key]: v });
  return (
    <div className="segments">
      <ChipGroup<WeightBand | null>
        legend="Weight"
        value={value.weight_band ?? null}
        onChange={(v) => set("weight_band", v)}
        options={[
          { value: null, label: "All" },
          ...weightBands.map((w) => ({ value: w as WeightBand, label: `${w} lb` })),
        ]}
      />
      <ChipGroup<ZoneBandLabel | null>
        legend="Distance (USPS zone)"
        value={value.zone_band ?? null}
        onChange={(v) => set("zone_band", v)}
        options={[
          { value: null, label: "All" },
          ...zoneBands.map((z) => ({ value: z as ZoneBandLabel, label: `Zones ${z}` })),
        ]}
      />
      <ChipGroup<boolean | null>
        legend="Address"
        value={value.residential ?? null}
        onChange={(v) => set("residential", v)}
        options={[
          { value: null, label: "All" },
          { value: true, label: "Homes" },
          { value: false, label: "Businesses" },
        ]}
      />
      <ChipGroup<Tier | null>
        legend="Speed"
        value={value.speed ?? null}
        onChange={(v) => set("speed", v)}
        options={[{ value: null, label: "All" }, ...TIERS.map((t) => ({ value: t, label: tierName(t) }))]}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

/** "1–5 lb · homes" for the answer kicker; empty when no segment is set. */
export function describeSegment(s: SegmentFilter | null): string {
  if (!s) return "";
  const parts: string[] = [];
  if (s.weight_band) parts.push(`${s.weight_band} lb`);
  if (s.zone_band) parts.push(`zones ${s.zone_band}`);
  if (s.residential != null) parts.push(s.residential ? "homes" : "businesses");
  if (s.speed) parts.push(tierName(s.speed).toLowerCase());
  return parts.join(" · ");
}

import { Bar, BarChart, CartesianGrid, ResponsiveContainer, Tooltip, XAxis, YAxis } from "recharts";
import type { BlendedResponse } from "../../api/types";
import { CARRIER_NAME, formatUsd } from "../../lib/format";
import { ChartFrame, useCssColors } from "./common";
import { OTHER_KIND, splitRows, surchargeKinds, type SplitRow } from "./logic";
import { conditionLabel, pct0 } from "./money";
import { useMediaQuery } from "../../hooks/useMediaQuery";

const COLOR_VARS = {
  base: "--q3-base",
  s0: "--q3-sur-1",
  s1: "--q3-sur-2",
  s2: "--q3-sur-3",
  s3: "--q3-sur-4",
  fuel: "--q3-fuel",
  ink: "--ink",
  muted: "--ink-muted",
  rule: "--rule",
  sheet: "--sheet",
  paper: "--paper",
  usps: "--carrier-usps",
  ups: "--carrier-ups",
  fedex: "--carrier-fedex",
} as const;

interface Segment {
  key: string;
  label: string;
  colorKey: keyof typeof COLOR_VARS;
  value: (r: SplitRow) => number;
}

function segmentsFor(kinds: { shown: string[]; folded: string[] }): Segment[] {
  const sur: Segment[] = kinds.shown.map((k, i) => ({
    key: `k_${k}`,
    label: conditionLabel(k),
    colorKey: (["s0", "s1", "s2", "s3"] as const)[Math.min(i, 3)]!,
    value: (r) => r.kinds[k] ?? 0,
  }));
  if (kinds.folded.length)
    sur.push({ key: "k_other", label: "Other surcharges", colorKey: "s3", value: (r) => r.kinds[OTHER_KIND] ?? 0 });
  return [
    { key: "base", label: "Base rate", colorKey: "base", value: (r) => r.base },
    ...sur,
    { key: "fuel", label: "Fuel", colorKey: "fuel", value: (r) => r.fuel },
  ];
}

export function CostSplitChart({ data }: { data: BlendedResponse }) {
  const colors = useCssColors(COLOR_VARS);
  const narrow = useMediaQuery("(max-width: 39.999rem)");
  const kinds = surchargeKinds(data);
  const rows = splitRows(data, kinds, CARRIER_NAME);
  const segs = segmentsFor(kinds);
  const chartRows = rows.map((r) => {
    const o: Record<string, number | string> = { label: r.label, carrier: r.carrier };
    for (const s of segs) o[s.key] = s.value(r);
    return o;
  });
  const byLabel = new Map(rows.map((r) => [r.label, r]));
  const heaviest = [...rows].sort((a, b) => b.surchargeShare + b.fuelShare - (a.surchargeShare + a.fuelShare))[0];

  const summary = (
    <>
      {rows.map((r, i) => (
        <span key={r.carrier}>
          {i > 0 && "; "}
          {r.label} {formatUsd(r.total)}: base {formatUsd(r.base)}, surcharges {formatUsd(r.surcharges)} (
          {pct0(r.surchargeShare)}), fuel {formatUsd(r.fuel)} ({pct0(r.fuelShare)})
        </span>
      ))}
      .
      {heaviest && heaviest.surchargeShare + heaviest.fuelShare > 0 && (
        <>
          {" "}
          Add-ons weigh most on {heaviest.label}: {pct0(heaviest.surchargeShare + heaviest.fuelShare)} of its cost is
          surcharges and fuel rather than base rate.
        </>
      )}
    </>
  );

  const yWidth = narrow ? 104 : 168;
  const tick = (props: { x?: number | string; y?: number | string; payload?: { value?: string } }) => {
    const x = Number(props.x ?? 0);
    const y = Number(props.y ?? 0);
    const label = props.payload?.value ?? "";
    const r = byLabel.get(label);
    if (!r) return <g />;
    return (
      <g transform={`translate(${x - yWidth + 4},${y})`}>
        <text x={0} y={-4} fill={colors[r.carrier]} fontWeight={700} fontSize={14} fontFamily="var(--font-ui)">
          {label} {formatUsd(r.total)}
        </text>
        <text x={0} y={13} fill={colors.muted} fontSize={12} fontFamily="var(--font-ui)">
          {narrow ? `surch. ${pct0(r.surchargeShare)}` : `surcharges ${pct0(r.surchargeShare)} · fuel ${pct0(r.fuelShare)}`}
        </text>
      </g>
    );
  };

  const chart = (
    <>
      <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height={rows.length * 64 + 40} initialDimension={{ width: 600, height: 240 }}>
        <BarChart data={chartRows} layout="vertical" margin={{ top: 4, right: 12, bottom: 4, left: 0 }} barCategoryGap="28%">
          <CartesianGrid horizontal={false} stroke={colors.rule} />
          <XAxis
            type="number"
            tickFormatter={(v: number) => `$${v}`}
            tick={{ fill: colors.muted, fontSize: 12 }}
            axisLine={false}
            tickLine={false}
          />
          <YAxis type="category" dataKey="label" width={yWidth} tick={tick} axisLine={false} tickLine={false} />
          <Tooltip
            cursor={{ fill: colors.rule, opacity: 0.35 }}
            contentStyle={{ background: colors.sheet, border: `1px solid ${colors.rule}`, borderRadius: 2, fontSize: 13 }}
            labelStyle={{ color: colors.ink, fontWeight: 700 }}
            formatter={(v, name) => [formatUsd(Number(v)), name]}
          />
          {segs.map((s) => (
            <Bar
              key={s.key}
              dataKey={s.key}
              name={s.label}
              stackId="cost"
              fill={colors[s.colorKey]}
              stroke={colors.paper}
              strokeWidth={2}
              isAnimationActive={false}
            />
          ))}
        </BarChart>
      </ResponsiveContainer>
      <ul className="legend" aria-hidden="true">
        {segs.map((s) => (
          <li key={s.key}>
            <span className="legend__swatch" style={{ background: `var(${COLOR_VARS[s.colorKey]})` }} />
            {s.label}
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>
    </>
  );

  const table = (
    <table className="ledger-table">
      <caption className="visually-hidden">Cost per parcel by part, per carrier</caption>
      <thead>
        <tr>
          <th scope="col">Carrier</th>
          {segs.map((s) => (
            <th key={s.key} scope="col" className="num">
              {s.label}
            </th>
          ))}
          <th scope="col" className="num">
            Total
          </th>
          <th scope="col" className="num">
            Surcharge share
          </th>
        </tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody>
        {rows.map((r) => (
          <tr key={r.carrier}>
            <th scope="row">{r.label}</th>
            {segs.map((s) => (
              <td key={s.key} className="num">
                {formatUsd(s.value(r))}
              </td>
            ))}
            <td className="num">{formatUsd(r.total)}</td>
            <td className="num">{pct0(r.surchargeShare)}</td>
          </tr>
        ))}
      </tbody>
    </table>
  );

  return <ChartFrame title="What each parcel costs, by part" summary={summary} chart={chart} table={table} />;
}

import { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { useApi, useLoad } from "../../api/ApiContext";
import type { BlendedResponse, Carrier, Parcel, SegmentFilter } from "../../api/types";
import type { ControlsState } from "../../state/urlState";
import type { Meta } from "../../api/types";
import { formatInt, formatUsd } from "../../lib/format";
import { carrierVar } from "../../lib/carriers";
import { LoadProblem, NeedParcels, useLastData, type ParcelActions } from "./common";
import { blendedAnswer, cleanSegment, totalQuantity, type BlendedAnswer } from "./logic";
import { carrierName, pct0, signedUsd } from "./money";
import { SegmentChips, describeSegment } from "./SegmentChips";
import { CostSplitChart } from "./CostSplitChart";

export interface BlendedPanelProps extends ParcelActions {
  controls: ControlsState;
  meta: Meta | null;
  parcels: Parcel[] | null;
}

export function BlendedPanel({ controls, meta, parcels, onLoadSample, onUploadCsv }: BlendedPanelProps) {
  if (!parcels || parcels.length === 0) {
    return (
      <NeedParcels
        what="Load the sample mix or upload a CSV to see what each carrier costs per parcel across the whole set, how much of it is surcharges, and whether your shipping price covers it."
        onLoadSample={onLoadSample}
        onUploadCsv={onUploadCsv}
      />
    );
  }
  return <Blended controls={controls} meta={meta} parcels={parcels} />;
}

function Blended({ controls, meta, parcels }: { controls: ControlsState; meta: Meta | null; parcels: Parcel[] }) {
  const api = useApi();
  const [segment, setSegment] = useState<SegmentFilter>({});
  const clean = cleanSegment(segment);
  const controlsKey = JSON.stringify(controls);
  const segKey = JSON.stringify(clean);
  const state = useLoad(
    (signal) => api.blended({ parcels, controls, ...(clean ? { segment: clean } : {}) }, signal),
    [api, parcels, controlsKey, segKey],
  );
  const data = useLastData(state);
  const total = useMemo(() => totalQuantity(parcels), [parcels]);
  const loading = state.status === "loading";

  return (
    <div className="q3" aria-busy={loading}>
      {state.status === "error" && <LoadProblem error={state.error} />}
      {!data && loading && <p className="q-loading">Pricing {formatInt(total)} parcels with every carrier…</p>}
      {data && (
        <Body
          data={data}
          controls={controls}
          segment={clean}
          total={total}
          chips={
            <SegmentChips
              value={segment}
              onChange={setSegment}
              weightBands={meta?.segments.weight_bands}
              zoneBands={meta?.segments.zone_bands}
            />
          }
          stale={loading}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function Body({
  data,
  controls,
  segment,
  total,
  chips,
  stale,
}: {
  data: BlendedResponse;
  controls: ControlsState;
  segment: SegmentFilter | null;
  total: number;
  chips: React.ReactNode;
  stale: boolean;
}) {
  const answer = blendedAnswer(data);
  const seg = describeSegment(segment);
  const scope = `${formatInt(data.parcels_considered)} ${segment ? `of ${formatInt(total)} ` : ""}parcels`;

  return (
    <div className={stale ? "q-stale" : undefined}>
      {answer ? (
        <Answer data={data} answer={answer} kicker={`Cheapest single carrier · ${data.year} prices · ${scope}${seg ? ` · ${seg}` : ""}`} />
      ) : (
        <div className="answer">
          <p className="kicker">{seg || "This selection"}</p>
          <p className="answer__figure answer__figure--empty">No parcels</p>
          <p className="answer__caption">None of your parcels fall in this segment. Choose “All” in a group to widen it.</p>
        </div>
      )}

      {answer && <Verdict data={data} answer={answer} controls={controls} />}

      <section className="q-block" aria-label="Filter by kind of parcel">
        <div className="q-block__head">
          <h3 className="q-block__title">Look at one kind of parcel</h3>
          <p className="q-count" role="status">
            <strong className="figure">{formatInt(data.parcels_considered)}</strong> of {formatInt(total)} parcels in
            this segment
          </p>
        </div>
        {chips}
      </section>

      {answer && <CostSplitChart data={data} />}
      {answer && <Unavailable data={data} />}
    </div>
  );
}

function Answer({ data, answer, kicker }: { data: BlendedResponse; answer: BlendedAnswer; kicker: string }) {
  const { cheapest, others, mixSavingPerParcel, mixSavingTotal } = answer;
  const mix = data.best_mix;
  const mixCounts = Object.entries(mix.parcels_by_carrier)
    .filter(([, n]) => n > 0)
    .sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]);
  return (
    <div className="answer q3-answer">
      <p className="kicker">{kicker}</p>
      <p className="answer__figure" data-testid="q3-answer">
        <span className="carrier-tag" style={{ color: carrierVar(cheapest.carrier) }}>
          {carrierName(cheapest.carrier)}
        </span>{" "}
        {formatUsd(cheapest.cost_per_parcel)}
        <span className="answer__unit"> per parcel</span>
      </p>
      <p className="answer__caption">
        Blended over every parcel at its cheapest {carrierName(cheapest.carrier)} service for the speed it needs.
        {others.length > 0 && " "}
        {others.map((c, i) => (
          <span key={c.carrier}>
            {i > 0 && ", "}
            <strong style={{ color: carrierVar(c.carrier) }}>{carrierName(c.carrier)}</strong> {formatUsd(c.cost_per_parcel)}{" "}
            ({signedUsd(c.cost_per_parcel - cheapest.cost_per_parcel)})
          </span>
        ))}
        {others.length > 0 && "."}
      </p>
      <div className="mix" data-testid="q3-mix">
        <p className="mix__line">
          <span className="mix__label">Best mix</span>{" "}
          <span className="figure mix__figure">{formatUsd(mix.cost_per_parcel)}</span> per parcel, choosing the cheapest
          carrier for each parcel:{" "}
          {mixSavingPerParcel > 0 ? (
            <>
              <strong>{formatUsd(mixSavingPerParcel)} less per parcel</strong> than {carrierName(cheapest.carrier)} alone (
              {formatUsd(mixSavingTotal)} on these parcels).
            </>
          ) : (
            <>no saving over {carrierName(cheapest.carrier)} alone.</>
          )}
        </p>
        <p className="mix__split">
          {mixCounts.map(([c, n], i) => (
            <span key={c}>
              {i > 0 && " · "}
              <span style={{ color: carrierVar(c as Carrier) }}>{carrierName(c)}</span> {formatInt(n)}
            </span>
          ))}
        </p>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function Verdict({ data, answer, controls }: { data: BlendedResponse; answer: BlendedAnswer; controls: ControlsState }) {
  const c = answer.cheapest;
  const loss = c.margin_per_parcel < 0;
  const charged = data.revenue_per_parcel;
  const mixedPrices = Math.abs(charged - controls.flat_price) >= 0.005;
  const rows = [
    ...[...data.carriers].filter((x) => x.parcels_shipped > 0).sort((a, b) => a.cost_per_parcel - b.cost_per_parcel),
  ];
  return (
    <section className={`verdict ${loss ? "verdict--loss" : "verdict--profit"}`} aria-labelledby="q3-verdict">
      <h3 id="q3-verdict" className="verdict__q">
        Does your {formatUsd(controls.flat_price)} shipping price cover the cost?
      </h3>
      <p className="verdict__figure" data-testid="q3-verdict">
        <span className="verdict__word">{loss ? "No." : "Yes."}</span>{" "}
        {loss ? (
          <>
            You lose {formatUsd(-c.margin_per_parcel)} per parcel with {carrierName(c.carrier)}
          </>
        ) : (
          <>
            {formatUsd(c.margin_per_parcel)} margin per parcel with {carrierName(c.carrier)}
          </>
        )}
      </p>
      <p className="verdict__loss-share" data-testid="q3-loss-share">
        <strong>{pct0(c.loss_share)}</strong> of parcels ({formatInt(c.parcels_at_loss)} of {formatInt(c.parcels_shipped)})
        ship at a loss even with the cheapest carrier
        {data.best_mix.loss_share !== c.loss_share && (
          <>; {pct0(data.best_mix.loss_share)} with the best mix</>
        )}
        .
      </p>
      {mixedPrices && (
        <p className="verdict__note">
          You charge {formatUsd(charged)} per parcel on average: the flat {formatUsd(controls.flat_price)}, and your own
          price on rows that have one.
        </p>
      )}
      <table className="ledger-table margin-table">
        <caption className="visually-hidden">Margin per parcel and share shipped at a loss, per carrier</caption>
        <thead>
          <tr>
            <th scope="col">Carrier</th>
            <th scope="col" className="num">
              Cost / parcel
            </th>
            <th scope="col" className="num">
              Margin / parcel
            </th>
            <th scope="col">Shipped at a loss</th>
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody>
          {[...rows.map((r) => ({ key: r.carrier as string, name: carrierName(r.carrier), color: carrierVar(r.carrier), s: r })),
            { key: "mix", name: "Best mix", color: "var(--ink)", s: data.best_mix }].map(({ key, name, color, s }) => (
            <tr key={key} data-testid={`margin-${key}`}>
              <th scope="row" style={{ color }}>
                {name}
              </th>
              <td className="num">{formatUsd(s.cost_per_parcel)}</td>
              <td className={`num ${s.margin_per_parcel < 0 ? "money--loss" : "money--profit"}`}>
                {signedUsd(s.margin_per_parcel)} {s.margin_per_parcel < 0 ? "loss" : "margin"}
              </td>
              <td>
                <span className="meter" aria-hidden="true">
                  <span className="meter__fill" style={{ transform: `scaleX(${s.loss_share})` }} />
                </span>
                <span className="meter__text">{pct0(s.loss_share)}</span>
              </td>
            </tr>
          ))}
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </section>
  );
}

function Unavailable({ data }: { data: BlendedResponse }) {
  const gaps = data.carriers.filter((c) => c.parcels_unavailable > 0);
  if (gaps.length === 0 && data.best_mix.parcels_unavailable === 0) return null;
  return (
    <div className="q-notes" role="note">
      <p className="kicker">Parcels a carrier cannot ship</p>
      <ul>
        {gaps.map((c) => (
          <li key={c.carrier}>
            <strong style={{ color: carrierVar(c.carrier) }}>{carrierName(c.carrier)}</strong> cannot ship{" "}
            {formatInt(c.parcels_unavailable)} of these parcels at the speed they need; its cost per parcel covers the
            other {formatInt(c.parcels_shipped)}, so compare with care.
          </li>
        ))}
        {data.best_mix.parcels_unavailable > 0 && (
          <li>{formatInt(data.best_mix.parcels_unavailable)} parcels cannot be shipped by any carrier.</li>
        )}
      </ul>
    </div>
  );
}

cat > ~/parcel-rates-issue-6/frontend/src/views/yearly/logic.ts <<'EOF'
/** Pure derivations for the Q4 year-over-year view. */
import type { Carrier, CarrierYears, Driver, Drivers, YearRow, YearlyResponse } from "../../api/types";
import { carrierName, signedPct, signedUsd, tierName } from "../blended/money";

export type Dimension = keyof Drivers;
export const DIMENSIONS: readonly Dimension[] = ["weight_band", "zone_band", "residential", "speed"];
export const DIMENSION_LABEL: Record<Dimension, string> = {
  weight_band: "Weight",
  zone_band: "Distance",
  residential: "Address",
  speed: "Speed",
};

const round2 = (n: number) => Math.round(n * 100) / 100;

/** Latest year every carrier with data publishes (2026 when FedEx alone has 2027). */
export function referenceYear(r: YearlyResponse): number | null {
  const sets = r.carriers.filter((c) => c.years.length > 0).map((c) => new Set(c.years.map((y) => y.year)));
  if (sets.length === 0) return null;
  const common = [...sets[0]!].filter((y) => sets.every((s) => s.has(y)));
  if (common.length) return Math.max(...common);
  return Math.max(...r.carriers.flatMap((c) => c.years.map((y) => y.year)));
}

export const rowFor = (c: CarrierYears, year: number) => c.years.find((y) => y.year === year) ?? null;

/** The carrier the owner would pick: cheapest per parcel in the reference year. */
export function pickCarrier(r: YearlyResponse, ref: number): CarrierYears | null {
  let best: CarrierYears | null = null;
  let bestCost = Infinity;
  for (const c of r.carriers) {
    const row = rowFor(c, ref);
    if (row && c.parcels_used > 0 && row.cost_per_parcel < bestCost) {
      best = c;
      bestCost = row.cost_per_parcel;
    }
  }
  return best;
}

export interface PeriodChange {
  fromYear: number;
  toYear: number;
  from: number;
  to: number;
  dollars: number;
  percent: number;
  /** Announced increases compounded over the same years; null when a year has none. */
  announcedPercent: number | null;
}

/** Change in cost per parcel from the carrier's first year to `toYear`, against the compounded announcements. */
export function periodChange(c: CarrierYears, toYear: number): PeriodChange | null {
  const first = c.years[0];
  const last = rowFor(c, toYear);
  if (!first || !last || last.year <= first.year || first.cost_per_parcel === 0) return null;
  let factor: number | null = 1;
  for (const y of c.years) {
    if (y.year <= first.year || y.year > toYear) continue;
    const p = y.announced_increase.percent;
    factor = p === null || factor === null ? null : factor * (1 + p / 100);
  }
  return {
    fromYear: first.year,
    toYear,
    from: first.cost_per_parcel,
    to: last.cost_per_parcel,
    dollars: round2(last.cost_per_parcel - first.cost_per_parcel),
    percent: ((last.cost_per_parcel - first.cost_per_parcel) / first.cost_per_parcel) * 100,
    announcedPercent: factor === null ? null : (factor - 1) * 100,
  };
}

/** Cost path if every year had risen exactly by the announced increase, from the first year's cost. */
export function announcedPath(c: CarrierYears): Map<number, number> {
  const out = new Map<number, number>();
  const first = c.years[0];
  if (!first) return out;
  let v = first.cost_per_parcel;
  out.set(first.year, v);
  for (const y of c.years.slice(1)) {
    const p = y.announced_increase.percent;
    if (p === null) break;
    v = v * (1 + p / 100);
    out.set(y.year, round2(v));
  }
  return out;
}

/** Default for the next-year slider: the pick carrier's latest announced increase. */
export function defaultIncrease(c: CarrierYears | null): number | null {
  if (!c) return null;
  for (let i = c.years.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const p = c.years[i]!.announced_increase.percent;
    if (p !== null) return p;
  }
  return null;
}

/* ---------- fuel ---------- */

export interface FuelStep {
  carrier: Carrier;
  fromYear: number;
  toYear: number;
  change: number;
  fuelChange: number;
  /** fuel change as a share of the total change (can exceed 1 or be negative) */
  share: number | null;
  groundFrom: number | null;
  groundTo: number | null;
}

export function fuelStep(c: CarrierYears, prev: YearRow, cur: YearRow): FuelStep | null {
  if (!cur.fuel || !prev.fuel || !cur.change_vs_previous) return null;
  const change = cur.change_vs_previous.dollars_per_parcel;
  const fuelChange = round2(cur.summary.split.fuel.per_parcel - prev.summary.split.fuel.per_parcel);
  return {
    carrier: c.carrier,
    fromYear: prev.year,
    toYear: cur.year,
    change,
    fuelChange,
    share: change !== 0 ? fuelChange / change : null,
    groundFrom: prev.fuel.ground.applied_percent,
    groundTo: cur.fuel.ground.applied_percent,
  };
}

/** The year step where the carrier's cost rose most, with its fuel part. */
export function biggestFuelStep(c: CarrierYears, upTo?: number): FuelStep | null {
  let best: FuelStep | null = null;
  for (let i = 1; i < c.years.length; i++) {
    const cur = c.years[i]!;
    if (upTo !== undefined && cur.year > upTo) break;
    const s = fuelStep(c, c.years[i - 1]!, cur);
    if (s && (!best || s.change > best.change)) best = s;
  }
  return best;
}

export function fuelSentence(s: FuelStep): string {
  const name = carrierName(s.carrier);
  const pct = s.share !== null && s.change > 0 && s.fuelChange > 0 ? ` (${Math.round(s.share * 100)}% of it)` : "";
  const rates =
    s.groundFrom !== null && s.groundTo !== null && s.groundFrom !== s.groundTo
      ? `; the ground fuel surcharge went from ${s.groundFrom}% to ${s.groundTo}%`
      : "";
  return `${name} ${s.fromYear}→${s.toYear}: ${signedUsd(s.change)} per parcel, of which fuel ${signedUsd(s.fuelChange)}${pct}${rates}.`;
}

/* ---------- drivers ---------- */

export function sortedDrivers(list: Driver[]): Driver[] {
  return [...list].sort((a, b) => Math.abs(b.change_per_parcel) - Math.abs(a.change_per_parcel) || a.segment.localeCompare(b.segment));
}

export function segmentLabel(dim: Dimension, segment: string): string {
  switch (dim) {
    case "weight_band":
      return `${segment} lb`;
    case "zone_band":
      return `Zones ${segment}`;
    case "residential":
      return segment === "residential" ? "Homes" : segment === "business" ? "Businesses" : segment;
    case "speed":
      return tierName(segment);
  }
}

function segmentPhrase(dim: Dimension, segment: string): string {
  switch (dim) {
    case "weight_band":
      return `parcels of ${segment} lb`;
    case "zone_band":
      return `parcels to zones ${segment}`;
    case "residential":
      return segment === "residential" ? "deliveries to homes" : "deliveries to businesses";
    case "speed":
      return `${tierName(segment).toLowerCase()} parcels`;
  }
}

/** The dimension whose largest single segment explains most of the change. */
export function strongestDimension(d: Drivers): Dimension {
  let best: Dimension = "weight_band";
  let bestV = -1;
  for (const dim of DIMENSIONS) {
    const top = sortedDrivers(d[dim])[0];
    const v = top ? Math.abs(top.change_per_parcel) : 0;
    if (v > bestV) {
      best = dim;
      bestV = v;
    }
  }
  return best;
}

export function driverSentence(carrier: Carrier, row: YearRow, dim: Dimension): string | null {
  const ch = row.change_vs_previous;
  const list = row.drivers?.[dim];
  if (!ch || !list || list.length === 0) return null;
  const top = sortedDrivers(list)[0]!;
  const name = carrierName(carrier);
  const span = `${ch.from_year} to ${row.year}`;
  const what = segmentPhrase(dim, top.segment);
  const share = ch.dollars_per_parcel !== 0 ? Math.round((top.change_per_parcel / ch.dollars_per_parcel) * 100) : null;
  const shareText = share !== null && share > 0 ? `, ${share}% of it` : "";
  const direction = top.change_per_parcel >= 0 ? "added" : "took off";
  return (
    `Top driver: ${what} (${top.parcels} parcels) ${direction} ${signedUsd(Math.abs(top.change_per_parcel)).replace("+", "")} per parcel ` +
    `of ${name}'s ${signedUsd(ch.dollars_per_parcel)} change from ${span}${shareText}.`
  );
}

/* ---------- warnings ---------- */

const MONTHS = ["Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr", "May", "Jun", "Jul", "Aug", "Sep", "Oct", "Nov", "Dec"];

export function formatDate(iso: string): string {
  const [y, m, d] = iso.split("-").map(Number);
  return `${d} ${MONTHS[(m ?? 1) - 1]} ${y}`;
}

export interface PointNote {
  carrier: Carrier;
  year: number;
  text: string;
  kind: "warning" | "edition";
}

/**
 * Warnings from the response, plus a note when the year's prices took effect mid-year
 * (the backend reports `as_of`, not a warning, for that): a year priced from a mid-year
 * edition is not a January-to-January comparison.
 */
export function pointNotes(r: YearlyResponse): PointNote[] {
  const out: PointNote[] = [];
  for (const c of r.carriers) {
    for (const y of c.years) {
      for (const w of y.warnings) out.push({ carrier: c.carrier, year: y.year, text: w, kind: "warning" });
      if (y.as_of) {
        const [ay, am] = y.as_of.split("-").map(Number);
        if (ay === y.year && am !== undefined && am >= 3) {
          out.push({
            carrier: c.carrier,
            year: y.year,
            kind: "edition",
            text: `Priced from the edition effective ${formatDate(y.as_of)}, published mid-year, so the step into and out of ${y.year} is not January to January.`,
          });
        }
      }
    }
  }
  return out;
}

export const pctText = (n: number) => signedPct(n, 1);

import { CartesianGrid, Line, LineChart, ResponsiveContainer, Tooltip, XAxis, YAxis } from "recharts";
import type { Carrier, YearlyResponse } from "../../api/types";
import { formatUsd } from "../../lib/format";
import { useMediaQuery } from "../../hooks/useMediaQuery";
import { ChartFrame, useCssColors } from "../blended/common";

import { announcedPath, biggestFuelStep, fuelSentence, referenceYear, type PointNote } from "./logic";

const COLOR_VARS = {
  usps: "--carrier-usps",
  ups: "--carrier-ups",
  fedex: "--carrier-fedex",
  muted: "--ink-muted",
  ink: "--ink",
  rule: "--rule",
  sheet: "--sheet",
  paper: "--paper",
  loss: "--loss",
} as const;

/** Marker shape per carrier, so lines differ without colour. */
const SHAPE: Record<Carrier, "circle" | "square" | "triangle"> = { usps: "circle", ups: "square", fedex: "triangle" };
const SHAPE_WORD: Record<Carrier, string> = { usps: "circles", ups: "squares", fedex: "triangles" };

function Marker({ cx, cy, shape, color, ring, r = 5 }: { cx: number; cy: number; shape: string; color: string; ring: string; r?: number }) {
  if (shape === "square")
    return <rect x={cx - r} y={cy - r} width={r * 2} height={r * 2} fill={color} stroke={ring} strokeWidth={2} />;
  if (shape === "triangle")
    return (
      <polygon
        points={`${cx},${cy - r - 1.5} ${cx + r + 1},${cy + r} ${cx - r - 1},${cy + r}`}
        fill={color}
        stroke={ring}
        strokeWidth={2}
      />
    );
  return <circle cx={cx} cy={cy} r={r} fill={color} stroke={ring} strokeWidth={2} />;
}

export function YearChart({ data, notes }: { data: YearlyResponse; notes: PointNote[] }) {
  const colors = useCssColors(COLOR_VARS);
  const narrow = useMediaQuery("(max-width: 39.999rem)");
  const carriers = data.carriers.filter((c) => c.years.length > 0 && c.parcels_used > 0);
  const years = new Set<number>();
  for (const c of carriers) {
    c.years.forEach((y) => years.add(y.year));
    if (c.projected) years.add(c.projected.year);
  }
  const yearList = [...years].sort((a, b) => a - b);
  const paths = new Map(carriers.map((c) => [c.carrier, announcedPath(c)]));
  const noteAt = new Set(notes.map((n) => `${n.carrier}:${n.year}`));

  const rows = yearList.map((year) => {
    const o: Record<string, number | null> = { year };
    for (const c of carriers) {
      const row = c.years.find((y) => y.year === year);
      const last = c.years[c.years.length - 1]!;
      o[c.carrier] = row ? row.cost_per_parcel : null;
      o[`${c.carrier}_ann`] = paths.get(c.carrier)?.get(year) ?? null;
      o[`${c.carrier}_proj`] =
        year === last.year ? last.cost_per_parcel : c.projected && year === c.projected.year ? c.projected.cost_per_parcel : null;
    }
    return o;
  });

  const ref = referenceYear(data);
  const fuelSteps = carriers.map((c) => biggestFuelStep(c, ref ?? undefined)).filter((s) => s !== null);

  const summary = (
    <>
      {carriers.map((c, i) => {
        const first = c.years[0]!;
        const last = c.years[c.years.length - 1]!;
        const pct = ((last.cost_per_parcel - first.cost_per_parcel) / first.cost_per_parcel) * 100;
        return (
          <span key={c.carrier}>
            {i > 0 && " "}
            {carrierName(c.carrier)} ({SHAPE_WORD[c.carrier]}) went from {formatUsd(first.cost_per_parcel)} in {first.year} to{" "}
            {formatUsd(last.cost_per_parcel)} in {last.year} ({signedPct(pct)})
            {c.projected && (
              <>
                , projected {formatUsd(c.projected.cost_per_parcel)} in {c.projected.year} at {signedPct(c.projected.increase_percent)}
              </>
            )}
            .
          </span>
        );
      })}{" "}
      Dashed lines follow the announced increases from the first year; dotted segments are the projection.
    </>
  );

  const dot =
    (carrier: Carrier) =>
    (props: { cx?: number; cy?: number; index?: number; payload?: Record<string, number | null> }) => {
      const { cx, cy, payload } = props;
      if (cx === undefined || cy === undefined || !payload || payload[carrier] == null) return <g key={`${carrier}-${props.index}`} />;
      const flagged = noteAt.has(`${carrier}:${payload.year}`);
      const isLast = carriers.find((c) => c.carrier === carrier)?.years.at(-1)?.year === payload.year;
      return (
        <g key={`${carrier}-${props.index}`}>
          <Marker cx={cx} cy={cy} shape={SHAPE[carrier]} color={colors[carrier]} ring={colors.paper} />
          {flagged && (
            <g>
              <circle cx={cx} cy={cy - 16} r={8} fill={colors.paper} stroke={colors.ink} strokeWidth={1.5} />
              <text x={cx} y={cy - 12} textAnchor="middle" fontSize={11} fontWeight={700} fill={colors.ink}>
                !
              </text>
            </g>
          )}
          {isLast && !narrow && (
            <text x={cx + 10} y={cy + 4} fontSize={12} fontWeight={700} fill={colors[carrier]} fontFamily="var(--font-ui)">
              {carrierName(carrier)}
            </text>
          )}
        </g>
      );
    };

  const chart = (
    <>
      <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height={narrow ? 280 : 340} initialDimension={{ width: 600, height: 320 }}>
        <LineChart data={rows} margin={{ top: 24, right: narrow ? 12 : 64, bottom: 4, left: 0 }}>
          <CartesianGrid vertical={false} stroke={colors.rule} />
          <XAxis
            dataKey="year"
            type="number"
            domain={["dataMin", "dataMax"]}
            ticks={yearList}
            tickFormatter={(v: number) => (narrow ? `’${String(v).slice(2)}` : String(v))}
            tick={{ fill: colors.muted, fontSize: 12 }}
            axisLine={{ stroke: colors.rule }}
            tickLine={false}
            padding={{ left: 12, right: 12 }}
          />
          <YAxis
            tickFormatter={(v: number) => `$${v}`}
            tick={{ fill: colors.muted, fontSize: 12 }}
            axisLine={false}
            tickLine={false}
            width={44}
            domain={["auto", "auto"]}
          />
          <Tooltip
            contentStyle={{ background: colors.sheet, border: `1px solid ${colors.rule}`, borderRadius: 2, fontSize: 13 }}
            labelStyle={{ color: colors.ink, fontWeight: 700 }}
            formatter={(v, name) => [formatUsd(Number(v)), name]}
          />
          {carriers.map((c) => [
            <Line
              key={`${c.carrier}-ann`}
              dataKey={`${c.carrier}_ann`}
              name={`${carrierName(c.carrier)} at announced increases`}
              stroke={colors[c.carrier]}
              strokeWidth={1.5}
              strokeDasharray="6 4"
              strokeOpacity={0.75}
              dot={false}
              activeDot={false}
              isAnimationActive={false}
              connectNulls={false}
            />,
            <Line
              key={`${c.carrier}-proj`}
              dataKey={`${c.carrier}_proj`}
              name={`${carrierName(c.carrier)} projected`}
              stroke={colors[c.carrier]}
              strokeWidth={2}
              strokeDasharray="1 5"
              strokeLinecap="round"
              dot={false}
              activeDot={false}
              isAnimationActive={false}
              connectNulls
            />,
            <Line
              key={c.carrier}
              dataKey={c.carrier}
              name={carrierName(c.carrier)}
              stroke={colors[c.carrier]}
              strokeWidth={2.5}
              dot={dot(c.carrier)}
              activeDot={{ r: 6 }}
              isAnimationActive={false}
              connectNulls={false}
            />,
          ])}
        </LineChart>
      </ResponsiveContainer>
      <ul className="legend" aria-hidden="true">
        {carriers.map((c) => (
          <li key={c.carrier}>
            <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 14 14">
              <Marker cx={7} cy={7} shape={SHAPE[c.carrier]} color={`var(--carrier-${c.carrier})`} ring="transparent" r={4.5} />
            </svg>
            {carrierName(c.carrier)}
          </li>
        ))}
        <li>
          <span className="legend__line" style={{ borderTopStyle: "dashed", borderColor: "var(--ink-muted)" }} />
          Announced increases
        </li>
        <li>
          <span className="legend__line" style={{ borderTopStyle: "dotted", borderColor: "var(--ink-muted)" }} />
          Projection
        </li>
        <li>
          <span className="legend__flag">!</span> Note below
        </li>
      </ul>
    </>
  );

  const table = (
    <table className="ledger-table">
      <caption className="visually-hidden">Cost per parcel by carrier and year</caption>
      <thead>
        <tr>
          <th scope="col">Carrier</th>
          <th scope="col">Year</th>
          <th scope="col" className="num">
            Cost / parcel
          </th>
          <th scope="col" className="num">
            Change
          </th>
          <th scope="col" className="num">
            Announced
          </th>
          <th scope="col" className="num">
            Fuel (ground / express)
          </th>
        </tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody>
        {carriers.flatMap((c) => [
          ...c.years.map((y) => (
            <tr key={`${c.carrier}-${y.year}`}>
              <th scope="row">{carrierName(c.carrier)}</th>
              <td>
                {y.year}
                {noteAt.has(`${c.carrier}:${y.year}`) && " (see note)"}
              </td>
              <td className="num">{formatUsd(y.cost_per_parcel)}</td>
              <td className="num">{y.change_vs_previous?.percent != null ? signedPct(y.change_vs_previous.percent) : "—"}</td>
              <td className="num">{y.announced_increase.percent != null ? `${y.announced_increase.percent}%` : "—"}</td>
              <td className="num">
                {y.fuel ? `${y.fuel.ground.applied_percent ?? "—"}% / ${y.fuel.express.applied_percent ?? "—"}%` : "none"}
              </td>
            </tr>
          )),
          ...(c.projected
            ? [
                <tr key={`${c.carrier}-proj`}>
                  <th scope="row">{carrierName(c.carrier)}</th>
                  <td>{c.projected.year} (projected)</td>
                  <td className="num">{formatUsd(c.projected.cost_per_parcel)}</td>
                  <td className="num">{signedPct(c.projected.increase_percent)}</td>
                  <td className="num">—</td>
                  <td className="num">—</td>
                </tr>,
              ]
            : []),
        ])}
      </tbody>
    </table>
  );

  const fuelCarriers = carriers.filter((c) => c.years.some((y) => y.fuel));
  const aside = (
    <div className="fuel-note" data-testid="fuel-note">
      <p className="fuel-note__title">How much of the change is fuel?</p>
      {fuelSteps.map((s) => (
        <p key={s.carrier} className="fuel-note__line">
          {fuelSentence(s)}
        </p>
      ))}
      {fuelCarriers.length > 0 && (
        <table className="fuel-strip">
          <caption className="visually-hidden">Fuel surcharge applied per year, ground services</caption>
          <thead>
            <tr>
              <th scope="col">Fuel, ground</th>
              {yearList
                .filter((y) => fuelCarriers.some((c) => c.years.some((r) => r.year === y)))
                .map((y) => (
                  <th key={y} scope="col" className="num">
                    {y}
                  </th>
                ))}
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            {fuelCarriers.map((c) => (
              <tr key={c.carrier}>
                <th scope="row" style={{ color: `var(--carrier-${c.carrier})` }}>
                  {carrierName(c.carrier)}
                  {c.years.some((y) => y.fuel?.ground.is_proxy) && <span className="fuel-strip__proxy"> *</span>}
                </th>
                {yearList
                  .filter((y) => fuelCarriers.some((cc) => cc.years.some((r) => r.year === y)))
                  .map((y) => {
                    const row = c.years.find((r) => r.year === y);
                    return (
                      <td key={y} className="num">
                        {row?.fuel?.ground.applied_percent != null ? `${row.fuel.ground.applied_percent}%` : "—"}
                      </td>
                    );
                  })}
              </tr>
            ))}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      )}
      {fuelCarriers.some((c) => c.years.some((y) => y.fuel?.ground.is_proxy)) && (
        <p className="fuel-strip__foot">* FedEx’s published fuel history, applied as a proxy (UPS; FedEx 2027 repeats 2026).</p>
      )}
      {carriers.some((c) => !c.years.some((y) => y.fuel)) && <p className="fuel-strip__foot">USPS charges no fuel surcharge.</p>}
    </div>
  );

  return <ChartFrame title="Cost per parcel, year by year" summary={summary} chart={chart} table={table} aside={aside} />;
}

import { Bar, BarChart, CartesianGrid, Cell, ReferenceLine, ResponsiveContainer, Tooltip, XAxis, YAxis } from "recharts";
import type { Carrier, YearRow } from "../../api/types";
import { useMediaQuery } from "../../hooks/useMediaQuery";
import { formatUsd } from "../../lib/format";
import { ChartFrame, useCssColors } from "../blended/common";
import { carrierName, signedUsd } from "../blended/money";
import { DIMENSION_LABEL, driverSentence, segmentLabel, sortedDrivers, type Dimension } from "./logic";

const COLOR_VARS = { up: "--q4-up", down: "--q4-down", muted: "--ink-muted", ink: "--ink", rule: "--rule", sheet: "--sheet" } as const;

export function DriverChart({ carrier, row, dim }: { carrier: Carrier; row: YearRow; dim: Dimension }) {
  const colors = useCssColors(COLOR_VARS);
  const narrow = useMediaQuery("(max-width: 39.999rem)");
  const list = sortedDrivers(row.drivers?.[dim] ?? []);
  const sentence = driverSentence(carrier, row, dim);
  const ch = row.change_vs_previous;
  const rows = list.map((d) => ({ label: segmentLabel(dim, d.segment), value: d.change_per_parcel, parcels: d.parcels }));
  const max = Math.max(0.01, ...rows.map((r) => Math.abs(r.value)));
  const yWidth = narrow ? 118 : 170;
  const byLabel = new Map(rows.map((r) => [r.label, r]));

  const tick = (props: { x?: number | string; y?: number | string; payload?: { value?: string } }) => {
    const r = byLabel.get(props.payload?.value ?? "");
    const x = Number(props.x ?? 0);
    const y = Number(props.y ?? 0);
    if (!r) return <g />;
    return (
      <g transform={`translate(${x - yWidth + 4},${y})`}>
        <text x={0} y={-3} fill={colors.ink} fontSize={13} fontWeight={600} fontFamily="var(--font-ui)">
          {r.label}
        </text>
        <text x={0} y={13} fill={colors.muted} fontSize={12} fontFamily="var(--font-ui)">
          {signedUsd(r.value)} · {r.parcels} parcels
        </text>
      </g>
    );
  };

  const chart = (
    <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height={rows.length * 48 + 36} initialDimension={{ width: 600, height: 240 }}>
      <BarChart data={rows} layout="vertical" margin={{ top: 4, right: 16, bottom: 4, left: 0 }} barCategoryGap="30%">
        <CartesianGrid horizontal={false} stroke={colors.rule} />
        <XAxis
          type="number"
          domain={[-max * 1.05, max * 1.05]}
          tickFormatter={(v: number) => signedUsd(v)}
          tick={{ fill: colors.muted, fontSize: 12 }}
          axisLine={false}
          tickLine={false}
          tickCount={5}
        />
        <YAxis type="category" dataKey="label" width={yWidth} tick={tick} axisLine={false} tickLine={false} />
        <ReferenceLine x={0} stroke={colors.ink} />
        <Tooltip
          cursor={{ fill: colors.rule, opacity: 0.35 }}
          contentStyle={{ background: colors.sheet, border: `1px solid ${colors.rule}`, borderRadius: 2, fontSize: 13 }}
          labelStyle={{ color: colors.ink, fontWeight: 700 }}
          formatter={(v) => [`${signedUsd(Number(v))} per parcel`, "Contribution"]}
        />
        <Bar dataKey="value" isAnimationActive={false} radius={2}>
          {rows.map((r) => (
            <Cell key={r.label} fill={r.value >= 0 ? colors.up : colors.down} />
          ))}
        </Bar>
      </BarChart>
    </ResponsiveContainer>
  );

  const table = (
    <table className="ledger-table">
      <caption className="visually-hidden">
        Contribution of each {DIMENSION_LABEL[dim].toLowerCase()} segment to the change in cost per parcel
      </caption>
      <thead>
        <tr>
          <th scope="col">Segment</th>
          <th scope="col" className="num">
            Parcels
          </th>
          <th scope="col" className="num">
            Per parcel
          </th>
          <th scope="col" className="num">
            Total
          </th>
        </tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody>
        {list.map((d) => (
          <tr key={d.segment}>
            <th scope="row">{segmentLabel(dim, d.segment)}</th>
            <td className="num">{d.parcels}</td>
            <td className="num">{signedUsd(d.change_per_parcel)}</td>
            <td className="num">{signedUsd(d.change_total)}</td>
          </tr>
        ))}
        {ch && (
          <tr className="ledger-table__total">
            <th scope="row">All parcels</th>
            <td className="num">{list.reduce((n, d) => n + d.parcels, 0)}</td>
            <td className="num">{signedUsd(ch.dollars_per_parcel)}</td>
            <td className="num">—</td>
          </tr>
        )}
      </tbody>
    </table>
  );

  const summary = (
    <>
      <span className="driver-sentence" data-testid="driver-sentence">
        {sentence ?? "No change to break down."}
      </span>{" "}
      Bars add up to the {ch ? signedUsd(ch.dollars_per_parcel) : formatUsd(0)} per parcel change for {carrierName(carrier)}; to the right
      a segment made parcels dearer, to the left cheaper.
    </>
  );

  return <ChartFrame title={`What drove ${carrierName(carrier)}’s change, by ${DIMENSION_LABEL[dim].toLowerCase()}`} summary={summary} chart={chart} table={table} />;
}

import { useEffect, useId, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { useApi, useLoad } from "../../api/ApiContext";
import type { Carrier, Meta, Parcel, YearlyResponse } from "../../api/types";
import type { ControlsState } from "../../state/urlState";
import { carrierVar } from "../../lib/carriers";
import { formatInt, formatUsd } from "../../lib/format";
import { LoadProblem, NeedParcels, useDebounced, useLastData, type ParcelActions } from "../blended/common";
import { ChipGroup } from "../blended/SegmentChips";
import { carrierName, signedPct, signedUsd } from "../blended/money";
import { totalQuantity } from "../blended/logic";
import { YearChart } from "./YearChart";
import { DriverChart } from "./DriverChart";
import {
  DIMENSIONS,
  DIMENSION_LABEL,
  defaultIncrease,
  periodChange,
  pickCarrier,
  pointNotes,
  referenceYear,
  strongestDimension,
  type Dimension,
  type PointNote,
} from "./logic";

export interface YearlyPanelProps extends ParcelActions {
  controls: ControlsState;
  meta: Meta | null;
  parcels: Parcel[] | null;
}

export const INCREASE_MIN = -10;
export const INCREASE_MAX = 20;

export function YearlyPanel({ controls, parcels, onLoadSample, onUploadCsv }: YearlyPanelProps) {
  if (!parcels || parcels.length === 0) {
    return (
      <NeedParcels
        what="Load the sample mix or upload a CSV to see how the cost of your parcels moved under each year's published prices, against the increases the carriers announced, and which parcels drove it."
        onLoadSample={onLoadSample}
        onUploadCsv={onUploadCsv}
      />
    );
  }
  return <Yearly controls={controls} parcels={parcels} />;
}

function Yearly({ controls, parcels }: { controls: ControlsState; parcels: Parcel[] }) {
  const api = useApi();
  const [increase, setIncrease] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const sent = useDebounced(increase, 250);
  const controlsKey = JSON.stringify(controls);
  const state = useLoad(
    (signal) => api.yearly({ parcels, controls, ...(sent !== null ? { next_year_increase_percent: sent } : {}) }, signal),
    [api, parcels, controlsKey, sent],
  );
  const data = useLastData(state);
  const total = useMemo(() => totalQuantity(parcels), [parcels]);

  // The slider starts at the pick carrier's latest announced increase, which the first answer tells us.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (increase !== null || !data) return;
    const ref = referenceYear(data);
    const d = ref !== null ? defaultIncrease(pickCarrier(data, ref)) : null;
    if (d !== null) setIncrease(d);
  }, [data, increase]);

  const loading = state.status === "loading";
  return (
    <div className="q4" aria-busy={loading}>
      {state.status === "error" && <LoadProblem error={state.error} />}
      {!data && loading && <p className="q-loading">Pricing {formatInt(total)} parcels under every year’s prices…</p>}
      {data && <Body data={data} increase={increase} onIncrease={setIncrease} stale={loading} />}
    </div>
  );
}

function Body({
  data,
  increase,
  onIncrease,
  stale,
}: {
  data: YearlyResponse;
  increase: number | null;
  onIncrease: (v: number) => void;
  stale: boolean;
}) {
  const ref = referenceYear(data);
  const pick = ref !== null ? pickCarrier(data, ref) : null;
  const notes = pointNotes(data);
  if (!pick || ref === null) {
    return <p className="q-loading">No carrier could price these parcels in every year.</p>;
  }
  const change = periodChange(pick, ref);
  const others = data.carriers
    .filter((c) => c.carrier !== pick.carrier && c.parcels_used > 0)
    .map((c) => ({ c, ch: periodChange(c, ref) }))
    .filter((x) => x.ch !== null);

  return (
    <div className={stale ? "q-stale" : undefined}>
      <div className="answer q4-answer">
        <p className="kicker">
          {carrierName(pick.carrier)}, your cheapest carrier in {ref} · {formatInt(pick.parcels_used)} parcels
        </p>
        {change ? (
          <>
            <p className="answer__figure" data-testid="q4-answer">
              <span className="carrier-tag" style={{ color: carrierVar(pick.carrier) }}>
                {carrierName(pick.carrier)}
              </span>{" "}
              {signedPct(change.percent)}
              <span className="answer__unit"> since {change.fromYear}</span>
            </p>
            <p className="answer__caption" data-testid="q4-caption">
              {formatUsd(change.from)} → {formatUsd(change.to)} per parcel from {change.fromYear} to {change.toYear} (
              {signedUsd(change.dollars)}).{" "}
              {change.announcedPercent !== null ? (
                <>
                  The increases {carrierName(pick.carrier)} announced compound to{" "}
                  <strong>{signedPct(change.announcedPercent)}</strong> over the same years, so your mix rose{" "}
                  <strong>
                    {Math.abs(change.percent - change.announcedPercent).toFixed(1)} points{" "}
                    {change.percent >= change.announcedPercent ? "more" : "less"}
                  </strong>{" "}
                  than announced.
                </>
              ) : (
                <>No announced increase is recorded for every year, so there is nothing to compare against.</>
              )}
            </p>
            {others.length > 0 && (
              <p className="q4-others">
                Same years for the others:{" "}
                {others.map(({ c, ch }, i) => (
                  <span key={c.carrier}>
                    {i > 0 && " · "}
                    <strong style={{ color: carrierVar(c.carrier) }}>{carrierName(c.carrier)}</strong> {signedPct(ch!.percent)}
                    {ch!.announcedPercent !== null && <> (announced {signedPct(ch!.announcedPercent)})</>}
                  </span>
                ))}
              </p>
            )}
          </>
        ) : (
          <p className="answer__figure">{formatUsd(rowCost(pick, ref))}</p>
        )}
      </div>

      <NextYear data={data} pick={pick.carrier} increase={increase} onIncrease={onIncrease} />

      <YearChart data={data} notes={notes} />
      <Notes notes={notes} />
      <Drivers data={data} defaultCarrier={pick.carrier} refYear={ref} />
      <Excluded data={data} />
    </div>
  );
}

const rowCost = (c: YearlyResponse["carriers"][number], y: number) => c.years.find((r) => r.year === y)?.cost_per_parcel ?? 0;

function NextYear({
  data,
  pick,
  increase,
  onIncrease,
}: {
  data: YearlyResponse;
  pick: Carrier;
  increase: number | null;
  onIncrease: (v: number) => void;
}) {
  const id = useId();
  const c = data.carriers.find((x) => x.carrier === pick)!;
  const last = c.years[c.years.length - 1]!;
  const def = defaultIncrease(c);
  const value = increase ?? def ?? 0;
  const projected = c.projected;
  const local = Math.round(last.cost_per_parcel * (1 + value / 100) * 100) / 100;
  const shown = projected && projected.increase_percent === value ? projected.cost_per_parcel : local;
  return (
    <section className="next-year" aria-labelledby={`${id}-t`}>
      <h3 id={`${id}-t`} className="q-block__title">
        Next year, {last.year + 1}
      </h3>
      <div className="next-year__row">
        <div className="next-year__control">
          <div className="next-year__head">
            <label htmlFor={id}>Increase for {last.year + 1}</label>
            <output htmlFor={id} className="next-year__value">
              {signedPct(value)}
            </output>
          </div>
          <input
            id={id}
            type="range"
            min={INCREASE_MIN}
            max={INCREASE_MAX}
            step={0.1}
            value={value}
            aria-describedby={`${id}-hint`}
            aria-valuetext={signedPct(value)}
            onChange={(e) => onIncrease(Number(e.target.value))}
          />
          <p id={`${id}-hint`} className="next-year__hint">
            {def !== null ? (
              <>
                Starts at {carrierName(pick)}’s latest announced increase, {signedPct(def)}.{" "}
                {value !== def && (
                  <button type="button" className="btn btn--quiet next-year__reset" onClick={() => onIncrease(def)}>
                    Reset to {signedPct(def)}
                  </button>
                )}
              </>
            ) : (
              "No announced increase recorded to start from."
            )}
          </p>
        </div>
        <p className="next-year__result" data-testid="q4-projection">
          <span className="figure next-year__figure" style={{ color: carrierVar(pick) }}>
            {formatUsd(shown)}
          </span>{" "}
          per parcel with {carrierName(pick)} in {last.year + 1}, from {formatUsd(last.cost_per_parcel)} in {last.year} (
          {signedUsd(shown - last.cost_per_parcel)}). The dotted lines in the chart apply the same increase to every carrier.
        </p>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

function Notes({ notes }: { notes: PointNote[] }) {
  if (notes.length === 0) return null;
  return (
    <div className="q-notes point-notes" data-testid="point-notes">
      <p className="kicker">Notes on the points marked !</p>
      <ul>
        {notes.map((n, i) => (
          <li key={i} className={`point-notes__item point-notes__item--${n.kind}`}>
            <strong style={{ color: carrierVar(n.carrier) }}>
              {carrierName(n.carrier)} {n.year}
            </strong>
            {n.kind === "warning" ? " (incomplete data): " : ": "}
            {n.text}
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>
    </div>
  );
}

function Drivers({ data, defaultCarrier, refYear }: { data: YearlyResponse; defaultCarrier: Carrier; refYear: number }) {
  const withDrivers = data.carriers.filter((c) => c.years.some((y) => y.drivers));
  const [carrier, setCarrier] = useState<Carrier>(defaultCarrier);
  const c = withDrivers.find((x) => x.carrier === carrier) ?? withDrivers[0];
  const steps = c ? c.years.filter((y) => y.drivers && y.change_vs_previous) : [];
  const defaultTo = [...steps].reverse().find((y) => y.year <= refYear)?.year ?? steps.at(-1)?.year;
  const [toYear, setToYear] = useState<number | undefined>(defaultTo);
  const row = steps.find((y) => y.year === toYear) ?? steps.find((y) => y.year === defaultTo);
  const [dim, setDim] = useState<Dimension | null>(null);
  if (!c || !row || !row.drivers) return null;
  const activeDim = dim ?? strongestDimension(row.drivers);

  return (
    <section className="q-block drivers" aria-label="What drove the change">
      <div className="q-block__head">
        <h3 className="q-block__title">Which parcels drove the change?</h3>
      </div>
      <div className="segments">
        <ChipGroup<Carrier>
          legend="Carrier"
          value={c.carrier}
          onChange={(v) => {
            setCarrier(v);
            setToYear(undefined);
          }}
          options={withDrivers.map((x) => ({ value: x.carrier, label: carrierName(x.carrier) }))}
        />
        <ChipGroup<number>
          legend="Between"
          value={row.year}
          onChange={setToYear}
          options={steps.map((y) => ({ value: y.year, label: `${y.change_vs_previous!.from_year}→${y.year}` }))}
        />
        <ChipGroup<Dimension>
          legend="Split by"
          value={activeDim}
          onChange={setDim}
          options={DIMENSIONS.map((d) => ({ value: d, label: DIMENSION_LABEL[d] }))}
        />
      </div>
      <DriverChart carrier={c.carrier} row={row} dim={activeDim} />
    </section>
  );
}

function Excluded({ data }: { data: YearlyResponse }) {
  const ex = data.carriers.filter((c) => c.parcels_excluded > 0);
  if (ex.length === 0) return null;
  return (
    <div className="q-notes" role="note">
      <p className="kicker">Parcels left out of the comparison</p>
      <ul>
        {ex.map((c) => (
          <li key={c.carrier}>
            <strong style={{ color: carrierVar(c.carrier) }}>{carrierName(c.carrier)}</strong>:{" "}
            {formatInt(c.parcels_excluded)} parcels it cannot ship in every year are left out, so its years compare the
            same {formatInt(c.parcels_used)} parcels.
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>
    </div>
  );
}

.fuel-strip .num {

.point-notes__item {

}

.ledger-table__total th,
.ledger-table__total td {
  border-top: 1px solid var(--rule-strong);
  font-weight: 700;
}

@media (max-width: 39.999rem) {
  .next-year {
    padding: var(--space-4);
  }

  .next-year__row {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
  }
}

/** Round tick values (steps of 1, 2, 2.5 or 5 × 10^k) spanning lo..hi and always including 0. */
export function niceTicks(lo: number, hi: number, target = 4): number[] {
  const span = Math.max(hi - lo, 0.01);
  const raw = span / target;
  const mag = 10 ** Math.floor(Math.log10(raw));
  const step = [1, 2, 2.5, 5, 10].map((m) => m * mag).find((s) => s >= raw) ?? 10 * mag;
  const start = Math.floor(lo / step) * step;
  const end = Math.ceil(hi / step) * step;
  const out: number[] = [];
  for (let v = start; v <= end + step / 2; v += step) out.push(Math.round(v * 100) / 100);
  if (out.length < 2) out.push(out[0]! + step);
  return out;
}
'''
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF

import type { Parcel, ParcelOut } from "../api/types";

/** Server parcels carry every key with nulls; the UI and requests use absent keys instead. */
export function fromParcelOut(p: ParcelOut): Parcel {
  const dims =
    p.length_in !== null && p.width_in !== null && p.height_in !== null
      ? { length_in: p.length_in, width_in: p.width_in, height_in: p.height_in }
      : {};
  return {
    weight_lb: p.weight_lb,
    distance_miles: p.distance_miles,
    residential: p.residential,
    speed: p.speed,
    quantity: p.quantity,
    ...dims,
    ...(p.price_charged !== null ? { price_charged: p.price_charged } : {}),
    ...(p.delivery_area !== "none" ? { delivery_area: p.delivery_area } : {}),
    ...(p.nonstandard_packaging ? { nonstandard_packaging: true } : {}),
  };
}
```

/** Test helpers for the Q3/Q4 views: a mock client with spies, the sample parcels, a ResizeObserver stub. */
import { render } from "@testing-library/react";
import { vi } from "vitest";
import type { ReactElement } from "react";
import { ApiProvider } from "../../api/ApiContext";
import { createMockClient, type ApiClient } from "../../api/client";
import { mockBlendedResponse, mockDefaultControls, mockMeta, mockSampleParcels, mockYearlyResponse } from "../../api/mocks";
import { fromParcelOut } from "../../lib/parcels";
import type { BlendedRequest, BlendedResponse, YearlyRequest, YearlyResponse } from "../../api/types";

export const sampleParcels = mockSampleParcels.parcels.map(fromParcelOut);
export const controls = mockDefaultControls;
export const meta = mockMeta;

export function stubResizeObserver() {
  class RO {
    observe() {}
    unobserve() {}
    disconnect() {}
  }
  vi.stubGlobal("ResizeObserver", RO);
}

export function spyClient(overrides: {
  blended?: (b: BlendedRequest) => BlendedResponse;
  yearly?: (b: YearlyRequest) => YearlyResponse;
} = {}) {
  const base = createMockClient(0);
  const blended = vi.fn(async (b: BlendedRequest) => (overrides.blended ?? (() => mockBlendedResponse))(b));
  const yearly = vi.fn(async (b: YearlyRequest) => (overrides.yearly ?? (() => mockYearlyResponse))(b));
  const client: ApiClient = { ...base, blended, yearly };
  return { client, blended, yearly };
}

export function renderWith(client: ApiClient, ui: ReactElement) {
  return render(<ApiProvider client={client}>{ui}</ApiProvider>);
}

        </section>
        <BlendedView controls={controls} meta={meta} parcels={null} />
      </>,

    const { client } = spyClient();
    renderWith(client, <BlendedView controls={controls} meta={meta} parcels={sampleParcels} />);
    expect(await screen.findByTestId("q3-verdict")).toHaveTextContent("No. You lose $10.98 per parcel with USPS");

  });

  it("shows a margin, not a loss, when the price covers the cost", async () => {

    expect(screen.getByTestId("q3-loss-share")).toHaveTextContent("10% of parcels (30 of 300)");
  });

  it("re-queries with the segment when a chip is pressed, and drops it on All", async () => {
    const { client, blended } = spyClient({

    });
    renderWith(client, <BlendedView controls={controls} meta={meta} parcels={sampleParcels} />);
    await screen.findByTestId("q3-answer");
    const weight = screen.getByRole("group", { name: "Weight" });
    await userEvent.click(within(weight).getByRole("button", { name: "1–5 lb" }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(blended.mock.lastCall![0].segment).toEqual({ weight_band: "1–5" }));
    expect(within(weight).getByRole("button", { name: "1–5 lb" })).toHaveAttribute("aria-pressed", "true");
    await userEvent.click(within(screen.getByRole("group", { name: "Address" })).getByRole("button", { name: "Homes" }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(blended.mock.lastCall![0].segment).toEqual({ weight_band: "1–5", residential: true }));
    expect(await screen.findByText(/in\s+this segment/)).toHaveTextContent("22 of 300 parcels in this segment");
    expect(screen.getByText(/Cheapest single carrier/)).toHaveTextContent("22 of 300 parcels · 1–5 lb · homes");
    await userEvent.click(within(weight).getByRole("button", { name: "All" }));

    await waitFor(() => expect(blended.mock.lastCall![0]).not.toHaveProperty("segment"));

  it("says so when a segment holds no parcels", async () => {
    const empty: BlendedResponse = {
      ...mockBlendedResponse,
      parcels_considered: 0,
      carriers: mockBlendedResponse.carriers.map((c) => ({ ...c, parcels_shipped: 0 })),
    };
    const { client } = spyClient({ blended: () => empty });
    renderWith(client, <BlendedView controls={controls} meta={meta} parcels={sampleParcels} />);
    expect(await screen.findByText("No parcels")).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.queryByTestId("q3-verdict")).not.toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it("notes parcels a carrier cannot ship", async () => {
    const gap: BlendedResponse = {
      ...mockBlendedResponse,
      carriers: mockBlendedResponse.carriers.map((c) =>
        c.carrier === "fedex" ? { ...c, parcels_unavailable: 12, parcels_shipped: 288 } : c,
      ),
    };
    const { client } = spyClient({ blended: () => gap });
    renderWith(client, <BlendedView controls={controls} meta={meta} parcels={sampleParcels} />);
    expect(await screen.findByText(/cannot ship\s+12 of these parcels/)).toHaveTextContent("covers the other 288");
  });

  it("offers the cost split as a table, with the surcharge share", async () => {
    const { client } = spyClient();
    renderWith(client, <BlendedView controls={controls} meta={meta} parcels={sampleParcels} />);
    await screen.findByTestId("q3-answer");

    expect(within(figure).getByText(/Add-ons weigh most on UPS: 34%/)).toBeInTheDocument();

    expect(ups).toHaveTextContent("$9.07"); // fuel
    expect(ups).toHaveTextContent("13%");
    expect(within(figure).getByRole("button", { name: "Show as chart" })).toHaveAttribute("aria-pressed", "true");
  });
});

describe("blended logic", () => {
  it("picks the cheapest carrier and the mix saving", () => {
    const a = blendedAnswer(mockBlendedResponse)!;
    expect(a.cheapest.carrier).toBe("usps");
    expect(a.others.map((c) => c.carrier)).toEqual(["ups", "fedex"]);
    expect(a.mixSavingPerParcel).toBe(1.11);
  });

  it("keeps the three biggest surcharge kinds and folds the rest", () => {
    const k = surchargeKinds(mockBlendedResponse);
    expect(k.shown).toEqual(["residential", "nonstandard_volume", "delivery_area"]);
    expect(k.folded).toEqual(expect.arrayContaining(["additional_handling_packaging", "nonstandard_length", "delivery_area_extended"]));
    const usps = splitRows(mockBlendedResponse, k, CARRIER_NAME).find((r) => r.carrier === "usps")!;
    expect(usps.kinds.nonstandard_volume).toBe(1.87);
    expect(usps.kinds[OTHER_KIND]).toBe(0.14);
  });

  it("sends no segment when every group is All", () => {
    expect(cleanSegment({ weight_band: null, residential: null })).toBeNull();
    expect(cleanSegment({ residential: false })).toEqual({ residential: false });
  });
});

  it("starts the next-year slider at the latest announced increase and sends it", async () => {

    vi.useRealTimers();

describe("yearly logic", () => {
  it("compares carriers at the latest year they all publish", () => {
    expect(referenceYear(mockYearlyResponse)).toBe(2026);
    expect(pickCarrier(mockYearlyResponse, 2026)!.carrier).toBe("usps");
    expect(defaultIncrease(carrier("usps"))).toBe(6.5);
  });

  it("computes the period change and compounds the announced increases", () => {
    const ch = periodChange(carrier("usps"), 2026)!;
    expect(ch.dollars).toBe(3.29);
    expect(ch.percent).toBeCloseTo(18.483, 2);
    expect(ch.announcedPercent).toBeCloseTo((1.0567 * 1.0343 * 1.065 - 1) * 100, 6);
    const path = announcedPath(carrier("usps"));
    expect(path.get(2023)).toBe(17.8);
    expect(path.get(2024)).toBe(18.81);
  });

  it("finds the biggest step and its fuel share", () => {
    const s = biggestFuelStep(carrier("fedex"), 2026)!;
    expect([s.fromYear, s.toYear, s.change, s.fuelChange]).toEqual([2025, 2026, 4.55, 2.72]);
    expect(fuelSentence(s)).toContain("(60% of it)");
    expect(biggestFuelStep(carrier("usps"))).toBeNull();
  });

  it("sorts drivers by magnitude, negatives included", () => {
    const list: Driver[] = [
      { segment: "a", parcels: 1, change_per_parcel: 0.2, change_total: 1 },
      { segment: "b", parcels: 1, change_per_parcel: -0.9, change_total: 1 },
      { segment: "c", parcels: 1, change_per_parcel: 0.5, change_total: 1 },
    ];
    expect(sortedDrivers(list).map((d) => d.segment)).toEqual(["b", "c", "a"]);
  });

  it("names the top driver and picks the dimension it lives in", () => {
    const row = carrier("ups").years.find((y) => y.year === 2026)!;
    expect(strongestDimension(row.drivers!)).toBe("residential");
    expect(driverSentence("ups", row, "speed")).toBe(
      "Top driver: ground parcels (262 of them) added $2.98 per parcel of UPS's +$4.61 change from 2025 to 2026, 65% of it.",
    );
  });

  it("turns warnings into plain words and flags mid-year editions", () => {
    expect(readableWarning("No 2027 rules recorded for: oversize, delivery_area; surcharges may be understated")).toBe(
      "No 2027 rules recorded for oversize, remote area. Surcharges may be understated.",
    );
    const notes = pointNotes(mockYearlyResponse);
    expect(notes.filter((n) => n.kind === "edition").map((n) => `${n.carrier} ${n.year}`)).toEqual([
      "usps 2023",
      "ups 2024",
      "ups 2026",
    ]);
    expect(notes.filter((n) => n.kind === "warning").map((n) => `${n.carrier} ${n.year}`)).toEqual(["fedex 2027"]);
  });

  it("makes round axis ticks that include zero", () => {
    expect(niceTicks(0, 1.77)).toEqual([0, 0.5, 1, 1.5, 2]);
    expect(niceTicks(-0.3, 1)).toContain(0);
  });
});
